title: Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Nneɛma
description: Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wode si Zcash so, a wɔahyehyɛ no akuwakuw sɛnea emu biara yɛ ma sen sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw no akuwakuw biako mu.
text: Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Nneɛma Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wode si Zcash so, a wɔahyehyɛ no akuwakuw sɛnea emu biara yɛ ma sen sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw no akuwakuw biako mu. The stack changed a great deal in 2026. zcashd, a ɛhwɛɛ network no so wɔ n’abakɔsɛm fã kɛse no ara mu no, duu n’asetra awiei wɔ 18 July 2026 wɔ block height 3417100, na node biara a wɔansakra no no too mu wɔ saa sorokɔ no mu na ɛbɛpow sɛ ɛbɛsan afi ase bio. Akwankyerɛ a wɔakyerɛw ama zcashd yɛ abakɔsɛm mprempren sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ mfiase, enti wɔahyehyɛ krataafa yi atwa nea ɛde sii ananmu no ho ahyia. Stack no wɔ animtiaabu mu Layer Nea wɔde bedi dwuma Fi ase wɔ :-- :-- :-- Full node Zebra or Zakura The Zebra Book, zakura.com na ɛwɔ hɔ Full node sika kotoku Zallet, wɔ beta mu Zallet Nhoma no Hann sika kotoku server Zaino anaasɛ lightwalletd Zaino, lightwalletd Wallet nhomakorabea ahorow Na librustzcash nnaka no librustzcash Mobile so Android ne iOS SDK ahorow Android, iOS Nsɛm a Wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu Protocol spec ne ZIP ahorow zips.z.sika a wɔde yɛ adwuma Nodes a ɛwɔ hɔ Node bi di adwene a ɛwɔ hɔ no ho adanse na ɛkura nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no. Nneɛma abien na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde nsiyɛ ayɛ. Zebra yɛ Zcash Foundation node, a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Rust mu, na ɛyɛ nea akwankyerɛfo dodow no ara susuw mprempren. The Zebra Book kata sɛnea wɔde besisi hɔ na wɔde ayɛ adwuma, ne adekorabea ne baabi a nkɔso kɔ so. Zakura yɛ node foforo, a n'akyerɛwfo kaa ho asɛm sɛ "consensus-compatible Zcash full node, built for scale", a ɛwɔ sync ntɛmntɛm, block pruning ne zcashd compatibility mode. Sean Bowe, a ɔne no hyehyɛɛ Zcash, ne Dev Ojha na wodi anim. Ɛyɛ open source wɔ Apache 2.0 ase wɔ zakura-core/zakura a ɛwɔ hɔ. ZecHub wɔ a Nodes a Ɛyɛ Pɛ kratafa a ɛka aguadi a ɛda wɔn ntam no ho asɛm. Node sika kotoku a ɛyɛ ma no zcashd boaboaa sika kotoku bi ano ne node no. Saa sika kotoku no nni hɔ bio, na Zallet ne nea wɔde besi ananmu. Zallet Nhoma no ka ho asɛm sɛ "Zcash sika kotoku a ɛwɔ node mũ a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Rust mu" a "wɔasi sɛ nea wɔde besi zcashd sika kotoku ananmu". Kenkan ahobammɔ ho kɔkɔbɔ no ansa na wode wo ho ato so. Zallet wɔ beta mu, "wɔnhwɛɛ mu koraa", nsakraeɛ a ɛbubu "betumi aba bere biara, a ɛhia sɛ wopopa na wosan yɛ wo Zallet sika kotokuo", na ɛnyɛ zcashd RPC kwan biara na wɔde akɔfa baabiara. Sɛ woretu nhyehyɛe bi a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no akɔ a, ZecHub wɔ a atutra ho akwankyerɛ fi zcashd kɔ Zebra ne Zallet ne a Zallet ntɛm a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm. Hann sika kotoku servers Wallet dodow no ara ntumi nkɔ node biara so. Wɔne server bi a ɛkora nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no so kasa na ɛsan de ne nsa kɔ akyi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obehu no ketewaa bi. lightwalletd yɛ mfitiaseɛ dwumadie, a wɔkyerɛwee wɔ Go mu, a wɔaka ho asɛm sɛ "akyi dwumadie a ɛma bandwidth-efficient interface ma Zcash blockchain". Zaino yɛ indexer foforo, a wɔde Rust akyerɛw, na ɛkenkan fi validator a edi mũ mu sen sɛ ɛbɛsoa n’ankasa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no bi. No Hann Adetɔfoɔ Protocol nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm no kata protocol no ankasa so. No Lightwallet Nodes a Wɔde Di Dwuma krataafa no ka nea saa server ahorow yi betumi ahu ne nea wontumi nhu wɔ obi a ɔde di dwuma ho, a ɛfata sɛ wote ase ansa na woapaw biako. Sika kotoku a wɔreyɛ Wallet adwuma dodow no ara kɔ so wɔ Rust crates ase librustzcash, a mobile SDK ahorow ne desktop sika kotoku pii si so. Wɔakyerɛw adaka biara ho nsɛm wɔ so docs.rs. title: Sɛnea wɔahyehyɛ Zcash
description: Sɛ yɛte sɛnea wɔahyehyɛ no ase a, ɛma biribiara a aka no yɛ mmerɛw. Ɛkyerɛ wo onii a ɔhwɛ mmara a wode wo ho to so no so, onii a wobɛkɔ ne nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ…
text: Sɛnea wɔahyehyɛ Zcash TL;DR Zcash nyɛ adwumakuw biako na ɛkyekyee, ahyehyɛde ahorow pii a wɔde wɔn ho a wɔn mu biara wɔ adwuma no fã soronko na ɛkyekyee Wɔ n’abakɔsɛm fã kɛse no ara mu no ahyehyɛde abien na edii nkɔso anim, Electric Coin Company ne Zcash Foundation Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2026 mu no, Electric Coin Company kuw no nyinaa gyaee adwuma wɔ nniso ho akasakasa bi akyi, na wɔsan hyehyɛɛ abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom no yɛɛ no ​​akuo ahodoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho Ɛnnɛ akuw ahorow na wodi protocol, node software, sika kotoku, nhwehwɛmu, scaling, ne sikasɛm ho dwuma Ahyehyɛdeɛ baako biara nni hɔ a ɛdi Zcash so, network no yɛ open source na enni kwan, na ɛkɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ wɔ nsakraeɛ biara mu Hena na eyi yɛ ma no Wɔn a wɔaba foforo a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛte nea ɔkyekye Zcash na ɔhwɛ so ankasa ase Obiara a ahyehyɛde din pii a ɛwɔ abɔde a nkwa wom mu no ama n’adwene atu afra Wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔresi onii a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma anaa baabi a wɔde nyansahyɛ bi bɛmena ho gyinae Nea enti a eyi ho hia Sɛ yɛte sɛnea wɔahyehyɛ no ase a, ɛma biribiara a aka no yɛ mmerɛw. Ɛkyerɛ wo onii a ɔhwɛ mmara a wode wo ho to so no so, onii a wobɛkɔ ne nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa, ne nea ɔhwɛ netɛw no fã a wodwen ho no so. Ɛsan nso da Zcash ahoɔden a ɛyɛ komm no mu biako adi: esiane sɛ adwuma no atrɛw wɔ akuw a wɔde wɔn ho mu nti, huammɔdi biako biara nni hɔ a entumi nkyere adwuma no anaasɛ ennyae. Kratafa yi yɛ asase mfonini. Wɔ ahyehyɛde biara a ɛwɔ kratafa mũ dedaw wɔ wiki yi so no, wubehu nsɛm tiawa bi a wɔakyerɛw ne link a wode bɛkenkan pii, sen sɛ wobɛsan ayɛ nea wɔakyerɛw wɔ hɔ no bio. Sɛnea na ɛyɛ adwuma kan no Zcash abakɔsɛm fã kɛse no ara mu no, ahyehyɛde abien na edii anim. Electric Coin Company no hyɛɛ Zcash ase wɔ afe 2016 mu na ɛde nkɔsoɔ kuo titire no mu dodoɔ no ara yɛɛ adwuma. Bootstrap, board bi a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔhyehyɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa mmoa Zcash na ɛhwɛɛ so. Zcash Foundation yɛɛ adwuma kaa ne ho sɛ adwumakuw a ɛde ne ho a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfaso, a ɛde n’adwene sii protocol no sohwɛ ne node a ɛde ne ho a wɔkyekyee so. Wɔde block akatua a wɔde sii hɔ maa nkɔso no fã bi na ɛboaa abien no nyinaa. Saa adum abien nhyehyɛe yi kuraa mu mfe pii, nanso na egyina saa sika a wɔkyɛ no ne ahyehyɛde abien no a wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ biako no so. Bere a mfitiase nkɔso ho sika no renya nkɔso na ne daakye a ɛbɛkyɛ no ankɔ so ayɛ nea wontumi nsi pi no, asɛmmisa a ɛfa sɛnea wobetua adwuma a ɛkɔ so ho ka ho no yɛɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse. Saa sikasɛm ho asɛmmisa no te nea ɛsakrae akyi no mu dodow no ara akyi, na ɛyɛ nea enti a mprempren akuw binom nya sika kɛse a efi abɔnten bere a afoforo de wɔn ho to mmoa so no fã. Afe 2026 nhyehyɛe foforo no Wɔ January 2026 mu no, nhyehyɛe no sesae kɛse. Wɔ January 7 no, Electric Coin Company panyin Josh Swihart de too gua wɔ X so sɛ adwumakuw no kuw no nyinaa agyae adwuma. Bootstrap yɛ adwumayɛkuo a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ a wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​afe 2020 sɛ wɔmfa nni Electric Coin Company a na abɛyɛ ne fã a ɛyɛ ne dea nyinaa so. Adwene a enhyia a ɛda adwumakuw kuw no ne saa bagua yi ntam no yɛɛ kɛse bere kɔɔ so na ɛkaa nsɛm pii, a nea ɛka ho ne ahyehyɛde no akwankyerɛ, sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde sika boa nkɔso, ne Zashi sika kotoku a kuw no pɛ sɛ wotu kɔ ankorankoro adwumakuw bi mu kɔboaboa abɔnten sika kɛse ano no daakye. Swihart kaa kɔ a wɔfirii no ho asɛm sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma a ɛma nkɔsoɔ, mmara mu asɛmfua a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔsesaa tebea ahodoɔ no kɛseɛ araa ma wɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔgyae adwuma no wɔ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn so, na ɔkaa sɛ adwumakuo no mu dodoɔ no ara atu akɔ baabi foforɔ a ɛne Zcash asɛmpatrɛ adwuma no nhyia. Akontaabu no fã foforo no ho hia ma atɛntrenee. Bootstrap hyehyɛɛ ntawntawdi no sɛ ɛyɛ nniso ne mmara a wɔdi so a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so ho asɛm. Zcash a ɔhyehyɛɛ no, Zooko Wilcox, yii board mufo a wɔabobɔ wɔn din wɔ akasakasa no mu no ano wɔ baguam, na ɔkae sɛ ɔne wɔn ayɛ adwuma mfe pii na obu wɔn sɛ nnipa a wodi nokware kɛse, bere a ɔdaa no adi pefee sɛ onni afã biara wɔ adwene a enhyia no ankasa ho. Ná nneɛma abien a akyinnyegye nni ho. Ɔ

text: Zcash Network Nkɔsoɔ a Wɔayɛ Zcash tu mpɔn denam network upgrades so: nsakrae a wɔayɛ no biako wɔ mmara a node biara pene so, emu biara yɛ adwuma wɔ set block height. Kenkan wɔn nnidiso nnidiso, efi Sprout kosi Ironwood. Sɛ wopɛ asɛm a wɔde aniwa hu a ɛfa sɛnea Zcash's kokoamsɛm akɔ so wɔ saa nkɔsoɔ yi nyinaa mu a, hwɛ Nkɔso a Ɛba wɔ Kokoam Nsɛm Ho. Kratafa yi ne index no. Ɛno ne bere nhyehyɛe. Dashboard ahorow bi kyerɛ wɔn wɔ mpɔtam hɔ bere mu, a ɛyɛ block koro no ara ne bere koro no ara. Fixed trigger ma upgrade biara ne ne activation block sorokɔ, ɛnyɛ kalenda da. NU7 tebea NU7 wɔ ɔmanfo Testnet so wɔ ne sorokɔ 4,465,026 (wɔyɛɛ adwuma 4 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2026). Mainnet dwumadie no sorokɔ yɛ 3,543,405 (ZIP 259 na ɛwɔ hɔ), a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛyɛ no 5 November 2026. Sprout retirement (ZIP 2003) — version 4 nkitahodi ahorow no bɛyɛ nea enni mu; Sprout sika a aka no bɛyɛ nea wontumi mfa nni dwuma. Adeyɛ anohyeto a wɔabɔ ho ban ne mfɛnsere a ɛtrɛw a ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkyekyere (17 → 102 blocks). Wɔmfa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe foforo biara mma. Baa dwumadibea ID a wɔpene so: 0x77190ad9. Ɛyɛ bɛyɛ a ɛbɛn sika a ɛwɔ wɛbsaet no so sen biara. Bere a ɛkyɛ nneɛma pii a ɛte sɛ Bitcoin no, edi Bitcoin sintɔ kɛse no ho dwuma denam ma a ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi yɛ kokoam sikasɛm mu nkitahodi koraa no so. Sɛ nkurɔfo nya sika nhyehyɛe a ɛne atipɛnfo di nkitaho a wɔmma ho kwan a, ɛma wotumi de bo a ɛsom sie, anaasɛ wɔne afoforo di nkitaho, a wɔde wɔn ho fi nnwumakuw a ɛwɔ mfinimfini no ho. ZEC ma nkurɔfo tumi paw bere a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔda wɔn sikasɛm ho nsɛm adi kyerɛ afoforo. Akadeɛ Zcash ne Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Asɛm no Abɔde a Nkwa Wom a Wɔabɔ Ho Ban Zcash Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Nkamfo Dɛn ne Zcash? Zcash yɛ "Zerocash" protocol no a wɔde di dwuma. Ɛyɛ open-source, blockchain-based ledger a ɛwɔ zero-nimdeɛ adansedie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa. Gyina Bitcoin mmara so, ɛyɛ specializes wɔ de ma gyinapɛn a ɛkorɔn a kokoamsɛm denam ne adanse nhyehyɛe a ɛkora kokoamsɛm so asɛmdi ho metadata. Wɔ ne titiriw mu no, Zcash yɛ kokoam data wurayɛ a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo a wɔmma ho kwan bere a wɔreyɛ nnwuma no. Dɛn nti na ɛho hia? Zcash siesie Bitcoin sintɔ kɛse no; ankorankoro wurayɛ ne data a wɔde ma afoforo. Wɔ wiase a blockchain application ne cryptocurrencies regye atom kɛse mu no, nkitahodi a wɔde din atoro di no nyɛ ɔkwan a ɛfata bio a wɔfa so bɔ nea ɔde di dwuma no kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Z.sika a wɔde yɛ adwuma Z.cash yɛ Zcash wɛbsaet titiriw. Ɛde Zcash mu nsɛm ne nkrataa ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma ahorow pii na ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma foforo no kwan ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mfiridwuma mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu a atwa Zcash ho ahyia no mu kɔ akyiri. Zcash GitHub na ɛyɛ adwuma Got coding chops na wopɛ sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ mu kɔ akyiri wɔ technical fã a Zcash? Zcash GitHub Repo no yɛ akoraeɛ ma zcashd, Zcash node dwumadie a ɛdi kan. zcashd duu ne automatic end-of-support halt wɔ 18 July 2026 na wɔnhwɛ so bio, na download krataafa a saa nsɛm yi de link kɔ no no, wɔmfa nni dwuma bio. Stack a wɔhwɛ so no yɛ Zebra ma node no ne Zallet ma sika kotoku no — hwɛ zcashd to Zebra ne Zallet atutra akwankyerɛ. Zcash Foundation GitHub GitHub akoraeɛ foforɔ a ɛgye Zcash Foundation no nnwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne ɔsebɔ, Zcash node a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Rust mu. Halo2 Nsusuwii ahorow a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ a enni adanse nhyehyɛe ahorow akyi. Zcash RPC Nsɛm a Wɔakyerɛw RPC ahyɛdeɛ zcashd a wɔada no adi no din. Sɛ wopɛ sika kotoku RPC ani a wɔahwɛ so yiye a, hwɛ Zallet Nhoma no. Eyi yɛ krataa a wonwiei .

title: Blossom
description: Blossom kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 653,600 (December 11, 2019 UTC).
text: Blossom Blossom kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 653,600 (December 11, 2019 UTC). Nea wobɛfa akɔ: sɛnea Blossom yɛɛ Zcash blocks no du bɛyɛ mmɔho abien ntɛmntɛm a ɛnsakra ZEC dodow a network no yɛ bere tenten. Blossom yɛ Zcash a ɔyɛ ɔbarima network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma. Wɔde sii hɔ denam... ZIP 206 na ɛwɔ hɔ, na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ ne nsakrae titiriw a wɔpene so no mu wɔ ZIP 208 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Na Blossom yɛ scalability upgrade: ɛmaa bere a wɔde asi wɔn ani so wɔ block ahorow ntam no yɛɛ tiaa fii sikɔne 150 koduu sikani 75, enti block ahorow no ba bɛyɛ mmɔho abien. Electric Coin Company no dii Blossom anim na wɔde too gua. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Sɛ wosoma ZEC a, wotwɛn ma network no si so dua wɔ block bi mu. Sɛ block ahorow no yɛ brɛoo a, wotwɛn kyɛ. Ansa na Blossom reba no, na wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ wɔbɛbɔ block foforo bɛyɛ sikɔne 150 biara. Blossom twaa saa botae no mu fã, kɔɔ sikani 75, enti nsɛm a wɔde si so dua no ba ntɛm na nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no betumi de nnwuma pii akɔ so wɔ bere koro no ara mu. Ɛyɛɛ eyi a wanbɔ ZEC pii anaasɛ ankanyan bere a wɔde bɛkyekyɛ daakye no fã. Nneɛma a wɔde siw ano ntɛmntɛm Blossom nsakrae titiriw no yɛ mmerɛw. Zcash target block spacing, bere a network no de asi n’ani so wɔ block biako ne nea edi hɔ ntam no, so tew fii sikɔne 150 kɔɔ sikani 75 (ZIP 208 na ɛwɔ hɔ). Wɔnam adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔayɛ adwuma so na ehu block ahorow, enti nsonsonoe ankasa a ɛda wɔn ntam no gu ahorow, nanso mprempren network no de asi n’ani so sɛ obenya block bɛyɛ sikɔne 75 biara sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ 150 biara. Nneɛma abien di akyi: Block ahorow ba bɛyɛ mmɔho abien, enti nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no tumi de nnwuma a wɔyɛ no bɛyɛ mmɔho abien wɔ bere biako biara mu. Wo asɛm no nya ne confirmation a edi kan ntɛm, efisɛ wontwɛn bere tenten saa mma block a edi hɔ no. Sɛ wɔbɛma sika a wɔde ma no akɔ so ayɛ nea ɛkɔ so daa Block ahorow a ɛyɛ ntɛmntɛm ma asɛmmisa bi sɔre. Sɛ Zcash yɛɛ blocks mmɔho abien na block biara da so ara tua akatua koro no ara a, network no bɛbɔ ZEC ntɛmntɛm mmɔho abien. Blossom kwati saa. Ɛtew akatua a wotua wɔ block biara so no so fã, na ɛmaa block-akatua a wɔtew so fã no mmɔho abien fii block 840,000 koduu 1,680,000 (ZIP 208 na ɛwɔ hɔ). Block dodow mmɔho abien, a emu biara tua fã no, yɛ adwuma kodu ZEC dodow koro no ara a wɔbɔ wɔ bere unit biara mu. Nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛma nyinaa ne bere a wɔbɛtew so daakye, a wɔsusuw no bere ankasa mu no ansakra. Nkɔso a ɛyɛ ahyɛde Na Blossom yɛ nsakrae a aman abien adwene hyia, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ na ɛsɛ sɛ node biara yɛ foforo na ama wɔakɔ so adi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no akyi (ZIP 206 na ɛwɔ hɔ). Na ɛnyɛ nea wobetumi apaw ama node operator a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔtra sync. Blossom yɛɛ adwuma wɔ mainnet block 653,600 na ɛkura n’ankasa consensus branch id, tag a ɛma nodes ne transactions si so dua sɛ wɔwɔ Blossom mmara no so. Nkɔsoɔ no de Zcash standard network upgrade mechanism (ZIP 200 na ɛwɔ hɔ). Baabi a Blossom fata Blossom yɛ Zcash network upgrade a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa. Ɛdii Overwinter ne Sapling akyi, na ɛbaa Heartwood ne Canopy anim. Nea ɛnte sɛ Sapling a ɛsan yɛɛ Zcash shielded cryptography no ho adwuma no, na Blossom de n’adwene asi nsenia ne ahoɔhare so. Na n’adwuma titiriw ne block timing, na ɛnyɛ kokoam nsɛm foforo. title: Canopy
description: Canopy kɔɔ live wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 1,046,400 (November 18, 2020 UTC).
text: Canopy Canopy kɔɔ live wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 1,046,400 (November 18, 2020 UTC). Nea wobɛfa: sɛnea Zcash kɔɔ so de sika boaa n’ankasa nkɔso bere a founders akatua no baa awiei, ne sɛnea Canopy hyehyɛɛ sikasɛm mu mpaapaemu a akyiri yi nkɔso da so ara si so. Canopy yɛ Zcash network upgrade a ɛtɔ so anum, a wɔsan frɛ no Network Upgrade 4 (NU4). Wɔde di dwuma denam ZIP 251 na ɛwɔ hɔ, na ɛyɛɛ adwuma wɔ mainnet block 1,046,400 wɔ November 18, 2020 (UTC), bere koro no ara a Zcash block akatua a edi kan no yɛɛ fã. Ná Canopy yɛ nniso ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso titiriw. Ɛde mfitiaseɛ a wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​akatua no baa awieeɛ na ɛhyɛɛ Zcash Development Fund foforɔ a ɛtua Electric Coin Company, Zcash Foundation, ne wɔn a wɔgye mmoa a wɔde wɔn ho no ka. Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ saa sikakorabea no akyi no firii mpɔtam nnisoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔatrɛ mu wɔ afe 2019 mu. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Zcash de sika ma n’ankasa nkɔso fi block akatua mu, efisɛ enni adwumakuw biara wɔ n’akyi. Ná wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​akatua a wotuae wɔ ne mfiase mfe no ho no bɛba awiei wɔ fã a edi kan no mu. Canopy na wɔde sii ananmu: ɛde block akatua biara mu kyɛfa pɔtee bi kɔɔ Nkɔso Foto mu na ɛkyerɛɛ nea obenya. Wɔnam nkɔso a wɔyɛe akyiri yi so yɛɛ saa mfonini no yiye, kosii sɛ NU6.1. Nkɔso sikakorabea no Canopy de mfitiaseɛ founders akatua no baa awieeɛ na ɔde Zcash Development Fund sii ananmu. Nsakraeɛ no sii fam wɔ block korɔ no ara so sɛ Zcash fã a ɛdi kan no, berɛ a block akatua no kɔɔ fam firii 6.25 ZEC kɔɔ 3.125 ZEC. Enti wɔn a wotu fam huu sɛ wɔatwa wɔn akatua no mu abien da koro no ara a saa akatua ketewaa no fã foforo fii ase sen kɔɔ nkɔso mu no. Na wɔahyɛ sɛ sikakorabea no bɛyɛ adwuma mfeɛ nnan, ɛfiri saa fã a ɛdi kan yi wɔ November 2020 mu kɔsi fã a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe 2024. Wɔkyerɛw nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔpenee so no sɛ ZIP 1014 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Mfiri a wɔpene so a ɛde sika no kɔ ankasa ne sika a wɔde ma no kwan: ZIP 207 na ɛwɔ hɔ de ɔkwan a wɔfa so de block subsidy no fã bi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu sɛ wobenya no bae, na ZIP 214 na ɛwɔ hɔ hyehyɛ mmara pɔtee ne wɔn a wɔbɛgye no address ama Nkɔsoɔ Fotoɔ no. Sɛnea wɔkyekyɛ sika no mu Development Fund no gye block biara akatua ɔha biara mu nkyem 20. Wɔn a wotu fam no sie ɔha biara mu nkyem 80 a aka no. Afei wɔkyekyɛ saa ɔha biara mu nkyem 20 no mu akwan abiɛsa, di ZIP 1014 akyi. ɔha biara mu 35 de maa Bootstrap Project, Electric Coin Company no awofo ahyehyɛde no. ɔha biara mu nkyem 25 de bɛma Zcash Foundation. ɔha biara mu nkyem 40 ma Major Grants a ɛma wonya sika de yɛ adwuma a wɔde wɔn ho yɛ na Zcash Foundation na ɛhwɛ so. Akyiri yi Mmoa Kɛseɛ bɛyɛɛ Zcash Community Grants (ZCG). Sɛ wɔde toto block akatua no nyinaa ho sen sɛ wɔde sikakorabea no nkutoo susuw ho a, saa kyɛfa no yɛ adwuma kodu ɔha biara mu nkyem 7 ma Electric Coin Company, ɔha biara mu nkyem 5 ma Zcash Foundation, ne ɔha biara mu nkyem 8 ma Major Grants. Akwan abien no nyinaa a wɔfa so kyerɛkyerɛ mu no yɛ akontaahyɛde koro. Sprout pool no sesa Canopy nso fii ase gyaee ɔtare a akyɛ sen biara a wɔabɔ ho ban no. Sprout ne Zcash ɔtare a edi kan a wɔabɔ ho ban, na Canopy fii ase twitwaa mu faa mu ZIP 211 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Efi bere a Canopy yɛɛ adwuma no, wontumi mfa botae foforo biara nka Sprout pool no ho. Wɔ mfiridwuma mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ vpubold field a ɛwɔ JoinSplit biara mu no yɛ zero. Sika a ɛwɔ Sprout dedaw no da so ara tumi yi, enti wɔmfa obiara nkɔ, nanso ɔtare no betumi atew afi ha nkutoo. Eyi yɛ anammɔn a edi kan a ɛbɛma awiei koraa no wɔbɛpoo Sprout ɔtare a ɛyɛ agyapade no de agye atare foforo a wɔabɔ ho ban no atom. Mfiridwuma mu nneɛma a ɛka ho no Wɔ sikasɛm mu nsakrae no akyi no, Canopy de mfiridwuma mu ZIP nketewa abien kuraa. ZIP 212 na ɛwɔ hɔ sesaa sɛnea obi a ogye no nya Sapling bere tiaa mu ahintasɛm no, na onya fii nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no pefee mu. ZIP 215 na ɛwɔ hɔ kyerɛw mmara a ɛda adi pefee a ɛbɛma Ed25519 nsaano nkyerɛwee no ayɛ nokware, enti node biara pene so wɔ nsaano nkyerɛwee a wɔkan no sɛ ɛyɛ nokware no ho. title: Crosslink Protocol no ho nhyehyɛe
description: Crosslink Protocol yɛ nkɔsoɔ titire wɔ Zcash nkɔsoɔ mu, ɛkyerɛ no kwan kɔ Hybrid Proof-of-Stake (PoS) ne Proof-of-Work (PoW) nhwɛsoɔ so. Amanneɛbɔ PoW, ɛwom sɛ…
text: Crosslink Protocol no ho nhyehyɛe TL;DR Crosslink protocol no yɛ nhyehyeɛ a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa ama Zcash's hybrid Proof-of-Work/Proof-of-Stake (PoW/PoS) stage. Ɛde PoW ne Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) protocol bom, na ɛma awerɛhyem sɛ ɛbɛba awiei bere tenten a PoW anaa PoS da so ara yɛ ahobammɔ no. Hybrid PoS de notaries a wɔgye blocks a egyina staked ZEC so di dwuma — mfiase no na ɛyɛ static, akyiri yi wɔpaw no gyina staked ZEC. Crosslink botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma ledger mmienu: finalized ledger (LOGfin) ama rollback ahobanbɔ, ne lower-latency ledger (LOGba) a ɛtrɛw no nsen L blocks. Safety Mode bi yɛ adwuma sɛ ledger a wɔawie no di akyi bɛboro L blocks a: PoW kɔ so, nanso sikasɛm dwumadi ahorow no gyina kosi sɛ wobesiesie asɛm no. Bere kɔ so no, PoS validators benya akatua mu kyɛfa a ɛrenya nkɔanim, na ɛbɛtew PoW miners’ akatua so; protocol no de nsakrae ba nkakrankakra. Shielded Labs, a ɛwɔ ɔkwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛka Crosslink 2 abom wɔ Zcash's Zebra client no mu. Crosslink nnyɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mainnet so. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ Shielded Labs' Feature Net, sɔhwɛ ntam nkitahodi a obiara betumi akɔ mu. Hwɛ "Baabi a Crosslink gyina" wɔ aseɛ ha. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Nnianim: Zcash Hybrid PoS ne Crosslink Protocol no Crosslink Protocol yɛ nkɔsoɔ titire wɔ Zcash nkɔsoɔ mu, ɛkyerɛ no kwan kɔ Hybrid Proof-of-Stake (PoS) ne Proof-of-Work (PoW) nhwɛsoɔ so. Amanneɛbɔ PoW, ɛwom sɛ wotumi de ho to so sɛ ɛbɛma nkitahodi ahobammɔ ahwɛ ahu no, hyia ɔkasatia wɔ ahoɔden a wɔde di dwuma ne asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ mfinimfini a ɛbata mfiridwuma mu a wotu fagude ho no ho. Crosslink de nhyehyɛe a wɔde afrafra ba, a ɛde PoW ahoɔden a wɔada no adi no ne PoS mu mfaso a ɛwɔ adwumayɛ ne nniso mu no bom. Saa nsakrae yi ne wiase nyinaa nkɔsoɔ wɔ blockchain nnoɔma foforɔ mu, baabi a nnwuma redan akɔ akwan a ɛbɛma nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ne decentralized so no hyia. Crosslinks’ dual consensus model hwɛ hu sɛ Zcash kura ne cryptographic kokoamsɛm ho bɔhyɛ a emu yɛ den bere a ɛrenya nkɔso de adi nnɛyi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma. Hybrid Proof-of-Stake (PoS) kwan no de atetesɛm Proof-of-Work (PoW) ne PoS bom, a ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛdi mmerɛwyɛ te sɛ 51% ntua ho dwuma berɛ a ɛkura decentralization mu na ɛtew ahoɔden a wɔde di dwuma so. Hybrid PoS de notaries a wɔgye blocks a egyina staked ZEC. Wɔayɛ saa adwinnade yi sɛ ɛbɛma nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ahobanbɔ ne checkpoint validation atu mpɔn, na ɛde ɔkwan foforo a ɛyɛ den kɛse ma wɔ PoW nhyehyɛe a ɛho tew ananmu. Dɛn nti na Hybrid PoS/PoW sɛ sɔhwɛ a edi kan? Ɛnya nkɔsoɔ kɔ PoS kronkron so. Ɛma wotumi tu fagude ne staking use cases ne ecosystem crossover bere koro mu. Ɛbrɛ ahobanbɔ ho nsɛm a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ PoS protocol no ase kɔsi sɛ ɛbɛnya validator stake ne ahotosoɔ kɛseɛ. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no nyinaa no, Ethereum ada no adi wɔ Production mu. Nea Crosslink yɛ Crosslink protocol no yɛ nhyehyeɛ a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa ama Zcash's hybrid Proof-of-Work/Proof-of-Stake (PoW/PoS) stage. Ɛde PoW ne Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) protocol bom, na ɛma awerɛhyem sɛ ɛbɛba awiei bere tenten a PoW anaa PoS da so ara yɛ ahobammɔ no. Nsusuiɛ no botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ nkitahodiɛ ahobanbɔ ne decentralization mu den denam staked validation a wɔde bɛka ho berɛ a wɔkura miner kyɛfa mu. Ade titiriw bi a ɛwɔ nsusuwii no mu a wɔfrɛ no Crosslink 2 no ma adansi no yɛ mmerɛw denam BFT nyansahyɛfo ne wɔn a wotu fagude a ɛka bom no so. Saa kwan a wɔayɛ no mmerɛw yi ma nsakraeɛ a ɛba nhyehyɛɛ mu no so tew na ɛma kwan ma wɔde "dummy" BFT layer di dwuma, na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ na wɔde adi dwuma berɛ a wɔkura ahobanbɔ gyinapɛn a ɛkorɔn mu. Nhyehyeɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma no bi ne ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ adwuma a wɔasusu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔ mfiridwuma ho ka a wɔde bɛka Crosslink 2 abom wɔ Zcash's Zebra afɛfoɔ no mu. Saa dwumadie a wɔde di dwuma nkakrankakra yi twe adwene si so sɛ wɔbɛkari pɛ wɔ nkannyan a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no mu, wɔbɛtew ɔhaw so, na wɔde ahyia Zcash botaeɛ a ɛfa scalability, dwumadie, ne decentralization ho. title: FROST
description: Schnorr dijitaal nsaano nkyerɛwee yɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ: (KeyGen, Sign, Verify).
text: FROST TL;DR FROST (Flexible Round-Optimised Schnorr Threshold Signatures) yɛ threshold signature ne distributed key generation protocol: wɔn a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ dodoɔ bi mu biara kura kyɛfa wɔ kokoam safoa a wɔbom yɛ mu, na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn mu threshold nɔma bi yɛ adwuma bom na ama wɔayɛ nsaano nkyerɛwee baako. Esiane sɛ nea efi mu ba ne Schnorr nsaano nkyerɛwee biako nti, asɛm a wɔayɛ no saa kwan yi so no te sɛ asɛm a wɔyɛ no kwa wɔ ntwamutam no so. Ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nkitahodi kakraa bi na ɛyɛ, ebetumi atu mmirika bere koro mu, na ebetumi ahu obi a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu a ɔbɔ bra bɔne na ayi no afi mu. Wɔ Zcash fam no, eyi kyerɛ sɛ FROST ma afã horow pii, a wɔatew wɔn ho wɔ asasesin mu no tumi di sika a wɔsɛe no tumi a ɛwɔ ZEC a wɔabɔ ho ban no so — mfaso wɔ so ma sikakorabea, escrow, nnwuma a ɛnyɛ sikakorabea, ne Zcash Shielded Assets (ZSA). It was created by Chelsea Komlo (University of Waterloo, Zcash Foundation) and Ian Goldberg (University of Waterloo). Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Dɛn ne Schnorr nsaano nkyerɛwee? Schnorr dijitaal nsaano nkyerɛwee yɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ: (KeyGen, Sign, Verify). Schnorr nsaano nkyerɛwee wɔ mfaso pii. Mfaso titiriw biako ne sɛ, sɛ wɔde nsafe pii di dwuma de hyɛ nkrasɛm koro ase a, wobetumi de nsaano nkyerɛwee a efi mu ba no abom ayɛ no nsaano nkyerɛwee biako. Eyi betumi atew multisig sikatua ne nnwuma afoforo a ɛfa multisig ho no kɛse so kɛse. Dɛn ne FROST? Schnorr Threshold Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Ɛyɛ Nsakrae Kurukuruwa-Optimised - . Created by Chelsea Komlo (University of Waterloo, Zcash Foundation) & Ian Goldberg (University of Waterloo). FROST yɛ threshold signature ne distributed key generation protocol a ɛhia nkitahodi rounds kakraa bi na wobetumi ayɛ no parallel. FROST protocol yɛ Schnorr nsaano nkyerɛwee nhyehyɛe no threshold version. Nea ɛnte sɛ nsaano nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ ɔfã biako tebea mu no, ahyɛnsode nsaano nkyerɛwee hwehwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ ase no dodow bi a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ ase no yɛ biako, na wɔn mu biara kura kokoam safe biako mu kyɛfa. Dɛn ne Threshold Signatures? Chelsea Komlo - Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so Ne saa nti, sɛ wɔyɛ nsaano nkyerɛwee wɔ threshold nhyehyɛe mu a, ɛde sika pii ba esiane ntwamutam a ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ ase no mu nti, na ɛma ɛyɛ den bere a wɔde kokoam kyɛfa sie wɔ mfiri a ntwamutam anohyeto wom so anaasɛ bere a nkitahodi kɔ so wɔ ntwamutam a wontumi mfa ho nto so so. Network overhead bere a signing adwumayɛ no so tew denam ɔkwan foforo a wɔde di dwuma a ɛbɔ ho ban fi atoro ntua ho na ɛfa nhyehyɛe afoforo nso ho. FROST ma threshold signature protocols tu mpɔn denam ma a ɛma kwan ma wɔyɛ signature dwumadie dodoɔ a anohyetoɔ nni mu dwoodwoo wɔ parallel (concurrency) mu. Wobetumi de adi dwuma sɛ 2-round protocol, baabi a signers de nkrasɛm 2 mena na wogye nyinaa, anaasɛ sɛ optimized single-round signing protocol a ɛwɔ preprocessing stage. FROST nya ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛba wɔ adwumayɛ mu no fã bi denam ma a ɛma protocol no gyae nyinsɛn wɔ obi a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu a ɔnyɛ abrabɔ bɔne anim, a afei wɔhunu no na wɔyi no firi daakye dwumadie mu. Wɔde ahobammɔ ho adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ FROST wɔ ahobammɔ wɔ ntua a wɔapaw ho, a yɛfa no sɛ discrete logarithm haw no yɛ den, na ɔtamfo no di wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu kakraa bi so sen threshold no ama ha. Ɔkwan bɛn so na FROST yɛ adwuma? FROST protocol no kura nneɛma abien a ɛho hia: Nea edi kan no, n a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no yɛ distributed key generation (DKG) protocol de yɛ common verification key. Wɔ awiei no, obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no nya kokoam kokoam safe kyɛfa ne ɔmanfo nokwaredi safe kyɛfa. Ɛno akyi no, t-out-of-n participants biara betumi ayɛ threshold signing protocol de ayɛ adwuma abom ayɛ Schnorr signature a ɛfata. Aniwa so / Nsɛso Fa no sɛ FROST te sɛ safe-deposit box a ɛbue bere a keyholders pii a wɔama wɔn tumi dan wɔn safe no bom nkutoo — nanso ɛnyɛ keyholder biara na wɔhwehwɛ; nɔma a wɔahyɛ no ara kwa (sɛ nhwɛso no, 5 biara mu 3). Sɛ wobue adaka no wie a, obi a ɔhwɛ abɔnten ntumi nhu safe a wɔde kuraa mu a wɔdaa no a

title: FROST & Threshold Custody ma ZEC a Wɔabɔ ho ban
description: Sɛ wopɛ FROST protocol no ho nsɛm a ɛfa cryptographic ho nyinaa a, hwɛ FROST mfiridwuma ho kratafa.
text: FROST & Threshold Custody ma ZEC a Wɔabɔ ho ban Sɛ wopɛ FROST protocol no ho nsɛm a ɛfa cryptographic ho nyinaa a, hwɛ FROST mfiridwuma ho kratafa. FROST threshold custody kɔ so ba wɔ Zcash nkɔmmɔbɔ mu — na ɛyɛ top track wɔ ZecHub Hackathon 2026 — nanso ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ adwene no mu wɔ kasa a emu da hɔ mu. Kratafa yi ka nea ɛkyerɛ, bere a wuhia ankasa, aguadi a wɔde di gua, ne nnwinnade a ɛboa no nnɛ ho asɛm. --- TL;DR FROST ma kuw bi a wɔwɔ safoa bom di Zcash address a wɔabɔ ho ban so a obiara nni hɔ a okura kokoam safoa no nyinaa. t-of-n threshold kyerɛ sɛ: ɛsɛ sɛ t nkurɔfo bom de wɔn nsa hyɛ ase na wɔabɔ ka; t-1 biara anaa nea ennu saa no nkutoo ntumi mfa sika no nkɔ baabiara. Nkitahodi te sɛ asɛm foforo biara a wɔabɔ ho ban — on-chain footprint biara nni hɔ a ɛda no adi sɛ wɔde threshold signing dii dwuma. Eyi yɛ soronko koraa wɔ multisig a ɛda adi pefee (a ɛyɛ ɔmanfo on-chain na Zcash aboa bere tenten) — FROST yɛ adwuma wɔ shielded pool no mu. Ɛyɛ mfasoɔ ma DAOs, exchanges, custody services, joint savings, ne team treasuries — baabiara a asɛm baako a ɛyɛ huammɔdi titire no nnye ntom. --- Dɛn ne FROST wɔ kasa a emu da hɔ mu? Fa no sɛ adwumayɛfo baasa a wɔn mu biara kura safe bi. Sɛ wobetumi asɛe sika afi wɔn sika kotoku a wɔkyɛ mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ baasa no mu baanu biara pene so na wɔbom de wɔn nsa hyɛ ase. Aguadi a efi mu ba no te sɛ nea ɛne ankorankoro a wɔde mena daa no yɛ pɛ — ɔhwɛfo biara ntumi nhu mfi blockchain no mu sɛ nnipa pii na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu. FROST (Flexible Round-Optimized Schnorr Threshold Signatures) is the cryptographic protocol that makes this possible for shielded Zcash. It was created by Chelsea Komlo (University of Waterloo / Zcash Foundation) and Ian Goldberg. Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ mu: Threshold: t-of-n signers nko ara na ɛhia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu (e.g. 2-of-3, 3-of-5) Shielded: ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ Orchard kokoamsɛm pool no mu — sika dodow, nea ɔde kɔmaa, ne nea ogye no tra kokoam Indistinguishable: nsaano nkyerɛwee a etwa to no te sɛ Zcash shielded asɛm foforo biara Non-custodial: ɔfã biako biara nni hɔ a okura safoa a edi mũ no da — ɛnyɛ ɔhwɛfo no mpo --- Bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wode threshold custody di dwuma? Threshold custody yɛ nteaseɛ berɛ a sɛ wobɛhwere safoa baako anaa onipa baako a, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ wobɛhwere sika no. Tebea a Ɛwɔ Nea enti a threshold custody boa ----------- ---------------------------- DAO anaa kuw sikakorabea Admin biako biara nni hɔ a obetumi asɛe sika wɔ ɔfã biako; hwehwɛ sɛ wɔpene so Nsesa anaa ɔhwɛfoɔ Ɔkyekyɛ asiane titiriw mu wɔ ahobammɔ mmeae anaa adwumayɛfo Ankorankoro awɔw mu nneɛma a wɔde sie (a abusua a wogye wɔn di ka ho) 2-of-3 ntam wo + abusua mufoɔ mmienu — wuwu anaasɛ hwere kwan a wobɛfa so, sika nnyera Escrow na ɛyɛ adwuma Adetɔfo, adetɔnfo, ne ɔtemmufo biara kura kyɛfa; sika gyae bere a nnipa baanu pene so Mmoa a ɛsom bo kɛse a wɔde ma ZCG-style: hwehwɛ sɛ nnipa pii a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ase ansa na wɔatua Developer safoa sohwɛ Siw insider threat ano — engineer biako biara nni hɔ a obetumi asɛe protocol fund Ebia nhia threshold custody ma ankorankoro sika kotoku a wo nkutoo wohwɛ so, sika nketenkete, anaa tebea horow a coordination overhead a wɔde aka ho no boro asiane a wɔatew so no so. --- Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ multisig a ɛda adi pefee ho? Zcash fi bere tenten aboa transparent multisig — safoa pii a ɛho hia sɛ wɔsɛe sika fi t-address so. Nanso multisig a ɛda adi pefee no wɔ kokoamsɛm ho ka kɛse: multisig nhyehyɛe no, ɔmanfo safe nyinaa, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ ase nyinaa da adi wɔ blockchain no so. FROST di eyi ho dwuma denam adwuma a ɛyɛ wɔ ɔtare a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu no so: Multisign a ɛda adi pefee FROST aboboano (a wɔabɔ ho ban) -- --------------------- -------------------------- Tadeɛ Nneɛma a ɛda adi pefee (ɔmanfo) Orchard (a wɔabɔ ho ban) Signers a wotumi hu wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so Yiw — ɔmanfo nsafe nyinaa ada adi Dabi — wontumi nkyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda obiako a ɔde ne nsa hyɛ ase sɛe Sika dodow a wotumi hu Yiw Dabi Nkitahodi a wɔhwehwɛ On-nkɔns

title: Nodes a Ɛyɛ Pɛ
description: Full Node yɛ software a ɛyɛ cryptocurrency blockchain no mfonini a edi mũ, na ɛma wunya kwan kɔ protocol no mu nneɛma so.
text: Nodes a Ɛyɛ Pɛ TL;DR Node a edi mũ sie Zcash blockchain no mfonini a edi mũ na ɛhwɛ block foforo biara ne asɛm a ɛne mmara a wɔpene so no hyia. Zebra (zebrad) ne node a ɛsɛ sɛ wode hyehyɛ mu nnɛ. Zakura yɛ dwumadie a ɛtɔ so mmienu, forked fi Zebra. zcashd yɛ obi a wakɔ pɛnhyen. Wɔduruu ne End-of-Support gyinabea wɔ 18 July 2026 wɔ block height 3417100, na saa nodes no mfi aseɛ bio. Mprempren node ne wallet no yɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛsono emu biara. Zallet tu mmirika tia node bi na okura nsafe no. W’ankasa node a wode bedi dwuma no ma wunya ahotoso a ɛde ne ho na eyi hia a ehia sɛ wode wo ho to obi foforo server so no fi hɔ. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Full Node yɛ software a ɛyɛ cryptocurrency blockchain no mfonini a edi mũ, na ɛma wunya kwan kɔ protocol no mu nneɛma so. Ɛkura kyerɛwtohɔ a edi mũ a ɛfa asɛm biara a asi fi genesis ho na enti ɛtumi hwɛ sɛ nkitahodi foforo ne blocks a wɔde aka blockchain no ho no yɛ nokware. Node Nneɛma a Wɔde Di Dwuma Zebra Zebra yɛ Zcash protocol no a ɛde ne ho, ayɛ krado sɛ ɛyɛ node a edi mũ a wɔde di dwuma, a Zcash Foundation na ɛyɛe na wɔkyerɛwee wɔ Rust. Sɛnea zcashd akɔ pɛnhyen no, Zebra (zebrad) yɛ node a edi mũ a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ma deployments foforo. Zebra di blocks ne transactions ho adanseɛ, ɛde ne ho hyɛ peer-to-peer network no mu, na ɛda RPC interface bi adi ma applications. Sika kotoku no yɛ ade a ɛyɛ soronko mprempren: Zallet tu mmirika tia Zebra node na ɛdi safe ne kari pɛ ho dwuma. Wei besi zcashd, a ɛboaboaa node ne sika kotoku no ano wɔ adeyɛ biako mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛsom sika kotoku a kanea a wɔabɔ ho ban no, node no tu mmirika kɔ indexer bi nkyɛn, anaasɛ nea wɔde asi hɔ no lightwalletd anaa nea ɛyɛ foforo no Zaino. Hwɛ sɛ wobɛkenkan Zebra nwoma no ama nhyehyeɛ akwankyerɛ, na kɔka R&D Discord server no ho na woanya mmoa. GitHub Zebra Nhoma no Hwɛ Zebra Full Node a Ɛyɛ Fɛ ma instɔlehyɛn anammɔn, nhyehyeɛ, ne hardware ahwehwɛdeɛ. Zakura Zakura yɛ node a ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɛne adwene hyia a ɛne ne ho hyia, a wɔde forked afiri Zebra mu na Valar Group ne Project Tachyon. Ɛdi protocol mmara korɔ no ara akyi na ɛde synchronization a ɛyɛ ntɛm, block pruning, ne zcashd RPC compatibility layer ka ho. Hwɛ Zakura Node na ɔkyerɛwee. zcashd (wɔakɔ pɛnhyen) Hyɛ no nsow: zcashd akɔ pɛnhyen. Electric Coin Company de too gua sɛ wɔabu no animtiaa, na wɔduruu automatic End-of-Support halt no so wɔ 18 July 2026 wɔ block height 3417100. zcashd 6.20.0 node biara a wɔansakra no no to mu wɔ saa sorokɔ no so na ɛpow sɛ ɛbɛsan ahyɛ aseɛ, na software no ntumi mmoa NU6.3. Fa Zebra. Sɛ wokura zcashd wallet.dat, di akyi Akwankyerɛ a ɛfa atutra ho: zcashd kɔ zebrad/Zallet. zcashd yɛ mfitiaseɛ Full Node dwumadie ma Zcash, a Electric Coin Company. Wɔakora adansi akwankyerɛ a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no so ama nhwɛsoɔ ne ama adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔretu afiri zcashd. zcashd da API ahorow bi adi denam ne RPC nkitahodi so. Saa API yi ma dwumadie a ɛma abɔnten dwumadie ahodoɔ tumi ne node no di nkitaho. lightwalletd yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa application a ɛde node a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ di dwuma de ma developers tumi yɛ na wɔhwɛ mobile-friendly shielded light wallets a enhia sɛ wɔne zcashd. title: Halo
description: Halo yɛ ahotosoɔ, recursive zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) system a Sean Bowe hunuu wɔ Electric Coin Co. Ɛyi hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde ahotosoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ fi hɔ na ɛma…
text: Halo TL;DR Halo yɛ ahotosoɔ, recursive zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) system a Sean Bowe hunuu wɔ Electric Coin Co. Ɛyi hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde ahotosoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ fi hɔ na ɛma recursive proof composition yɛ adwuma, a ɛyɛ Zcash's mprempren scalability ne ahobanbɔ kwankyerɛ no fapem. Nea ɛyɛ: zk-SNARK adansi a ɛwɔ recursion a etu mpɔn na enni nhyehyɛe guasodeyɛ a wogye di. Nea enti a ɛho hia: Zcash's Orchard shielded pool, a wɔde NU5 yɛɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2022 mu no, tu mmirika wɔ Halo 2 — nhwehwɛmu yi a wɔde di dwuma no so. Agyapade titiriw: "awuduru nwura" biara nni hɔ a efi nhyehyɛe guasodeyɛ ahorow mu, ne adanse a ebetumi adi adanse afoforo a ɛkame ayɛ sɛ anohyeto nni mu ho adanse. Tumi krataa: Halo 2 yɛ open source ase MIT ne Apache 2.0, enti obiara a ɔwɔ abɔde a nkwa wom mu no betumi de asi so. --- Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Halo yɛ ahotoso, recursive zero-nimdeɛ adanse nhyehyɛe a Sean Bowe hui wɔ Electric Coin Co. Ɛyi nhyehyɛe a wogye di no fi hɔ na ɛma kwan ma Zcash blockchain no scalability kɛse. Halo yɛ zero-nimdeɛ adanseɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi kan a ɛyɛ adwuma yie na ɛsan yɛ bio — a wɔbu no kɛseɛ sɛ nyansahu mu nkɔsoɔ. Nneɛma abien a ɛwɔ mu no Succinct Polynomial Commitment Scheme. Ɛma committer kwan ma ɔde ne ho to polynomial a ɛwɔ ahama tiawa a verifier betumi de adi dwuma de asi nhwehwɛmu a wɔakyerɛ sɛ wɔayɛ wɔ committed polynomial no so dua. Polynomial Interactive Oracle Proof. Verifier no srɛ prover (algorithm bi) sɛ ɔmmue commitments nyinaa wɔ mmeae a ɔpɛ, de polynomial commitment scheme no di dwuma, na ɔhwɛ sɛ identity no kura nokware wɔ wɔn ntam. Nsiesiei biara nni hɔ a wotumi de ho to so zk-SNARKs de wɔn ho to common reference string (CRS) so sɛ ɔmanfoɔ parameter a wɔde bɛdi adanseɛ na wɔadi ho adanseɛ. Ɛsɛ sɛ obi a wogye no di di kan yɛ saa CRS yi. Ɛde besi nnansa yi no, na ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ akontaabu a ahobammɔ wom a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa nnipa pii ho (MPC) — sɛnea Aztec ntam nkitahodi ne Zcash yɛ no — na ama asiane a ɛwɔ mu wɔ eyi mu no so atew setup guasodeyɛ a wogye di. Zcash's kan Sprout ne Sapling shielded pools no de BCTV14 ne Groth16 zk-proving nhyehyɛe ahorow no dii dwuma. Bere a na eyinom yɛ ahobammɔ no, na wɔwɔ anohyeto ahorow: na wontumi nsɛe no efisɛ na wɔakyekyere no wɔ dwumadie baako ho, "awuduru nwura" (nwura a awuduru wom" (cryptographic nneɛma nkaeɛ a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ genesis guasodeyɛ no mu) tumi kɔ so, na na ahotosoɔ bi wɔ hɔ (ɛwom sɛ ɛyɛ simma ketewaa bi de) a ɛbɛma wɔabu guasodeyɛ no sɛ ɛyɛ nea wɔgye tom. Halo yi nhyehyɛe a wogye di no fi hɔ denam ɔhaw ahorow pii a ɛbɔ bom mpɛn pii wɔ elliptic curves kyinhyia so, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi de akontaabu adanse adi dwuma de asusuw wɔn ho yiye (nested amortization). Nsunsuansoɔ bɔne ne sɛ structured reference string (asɛm a ɛfiri guasodeɛ bi mu ba) no bɛyɛ upgradeable, na ɛma applications te sɛ smart contracts tumi yɛ adwuma. Halo ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no awerɛhyem abien a ɛho hia fa ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ nimdeɛ a enni adanse nhyehyɛe kɛse bi mu. Nea edi kan no, ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi kyerɛ sɛ obiara nni hɔ a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ genesis guasodeyɛ no mu a wayɛ kokoam akyi pon bi a wɔde bɛyɛ nnaadaa nnwuma. Nea ɛto so abien no, ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi kyerɛ sɛ bere kɔ so no, nhyehyɛe no akɔ so ayɛ nea ahobammɔ wom, bere mpo a wɔayɛ no foforo na wɔayɛ nsakrae wom no. Sean Bowe's nkyerɛkyerɛmufo a ɔwɔ Dystopia Labs --- Aniwa so / Nsɛso Notary nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no Susuw zk-SNARK a ɛyɛ daa ho sɛ krataa a wɔakyerɛw so: stamp biako, nokwaredi biako, wɔayɛ. Afei fa no sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wokyerɛ sɛ nkrataa mpem du a wɔaboaboa ano no yɛ nokware. Sɛ ɛnyɛ recursion a, anka ɛsɛ sɛ verifier hwɛ stamp biara. Halo dane krataa biara a wɔagye atom no yɛ no stamp wɔ next krataa no so, kɔsi sɛ stack no nyinaa bɛbubu ayɛ no krataa baako a stamp baako na ɛwɔ mu. Sɛ wohwɛ krataa a etwa to no mu a, ɛdɔɔso sɛ wubenya nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no nyinaa mu ahotoso — na nea ɛho hia titiriw no, Halo's notary (proving system) yɛ n’ankasa stamps a enhia abɔnten so tumidi da sɛ ɔde ne nsɔano besi hɔ. title: Heartwood
description: Heartwood kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 903,000 (July 16, 2020 UTC).
text: Heartwood Heartwood kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 903,000 (July 16, 2020 UTC). Nea wobɛfa akɔ: sɛnea Heartwood ma wɔn a wotu fam no nya wɔn block akatua no tẽẽ kɔ address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban mu, ne sɛnea ɛmaa Zcash adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma no tumi hwɛɛ mu denam adetɔfo a wɔn mu yɛ hare so. Heartwood yɛ Zcash a ɛyɛ adwuma network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, consensus-rule hard fork a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ ne deployment mu wɔ ZIP 250 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Ɛboaboaa nsakrae abien a wɔayɛ wɔ nneɛma ho no bom: ZIP 213 na ɛwɔ hɔ (Shielded Coinbase) ne ZIP 221 na ɛwɔ hɔ (FlyClient) (FlyAdetɔfo). Heartwood yɛ Zcash network upgrade kɛseɛ a ɛtɔ so nnan, na wɔboom boaa no Electric Coin Company ne nea Zcash Foundation. Te sɛ Zcash upgrade biara no, ɛde consensus branch id foforo sii hɔ, tag a ɛma akwan abien replay ahobammɔ ma enti atɔ a wɔasi wɔ mmara foforo no ase no ntumi nsan nkɔbɔ wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn dedaw no so, ne nea ɛne no bɔ abira. Heartwood yɛ adwuma wɔ block sorokɔ a wɔahyɛ (903,000), na ɛnyɛ dɔn bere pɔtee bi mu, enti simma pɔtee a wuhu wɔ dashboard so no betumi ayɛ soronko kakra wɔ beae biako akɔ foforo. Block no, ne bere no, yɛ ade koro. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Wɔn a wotu fam no nya ZEC a wɔayɛ no foforo bere biara a wobetu block bi. Ansa na Heartwood reba no, na ɛsɛ sɛ saa sika no kɔ address a ɛda adi pefee so, a ɛyɛ ɔmanfo de. Ná obiara betumi ahwɛ sika dodow a obi a otu fam nya ne baabi a sika no kɔ akyi. Nea enti a Sapling di kan Shielded coinbase de n’ani si Sapling outputs so pɔtee, na ntease bi wɔ hɔ a enti ɛte saa. title: Indexer Nsusuwii: Zaino ne Ztreamer
description: Zaino ne Ztreamer yɛ indexers mmienu a ɛsom lightwallet gRPC protocol, API a Zcash kanea sika kotokuo de di dwuma de yɛ sync. Kratafa yi bɔ ntotoho a ɛde ne…
text: Indexer Nsusuwii: Zaino ne Ztreamer Zaino ne Ztreamer yɛ indexers mmienu a ɛsom lightwallet gRPC protocol, API a Zcash kanea sika kotokuo de di dwuma de yɛ sync. Kratafa yi bɔ ntotoho a ɛde ne ho, a wotumi san yɛ bio a ɛfa abien no ho no mua: sɛ ebia wɔsan de mmuae koro no ara ba, bere tenten a egye na wɔde ayɛ wɔn index, ne sɛnea wɔde sika kotoku di dwuma ntɛmntɛm. TL;DR Indexer abien no nyinaa san de nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn data a ɛteɛ ba. Mmuae biara a wobetumi ahwɛ wɔ Zebra ho no hyiae, enti sika kotoku betumi de emu biara adi dwuma. Nsonsonoeɛ a wɔhunu ne nhyiamu ne edge cases: mfomsoɔ koodu, byte nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ hash baako mu, sɛdeɛ wɔkan address a wɔayɛ no mmienu, ne JSON-RPC mmuaeɛ nsusuiɛ kakraa bi. Ztreamer kyekye ne index bɛyɛ 6× ntɛmntɛm wɔ CPU koro no ara so. Zaino fi ase bua wɔ sikani 6 akyi denam abisade ahorow a ɔde kɔma Zebra bere a ɛresi no so. Ztreamer som ntɛmntɛm wɔ tebea biara a wɔsusuw mu: 13–17× blocks pii wɔ sekan biara mu ma wallet download a edi mũ. Zaino's latency no fã kɛse no ara fi socket nhyehyɛe biako a ɛyera mu (TCPNODELAY), a ɛde bɛyɛ 40 ms ka abisade pii ho. Ɛyɛ ade a wɔde siesie fie wɔ ɔkwan biako so. Nea Wɔde Totoo Ho Si Backing node no Adɛn :-- :-- :-- Zaino 0.10.1 na ɛwɔ hɔ Zebra 6.4.2 (direct akyi asɛm) Zaino a ɛyɛ den a wɔayi no adi nnansa yi Zaino 0.9.0 na ɛwɔ hɔ Zebra 6.4.2 (direct akyi asɛm) Nkyerɛase a wɔsusuu wɔ Ztreamer's ankasa ntotoho a wɔatintim mu Ztreamer v0.1.0 na ɛwɔ hɔ Zakura node a wɔde ahyɛ mu Ztreamer tag a aba foforo Ztreamer wura Zakura a wɔde ahyɛ mu 1.5.1 Nea Ztreamer's install akwankyerɛ no si Wɔn baanu no de adwini ahorow di dwuma: Zaino tu mmirika sɛ adeyɛ a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ a nkyɛn Zebra full node, kenkan Zebra's tebea, na ɛkora n’ankasa index so. Ɛyɛ indexer a ɛwɔ.. Z3 stack na ɛyɛ. Hwɛ Zaino. Ztreamer a wɔde ahyɛ mu a Zakura node (A Zebra fork) wɔ adeyɛ koro no ara mu na ɛkora compact-block index so. Sɛnea Wɔsusuu No Data koro no ara ma obiara. Ɔdan biara fii ase fii Zcash Foundation testnet snapshot koro no ara mu, a wɔahyɛ no nwini wɔ sorokɔ 4,382,897, enti wɔn nyinaa yɛɛ indexed nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn koro no ara pɛpɛɛpɛ. Obiara betumi ayɛ bio. Biribiara tu mmirika wɔ free GitHub-hosted runners so: fork akorae no na tu adwumayɛ kwan biako. Runs abiɛsa wɔ build biara mu, emu biara fi index a hwee nni mu. Server no ne load generator no tuu mmirika wɔ CPU cores ahorow so. Nhyiamu: lightwallet-protocol gRPC akwan 20 no nyinaa (sɔhwɛ nsɛm 274), de totoo byte ma byte wɔ adansi nyinaa mu na wɔhwɛɛ no wɔ Zebra's JSON-RPC ho. Wɔhwɛɛ JSON-RPC akwan 28 a Zaino som no nso. Adwumayɛ: bere ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛkyekye index no, per-request latency, block-range throughput, 1 kosi 128 concurrent clients, ne wallet download a edi mũ fi Sapling activation kɔ tip no so. Ztreamer som hwee kosi sɛ ne index no bɛwie. Wɔ CPU mfonini koro no ara so no, Zaino 0.10.1 gyee 6–6.5× tenten te sɛ Ztreamer v0.1.0 na ɛde 7.5–8× CPU bere (Zebra ka ho) dii dwuma. title: Ironwood
description: Ironwood yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 3,428,143 wɔ July 28, 2026 UTC, na ɛyɛ live fi saa bere no.
text: Ironwood Ironwood yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 3,428,143 wɔ July 28, 2026 UTC, na ɛyɛ live fi saa bere no. Nea wobɛfa: nea Ironwood sesa, nea enti a bɔne bi a ɛwɔ sika a ahintaw mu yɛ aniberesɛm, ne sɛnea turnstile no ma obiara si so dua sɛ wɔanhyɛ ZEC biara. Ironwood yɛ Zcash network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, a wɔfrɛ no NU6.3, a ɛde ɔtare foforo a wɔabɔ ho ban a ɛwɔ din koro no ara ba. BI ɔtare a wɔabɔ ho ban yɛ sikakorabea ahorow a ne sika ne ne wuranom tra hɔ ahintaw zero-nimdeɛ a wɔde sie. Ironwood wɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛsiw na wɔabu soundness bug a wɔhunu wɔ Orchard shielded pool a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no mu, na ama mpɔtam hɔfoɔ anya ɔkwan a ɛyɛ den a wɔbɛfa so ahwɛ sɛ ZEC a wɔde ma nyinaa yɛ nokware. Wɔakyerɛ ne mmara a wɔpene so no mu ZIP 258 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Sɛ wowɔ sika a ɛda adi te sɛ Bitcoin a, obiara betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔanyɛ sika biara denam ɔmanfo nhoma a ɔkenkan so. Sika a wɔabɔ ho ban de sika dodow no sie, enti wuntumi nhwɛ kɛkɛ. Mmom no, ɛsɛ sɛ cryptography no ankasa ma awerɛhyem sɛ obiara ntumi mmɔ sika wɔ kokoam. Ironwood ho hia efisɛ wohuu mmoawa bi wɔ saa guarantee no mu maa Orchard ɔtare no. Upgrade no to gap no mu na ɛma obiara nya ɔkwan a ɔbɛfa so asi so dua sɛ ZEC a wɔde ma nyinaa da so ara yɛ nokware. Ɛyɛ foforo wɔ Zcash? Fi ase fi ase Dɛn ne ZEC ne Zcash ne Atare a Wɔabɔ Ho Ban, afei san bra ha. Nea enti a Ironwood ho hia Wɔ May 2026 awiei no, ahobammɔ ho nhwehwɛmufo a ɔde ne ho Taylor Hornby, bere a na ɔreyɛ protocol audit ma.. Shielded Labs, de asɛyɛde daa soundness bug bi adi wɔ Orchard shielded pool no mu. Na Orchard yɛ Zcash's ɔtare foforo a wɔabɔ ho ban saa bere no, na sintɔ no traa ne zero-knowledge circuit no fã bi a ɛyɛ elliptic-curve, a ɛde.. Halo 2 nhyehyɛe a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware. Soundness bug kyerɛ sɛ akontaabu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ asɛm bi yɛ nokware no nkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware koraa. Wɔ nsusuwii mu no, anka ɔtowhyɛfo betumi de sintɔ no adi dwuma de ayɛ bo a enni mu wɔ Orchard ɔtare no mu na wasɛe sika a ɛnyɛ wɔn de ankasa, na onnyaw biribiara a node a ɛyɛ daa bɛkyere. Zcash's da so ara kata sɛnea bo a ɛsom betumi afi Orchard, enti na wontumi nhyɛ nneɛma a wɔde ma nyinaa mu den, nanso ɔtare no ankasa cryptography no ankyerɛ bio sɛ sika biara a ahintaw a ɛwɔ mu no yɛ nokware. Nnɔmba a ɛwɔ atifi hɔ no yɛ mfonini a wɔayɛ no mmerɛw. Na mfomso ankasa no wɔ ɔmansin no akontaabu fã pɔtee bi mu, na ɛnyɛ sika a ɛkɔ mu na efi mu no dodow ankasa. Asɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ woyi fi hɔ ara ne sɛ soundness bug betumi ama wɔayɛ value wɔ pool no mu a wɔrenhu. Nea ɛho hia no, adanse biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde bɔne no dii dwuma da, adanse biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛkaa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no sika, na adanse biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ZEC a wɔde ma nyinaa sesae. Wɔnam ahobammɔ ho nhwehwɛmu so huu no na wosiesiee ansa na ɛrepira biara a wonim. Mmuae a wɔde mae Zcash mpɔtam hɔfo de nneɛma a wɔasiesie no kɔmaa wɔn wɔ akwan horow so sen sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ prɛko pɛ. Wɔ June 2026 mfiase no, bere tiaa mu adeyɛ bi maa Orchard pool no yɛɛ adwuma bere a na wɔresiesie nsiesie a edi mũ no. NU6.2 upgrade no siesiee Orchard circuit no ankasa, na ɛtoo soundness mmerɛwyɛ a ɛwɔ ase no mu. NU6.3 a wɔayɛ no foforo, Ironwood, de ɔtare a wɔabɔ ho ban foforo ne ɔmanfo nhwehwɛmubea ba sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a bo betumi afi Orchard ɔtare dedaw no mu wɔ akontaabu a edi mũ ase. Nea Ironwood ɔtare no yɛ NU6.2 bɔɔ Orchard amansin no ho ban maa nnwuma foforɔ nyinaa, nanso boɔ a wɔabɔ wɔ mmara dedaw no ase no da so ara te Orchard pool no mu. title: So Zcash yɛ nea ɛwɔ Quantum akyi?
description: Efi bere a wɔyɛɛ Ironwood nkɔso no, Zcash yɛ quantum-recoverable ma sika a wɔde asie wɔ Ironwood pool no mu. Ɛno yɛ anammɔn ankasa, nanso ɛnyɛ ade koro ne sɛ…
text: So Zcash yɛ nea ɛwɔ Quantum akyi? Mmuae tiawa Dabi, ennya nyɛɛ saa. Efi bere a wɔyɛɛ Ironwood nkɔso no, Zcash yɛ quantum-recoverable ma sika a wɔde asie wɔ Ironwood pool no mu. Ɛno yɛ anammɔn ankasa, nanso ɛnyɛ ade koro ne sɛ wobɛtra quantum akyi ahobammɔ. ZIP 2005, spec a ɛwɔ n'akyi no ka saa tẽẽ: nsakrae no "mma n'ankasa mma protocol no nyɛ ahobammɔ wɔ quantum atamfo ho". Ɛsiesie Ironwood sika sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi de akɔ daakye Recovery Protocol mu bere a wɔadum mprempren cryptography no pɛn no. Saa krataafa yi tetew nea Zcash bɔ ho ban nnɛ, nea Ironwood sesaa, nea ɛda so ara da adi, ne nea ɛyɛ nsusuwii ara kwa. No tebea pon so bɛn awiei no kyerɛ baabi a afã biara gyina ne bere a etwa to a wɔhwɛɛ mu. Hena na eyi yɛ ma no Obiara a wahu "quantum-recoverable" na wakenkan no sɛ "quantum-proof" Holders a wɔresi gyinae sɛ ebia wɔde sika bɛkɔ Ironwood Akyerɛwfo ne ahwɛfo a wohia mmuae a wonya fi mu a wɔde bɛtwe adwene asi nkurɔfo so Sɛ wopɛ quantum computing ankasa ho nsɛm a, fi ase fi ase Akwantuo akyi Ahobanbɔ wɔ Zcash. Nea enti a asɛmmisa no yɛ nea ɛyɛ basaa "Post-quantum" nya su te sɛ nea ɛyɛ agyapade biako. Wɔ Zcash no anyɛ yiye koraa no ɛyɛ nsɛmmisa anan a ɛsono emu biara, na ɛsono mmuae: Privacy. So quantum attacker betumi ahu nea otuaa hena ne sika dodow ahe? Spending. So quantum attacker betumi asɛe sika a ɛnyɛ wɔn de? Inflation. So quantum attacker betumi abɔ ZEC afi biribiara mu? Recovery. Sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wodum mprempren cryptography no a, so nokwaredifo a wɔde di dwuma no da so ara betumi anya wɔn sika afi mu? Ironwood sesa asɛmmisa a ɛto so anan no mmuae nkutoo, na ɛyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Ironwood ɔtare no mu nkutoo. Ahunahuna a ɛwɔ eyi nyinaa akyi ne ɔtowhyɛfo a obetumi abu discrete logarithms wɔ elliptic curves a Zcash de di dwuma no so. Quantum kɔmputa kɛse a ɛdɔɔso a ɛde Shor algorithm di dwuma no bɛyɛ ɔkwan biako a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ saa. ZIP 2005 kyerɛ sɛ single discrete logarithm a wobɛhwehwɛ no dɔɔso sɛ ɛbɛma nneɛma bo akɔ soro a wopɛ anaasɛ wobɛwia sika. Nea Zcash bɔ ho ban nnɛ Saa pon yi kyerɛkyerɛ protocol no mu sɛnea ɛretu mmirika mprempren, tia ɔtowhyɛfo a obetumi abubu discrete logarithms. Ɛfa ɔtare biara a wɔabɔ ho ban ho, Ironwood ka ho, ɛfiri sɛ Ironwood de Orchard circuit, Halo 2 adanseɛ ne RedPallas nsaano nkyerɛwee korɔ no ara di dwuma sɛ Orchard. Agyapadeɛ Tia quantum ntuafo nnɛ Nea Ironwood sesae --- --- --- Kokoamusɛm Kura sɛ ɔtowhyɛfo no nnim wo address a wɔabɔ ho ban no a. Adanse ne nsaano nkyerɛwee a wɔasan ayɛ no foforo biara ntumi nkɔ. Sɛ ɔtowhyɛfo no nim address no ampa a, wobetumi decrypt nsɛm a wɔde amena no, a dedaw a wɔakora so afi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu ka ho. Hwee. ZIP 2005: "Tebea a ɛfa Privacy ho no nsakrae mma pool biara." Sika a wɔsɛe no Ɛnyɛ nea wɔabɔ ho ban. Obi a ɔtow hyɛ nkurɔfo so betumi ayɛ adanse atoro anaasɛ wasɛe nsaano nkyerɛwee na wawia ade afi ɔtare biara a wɔabɔ ho ban mu, wɔ address ahorow a wonhuu bi da mpo ho. Biribiara nni hɔ de besi nnɛ. Ahobanbɔ no ba bere a woadan daakye akɔ Recovery Protocol no so akyi nkutoo. Nneɛma boɔ sorokɔ Ɛnyɛ nea wɔabɔ ho ban. Obi a ɔtow hyɛ nkurɔfo so betumi ayɛ adanse a ɛte sɛ nea ɛfata na wayɛ ZEC wɔ ɔtare biara a wɔabɔ ho ban mu, ebia obiara renhu. Anohyeto biako pɛ ne.. turnstile a wɔde dannan nneɛma: ɔtare biara ntumi ntua sika a ɛboro ne sika a wɔakyerɛw ato hɔ no so. Biribiara nni hɔ de besi nnɛ. Ironwood nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw mprempren de wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn mu nsɛm nyinaa mu wɔ ɔkwan bi so a ɛnsɛ sɛ quantum ntuafo tumi yɛ atoro, a ɛno ne nea daakye Recovery Protocol hia na ama nneɛma a wɔde ma no akɔ so ayɛ nea ɛfata. Pɛ deɛ ayera Sprout, Sapling ne Orchard nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no nni ɔkwan biara a wɔfa so san nya ahoɔden. Sɛ wodum wɔn protocol ahorow no wie a, biribiara a aka wɔ wɔn mu no bɛyɛ nea wontumi nkɔ hɔ. Ironwood krataa biara yɛ nea wobetumi asan anya wɔ nnyinasosɛm mu. Sapling anaa Orchard nkyerɛwde biara nni hɔ a ɛte saa. Transparent ZEC yɛ asɛm a ɛyɛ soronko. text: Zcash Lightwallet Nodes a ɛwɔ hɔ no TL;DR Nnipa dodow no ara nam sika kotoku a emu yɛ hare so de Zcash di dwuma, a ɛntwe blockchain no nyinaa. Mmom no, ɛne server bi a ayɛ saa adwuma no dedaw kasa. Software asinasin mmienu som sika kotokuo a emu yɛ hare nnɛ: lightwalletd, mfitiaseɛ dwumadie a wɔkyerɛw no Go, ne Zaino, indexer foforɔ a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Rust mu. Wo safe no mfi wo mfiri no mu da, na server no ntumi nsɛe wo sika anaasɛ nkenkan sika dodow ne memos a ɛwɔ nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ban koraa mu. Nea server no wɔ beae pa sɛ wubesua ne wo IP address ne bere a wo dwumadi — shielded transactions bɔ nea ɛkɔ blockchain no so ho ban, ɛnyɛ wo nkitahodi ne server no. Tor yi IP nkyerɛkyerɛmu no fi hɔ; ɛwɔ sika kotoku a wɔde asi so mu zcashclientbackend, na wɔ ZODL mu no ɛyɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ Advanced Settings mu. Wubetumi asesa server a wo sika kotoku no de di dwuma, anaasɛ wobɛma w’ankasa de ayɛ adwuma — lightwalletd ne Zaino nyinaa yɛ open source. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Nnipa dodow no ara nam sika kotoku a emu yɛ hare so de Zcash di dwuma, a ɛntwe blockchain no nyinaa. Mmom no, ɛne server bi a ayɛ saa adwuma no dedaw kasa. Saa krataafa yi kyerɛkyerɛ nea saa server ahorow no yɛ, nea wobetumi ahu ne nea wontumi nhu fa wo ho, sɛnea wobɛfa wo nkitahodi no so wɔ Tor so, ne sɛnea wobɛsesa server a wo sika kotoku de di dwuma no. Software abien na ɛsom sika kotoku a emu yɛ hare nnɛ. lightwalletd yɛ mfitiaseɛ dwumadie, a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Go mu. Zaino yɛ indexer foforo a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Rust mu, a wɔasi sɛ zcashd deprecation adwuma no fã. Nea light wallet server yɛ Sika kotoku server a ɛyɛ hare te wo sika kotoku ne Zcash blockchain ntam na ɛma ɛyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no ho hwɛbea a ɛyɛ den wɔ bandwidth mu. Ɛyɛ nneɛma abiɛsa ma wo. Ɛsom compact blocks. Sɛ́ anka ɛde blocks mũ no nyinaa bɛmena no, ɛde kratasin ketewaa bi a nea sika kotoku hia na ama wɔahu sika a wɔatua nkutoo na ɛwɔ mu kɔ ne address a wɔabɔ ho ban no so, ahu sika a wɔsɛee no wɔ ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no so, na ama n’adansefo ayɛ foforo. Ɛde wo nnwuma no kɔma afoforo. Sɛ wode mena a, wo sika kotoku no de asɛm a woawie no ma server no, na ɛde kɔ network no so. Ɛbua nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nsɛmmisa, te sɛ mprempren ɔsorokɔ ne sikatua ho nsɛm a wo sika kotoku hia. Wo sika kotoku no da so ara yɛ kokoam adwuma no wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Ɛkura wo nsafe, ɛsɔ blocks hwɛ de hwehwɛ wo nsɛm a woakyerɛw, na ɛkyekyere na ɛde ne nsa hyɛ nnwuma ase wɔ wo mfiri no so. Nea server no betumi ahu ne nea entumi nhu Eyi ne ɔfã a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wubenya mfomso. Wo safe no mfi wo mfiri no mu da, nanso ɛno ne sɛ server no nsua wo ho hwee. Nsɛm a wɔde gyina hɔ ma wɔ ha ne Zcash sika kotoku app ahunahuna nhwɛso, a sɛ eyi ho hia wo a, ɛfata sɛ wokenkan ne nyinaa. Ɛde ɔtamfo ahorow pii si hɔ. Nea ɛho hia ma krataafa yi ne ɔtamfo a obetumi ahwɛ traffic a ɛda wo sika kotoku ne intanɛt ntam, ne server ne intanɛt ntam. Obiara a ɔde server no di dwuma no fi awosu mu wɔ saa gyinabea no fã bi, efisɛ wo sika kotoku no ne wɔn di nkitaho tẽẽ. Fi ase fi nea wɔabɔ ho ban no so. Wɔ ɔtamfo biara a ɔwɔ model no mu, a obi a wasɛe server no ka ho, "entumi nsua ɔdefo no cryptographic key material biara (spending keys, viewing keys, seed phrase, ne nea ɛkeka ho)", entumi nwia wo sika, na entumi mma womfa sika a woanhyɛ da sɛ wode bɛmena no nkɔ. Sika dodow ne memos a ɛwɔ nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ban koraa mu no kɔ so yɛ encrypted. Afei nea wɔammɔ ho ban nso wɔ hɔ. Ahunahuna nhwɛso no bobɔ eyinom din sɛ mmerɛwyɛ ahorow a wonim wɔ ɔtamfo a ɔhwɛ kar akwan so ho: Mmerɛwyɛ Sɛnea :-- :-- Woreka onipa ko a woyɛ "Ɔtamfo no nim ɔdefo no IP address, a ebetumi ama wɔakɔ ɔdefo no nipasu ankasa so" Telling roughly baabi a wowɔ Wo IP a wobɛhwehwɛ "wɔ geolocation database mu de abɛn wɔn beae" Saa asɛm no a wobɛka ne bere a wode asɛm a wɔabɔ ho ban kɔmaa anaa wo nsa kaa Sending "de bandwidth pii di dwuma, a ɛda adi ɛwom mpo sɛ wɔde encrypted nkitahodi no". Model no hyɛ no nsow sɛ adeyɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔde nneɛma bɛmena na wɔagye no da adi wɔ server no ankasa so Nkitahodi dodow a woayɛ wɔ bere tenten mu a

title: NU5
description: NU5 kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 1,687,104 (May 31, 2022 UTC).
text: NU5 NU5 kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 1,687,104 (May 31, 2022 UTC). Nea wobɛfa: sɛnea NU5 maa Zcash shielded pool foforo a enhia nhyehyɛe a wogye di, ne address type biako a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ pool ahorow nyinaa so. NU5 (Network Upgrade 5) yɛ Zcash a ɛtɔ so nsia network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, a wɔde di dwuma denam ZIP 252 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Ɛyɛ cryptographic upgrade kɛse. Ɛde Orchard shielded payment protocol, a wɔasi wɔ Halo 2 proving system so, a Addresses a wɔaka abom ne version 5 transaction format foforo ka ho bae. NU5 a wɔde kɔmaa wɔ Electric Coin Company's zcashd v5.0.0 a wɔayi no adi no mu. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Ɔtare a wɔabɔ ho ban no yɛ nea wotumi de ho to so te sɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛɛ no no ara pɛ. Zcash's atare abien a edi kan a wɔabɔ ho ban, Sprout ne Sapling, biara hia nhyehyɛe guasodeyɛ a wogye di pɛnkoro na ama wɔanya wɔn kokoam parameters. Sɛ wɔkora saa parameters no so da bi sen sɛ wɔbɛsɛe no a, anka obi betumi atintim ZEC atoro a obiara renhu. NU5's Orchard pool no to saa dadwen no mu denam Halo 2 proving system a enhia guasodeyɛ a ɛte saa a wɔde di dwuma no so. Nhyehyɛe a wotumi de ho to so no Orchard yɛ shielded protocol a NU5, a wɔakyerɛ aseɛ wɔ ZIP 224 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Wɔasi no wɔ Halo 2 proving system so, a ɛde ɔkwan bi a wɔfrɛ no PLONKish arithmetization di dwuma wɔ Pallas ne Vesta curve cycle no so. Akatua a mfaso wɔ so no yɛ mmerɛw: Halo 2 nhia nhyehyɛe a wotumi de ho to so na enhia reference string a wɔahyehyɛ, enti kokoam parameter biara nni hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma ɔkwammɔne so da. Sprout ne Sapling nyinaa gyina nhyehyɛe a wotumi de ho to so so. Nnipa kuw bi tuu mmirika yɛɛ guasodeyɛ bi de kyekyee ɔtare biara parameters, na na ɛsɛ sɛ obiara nya ahotoso sɛ anyɛ yiye koraa no wɔn mu biako sɛee wɔn ahintasɛm no fã bi. Orchard yi saa adwene no fi hɔ. Pool dedaw no da so ara wɔ hɔ wɔ NU5, enti no-setup guarantee no fa sika a wokura wɔ Orchard pool no mu no ho. Nea NU5 sesae NU5 boaboa nsakraeɛ pii a wɔpene so, ne nyinaa bom yɛ adwuma wɔ block 1,687,104. Ɛde Orchard shielded pool (ZIP 224), Halo 2 a egyina protocol a yɛaka ho asɛm wɔ atifi hɔ no kaa ho. Ɛde version 5 transaction format (ZIP 225) kaa ho, nhyehyeɛ a wɔasan asiesie a ɛwɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma transparent, Sapling, ne Orchard data foforɔ. Woyii Sprout fields no fii hɔ, na version 4 format dedaw no kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma bere a wɔde yɛɛ adwuma akyi. Ɛde Unified Addresses ne unified viewing keys (ZIP 316) bae, a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ ɔfã a edi hɔ no mu. Ɛfaa transaction identifier non-malleability (ZIP 244), ɔkwan foforo a wɔfa so bu transaction’s id a ɛtetew nea asɛm bi yɛ fi adanse ne nsaano nkyerɛwee a ɛma ho kwan no ho. Ɛfaa canonical Jubjub point encodings (ZIP 216) de yii encodings a ɛnyɛ gyinapɛn na ɛhyɛɛ mmara a ɛfa nea wɔbu sɛ ɛyɛ asɛm a ɛfata ho no mu den. Ɛmaa relay a ɛfa version 5 nkitahodi ho wɔ peer-to-peer network (ZIP 239) no nyinaa so tumi yɛɛ adwuma. NU5 nso yɛɛ ZIP dodoɔ bi a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no foforɔ (32, 203, 209, 212, 213, 221, ne 401) enti wɔbu akontaa ma Orchard pool foforɔ no. Address ahorow a Wɔaka abom Ansa na NU5, na pool biara wɔ n’ankasa address type, na na ɛsɛ sɛ obi a ɔde nneɛma mena no hu nea wopɛ. Address ahorow a Wɔaka abom, a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 316 na ɛwɔ hɔ, sesa saa. Unified Address biako betumi aboaboa receivers ano ama bɛboro pool biako, enti nea ɔde kɔma no sika kotoku no paw nea eye sen biara a ɛboa no ara kwa. Unified viewing keys yɛ adwuma ɔkwan koro no ara so ma hwɛ. Wɔma wotumi hu akenkan nkutoo wɔ atare ahorow no atifi a address bi kata so. Sɛ wopɛ ɛno ho nsɛm pii a, hwɛ.. Nneɛma a Wɔde Hwɛ Nneɛma kratafa. Baabi NU5 te NU5 dii Zcash's nkɔsoɔ a ɛdi kan no akyi: Overwinter, Sapling, Blossom, Heartwood, ne Canopy. It activated on mainnet on May 31, 2022. Wɔpaw Orchard's curve cycle efisɛ ɛboa recursion, a ɛyɛ fapem ma akyiri yi scaling adwuma. NU5 yɛ nea edii NU6 ne NU6.x line of upgrades anim tẽẽ, a ɛkyekyee wɔ Orchard pool no so na akyiri yi ɛyɛɛ patched no. Nsɛmfua Nkyerɛase Asɛmfua Plain-English asekyer

title: NU6
description: NU6 kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 2,726,400 (November 23, 2024 UTC).
text: NU6 NU6 kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 2,726,400 (November 23, 2024 UTC). Nea wobɛfa: sɛnea Zcash kɔ so de sika boa n’ankasa nkɔso bere a wɔatew so fã akyi, nea enti a ɛde sika a wɔde asie a na ennya nnim sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma no sii hɔ, ne sɛnea ɛmaa ZEC nneɛma a wɔde bɛma nyinaa yɛ nea wotumi hyɛ ho nkɔm pɛpɛɛpɛ. NU6 yɛ Zcash network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, a wɔde di dwuma denam ZIP 253 na ɛwɔ hɔ, a ɛyɛɛ adwuma wɔ mainnet so wɔ November 2024 mu wɔ block 2,726,400. Ɛyɛ sika ne... nkɔso-sika a wɔde ma upgrade: ɛmaa block subsidy no mu kyɛfa kɔɔ nkɔsoɔ mu twaa November 2024 mu fã, ɛde in-protocol reserve sii hɔ maa daakye mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔasi gyinaeɛ sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma, na ɛhyɛɛ sɛdeɛ wɔkan ZEC foforɔ no mu den. Electric Coin Company ne Zcash Foundation nyinaa na wɔpenee NU6 so. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Zcash deɛ Nkɔso Foto na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ ɛbɛba awiei bɛyɛ November 2024 mu fã a wɔbɛtew so no, na ɛno ne nea ɛto so abien wɔ n’abakɔsɛm mu. NU6 maa saa sika no kɔɔ so, nanso sɛ anka ɛde sika biara bɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔgye no daa no nsa no, ɛde kyɛfa bi siee protocol no mu sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛtumi asi deɛ wɔde bɛyɛ ho gyinaeɛ akyiri yi. Ɛsan nso too akontaabu mu nsonsonoe a ɛyɛ komm mu, enti afei wobetumi ahyɛ ZEC dodow a ɛbɛba da no nyinaa ho nkɔm pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nea NU6 sesae NU6 kɔɔ so de block subsidy no 20% kɔmaa nkɔsoɔ sika wɔ November 2024 a wɔtew so fã akyi, mmara a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 1015 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Ɛkyekyɛɛ saa 20% no mu akwan mmienu. Block subsidy no mu 8% kɔ Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), a sika a wɔde ma mpɔtam hɔfoɔ na wɔyɛ adwuma ma wɔn. 12% kɔ in-protocol lockbox foforo mu, a wɔakora so ama daakye mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔasi gyinae sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma. Block subsidy a aka, ne transaction fees, kɔma wɔn a wotu fam a wɔbɔ network no ho ban no. NU6 nso yɛɛ funding-stream ne dev-fund mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw (ZIP 207 ne ZIP 214) no foforo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛfata nhyehyɛe foforo yi. Adaka a wɔde tow adaka a wɔatu ahyɛ da no 12% kyɛfa no yɛ adwene foforo a ɛwɔ NU6 mu. Sɛ anka wɔbɛtua no akɔ address a wɔde gye no so no, wɔde saa boɔ no kɔto in-protocol pool a wɔfrɛ no Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox, a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 2001 na ɔkyerɛwee. Lockbox no yɛ funding-stream type foforɔ (DEFERREDPOOL), a block-reward boɔ kɔ protocol no ankasa mu, ɛnyɛ onipa anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ bi. Network no di no akyi sɛ n’ankasa chain value pool balance, ɔkwan koro no ara a ɛfa so di balances a ɛwɔ shielded pools no akyi no. NU6 hyɛɛ da yɛɛ lockbox no nanso wogyaw asɛmmisa a ɛyɛ den no sɛ: hena na odi saa sika no so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wogyae? Wɔmaa saa asɛmmisa no ho mmuae akyiri yi denam NU6.1, a ɛde nnisoɔ no sii hɔ: ɛtoaa 8% block-subsidy stream no so kɔɔ Zcash Community Grants na ɛkyerɛɛ 12% stream kɔɔ sikakorabea a coin-holder-controlled fund a lockbox no guu mu. Nhoma ahorow no a wɔbɛkari pɛ NU6 nso too akontabuo mu nsonsonoeɛ bi mu wɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbɔ ZEC foforɔ, a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 236 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Coinbase nkitahodi ne nnwuma titiriw a etua block biara ZEC foforo ne ɛka. Ansa na NU6 reba no, na ɛsɛ sɛ coinbase asɛm bi nnye nea ɛboro nea wɔde ka no nkutoo. Ná obi a otu fam betumi aka sɛ ennu mmoa a wɔde ma no nyinaa, na ɛno hyew saa ZEC no komm. NU6 akyi no, ɛsɛ sɛ coinbase asɛm bi kari pɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ: ɛsɛ sɛ nea efi mu ba nyinaa bo yɛ pɛ ne miner subsidy ne fees, ɛnnɔɔso na ɛnnɔɔso. Esiane sɛ wɔn a wotu fagude no ntumi nnye ZEC ntom bio na wɔhyew ZEC wɔ akwanhyia mu nti, mprempren wobetumi ahyɛ ZEC dodow a ɛbɛba da biara ho nkɔm pɛpɛɛpɛ. Sɛnea sikasɛm mu nkɔso bae NU6 yɛ ti biako wɔ asɛm tenten bi mu a ɛfa sɛnea Zcash tua ne ho ka ho. Canopy (2020) de mfitiaseɛ founders akatua no baa awieeɛ na ɔbɔɔ... nkɔso sikakorabea. NU6 (November 2024) san hyehyɛɛ saa sika no wɔ fã a ɛtɔ so mmienu no akyi na wɔde Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox sii hɔ, de kyɛfa a wɔde bɛma no siee maa daakye mmoa a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ asi ho gyinaeɛ. NU6.1 (2025) buaa asɛmmisa a NU6 gyaa hɔ, a ɔhwɛ sika a wɔde asie no so, denam block subsidy no 8% a ɔtoaa so maa Zcash Community Grants

title: NU6.1
description: NU6.1 kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 3,146,400 (November 24, 2025 UTC).
text: NU6.1 NU6.1 kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 3,146,400 (November 24, 2025 UTC). Nea wobɛfa: sɛnea Zcash tua n’ankasa nkɔso ho ka a adwumakuw biara nni so, ne sɛnea NU6.1 maa mpɔtam hɔfo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ sika no nyaa asɛm tẽẽ wɔ saa sika no mu. NU6.1 yɛ Zcash network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 255 na ɛwɔ hɔ, a ɛde sikasɛm ne nniso nhyehyɛe foforo sii hɔ maa Zcash nkɔso. Ɛsi baabi a block akatua no fã bi kɔ ne nea ɔhwɛ so ho gyinae, na ɛsan nso de mfiridwuma mu nsiesie nketenkete kakraa bi kɔe. NU6.1 no, Electric Coin Company ne Zcash Foundation nyinaa na wɔpenee so. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Software dodow no ara yɛ nea adwumakuw bi tua ho ka. Zcash yɛ decentralized network a enni owura baako, enti ɛhyia asɛmmisa a ɛyɛ den: ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɛde sika ama nnipa a wɔkɔ so si no, wɔ ɔkwan bi so a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ de wɔn ho to so? NU6.1 yɛ Zcash mmuaeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren. Ɛde block biara akatua no fã bi kɔ atare abien mu, biako ma mpɔtam hɔ mmoa ne biako a sika wuranom ankasa di so. Sika a wɔde ma ho nhwɛso no NU6.1 kyekyɛ block akatua biara mu abiɛsa. Kyɛfa kɛse, bɛyɛ ɔha biara mu nkyem 80, kɔ wɔn a wotu fam a wɔbɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe no ho ban no nkyɛn. Ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 8 kɔ Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), a sika a wɔde ma mpɔtam hɔfoɔ na wɔyɛ adwuma ma wɔn. ɔha biara mu nkyem 12 kɔ sikakorabea foforo a sika wuranom di so, a Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox na ɛde aba. Wɔakyerɛkyerɛ saa nhwɛsoɔ yi mmara mu wɔ ZIP 1016 na ɛwɔ hɔ, na wɔtena hɔ kɔsi Zcash fã a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, a ɛma mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nya berɛ hwɛ sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ adwuma ansa na wɔayɛ no daa anaa wɔasesa. Hena na odi sika-kura sikakorabea no so Asuten a ɛyɛ ɔha biara mu nkyem 12 no ne adwene foforo no. Sɛ́ anka adwumakuw anaa fapem bi besi sɛnea wɔde bedi dwuma ho gyinae no, wɔn a wɔwɔ sika no bom si gyinae sɛ wobeyi saa sika no adi anaasɛ wobekura mu. Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox a wɔyɛɛ no ​​wɔ NU6 nkɔsoɔ a atwam no mu no, na ɛgu saa sikakorabea yi. Wɔn a wɔwɔ sika no bom si gyinae sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ sika no ama abɔde a nkwa wom ho adwuma anaasɛ wɔbɛto mu. Eyi ma nnipa a wokura ZEC no nya nne tẽẽ wɔ sɛnea Zcash tua ne daakye ho ka. Nsiesiei nketewa no NU6.1 nso tew mfiridwuma mu nneɛma abien ho. Ansa na NU6.1 reba no, na RPC akwan bi nhu sika a wɔayiyi afiri Orchard pool no mu yie, enti sika a aka ne sika a wɔtua no betumi ayɛ sɛ ɛnteɛ wɔ sika kotokuo ne nhwehwɛmufoɔ mu. NU6.1 siesiee saa asɛm no. Ɛsesaa zcashd sika kotoku default no sɛ ɛbɛkyekyere version 5 nkitahodi, format a wodii kan de bae wɔ NU5 mu, sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ version 4. Version 4 nkitahodi no tra hɔ. Sɛnea Zcash sika a wɔde ma no nyaa nkɔso NU6.1 yɛ anammɔn baako wɔ asɛm tenten bi a ɛfa sɛdeɛ Zcash tua n’ankasa nkɔsoɔ ho ka. Canopy (2020) de mfitiaseɛ founders akatua no baa awieeɛ na ɔbɔɔ a nkɔso sikakorabea. NU6 (2024) hyehyɛɛ Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox, de kyɛfa a wɔde bɛma no siee maa daakye mmoa a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ asi ho gyinaeɛ. title: NU6.2
description: NU6.2 kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC).
text: NU6.2 NU6.2 kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC). Nea wobɛfa akɔ: nea NU6.2 siesiee, nea enti a Zcash gyaee shielded transactions bɛyɛ da koro, ne sɛnea network no too tokuru no mu a wanhwere sika biara. NU6.2 yɛ Zcash network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so wɔ ZIP 257 na ɛwɔ hɔ, a ɛsan maa Orchard shielded protocol no yɛɛ adwuma bere a wogyaee ntɛm ara akyi. Ɛsiesiee soundness bug bi a ɛwɔ Orchard's zero-knowledge circuit no mu na ɛsan de sii hɔ wɔabɔ ho ban nkitahodi ahorow. Fa no sɛ ɛyɛ Orchard mmoawa ho asɛm no ti a ɛfa ntɛmpɛ a wosiesie ho. Nkɔso a wɔde di akyi no, Ironwood (NU6.3), afei ɔde ɔtare foforo ne ɔmanfo akontaabu a ɛfa dedaw no ho kaa ho. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Orchard ne baabi a ankorankoro Zcash sikatua dodow no ara kɔ so. Bere a wohuu sintɔ bi wɔ akontaabu a ɛma saa ɔtare no yɛ nokware no mu no, na nkitahodibea no hyia ɔkwan a emu yɛ den a wɔbɛpaw: ma nkitahodi a wɔabɔ ho ban no nkɔ so a asiane bi a wonim wom, anaasɛ gyae kosi sɛ wobesiesie no. NU6.2 ne sɛnea Zcash dii kan paw ahobammɔ na ɛda so ara san de kokoamsɛm ba wɔ da koro mu. Deɛn na ɛsiiɛ Na nea ɛkanyan no ne soundness bug wɔ Orchard's Action circuit mu, akontaabu a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ asɛm biara a wɔabɔ ho ban no di mmara no so. Nhwehwɛmufo a ɔde ne ho Taylor Hornby huu no bere a a Labs a Wɔabɔ ho Ban audit na ɔdaa no adi wɔ asɛdeɛ mu wɔ May 2026. Na ɛte hɔ a obiara nhu firi berɛ a Orchard hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2022 mu, na wɔ nsusuiɛ mu no ɛbɛtumi ama asɛm bi a ɛnnyɛ adwuma atwam sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma, a ɛbɛtumi ama wɔawia sika anaa wɔasɛe no mmɔho mmienu wɔ Orchard pool no mu. Zcash's turnstile akontaabu da so ara capped sɛnea bo a ɛsom betumi afi Orchard, enti ZEC nneɛma a wɔde ma nyinaa no ankasa antumi ankɔ soro, nanso sintɔ bi a ɛwɔ akontaabu no mu a ɛma sika a wɔabɔ ho ban no kɔ so yɛ nokware no yɛ aniberesɛm, enti network no yɛɛ ade wɔ nna kakraa bi mu. No Ironwood krataafa no kyerɛkyerɛ bɔne no mu ne sɛnea ebetumi ayɛ mfaso koraa. Gyinabea a egye ntɛmpɛ no Wɔ June 2, 2026 no, ntɛmpɛ soft fork bi maa Orchard nnwuma nyinaa yɛɛ adwuma bere tiaa bi. Wɔde kɔmaa sɛ hotfix wɔ zcashd v6.12.5 ne zebra v4.5.3 mu. Wɔgyaee Shielded Orchard sends ne receives, enti wɔantumi anyɛ Orchard adanse foforo biara anaasɛ wonnye ntom. Transparent ne Sapling nkitahodi kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma sɛnea ɛsɛ. Wɔamfa sika biara ankɔ baabi foforo, wɔamfa anhyɛ nwini mu, anaasɛ wɔanhwere. Gyinabea no gyaee Orchard dwumadi foforo nkutoo bere a na wɔawie nsiesie ankasa no. Nea NU6.2 sesae Ade kyee, June 3, 2026, NU6.2 hard fork no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ block 3,364,600 na ɛsan maa Orchard yɛɛ adwuma wɔ circuit a wɔateɛteɛ mu. Ɛsiesiee Action circuit no variable-base scalar multiplication gadget no denam anohyeto ahorow a ɛyerae a ɛde kaa ho no so. Ɛno maa wonya safe foforo a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware, enti adanse a wɔyɛe wɔ ɔmansin dedaw a mfomso wom no ase no ntumi nyɛ nokware bio, na ɛsɛ sɛ adanse foforo biara de nea wɔateɛteɛ no di dwuma. Ɛmaa adanse tenten pɔtee no yɛɛ mmara a wɔpene so, na ɛtoo ɔkwan bi a na wɔmfa nni dwuma kan no mu. Kood a wɔateɛteɛ no de kɔmaa wɔ zcashd v6.20.0 ne zebra v5.0.0, a wɔasi wɔ halo2gadgets v0.5.0 ne nnuaba turo adaka v0.14.0 so. Nea NU6.2 anyɛ NU6.2 bɔɔ ɔmansin no ho ban maa asɛm foforo biara, nanso bo a wɔabɔ wɔ mmara dedaw no ase no da so ara te Orchard pool no mu. Saa bo a ɛsom no ho akontaabu na wɔde akɔ ɔtare a ɛho tew mu no yɛ adwuma a ɛda nsow, na ɛno ne nea ɛyɛ Ironwood (NU6.3) nsa ne ne ɔtare foforo ne turnstile. So na biribiara ayera Dabi, adanse biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde bɔne no dii dwuma da, wɔannyɛ bo a ɛsom a wɔmma ho kwan, na ennyaa nkɛntɛnso biara wɔ sika a wɔde di dwuma no so. Zcash's turnstile akontaabu sii so dua sɛ nneɛma a wɔde mae nyinaa kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma wɔ adeyɛ no nyinaa mu. title: Nneɛma a Wɔde Hwɛ Nneɛma a Wɔde Kɔ Afiri (OVKs)
description: Outgoing viewing key (OVK) yɛ 32-byte botae a wɔde di dwuma de encrypt outgoing ciphertext a ɛwɔ shielded output mu nkutoo. Ɛma ɔfã bi nya nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no…
text: Nneɛma a Wɔde Hwɛ Nneɛma a Wɔde Kɔ Afiri (OVKs) Outgoing viewing key (OVK) yɛ 32-byte botae a wɔde di dwuma de encrypt outgoing ciphertext a ɛwɔ shielded output mu nkutoo. Ɛma ɔfã bi nya nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no pefee a wɔde kɔmaa no (address a wɔde kɔmaa no, ne bo, ne memo) a entumi nsɛe sika anaasɛ enhu nkyerɛwde a ɛba. Bere nyinaa nea ogye no de n’ankasa hwɛ safe a ɛba no decrypt krataa a ɛba no. OVK a wɔpaw no nsakra nea nea wɔde ma no no hu. Encoding a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn biara nni hɔ ma OVK a wɔanhyehyɛ no yiye; ɛyɛ baiti 32 kɛkɛ. TL;DR OVK na ɛhwɛ nea obetumi asan anya nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a efi sika a wɔabɔ ho ban mu no nkutoo so. Walets paw nhyehyɛe abiɛsa bi: Sender (wɔde sika a wɔtaa de ba a wɔde akontaabu no UFVK di dwuma), Custom (wɔsan de safe a wode ma), anaa Discard (obiara ntumi nsan nnye nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a ɛrekɔ no mfi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu). Wɔ Discard anaa custom OVK mpo mu no, UFVK wura da so ara hu sika a wɔsɛee no na obetumi abu sika a efi akontaabu no mu no ho akontaa. Ɔkwan baako pɛ a wotumi de ho to so a wobɛfa so ama sika bi ayɛ nea UFVK pɔtee bi nhu ne sɛ wobɛhwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no nyɛ saa akontaabu no dea da (akonta a ɛyɛ soronko anaa sika kotoku a ɛyɛ soronko). Nhyehyɛe abiɛsa no wɔ hɔ dedaw wɔ zcashclientbackend; ɛkame ayɛ sɛ sika kotoku biara a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ no de Sender nhyehyɛe a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ no nkutoo na edi dwuma. --- Nhyehyɛe abiɛsa no Walets a wɔde asi so zcashclientbackend paw an OvkPolicy bere a wɔkyekye asɛm bi a wɔde di gua no: Nhyehyɛeɛ Nsɛm a wɔde sie a ɛkɔ abɔnten Hena na akyiri yi obetumi asan anya nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a ɛrekɔ no -------- ---------------------- ---------------------------------------------- Ɔsomafo (default) Encrypted to akontaabu no OVK a ɛyɛ daa no Akontaabu a wɔde mena no Unified Full Viewing Key Amaneɛ Encrypted to the key(s) a wode ma no Obiara a okura safe (safoa) a wɔde ama no Discard Wɔmfa OVK biara nni dwuma (ovk = ⊥) Obiara nni hɔ (nea ɔde kɔmaa no mpo) Ɔdansifo a ɔyɛ mmerɛw bɔ a Custom nhyehyeɛ a ɛfiri 32-byte botaeɛ baako mu sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a abɔnten ne emu OVK nyinaa bɛyɛ safoa korɔ. Hwɛ sɛnea OvkPolicy nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw ne ZIP 310 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Nea nhyehyɛe biara yɛ ma Sender yɛ sika kotoku suban a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa. Sɛ wɔtu asɛm no wie a, obiara a okura akontaabu no UFVK no betumi decrypt ciphertexts a ɛrekɔ no na wasan anya address a wɔde gyee no, sika dodow, ne memos no. Custom ma wo de tumi a ɛbɛma obi a ɔto so abiɛsa (auditor, payment processor, receipt system, anaa separate device) tumi a ɔde bɛtwetwe sika pɔtee a ɛrekɔ so no ma wɔn a womma wɔn viewing key no nyinaa. Wubetumi nso de bere tiaa mu safe a wotow gu wɔ asɛm no akyi adi dwuma, anaasɛ wode safe ahorow adi dwuma ama counterpartes ahorow sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a safoa biako biara renhu sika biara a wɔde rekɔ. Discard kyerɛ sɛ sika kotoku a ɛde rema no ntumi nsan nnye nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a ɛrekɔ no mfi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu. Eyi ho wɔ mfaso bere a wopɛ sɛ wotew nea wobetumi asan anya sɛ akyiri yi UFVK no ayɛ basaa a, anaasɛ bere a wohyɛ da mpɛ on-chain record a akontaabu no OVK betumi abue. Nea obi a ɔwɔ UFVK da so ara hu Sɛ wɔde Discard anaa custom OVK di dwuma mpo a, obi a ɔwɔ akontaabu no UFVK no da so ara betumi: Hu akontaabu no mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no mu nea wɔsɛee no (ɛnam nullifiers so). Hu saa nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ mu no botae ahorow. San fa nsakraeɛ nsɛm biara (wɔde encrypt wɔ incoming incoming viewing key no so, ɛnyɛ OVK). Enti bu sika a efi akontaabu no mu no ho akontaa. Nea wontumi nhu ne ankorankoro address ahorow a wɔde ma no, sika a wɔakyekyɛ mu, ne nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm no. No WalletWrite nkrataa bɔ kɔkɔ sɛ data a ɛfa nnwuma a wɔayɛ wɔ Discard ase (anaasɛ random custom OVK) no, wontumi nnya mfi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn data mu sɛ mpɔtam hɔ kyerɛwtohɔ no yera a. Sika dodow a wɔbɛkora so afi UFVK pɔtee bi mu OvkPolicy nkutoo na ɛhwɛ sɛnea wɔsan nya nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee a ɛrekɔ no so. Ɛnsie sika a wɔsɛe no anaa sika a wɔabɔ no ankasa mfi akontaabu no ankasa UFVK mu. Ɔkwan biako pɛ a wotumi de ho to so a wobɛfa so

title: Overwinter
description: Overwinter kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 347,500 (June 26, 2018 UTC).
text: Overwinter Overwinter kɔɔ so traa ase wɔ Zcash mainnet so wɔ block 347,500 (June 26, 2018 UTC). Nea wobɛfa: sɛnea Zcash suaa sɛ ɔbɛsesa n’ankasa mmara dwoodwoo, ne nea enti a saa fapem no maa akyiri yi nkɔso biara, a efi ase wɔ Sapling, tumi yɛɛ yiye. Awɔw bere mu yɛ Zcash network upgrade a wɔde yɛ adwuma, nea edi kan bere a wɔde ntam nkitahodi no fii ase akyi. Wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ Zcash Nkɔsoɔ Nsusuiɛ ahodoɔ bi mu: ZIP 200 na ɛwɔ hɔ, ZIP 201 na ɛwɔ hɔ, ZIP 202 na ɛwɔ hɔ, ZIP 203 na ɛwɔ hɔ, ne ZIP 143 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Overwinter amfa nneɛma foforo biara a wɔabɔ ho ban anhyɛ mu. Mmom no ɛmaa protocol no yɛɛ den sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a daakye upgrades betumi de amena dwoodwoo. Upgrade no yɛ documented denam... Electric Coin Company wɔ Zcash upgrade krataafa a ɛyɛ aban de no so. Nea enti a eyi ho hia. Blockchain a ɛte ase ho mmara a wobɛsakra no yɛ asiane. Get it wrong na network no nkyerɛase abien betumi ampene so, anaasɛ wobetumi ayɛ asɛm bi a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ama nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biako ho mfonini akɔ foforo so. Ansa na Overwinter reba no, na Zcash nni ɔkwan biara a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn, a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bɛsan abɔ a wɔbɛfa so ayɛ mmara nsakrae ho nhyehyɛe. Overwinter siesiee saa asɛm no. Ɛmaa Zcash yɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata ma nkɔsoɔ ne, sɛdeɛ ɛho hia saa ara no, akwan mmienu replay ahobanbɔ, enti asɛm a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ mmara baako ase no, wɔrentumi nsan nkɔbɔ bio wɔ foforɔ ase. Saa fapem adwuma no ne nea ɛmaa Sapling, ne nkɔso biara a wɔyɛe wɔ ɛno akyi no, tumi yɛɛ adwuma yiye. Adwinnade a wɔde yɛ upgrade no Overwinter de Network Upgrade Mechanism a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 200 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Mprempren upgrade biara kyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma abien mu: consensus branch id a ɛbɔ mprempren mmara ahorow no din, ne activation height, block a mmara foforo no di dwuma wɔ so. Wei ma obiara a ɔreyɛ Zcash software no nya mfɛnsere a emu da hɔ a ɔde bɛyɛ foforo ansa na wasakra. Overwinter ankasa yɛɛ adwuma wɔ mainnet so wɔ block 347,500. ZIP 201 na ɛwɔ hɔ di sɛnea nodes ne wɔn ho wɔn ho di wɔ upgrade bi ho dwuma. Ansa na wɔbɛma ayɛ adwuma no, nodes pɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ atipɛnfo a wɔde version koro no ara di dwuma no ho. Wɔ activation mu no, node bi twa nkitahodi fi atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ consensus branch soronko so, enti network no mu paapae yiye wɔ mmara foforo no so sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ basaa. Replay ahobammɔ Replay yɛ bere a obi fa asɛm bi a na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biako so na ɔsan bɔ amanneɛ wɔ foforo so. Overwinter de nsaano nkyerɛwee nhyehyɛe foforo bi to saa ɔpon no mu, a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 143 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Sɛ sika kotoku bi de ne nsa hyɛ asɛm bi ase a, afei de nsaano nkyerɛwee no hyɛ bɔ mprempren nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no consensus branch id. Adwuma a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase ama baa dwumadibea biako no nyɛ adwuma wɔ baa dwumadibea foforo biara so kɛkɛ, wɔ ɔkwan biara so. Ɛno ne nea akwan abien so replay ahobammɔ kyerɛ. Eyi yɛ adwuma nsa ne nsa ne foforo version 3 transaction format fi ZIP 202 na ɛwɔ hɔ, a ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔfrɛ no Overwintered format no. Ɛde fOverwintered frankaa ne version kuw id a ɛma ɛda adi pefee sɛ mmara a wɔpene so bɛn na asɛm bi yɛ ne dea. Sɛ́ mfaso a ɛwɔ ɔfã bi no, nhyehyɛe foforo a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ ase no nso maa sɛnea wogye nnwuma a ɛda adi pefee tom ntɛmntɛm no yɛɛ yiye. Aguadi no bere atwam ZIP 203 na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔde kaa ho sɛ asɛm no bɛba awiei. Mprempren asɛm bi betumi ahyɛ expiration block height. Sɛ wɔantu no ankɔ saa sorokɔ no so a, node ahorow no tow fi mempool, dan a wɔtwɛn wɔ nnwuma a wɔannye so dua no mu. Ansa na eyi reba no, na asɛm bi betumi atra ase a wontumi nsi so dua bere tenten. Expiry kyerɛ sɛ awiei koraa no, asɛm bi a ɛda hɔ no ankasa fi hɔ, na ɛtew adwenem naayɛ so ma wo na ɛmma mempool no nhyɛ nnwuma dedaw a wɔantu mu ma. Baabi a ɛfata Overwinter yɛ Zcash network upgrade a edi kan wɔ October 2016 mainnet a wɔde sii hɔ akyi, na ɛhyɛɛ da de kɔmaa Sapling. Ná n’adwuma ne infrastructure, na ɛnyɛ features.
