text: Zcash Shielded Agyapadeɛ TL;DR Zcash Shielded Assets (ZSA) yɛ protocol ntrɛwmu a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa a ɛbɛma agyapade a ɛnyɛ ZEC — stablecoins, governance tokens, anaa amanne agyapade biara — atra Zcash's shielded pool no mu, a nea ɔde kɔmaa, nea ogye, ne sika dodow no bɛkora kokoam. Nea ɛyɛ: ERC-20-style amanne agyapade, nanso wɔabɔ ho ban denam default so. Hena na ɔresi no: QEDIT, wɔ mmoa a efi Zcash Foundation, a wɔne Electric Coin Company. Sɛnea wɔakyerɛ: ZIP 226 na ɛwɔ hɔ (transfer na hyew) bom ne ZIP 227 na ɛwɔ hɔ (a wɔde ma). Status: ɛntena mainnet so na ɛnyɛ Network Upgrade 7 (NU7). ZIP 259 na ɛwɔ hɔ, a ɛkyerɛ biribiara a NU7 de di dwuma no, nka ZIP 226 anaa ZIP 227 ho, na wɔanhyehyɛ ZSA dwumadie da biara. Fees: bere nyinaa wotua wɔ ZEC, a agyapade a wɔretu no mfa ho. --- Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Zcash Shielded Assets (ZSA) yɛ nkɔsoɔ a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa wɔ Zcash protocol no mu a ɛbɛma wɔatumi abɔ, de akɔ baabi foforɔ, na wɔahyew amanne kwan so agyapadeɛ wɔ Zcash nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no so. Sɛ wunim no yiye a ERC-20 na ɛwɔ hɔ token gyinapɛn wɔ Ethereum blockchain no so, ZSAs yɛ Zcash sɛnea ERC-20 token yɛ Ethereum. Zcash Shielded Assets bɛma wɔatumi abɔ amanneɛ tokens wɔ Zcash blockchain no so, na ɛnam so ama tokens a ɛnyɛ ZEC sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobenya mfaso afi nsɛm a wɔmmɔ ne kokoam nsɛm a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ Zcash blockchain no so no mu. Ade titiriw a wobetumi de ZSA ahorow adi dwuma bɛyɛ sɛ wɔde stablecoins bɛma wɔ Zcash protocol no so. Stablecoins yɛ cryptocurrencies a ɛde wɔn boɔ to fiat sika so, te sɛ US Dollar anaa Euro. Mprempren, stablecoins a wɔkyekyɛ no kɛse no bi ne ERC-20 tokens te sɛ USDC ne Dai. Ade foforo a wobetumi de ZSA ahorow adi dwuma ne sɛ wɔde nniso token bɛma. Sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, ZecHub (wiki yi tintimfoɔ) yɛ Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) na ɛbɛtumi ayɛ na ɛde ZSA ama ne mufoɔ ama wɔato aba wɔ nsusuiɛ ne nnisoɔ ho gyinaesie ho. Wɔreyɛ ZSA ahorow no denam QEDIT, wɔ mmoa kɛse bi a efi Zcash Foundation wɔ biakoyɛ mu ne Electric Coin Company. Bere a wɔda so ara reyɛ adwuma yi denneennen no, wɔde nsɛm foforo gu so saa asaawa yi a ɛwɔ Zcash forum no mu. No ZSA mmoa akwammisa krataa denam QEDIT, wobetumi anya afi Zcash Foundation mmoa wɛbsaet hɔ. --- Aniwa so / Nsɛso Envelope a wɔatoto mu no Fa w’adwene bu Zcash a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ asɛm bi ho sɛ envelope a ɛnyɛ den a wɔatoto mu a wɔde agu ɔmanfo nkrataa adaka mu. Obiara betumi ahu sɛ wɔde envelope bi too hɔ. Obiara ntumi nhu onii a ɔde kɔmaa, onii a ɔboaboa ano, anaa nea ɛwɔ mu — na envelope biara te sɛ nea ɛne foforo biara yɛ pɛ. Ɛnnɛ, envelope bi a ɛwɔ Zcash network no so tumi kura ade biako pɛ: ZEC. ZSA nnsesa envelope no. Ɛsesa nea wɔma ho kwan wɔ mu. ZSA akyi no, envelope koro no ara a wɔatoto mu no betumi akura stablecoin, DAO nniso token, anaa company nokwaredi point — na sɛ wohwɛ abɔnten a, ɛbɛda so ara te sɛ envelope foforo biara a ɛwɔ network no so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ade biako a ɛfata sɛ wokura mu: wɔtua poste no bere nyinaa wɔ ZEC, ɛmfa ho nea ɛwɔ envelope no mu. Nea obi a ɔhwɛ abɔnten so betumi ahu Obi a ɔhwɛ ade betumi ahu... ERC-20 wɔ Ethereum so ZSA wɔ Zcash --- --- --- Nea ɔde kɔmaa no Dwam Wɔabɔ ho ban Nea onyaa no Dwam Wɔabɔ ho ban Hwɛ dodow a wɔkanyan no Dwam Wɔabɔ ho ban Ankorankoro a wɔkari pɛ Dwam Wɔabɔ ho ban Agyapade no nyinaa a wɔde ma Dwam Ɔmanfoɔ — wɔahyɛ da Sika a wɔde tua sika no ETH na ɔkyerɛwee ZEC Nea enti a supply row no nyɛ bɔne Ntoatoasoɔ mmienu a ɛwɔ aseɛ wɔ pon no so no ne baabi a ZSA nya anigyeɛ. ZIP 227 hyɛ da ma asɛm a wɔde ma no yɛ nea ɛda adi pefee, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi adi agyapade biara a ɛkyinkyini no akyi wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so. Ankorankoro a wokura ne ankorankoro sika a wotua no tra hɔ kokoam; token dodow a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa nyɛ saa. Wɔ stablecoin issuer fam no, saa nkabom no ne asɛm no mmom sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ apam. Wobetumi ayɛ sika a wɔde asie no ho akontaabu de atoto nneɛma a ɔmanfo betumi agye atom ho, bere a nnipa a wɔde token no di dwuma ankasa no de wɔn sika a aka ne sika a wɔatua no sie wɔn ho. Agyapade biako, nipasu biako Agyapadeɛ

title: Zcash Sikakorabea Syncing
description: Zcash de adanse a wonni nimdeɛ di dwuma de bɔ asɛm no ho nsɛm ho ban fi nnipa a wonni tumi krataa ho. Saa kokoamsɛm yi ma syncing yɛ den ma light wallets efisɛ…
text: Zcash Sikakorabea Syncing TL;DR Esiane sɛ shielded Zcash transactions sie wɔn nsɛm nti, server ntumi nhwehwɛ wallet’s balance kɛkɛ ɔkwan a ebetumi ama transparent coins te sɛ Bitcoin anaa Ethereum. Lightwallets twe “compact blocks” nketewa fi server titiriw bi so (lightwalletd) na wɔn ankasa de wɔn private keys decrypt data a ɛfa ho no. Saa blocks no a wobɛpopa na woadi ho dwuma no gye bere, enti sika kotoku de akwan a wɔfa so yɛ synch ntɛmntɛm di dwuma na ama wode wo sika adi dwuma ntɛm. Akwan a ɛda nsow: Warp Sync (YWallet), Spend-before-sync (Zcash Mobile Wallet SDK V2), Blaze Sync (Zecwallet), ne DAGSync a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa no. Mpɛn pii no, saa akwan yi de memory anaa tumi a wɔde di dwuma foforo di gua de nya synchronization ntɛmntɛm. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Sɛnea Zcash syncing yɛ adwuma Zcash de adanse a wonni nimdeɛ di dwuma de bɔ asɛm no ho nsɛm ho ban fi nnipa a wonni tumi krataa ho. Saa kokoamsɛm yi ma syncing yɛ den ma light wallets efisɛ wɔmfa blockchain mũ no nyinaa nsie wɔ mpɔtam hɔ na mmom wɔde wɔn ho to server so ma nsɛm a ɛho hia. Bitcoin anaa Ethereum, servers betumi index blockchain no na wɔasan de account data aba ntɛmntɛm. Nanso Zcash no, server no ntumi nhu asɛm a ɛfa asɛm no ho. Enti ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na sika kotoku a emu yɛ hare atumi ayɛ ne sika a ɛkari pɛ ne ne abakɔsɛm a ɛne ne ho di nsɛ a ɛntwe blockchain no ankasa nyinaa na ennye mu? Zcash di ɔhaw yi ho dwuma denam akwan horow pii a ɛka bom so. Ɛwɔ server soronko bi, lightwalletd, a ɛsesa data fi node a ɛyɛ ma mu na ɛkora nea ɛho hia ma nkitahodi ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu nkutoo so. Wɔfrɛ saa data yi compact blocks, na ɛyɛ ketewaa koraa sen mfitiase blocks no. Light wallets di kan twe saa compact blocks yi fi lightwalletd server no so na afei wɔde wɔn private keys decrypt no. Sɛ wobɛyi saa compact blocks yi ase na woadi ho dwuma mpo a, ebetumi agye bere kɛse, titiriw bere a nnwuma pii wɔ block biara mu no. Enti sika kotoku fa akwan horow so de ma synchronization yɛ ntɛmntɛm na ɛma wode wo sika di dwuma ntɛm ara sɛnea wubetumi. Aniwa so / Nsɛso Fa no sɛ blockchain no yɛ dan kɛse bi a wɔde nkrataa mena a nnaka a wɔato mu ahyɛ mu ma. Sɛ ɔde sika a ɛda adi pefee di dwuma a, krataa a wɔde mena no kyerɛwfo no betumi akenkan nkyerɛwde a wɔakyerɛw so no na wakyerɛ wo nnaka a ɛyɛ wo de no ntɛm ara. Zcash mu no, wɔde nkyerɛwde no asie — enti ɛsɛ sɛ wo sika kotoku no fa ne nsafe na ɛyɛ komm hwɛ nnaka no ankasa mu de hwehwɛ nea ebetumi abue. Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ sync a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no yɛ akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so hyɛ saa nnaka no mu ntɛmntɛm. Deep Dive a Wɔde Nsu Gu Mu Warp Sync a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Warp sync yɛ YWallet ade a ɛhuruw anammɔn a ɛwɔ ntam a ɛfa decrypting ne dwumadie a ɛfa compact block biara ho, na ɛhuruw tẽẽ kɔ nea ɛtwa toɔ no so. Sɛ ɛbɛyɛ saa a, ɛde akontaabu ne nsɛm a wɔde sie di dwuma de bu nea etwa to a ebefi mu aba no ho akontaa a ɛnfa anammɔn biara mu. Warp sync tumi di block mpempem pii ho dwuma wɔ sekan biara mu, ntɛmntɛm sen ɔkwan a wɔtaa fa so yɛ synchronization no. Wei kyerɛ sɛ YWallet dwumadiefoɔ bɛtumi anya anigyeɛ wɔ adwumayɛ a ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm na ɛkɔ so yie mu, mpo sɛ wɔayɛ nnwuma ɔpehaha pii na wɔagye nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw wɔ wɔn akontaabuo mu. Sɛ yɛde saa anammɔn-huruw kwan yi to nkyɛn a, YWallet tumi di block ahorow pii ho dwuma bere koro mu, kyekyɛ adesoa no wɔ wo hardware a ɛwɔ hɔ no so na ama adwuma no ayɛ ntɛmntɛm mpo. Kenkan Nsɛm pii wɔ Warp Sync a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Wɔaka warp sync ho asɛm wɔ ha sɛ syncing kwan. Ywallet ankasa nyɛ nea wɔhwɛ so bio na wɔrensiesie no foforo mma Ironwood, enti ɛnyɛ sika kotoku a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu nnɛ. Spend-ansa na woayɛ sync Spend-before-sync yɛ ade foforo wɔ Zcash Mobile Wallet SDK V2 mu a ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi sɛe sika ntɛm ara bere a wɔabue wɔn sika kotoku no, a wɔntwɛn sɛ sika kotoku no bɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Saa ade yi ma wohu sika kotoku no sika a wɔsɛe no ntɛmntɛm na ɛma osuahu a ɔde di dwuma no tu mpɔn. Spend-before-sync yɛ adwuma denam compact-blocks synchronization algorithm a ɛyɛ blocks a efi lightwalletd server no so ho adwu

title: Zebra Full Node a Ɛyɛ Fɛ
description: Zebra yɛ Zcash node a edi kan a wɔakyerɛw ne nyinaa wɔ Rust mu. Ɛte Zcash peer-to-peer network so, baabi a ɛgye nkitahodie tom na ɛbɔ amanneɛ na ɛkora…
text: Zebra Full Node a Ɛyɛ Fɛ TL;DR Zebra (zebrad) yɛ Zcash full node a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Rust mu na Zcash Foundation. Ɛma blocks ne transactions yɛ nokware, ɛkora nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn tebea no so, na ɛne node afoforo kasa wɔ peer-to-peer network no so. Zebra ne zcashd de protocol koro no ara dii dwuma na wotumi yɛɛ adwuma. Efi bere a zcashd kɔhyɛɛ pɛnhyen no, Zebra soa adwuma a wɔpene so no. Akwan abien a wɔfa so tu mmirika: ne zfnd/zebra Docker mfonini, anaasɛ ɔdan bi a efi fibea. Hardware a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne CPU cores 4, RAM 16 GB, ne disk 300 GB. Anyɛ yiye koraa no, 2 cores ne 4 GB RAM, a disk 300 GB koro no ara ka ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Zebra yɛ Zcash node a edi kan a wɔakyerɛw ne nyinaa wɔ Rust mu. Ɛte Zcash peer-to-peer network so, baabi a ɛgye nkitahodie tom na ɛbɔ amanneɛ na ɛkora blockchain tebea no so. Sɛ wowɔ dwumadie a ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɛde ne ho a, ɛma network infrastructure no ntumi nnyina codebase baako biara so kɛseɛ. Zebra ne zcashd Mfitiaseɛ Zcash node, zcashd, Electric Coin Company na ɛyɛɛ no firi Bitcoin codebase. Wɔkyerɛw Zebra fi mfiase wɔ Rust, kasa a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkae mu, a wɔde wɔn adwene sii ahobammɔ ne adwumayɛ a etu mpɔn so. Nneɛma abien no nyinaa di nhyehyɛe koro akyi, enti na wobetumi adi nkitaho na wɔayɛ adwuma. zcashd duu ne End-of-Support gyinabea wɔ 18 July 2026 na ɛnhyɛ aseɛ bio, a ɛma Zebra ne Zakura sɛ node implementations a wɔde di dwuma. Hwɛ Nodes a Ɛyɛ Pɛ ma mfonini a ɛtrɛw no. Ɔsebɔ a ɔretu Zebra Wubetumi de Docker mfonini no ayɛ Zebra, anaasɛ wobɛtumi de nsa ayɛ. Yɛsrɛ sɛ hwɛ System Requirements ɔfã no. Docker a Wɔde Di Dwuma Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woyɛ nea wɔayi no adi foforo no na woayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ ne tip no a, yɛ ahyɛde a edidi so yi: Sɛ wopɛ akwankyerɛ a edi mũ a, hwɛ Docker nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm. Ɔsebɔ Zebra Ɔkyekye Zebra a wobɛkyekyere no hwehwɛ Rust, libclang, ne C++ compiler. Hwɛ sɛ wowɔ Rust version a ɛyɛ den a aba foforo a wɔde ahyɛ mu, efisɛ Zebra nkutoo na wɔde asɔ ahwɛ. Nneɛma a ɛho hia a egyina ɔdansi so no bi ne: libclang (wɔsan frɛ no libclang-dev anaa llvm-dev) clang anaa C++ compiler foforo (te sɛ g++ ma platforms nyinaa anaa Xcode ma macOS) protoc (Protocol Buffers compiler) a --experimentalallowproto3optional frankaa, a wɔde baa Protocol Buffers v3.12.0 (wɔyii no adi wɔ May 16, 2020) mu. Install na Fi ase Wɔ x8664 anaa aarch64 Linux a glibc 2.34 anaa nea ɛboro saa (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, RHEL 9+, Amazon Linux 2023) so no, wobɛtumi atwa adansiɛ a ɛgyina so no so na woahyɛ binary a wɔadi kan asi a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ aseɛ: Binaries koro no ara na wɔde abata GitHub biara a wɔayi no adi ho sɛnea zebrad- - .tar.gz, a emu biara wɔ SHA-256 checksum, Sigstore build-provenance adansedi ne Cosign nsaano nkyerɛwee. Wɔ platform dedaw so no, fa Docker mfonini no di dwuma anaa si fi fibea. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokyekye fi fibea a, nya koodu no na si release binary no: Fi ase node no wɔ: Installation akwankyerɛ: zebra.zfnd.org/ɔdefoɔ/install.html Nsiesiei & Nneɛma a Wobɛpaw Nsiesiei Fael a Worefi Ase Fa ahyɛde no yɛ nhyehyɛe fael: Wɔde zebrad.toml a wɔayɛ no bɛto Linux default preferences directory no mu. Sɛ wopɛ OS default mmeae foforo a, hwɛ nkrataa no. Nkɔso Bars a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ Hyehyɛ tracing.progressbar wɔ wo zebrad.toml mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛkyerɛ key metrics wɔ terminal no mu denam nkɔso bars a wode bedi dwuma so. Hyɛ no nsow: Ɔsɛmpɔw bi a wonim wɔ hɔ a nkɔso ho akontaabu betumi ayɛ kɛse dodo. Mining a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ Wobetumi asiesie Zebra ama mining denam MINERADDRESS ne port mapping a wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔ Docker mu no so. Wobetumi ahu nsɛm foforo wɔ.. Mining mmoa ho nkrataa. Custom Build Nneɛma a Wɔde Sisi Trɛw Zebra's dwumadie mu denam Cargo nneɛma foforɔ te sɛ Prometheus metrics, Sentry monitoring, experimental Elasticsearch support, ne nea ɛkeka ho. Fa nneɛma pii bom denam din a wobɛkyerɛw sɛ parameters of the --features frankaa bere a wɔde rehyɛ mu. Wɔayɛ debugging ne monitoring features binom adwuma wɔ release builds mu na ama adwumayɛ ayɛ yie. Sɛ wopɛ nhwehwɛmu ne developer nneɛma a wɔahyehyɛ no nyinaa a, hwɛ..

title: ZKP & ZK-SNARKS NKYERƐKYERƐMU
description: Adanse ne nea wogyina so yɛ akontaabu nyinaa. Adanse yɛ asɛm anaa theorem a worebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛda no adi & sequence of derivations made to declare the…
text: ZKP & ZK-SNARKS NKYERƐKYERƐMU TL;DR zk-SNARKs = Zero-Knowledge Nimdeɛ ho akyinnyegye a ɛyɛ tiawa a ɛnyɛ nkitahodi Wɔma ɔfã biako da no adi sɛ wonim biribi a wɔanna nsɛm no ankasa adi Zcash de zk-SNARKs di dwuma de kyerɛ sɛ asɛm bi yɛ nokware (sika dodow a ɛteɛ, nsɛm a wɔansɛe no) a ɛnna nea ɔde kɔmaa, nea ogye, anaa sika dodow adi "Tiatiaa" kyerɛ sɛ adanse no sua na ɛyɛ ntɛm sɛ wobetumi adi ho adanse mpo wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ho Orchard pool no de Halo 2, zk-SNARK nhyehyɛe a nhia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wotumi de ho to so di dwuma --- Dɛn ne Adanse? Adanse ne nea wogyina so yɛ akontaabu nyinaa. Adanse yɛ asɛm anaa theorem a worebɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛda no adi & sequence of derivations made to declare the theorem has been proved. s.e., s.e. anim a ɛwɔ ahinanan mu nyinaa a ne nyinaa yɛ 180° no, obiara betumi ahwɛ no wɔ ahofadi mu (verifier). Adanse ahorow Prover ---> Yɛ Claim ---> Verifier Paw ---> Gye/Pow (Prover ne verifier nyinaa yɛ algorithms) Wɔ kɔmputa ho nyansahu mu no asɛmfua a wɔde frɛ adanse a wotumi di ho adanse yiye ne NP adanse. Wobetumi de polynomial bere adi adanse ntiantiaa yi ho adanse. Adwene a ɛtrɛw no ne sɛ "Ano aduru bi wɔ hɔ ma theorem & wɔde kɔma verifier no sɛ ɔnhwɛ mu" Wɔ NP-kasa mu no = ɛsɛ sɛ tebea abien kura mu: Nea edi mũ: Nokware nsɛm no, nea ɔyɛ nokwaredifo begye atom (ɛma wɔn a wɔkyerɛ nokwaredi no kwan ma wodu adansedi ho) Nteaseɛ: Atoro nsɛm rennya adanseɛ biara (wɔ nsisi prover strategy nyinaa fam no wɔrentumi nkyerɛ sɛ asɛm a ɛnteɛ no teɛ). Nkitahodi & Probabalist Adanse Nkitahodi: Sɛ anka ɔbɛkenkan adanse no ara kwa no, nea ɔhwɛ so no ne ɔbenfo bi di nkitaho kɔ anim ne akyi wɔ nkrasɛm ahorow pii mu. Randomness: Verifier abisadeɛ a ɛfa prover ho no yɛ randomized na ɛsɛ sɛ prover tumi bua emu biara yie. Sɛ yɛde nkitahodi ne randomness bom di dwuma a, ɛyɛ yiye sɛ yɛbɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔka sɛ obi a ɔyɛ anifuraefo a ɔyɛ nokware wɔ Probabilistic Polynomial Time (PPT) mu. So Interactive Proofs betumi adi adanse yiye asen NP adanse ahorow? NP Adanse vs IP adanse: Anodisɛm NP IP -------------- ----------- -------- NP Aane Aane CO-NP no Aane #P no Aane PSPACE na ɛyɛ no Aane NP - Ano aduru bi wo ho ma asem bi CO-NP - a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ano aduru biara nni hɔ ma asɛm bi #P - Se wobekan ano aduru dodow a ewo asem bi ho PSPACE - a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nsɛm ahodoɔ a wɔsesa Dɛn ne Nimdeɛ a Ɛyɛ Zero? Nea verifier betumi abu ho akontaa wɔ nkitahodi bi akyi no ne nea wobetumi adi kan ada no adi no yɛ pɛ. Nkitahodi a ɛwɔ rounds pii so wɔ prover & verifier ntam no mmaa verifier no computional tumi nkɔ soro. Simulation Paradigm Saa sɔhwɛ yi wɔ hɔ wɔ cryptography nyinaa mu. Ɛde "Adwene Ankasa" & "Nhwɛso a Wɔayɛ no Nsusuwii" kyerɛ. Real View: Abakɔsɛm a ebetumi aba nyinaa a ɛfa nkitahodi a ɛda Prover & Verifier (P,V) ntam ho Simulated View: Verifier no yɛ nkitahodi a ebetumi aba nyinaa a ɛda Prover & Verifier ntam no ho mfonini Polynomial-bere nsonsonoe bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia wɔrehwɛ ankasa anaasɛ nea wɔayɛ no sɛnea ɛte no na ɛsrɛ nhwɛsode fi abien no nyinaa hɔ mpɛn pii. Wɔka sɛ adwene mmienu no yɛ "computationally indistinguishable" sɛ wɔ distinguisger algorithms/strategies nyinaa mu no, mpo wɔ akyi a wɔanya polynomial dodoɔ a ɛyɛ samples afiri real anaa simulated mu no, probability no yɛ >1/2. Zero-Nimdeɛ ho akyinnyegye a ɛfa Nimdeɛ ho Nkitahodi protocol (P,V) yɛ zero-nimdeɛ sɛ simulator (algorithm) bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔ probabilty polynomial-time verifier biara ho (bere a theorem no teɛ), probability distributions a ɛkyerɛ ankasa fi simulated view no yɛ computationally indistinguishable. Interactive Protocols ho wɔ mfaso bere a verifier biako wɔ hɔ. Nhwɛso bi bɛyɛ towtua ho akontaabufo a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ a onni ‘towtua ho adanse’ akwammisa krataa mu. Dɛn ne SNARK? Nimdeɛ ho akyinnyegye a ɛyɛ tiawa a ɛnyɛ nkitahodi Nkyerɛaseɛ a ɛtrɛ - Adanse tiawa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ asɛm bi yɛ nokware. Ɛsɛ sɛ adanse no yɛ tiawa na ɛyɛ ntɛm na ama wɔatumi akyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware. Wɔ SNARKS mu no wɔde nkra biako fi Mmebusɛm mu kɔ Verifier so. Afei nea ɔhwɛ so no betumi apaw sɛ obeg

title: Zcash a wobenya
description: Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wode Zcash bedi dwuma wɔ kokoam (shielded) nnwuma mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ wunya ZEC. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wunya ZEC a, ɛho behia sɛ wotɔ. Wubetumi atɔ ZEC afi…
text: Zcash a wobenya TL;DR Kɔtɔ ZEC wɔ exchange a ɛboa shielded withdrawals (Gemini, BitcoinVN, flyp.me) bere a ɛbɛyɛ yiye Dodow no ara titiriw centralized exchanges (Coinbase, Kraken, Binance) boa transparent withdrawals nkutoo — kyɛm wo ZEC bere a woanya no akyi Decentralized exchanges ma kwan ma ɛnyɛ custodial swaps nanso mpɛn pii no wɔtwe wɔn ho kɔ address ahorow a ɛda adi pefee so Wo ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛtɔ ZEC a edi mũ — fractions yɛ adwuma yiye --- Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wode Zcash bedi dwuma wɔ kokoam (shielded) nnwuma mu no, ɛsɛ sɛ wunya ZEC. text: MetaMask Zcash Snap Nkabom Akwankyerɛ Sɛ wopɛ nantew a edi mũ ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde aniwa hu a, hwɛ eyi YouTube akwankyerɛ: MetaMask seesei boa shielded Zcash (ZEC) denam ChainSafe-developed Zcash Snap so, ɛma wo kwan ma wosoma, gye, na wohwɛ kokoam ZEC so tẽẽ wɔ wo browser sika kotoku mu. Fa wo ho to ChainSafe WebZjs Wallet so Sra webzjs.nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ahobammɔ.dev. Klik Fa MetaMask Snap. Pene nkitahodi no so. title: Zcash Botae a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma
description: Zcash kyekyɛ sika mu kɔ akontabuo nhyehyɛeɛ soronko a wɔfrɛ no value pools mu. Pool biara wɔ n’ankasa cryptographic mmara ne kokoam nsɛm, bere a protocol no di…
text: Zcash Botae a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma TL;DR Zcash mprempren wɔ 5 value pools: Sprout (agyapade), Sapling, Orchard (wɔsɛe sika nkutoo), Ironwood, ne Transparent. Ironwood yɛ mprempren ɔtare a wɔabɔ ho ban titiriw, a ɛte ase fi bere a wɔyɛɛ NU6.3 foforo wɔ 28 July 2026. Orchard seesei spend-only: boɔ foforɔ biara ntumi nkɔ mu, na sika a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no tu kɔ Ironwood. Sapling (z-address ahorow a efi ase zs) da so ara boa kɛse na ɛkɔ so nya ZEC. Transparent addresses (t...) mma atɔfoɔ kokoamsɛm biara na ɛyɛ adwuma te sɛ Bitcoin. Sprout yɛ agyapadeɛ shielded pool a wɔakɔ pɛnhyen afiri dwumadie a ɛyɛ nnam mu. Orchard to Ironwood atutra no rekɔ so na turnstile no na ɛhwɛ so wɔ baguam. Sɛ wopɛ kokoam nsɛm ho bɔhyɛ a emu yɛ den a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kɔ so pɛ shielded-to-shielded (z → z) nkitahodi bere biara a ɛbɛyɛ yiye. Zcash Value Pools ho ntease Zcash kyekyɛ sika mu kɔ akontabuo nhyehyɛeɛ soronko a wɔfrɛ no value pools mu. Pool biara wɔ n’ankasa cryptographic mmara ne kokoam nsɛm, bere a protocol no di bo a ɛsom nyinaa a ɛkɔ wɔn ntam no akyi. Ɛnnɛ, netɛw no kura botae titiriw anum: Transparent — Ɔmanfo na wotumi hu koraa wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so. Sapling — Nnɛyi ɔtare a wɔabɔ ho ban a edi kan a wogye tom kɛse, a ɛda so ara yɛ adwuma. Orchard — Kan no titiriw titiriw shielded pool, mprempren spend-only. Ironwood — Mprempren ɔtare a wɔabɔ ho ban titiriw, a NU6.3. Sprout — Mfitiaseɛ shielded pool a wɔde sii hɔ ne Zcash wɔ afe 2016 mu. Bere a Zcash renya nkɔso no, wobetumi de atare foforo a wɔabɔ ho ban aba de ama ahobammɔ, kokoamsɛm, dwumadie, ne akontabuo atu mpɔn berɛ a wɔhwɛ ma ɛne sika a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no hyia. Mfonini 1: Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ atare mmiɛnsa a wɔabɔ ho ban (Sprout, Sapling ne Orchard) kɔsi 29 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2025, ansa na Ironwood reyɛ adwuma Atare a Wɔabɔ Ho Ban no Ironwood Pool Ironwood ne mprempren ɔtare titiriw a wɔabɔ ho ban. Ɛyɛɛ adwuma wɔ 28 July 2026 wɔ block 3,428,143 sɛ NU6.3 network upgrade no fã, na ɛhɔ na shielded value foforɔ te seesei. Ɛwɔ hɔ ɛfiri sɛ wɔhunuu mmerɛwyɛ bi wɔ Orchard's proving system no mu wɔ May 2026. Adanse biara nni hɔ sɛ wɔde dii dwuma pɛn, nanso mfomsoɔ no kyerɛ sɛ wɔantumi amfa adanseɛ no nko ara akyerɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔde kyɛm ahyɛ mu no yɛ nokware. Sɛ́ anka wɔde patch bɛhyɛ baabi no, network no yɛɛ ɔtare foforo a ɛwɔ circuit a wɔateɛteɛ mu na ɛde bo a ɛsom no faa turnstile a ɛkan sika biara a ɛwɔ baguam no so. Saa akontaabu no ne nea ɛsan de ahotoso a ɛne sɛ wɔabɔ nneɛma a wɔabɔ ho ban no akyi koraa no ba. Ironwood san de Orchard's Action model ne Halo 2 adanse ahorow di dwuma, enti ɛyɛ n’ade saa ara da biara da. Nneɛma abien yɛ foforo: nkitahodi de v6 format di dwuma, na Ironwood nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no yɛ quantum-recoverable ase ZIP 2005 na ɔkyerɛwee, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ sika kɔkɔɔ bi a ɛwɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu no kɔ so yɛ nea wotumi san nya bio sɛ daakye quantum kɔmputa bi bubu nnɛyi cryptography no a. Ɛno yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so san nya ahoɔden, ɛnyɛ quantum resistance, na ɛnyɛ nea ɛfa atare dedaw ho. Wonhia address foforo. Address ahorow a wɔaka abom no bom agyefo pii, na sika kotoku paw ɔtare a ɛfata ma wo. Orchard Pool Mfonini 2: Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ Orchard pool no kɔsi 29 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2025, ansa na Ironwood reyɛ adwuma Wɔde Orchard Shielded Pool no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ May 31, 2022 sɛ NU5 network upgrade no fã. Orchard de shielded protocol foforo a ɛmaa ɛho nhia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wotumi de ho to so na ɛbɛyɛɛ shielded pool titiriw a Unified Addresses (UAs) de di dwuma. Orchard dwumadie, adwumayɛ yie, ne kokoamsɛm nyaa nkɔsoɔ kɛseɛ denam ayɔnkofa metadata a ɛtwetwe so a ɔtew so na ɔde nkitahodiɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a egyina Nneyɛeɛ so baeɛ sene atetesɛm mu nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ mu ne nea wɔde ba a wɔabɔ ho ban. Efi bere a Ironwood upgrade no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ 28 July 2026 no, Orchard yɛ nea wɔsɛe no nkutoo. Botae foforo biara ntumi nkɔ pool no mu. Sika a wɔde asie dedaw no da so ara tumi sɛe, na wɔretu akɔ Ironwood denam turnstile no so. Sika kotoku di eyi ho dwuma ma wo, ɛwom sɛ dodow no ara ma wunya ahoɔhare no so tumi kakra

title: Dɛn Ne Zcash TEX Address ahorow?
description: Zcash TEX address yɛ address soronko bi a wɔde gye. TEX gyina hɔ ma "Transparent Exchange". Ɛyɛ Bech32m re-encoding a ɛyɛ p2pkh Transparent address biako. TEX…
text: Dɛn Ne Zcash TEX Address ahorow? TL;DR TEX address yɛ Zcash address a ɛda adi pefee a wɔakyerɛw no ɔkwan foforo so. Efi ase wɔ tex1 na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ ZIP 320 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Ɛka ade biako kyerɛ wo sika kotoku: fa sika a ɛda adi pefee nkutoo tua address yi. Sɛ wɔabɔ wo sika a aka no ho ban a, sika kotoku a ɛne no hyia yɛ anammɔn abien ma wo. Ɛde sika no kɔ bere tiaa mu address a ɛda adi pefee so, afei ɛde kɔ TEX address no so. Wɔ afe 2023 mu no, Binance bisaa Zcash mpɔtam hɔfoɔ sɛ wɔmma wɔn ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so apow sika a wɔde asie a wɔabɔ ho ban na wɔde asan akɔ. TEX address ahorow ne mmuae no, na Binance ne exchange no wɔ ZecHub no so Nneɛma a Wɔde Sesa Wɔn a Wɔhwɛ Nnipa So list a ɛfa TEX sika a wɔde asie. Mmoa anyin wɔ ɔfã a wɔde mena no nso: Coinbase ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no de ZEC kɔ TEX address ahorow so, na sika kotoku nnwinnade de ZIP 320 mmoa aka ho. Katua a wɔde kɔ TEX address so no yɛ baguam wɔ blockchain no so, te sɛ sikatua biara a ɛda adi pefee. Wo sika a wɔabɔ ho ban no nkae no tra kokoam. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Zcash TEX address yɛ address soronko bi a wɔde gye. TEX gyina hɔ ma "Transparent Exchange". Ɛyɛ Bech32m re-encoding a ɛyɛ p2pkh Transparent address biako. TEX address ahorow no fi ase tex1 na ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ Unified Addresses ho. TEX address ka kyerɛ sika kotoku a ɛne no hyia sɛ ɔnyɛ Transparent-Only (T -> T) asɛm. Nteaseɛ no te sɛ deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi: Sɛ sika kotokuo a ɛne no hyia hu TEX Address bi a, ɛdecode no na ama anya Transparent receiver a ɛwɔ mu no. Afei sika kotoku no de sika a wɔhwehwɛ ma tx no fi Shielded pool no mu kɔ address a ɛyɛ soronko, a nea ɔde di dwuma no di so, a ɛyɛ bere tiaa mu Transparent address (Z -> T). Afei ɛde saa sika no kɔma Transparent receiver a wɔabɔ no decoded a ɛwɔ TEX address (T -> T) no so. Wɔakyerɛ mfiridwuma ho nyansahyɛ a ɛfa TEX address ahorow ho wɔ Zcash mu ZIP 320 na ɛwɔ hɔ, a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ address su bi a wɔde begye sika afi Transparent Addresses nkutoo mu. Wɔde TEX address ahorow di dwuma kɛse dɛn? Abofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma no da so ara yɛ fã bi, nanso ɛnyɛ nea wɔde sesa ade biako pɛ bio. Ɛfata sɛ yɛtetew dwumadi ahorow abien mu: TEX deposit address ahorow a wɔde ma. Binance ne exchange a ɛwɔ yɛn Nneɛma a Wɔde Sesa Wɔn a Wɔhwɛ Nnipa So list a ɛde TEX address a wɔde sie ma, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a sika no befi baabi a ɛda adi pefee (ZIP 320, Akyisɛm). ZIP 320 nhwɛ kwan sɛ exchange afoforo bɛma TEX address gye sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wohu address a sikatua bi fi bae. Sending to TEX addresses. Eyi ne ɔfã a anyin. Wɔ October 2024 mu no, Coinbase de too gua sɛ Coinbase.com dwumadiefoɔ bɛtumi de Zcash akɔ TEX address ahodoɔ so (Coinbase Agyapadeɛ ho dawurubɔ). Wallet toolkits de ZIP 320 mmoa nso aka ho: KeepKey de nsaano nkyerɛwee aka ho ama TEX nkitahodi wɔ firmware 7.15 (keepkey/hdwallet #75 na ɛwɔ hɔ), ne XChainJS zcash-js nhomakorabea no yɛɛ patch bere a wɔpowee sɛ ɛyɛ nokware akyi tex1 wɔn a wogye no (ɛno ho nsɛm pii wɔ ase ha). Enti TEX address ahorow nyɛ amansan nyinaa de, nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔkenkanfo fa no bio sɛ Binance nkutoo ne beae a epue. Bere Bɛn na Mehia TEX Address Wohia TEX address bere a wode sika rekɔ Transparent address so denam sika kotoku a ɛnboa sɛ wode bɛkɔ Transparent address so tẽẽ no so. Sika kotoku binom mma kwan mma wɔmfa nkɔ Transparent address so tẽẽ, na ebia nea ogye no remfa TEX a ɛne no sɛ no mma. Enti, ɛtɔ mmere bi a, ebia ɛho behia sɛ wobɛdan afi Transparent so akɔ TEX address so. Wobetumi de nsa ayɛ eyi denam reference implementation a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ zip-320 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Wohia TEX address bere a wode sika rekɔ centralized exchange a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ saa sika no fi Transparent fibea. Binance ne nea enti a TEX address ahorow wɔ hɔ no. Wɔ November 2023 mu no, ɛka kyerɛɛ Zcash mpɔtam hɔfoɔ sɛ wɔbɛtumi ayi ZEC afiri wɔn din mu gye sɛ ɔkwan bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so apow sika a wɔde bɛto hɔ afiri address a wɔabɔ ho ban so na wɔde asan akɔma nea ɔde sika asie no (ZIP 320, Akyisɛm). text: Nkitahodi ahorow ZEC yɛ dijitaal agyapadeɛ a wɔde di dwuma kɛseɛ ma sikatua, ɛde kokoam nsɛm a ɛyɛ den a ɛma ɛfata ma nnwuma ahodoɔ te sɛ nnamfoɔ a wɔbɛtua, adetɔ, anaa ntoboa ma. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ bɛyɛ kɛse no, ɛho hia sɛ wote sɛnea nnwuma ahorow yɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mu no ase. TL;DR Zcash boa nkitahodi ahorow abien: shielded, a ɛma nsɛm no yɛ kokoam, ne transparent, a ɛkyerɛw to hɔ wɔ baguam. Address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban fi ase u or z. Address ahorow a ɛda adi pefee fi ase t na wɔyɛ wɔn ade te sɛ Bitcoin address kɛse. Nea wobɛpaw no yɛ wo dea wɔ sika biara a wubetua ho. Privacy yɛ option a Zcash de ma wo, ɛnyɛ setting a obi foforo besi ho gyinae ama wo. Sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi exchange bi ho a, ɛno ne beae a nkurɔfo taa hwere kokoam nsɛm. Sɛ sika a wɔde sesa no boa sika a woyi fi mu a ɛda adi pefee nkutoo a, w’ankasa bɔ sika no ho ban bere a aba no. Fees di akyi ZIP 317 na ɛwɔ hɔ na enyin bere a asɛm no kɛse te. Sika kotoku a ɛda so ara de flat fee dedaw no mena no betumi ahu sɛ wɔn nnwuma akyɛ. Zcash nkitahodi dodow no ara wɔ expiry height ase ZIP 203 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Sɛ asɛm bi twam ansa na wɔatu a, entumi nsi so dua wɔ saa bere tenten no akyi na ebia ebehia sɛ wɔsan de mena bio. Nkitahodi a Wɔabɔ ho Ban --- Nkitahodi a wɔabɔ ho ban no ba bere a wode ZEC kɔ wo sika kotoku a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu. Wo sika kotoku address a wɔabɔ ho ban no fi ase wɔ a u or z. Sɛ wode nsɛm a wɔabɔ ho ban remena a, wo ne nnipa a wo ne wɔn di nkitaho no betumi akora kokoam nsɛm bi a ɛrentumi nyɛ yiye wɔ ɔmanfo sikatua nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde di dwuma daa so. Sɛ wode asɛm a wɔabɔ ho ban bɛmena a, ɛyɛ mmerɛw bere a wode sika kotoku a ɛboa mprempren Zcash ntwamutam ne mprempren shielded pools redi dwuma no. Ansa na wode wo ho bɛto sika kotoku so ama kokoam nsɛm no, hwɛ sɛ ɛboa shielded sending, shielded receiving, ne pool a woayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wode bedi dwuma no anaa. Sɛ woreyi ZEC afi exchange bi mu a, hwɛ sɛ exchange no boa shielded anaa transparent withdrawals anaa. Sɛ ɛboa sika a woyi fi mu a ɛda adi pefee nkutoo a, fa sika no kɔ sika kotoku a wɔabɔ ho ban mu bere a aba akyi. Nkitahodi a wɔabɔ ho ban a wɔde bedi dwuma de akɔma na wɔagye sika no ne ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so akora kokoam nsɛm so na wɔatew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ sikatua ho nsɛm bɛpue no so. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee yɛ adwuma te sɛ Bitcoin nkitahodi. Adwuma ho nsɛm da adi wɔ baguam wɔ blockchain no so, a address ahorow a ɛda adi pefee ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛda adi pefee ka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkwati nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee bere a kokoam nsɛm yɛ ade titiriw no. Address a ɛda adi pefee da so ara ho wɔ mfaso wɔ tebea horow bi mu, titiriw bere a exchange anaa service bi ntumi mmoa address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban no. Sɛ wo nsa ka ZEC kɔ address a ɛda adi pefee so a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛbɔ ho ban ansa na woatua sika akyiri yi. Ɔkwan a Ɛyɛ Mmerewa a Wobɛfa so ayɛ Ho Mfonini Aguadi a ɛda adi pefee yɛ postcard. Postman no de kɔma, nanso obiara a odi ho dwuma wɔ kwan so no betumi akenkan nkrasɛm no, ahwɛ onii a ɔde kɔmaa no na wahu onii a ogye. Aguadi a wɔabɔ ho ban yɛ envelope a wɔatoto mu. Posɔfese adwuma no da so ara si so dua sɛ krataa ankasa a wɔde posɔfese ho ka ankasa nam nhyehyɛe no mu, na obiara ntumi nnyɛ biako anaasɛ ɔde krataa koro no ara mena mprenu. Nea ɛwɔ envelope no mu no tra nea ɔde kɔma ne nea ogye no ntam. Ɔfã a ɛho hia ne sɛ Zcash ma wusi nea wode bɛmena, tua denam sika a wotua so. Zcash Fees a Wɔtua Zcash mfa Ethereum-style gas units nni dwuma. Wɔtua Zcash ayɔnkofa ho ka wɔ ZEC mu, wɔtaa susuw wɔ zatoshis mu. ZEC biako ne zatoshi 100,000,000 yɛ pɛ. ZIP 317 na ɛwɔ hɔ kyerɛkyerɛ sikatua ho nhyehyɛe a wɔtaa de di dwuma a ɛne nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den no yɛ kɛse. Sɛ́ anka wɔde asɛm biara bedi dwuma de dedaw 1,000-zatoshi flat fee no bedi dwuma no, sika a wɔtaa tua no gyina "nneyɛe a ntease wom" te sɛ nneɛma a wɔde ba, nea wɔde fi mu, ne nneyɛe a wɔabɔ ho ban so. Nkitahodi a ɛnyɛ den taa fi ase bɛyɛ zatoshis 10,000, anaa ZEC 0.0001, na nnwuma a ɛyɛ den

title: Memos a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm
description: Sɛ wode Z2Z (shielded-to-shielded) asɛm remena a, wubetumi de memo (nkrasɛm) ahyɛ asɛm no mu. Wobetumi de saa memo yi adi dwuma ama nneɛma ahorow pii.
text: Memos a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm TL;DR Memo yɛ krataa tiawa a wode bata sikatua bi a wode kɔ address a wɔabɔ ho ban so ho. Wɔakora so, enti nnipa a wɔrehwɛ blockchain no ntumi nkenkan. Memo field no kura nsɛm a ɛkɔ baiti 512. Nkurɔfo de memos di dwuma de ka onii a ɔde sika bi kɔmaa ne nea wɔde tuaa no, anaasɛ wɔde kokoam nkrasɛm mena. Ka a wotua kɔ address ahorow a ɛda adi pefee so no ntumi mfa memo nkɔ. A sikatua ho abisade link betumi ahyɛ memo no ma ama wo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a sotɔɔ bi betumi ahyɛ biribiara a wɔkra no agyirae. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Encrypted Memos a Wɔde Kɔma Sɛ wode Z2Z (shielded-to-shielded) asɛm remena a, wubetumi de memo (nkrasɛm) ahyɛ asɛm no mu. Wobetumi de saa memo yi adi dwuma ama nneɛma ahorow pii. Nkitahodi a Wɔde Wɔn Nsa Hyɛ Wɔde memos di dwuma titiriw de de wɔn nsa hyɛ sikatua ase. Esiane sɛ shielded transactions encrypt wo data nti, wuntumi nhu onii a ɔde ZEC kɔmaa wo ne nea ebia na ZEC no yɛ. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi de memo field no adi dwuma de wɔn nsa ahyɛ wɔn din anaa wɔn din a wɔde frɛ wɔn ase de ama wɔn yɔnko no ahu onii ko a na asɛm no fi hɔ. Wobetumi nso akyerɛkyerɛ nea na wɔde di gua no mu. Nkrasɛm a Wɔde Kɔma Ade foforo a wɔde di dwuma ma encrypted memo no ne sɛ wode nkra bɛmena obi a ɔwɔ z-addr. Saa nkrasɛm yi betumi afa biribiara ho, sɛ́ ɛyɛ a nkaebɔ a wɔde ma n’adamfo bi or a nkrasɛm a ɛyɛ nkate a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ so yɛ kokoam sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye biara. Ɔdɔ Nsɛm a Wɔakyerɛw wɔ Blockchain no so Na obi wɔ hɔ a ɔde ɔdɔ krataa kɔmaa wɔn hokafo wɔ blocks a edi kan wɔ Zcash blockchain no mu biako mu. Obi hui sɛ wɔn hokafo no nam Zcash memo so de fael bi amena wɔn. Ná saa fael yi yɛ tekiti a wɔde kɔ adeyɛ titiriw bi a wɔyɛe wɔ amannɔne a na ɔne ne dɔfo a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri no reka ho asɛm sɛ wɔbɛbom akɔ. Ná memo no yɛ ɔdɔ ho krataa. Aniwa so / Nsɛso Fa no sɛ sikatua a wɔabɔ ho ban sɛ krataa a wɔatoto mu a sika wɔ mu. Memo no yɛ krataa a wɔabobɔw a sika no ka ho. Blockchain no ne posɔfese no. Ɛsoa envelope no na ɛkyerɛw sɛ ɛbaa hɔ, na enmmue da. Onipa a obue envelope no kenkan krataa a wɔakyerɛw no. Katua a ɛda adi pefee yɛ postcard, enti envelope biara nni hɔ a wobetumi abɔ krataa bi mu. Deep Dive a Wɔde Nsu Gu Mu Nea ɛfata wɔ memo mu Memo field no yɛ baiti 512 pɛpɛɛpɛ bere nyinaa. Wɔde zero bytes ahyɛ text memo tiawa bi mu ansa na wɔde encrypt, enti memo biara hwɛ ne kɛse koro wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so. Memo dodow no ara yɛ UTF-8 nkyerɛwee a ɛnyɛ den. ZIP 302 na ɛwɔ hɔ nso de memos a efi ase wɔ byte of 0xF5 anaa nea ɛkorɔn ma data ahorow afoforo, ne memo a ɛfa 0xF6 zeros akyi no kyerɛ "no memo". Nneɛma biara a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ asɛm bi mu no kura n’ankasa memo, enti asɛm biako a wotua nnipa pii ka no betumi de krataa soronko bi aka ho ama wɔn mu biara. Kɔ anim Abakɔsɛm mu nsɛm. Saa demo yi nkɔ so bio sɛnea wɔakyerɛw no. Demo a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no de zcashd, na ne script a wogye kenkan memos kɔ akyiri zcash-cli. zcashd duu ne automatic End-of-Support halt wɔ 18 July 2026, enti saa script no ntumi nkɔ node a ɛretu mmirika, na wɔankɔ. Sɛ wokenkan shielded memos fi command line no so a, ɛda so ara yɛ adwuma wɔ Zallet: zallet rpc zlistunspent san de krataa a wɔabɔ ho ban biara a wagye no a ɛwɔ saa ara ba memoStr field a script no kenkan. Hwɛ sɛnea Zallet Ntɛmntɛm Nhwehwɛmu Akwankyerɛ ama ahyɛdeɛ no, ne atutra ho akwankyerɛ a ɛkɔ Zebra ne Zallet sɛ wobɛtu node bi afiri zcashd. Zallet da so ara wɔ beta mu. Wɔde ɔfã yi asie sɛ abakɔsɛm kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛfa Magic-Wormhole demo no ho. Sɛnea wode Zcash Shielded Memos ne Magic-Wormhole CLI ne zcashd bedi dwuma de akɔma fael ahorow afi kɔmputa biako so akɔ foforo so yiye ni! title: Zcash Wallet Sikakorabea a Wɔsan Yɛ
description: Dɛn nti na wode wo ho a wobɛsan agye no sie?
text: Zcash Wallet Sikakorabea a Wɔsan Yɛ Dɛn nti na wode wo ho a wobɛsan agye no sie? Aba, sika a wɔsɛe no, safe a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma, ne sika kotoku fael ahorow no nyɛ nea wotumi sesa. Aba kasasin betumi anya sika kotoku safe ama sika kotoku pii, nanso ensi agyapade safe anaa sika kotoku fael biara ananmu. Safoa a wɔde hwɛ ade betumi ada dwumadi a wɔabɔ ho ban adi nanso entumi mma kwan sɛ wɔmfa sika nsɛe sika. Sika a wɔbɛsan anya no gyina sɛ wobenya tumi a ɛfata a wɔde di dwuma ne ɔkwan a wɔboa mprempren ma ɔtare a ɛkura sika no. Ma nneɛma a wode bɛsan agye no nyɛ kokoam na wo ne obiara a wunnye nni nkyɛ aba, sika a wɔde di dwuma safe, anaa sika kotoku fael da. Ahobammɔ ne Asɛyɛde Ɛho hia sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no te asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ kokoam safe ho dwuma a wodi mu no ase na wɔbɔ saa nsafe yi ho ban na obiara amma ho kwan. Sika a ahobammɔ wom no gyina asɛyɛde a nea ɔde di dwuma no wɔ sɛ ɔbɔ wɔn kokoam safe ho ban so. Sika a wɔde abɔ agyapadeɛ ho ban: Sprout, Sapling ne Orchard Ebia ɛho behia sɛ wotu ZEC dedaw a wɔabɔ ho ban no kɔ baabi foforo sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so san nya ahoɔden no fã. Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ no no krataa ka sɛ eyi gyina TEE nokwaredi, nokwaredi threshold key management ne cloud attestation root so, ɛnyɛ cryptography nkutoo so. Cross-chain step. Address a ɛda adi pefee kyerɛ ne balance ne incoming transfers wɔ baguam kosi sɛ wobɛbɔ ho ban. Screening. App no hwɛ connecting wallets atia databases te sɛ TRM ne Chainalysis, ne ne kratafa a ɛfa mmara sodi ho ka sɛ wobetumi ahwɛ kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow a wɔabɔ no kokoam mu sɛ mmara kwan so ntease bi wɔ hɔ a. text: Non-Custodial Exchanges TL;DR Nsesa a ɛnyɛ sikakorabea ma wutumi sesa sika fi w’ankasa sika kotoku mu. Wokora wo kokoam safe so, na exchange account biara nni hɔ a ɛkora wo sika so. Wo safe a wode sie no bɔ wo ho ban fi exchange hacks ne huammɔdi ahorow ho. Kokoamsɛm yɛ asɛmmisa a ɛda nsow. Sika a wode bɛto hɔ a wode fi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn foforo te sɛ Solana anaa Ethereum so mena no yɛ baguam wɔ saa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no so. Swap service no nso hu wo address ne connection data. Swap akwan binom de ZEC kɔ address a ɛda adi pefee, a ɛyɛ ɔmanfo de. Wo ZEC bɛyɛ kokoam bere a atena address a wɔabɔ ho ban mu pɛn no. Fa kyɛm gu w’ankasa sika kotoku mu ansa na woasɛe no. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Zcash Nneɛma a Ɛnyɛ Custodial Exchanges Wɔ wiase a ɛrenya nkɔso bere nyinaa a ɛfa cryptocurrency aguadi ho no, nsakrae a ɛnyɛ nea wɔde asie, a wɔsan frɛ no Decentralized Exchanges anaa DEXs, ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no di gua a wɔmfa wɔn sika nkɔma nsakrae akontaabu. Wode w’ankasa wo nsafe sie, nanso ɛno nkyerɛ sɛ obi foforo biara mfa ne ho nhyɛ mu. Ɛgyina ɔkwan no so no, swap betumi afa wɛbsaet anaa wallet app, routing service, smart contracts, solvers ne bridges so. Exchanges a wɔabobɔ din wɔ atifi hɔ no ma wunya na wodi Zcash fi w’ankasa sika kotoku mu. Sɛnea swap yɛ kokoam no gyina ɔsom no so, ntwamutam a wutua fi mu, ne sɛ ebia wo ZEC bɛkɔ akowie address a wɔabɔ ho ban mu anaa. Afã horow a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no kyerɛkyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ mu no mu. Nteaseɛ a ɛfa Nsesaeɛ a Ɛnyɛ Custodial ho Nsesaeɛ a ɛnyɛ sikakorabea, a wɔsan frɛ no Decentralized Exchanges (DEXs), yɛ nhyiamu a ɛma cryptocurrency aguadi yɛ mmerɛ a ɛnhia sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no de wɔn sika gu exchange no ankasa mu. Mmom no, wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no di wɔn kokoam safe so na wofi wɔn ankasa sika kotoku mu di gua. Cross-chain swaps da so ara de wɔn ho to afã afoforo so sɛ wɔbɛfa asɛm, afa kwan so na wɔasiesie aguadi no (hwɛ ase hɔ). Eyi betumi ama ahobammɔ atu mpɔn, efisɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfa wɔn ho nto exchange no so mfa nkura wɔn agyapade, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ so anaasɛ wɔbɛhwɛ so yiye no so. Ɛmma swap nyɛ kokoam wɔ n’ankasa so. Nkitahodi a wɔyɛ wɔ exchanges a ɛnyɛ custodial exchanges so no taa de smart contracts di dwuma, a ɛyɛ ɔmanfo de, na ɔsom a wode di dwuma no da so ara tumi hu w’address ne connection ho nsɛm. Mfaso titiriw a ɛwɔ cryptocurrency exchanges a ɛnyɛ sikakorabea so ne tumi a ɛkɔ soro a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma wɔ wɔn agyapade so no. Esiane sɛ saa nneɛma a wɔde sesa nneɛma yi nkora agyapade no so nti, wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no nya wɔn digyital sika no wurayɛ ne tumidi koraa. Nneɛma a ɛnyɛ Custodial Exchanges Vs Custodial Exchanges #1 Ahobanbɔ: Nsesaeɛ a ɛnyɛ sikakorabea yi hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde sika sie wɔ sikakorabea a ɛwɔ mfimfini mu. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no di wɔn kokoam safe so, na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hacks, insider ntua ne platform huammɔdi a ebia custodial exchanges behyia no so. Cross-chain swaps da so ara tumi kura sika bere tiaa bi wɔ deposit address anaa bridge bere a aguadi no resiesie no. #2 Privacy: Nneɛma a ɛnyɛ custodial swaps taa nhia exchange account, enti wotaa huruw sɛ wode email anaa ID bɛkyerɛw wo din. Ɛno ne din a wɔmmɔ no nyɛ ade koro. Sika a wode bɛmena wɔ source network (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, Solana anaa Ethereum) no yɛ ɔmanfoɔ wɔ saa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no so, na ɔsom no da so ara tumi hunu wo sika kotokuo address, IP address ne swap ho nsɛm. Kokoamsɛm wɔ Zcash afã no gyina baabi a wo ZEC si fam (hwɛ ase hɔ). #3 Decentralization: Nsesa a ɛnyɛ custodial no ne decentralized ethos a ɛwɔ cryptocurrencies mu no hyia kɛse. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no wɔ ahofadi kɛse ne wɔn aguadi dwumadi ahorow so tumi, a ɛne nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛtrɛw a ɛfa blockchain mfiridwuma ho no hyia. Wɔn a wogye no din ne krataa a wɔakyerɛw no tra address ahorow a ɛda adi pefee so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ krataa a wɔabɔ ho ban yɛ nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ban toatoa so. Wɔkyerɛw maa Zallet a edi kan na ɛnyɛ ahobammɔ sɛ wobetu mmirika sɛnea ɛte atia mprempren a wɔayi no adi no. Saa krataafa yi ne ɔkwan a wɔayɛ no foforo. Wɔhwɛɛ mu sɛ ɛnyɛ Zallet v0.1.0-beta.3 ne Zallet nwoma no firi 7 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2026. Nea wuhia Zebra ayɛ sync koraa, a RPC akyekyere localhost. Zaino yɛɛ sync tiaa saa Zebra node no. Zallet v0.1.0-beta.3 anaa foforo, wallet build, a ne RPC akyekyere localhost. Nhoma no mu nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ zsendmany sɛnea wɔde adi dwuma no. Wɔpow akontaahyɛde ho ka: sɛ wotwam a fee, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ saa null, efisɛ Zallet de ZIP 317 ho ka no di dwuma bere nyinaa. Akontaabu a wɔde sika ahyɛ mu a ne Unified Address betumi asɛe sika a wɔabɔ ho ban. Address ahorow a Wɔaka abom a Wɔde Ma. Memo a ɛwɔ address a ɛda adi so no yɛ mfomso. Mfa address a wɔde sika ahyɛ mu anaa kuki nhyɛ wiki no mu anaa script a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ mu. Mprempren no txBuilderFromFile.sh wɔ Unified Address a wɔde hardcoded ayɛ. Wɔn a wobegye no din Unified Address biako wɔ nkyerɛwde biara mu, nsɛm a wɔafa aka biara nni hɔ, nkyerɛwde a ɛda hɔ kwa biara nni hɔ. Nkyerɛwee no kenkan daoAddresses.md. A fixed 5 second sleep, a ɛyɛ nea script no yɛ no, hwere nea efi mu ba bere a build no gye bere tenten no. zgetoperationresult di oprehyɛn no, enti frɛ no kosi sɛ tebea no bɛyɛ terminal. text: Zcash Testnet a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Dɛn Ne Zcash Testnet no? Zcash Testnet yɛ blockchain a ɛne ne ho di nsɛ wɔ Zcash main network (Mainnet) ankasa a ɛsan yɛ protocol, mmara, ne ayɔnkofa nteaseɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ - nanso ɛwɔ nsonsonoeɛ titire mmienu: Nsika biara nni sika boɔ ankasa - wɔfrɛ no TAZ, ɛnyɛ ZEC, na wɔde yɛ sɔhwɛ nko ara. Wɔsɔ network upgrades, nnwinnade, ne software hwɛ wɔ ha kan ansa na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ Zcash blockchain ankasa no so. Ɔkwan foforɔ so no, Testnet te sɛ sandbox anaa experimental environment a developers, auditors, ne builders betumi asɔ adwene ahwɛ a wɔmfa sika ankasa nto asiane mu. Dɛn Nti na Testnet Wɔ Hɔ? Testnet ma safe replica a wode bɛsɔ ahwɛ, asɔ ahwɛ, na woasiesie nneɛma ansa na wode akɔ Mainnet. Nneɛma a wotumi yɛ no bi ne: Nkitahodi a wɔde mena ne nea wogye TAZ sika a ne bo nyɛ den a wɔde tu block foforo Ɔdefoɔ ntam nkitahodi ne API ahodoɔ a wɔbɛkyekyere Sɔhwɛ ayɔnkofa kokoam nsɛm (transparent vs shielded) . Nhwɛsoɔ: Nnwinnade te sɛ zcashtxtool fa Testnet di dwuma de yɛ nkitahodi na sɔ Zcash shielded asset functionalities hwɛ. Wiase ankasa mu tebea: Wallet developer betumi de software abɔ Testnet RPC endpoint na wayɛ asetena nyinaa ho mfonini - ɔbɔ address, ɔde shielded transactions bɛmena, na wagye sika a aka no atom - ansa na wakɔ live wɔ Mainnet so. Wɔsɔ Network Upgrades hwɛ Zcash yɛ ne core protocol no foforo bere ne bere mu (e.g., NU6.1, NU6.2 ne Ironwood). Testnet ma nkɔsoɔ foforɔ yɛ adwuma ansa na Mainnet aba, ɛma developers ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ tumi hunu na wɔsiesie mfomsoɔ. Nhwɛsoɔ: Wɔdi kan pia adwene foforɔ mmara anaa ayɔnkofa su kɔ Testnet. Sɛ wɔsɔ hwɛ yiye wie a, ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ Mainnet so wɔ block sorokɔ a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ. title: Address ahorow a Wɔaka abom
description: Address biako ma Zcash. Kyɛ, na nea ɔde kɔmaa no sika kotoku no nya ɔkwan a ɛyɛ kokoam sen biara a ɛbɛfa so atua wo ka.
text: Address ahorow a Wɔaka abom Address biako ma Zcash. Kyɛ, na nea ɔde kɔmaa no sika kotoku no nya ɔkwan a ɛyɛ kokoam sen biara a ɛbɛfa so atua wo ka. TL;DR Address a wɔaka abom (UA) yɛ Zcash address baako a ɛkura agyefoɔ dodoɔ bi: Ironwood, Sapling, ne transparent. Mainnet UA ahorow no fi ase u1. ZIP 316 na ɛkyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn mu, na wɔde NU5 nkɔsoɔ no baeɛ wɔ May 31, 2022. Nea ɔde soma no sika kotoku no paw kokoam pool a ɛsen biara a sika kotoku abien no nyinaa boa. W’ankasa wo npaw ɔtare da. Wo UA kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma bere a Ironwood pool no kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma wɔ July 2026. Na enhia sɛ wokyɛ address foforo. Wo sika kotoku no betumi ayɛ UA foforo ama obiara a ɔde nneɛma bɛmena no, na wɔn nyinaa tua ka wɔ akontaabu koro mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Address a wɔaka abom (UA) yɛ Zcash address biako a ɛka receivers pii bom yɛ biako. Wɔn a wogye sika yɛ address bi afã horow a wogye sika wɔ bo pɔtee bi mu: Ironwood, Sapling, ne nea ɛda adi pefee. UA bi fi ase wɔ u1 wɔ mainnet so na wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mu wɔ ZIP 316 na ɛwɔ hɔ, a wɔde NU5 ntwamutam a wɔayɛ no foforo no bae wɔ May 31, 2022. Ansa na address ahorow a wɔaka abom no reba no, na ZEC a wobenya no kyerɛ sɛ wobesusuw address ahorow ho. BI zs address gyee Sapling sika, a t address gyee sika a ɛda adi pefee, na sɛ wɔde mena wɔ ahorow ntam no faa anammɔn foforo. UA bi de saa asɛm no ba awiei. Wokyɛ address biako, na sika kotoku no yɛ nea aka no ho adwuma. Sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma Sɛ obi de kɔ wo UA a, wɔn sika kotoku kenkan agyefo a ɛwɔ mu no na ɛpaw kokoam pool a ɛsen biara a sika kotoku abien no nyinaa boa: Sɛ sika kotoku abien no nyinaa boa mprempren shielded pool no a, sikatua no du shielded. Biribiara nni baguam a ɛka nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no. Sɛ nea ɔde amena no tumi de fi ɔtare dedaw bi mu nkutoo soma a, sika kotoku no san hwe ase kɔ agyefo a eye sen biara a mo baanu nyinaa kyɛ no so, te sɛ Sapling. Sɛ nea ɔde kɔmaa no tumi de sika a ɛda adi pefee nkutoo mena a, sika a wotua no si wo UA no a ɛda adi pefee a ogye no mu, na wo sika kotoku no betumi abɔ ho ban afi hɔ. W’ankasa wuntumi nni eyi ho dwuma da. Address no kɔ so yɛ nea ɛte saa ara; routing no si wɔ ne mu. Nea enti a ɛho hia mprempren Zcash kɔ so yɛ upgrade. Bere a Ironwood pool no de NU6.3 yɛɛ adwuma wɔ July 28, 2026 no, na wɔn a wɔwɔ UA no nhia address foforo: sika kotoku no fii ase paw Ironwood receiver no kɛkɛ wɔ address ahorow a na wɔwɔ dedaw no mu. Na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wokura address dedaw a egyina hɔ ma wɔn ho no tu kɔ baabi foforo. Wɔn a wɔwɔ UA no anyɛ hwee. Eyi ne botae a wɔde yɛ adwini no. Pool foforo ba a daakye network upgrades ka ho, na address a wɔaka abom twetwe wɔn a obiara nsan nkyɛ address anaasɛ ɔde ne nsa mfa sika nkɔ baabi foforo. Hwɛ Zcash bo a ɛsom no pools ma mprempren pool lineup no. Address foforo a wɔde ma obiara a ɔde nneɛma bɛmena Walets betumi ayɛ address ahorow pii a wɔaka abom ama akontaabu biako. Wɔn mu biara tua sika wɔ sika koro mu, nanso wontumi mfa wɔn mu abien biara nka nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu. Fa UA soronko ma onipa anaa ɔsom biara a ɛtua wo ka, na wɔn mu baanu biara ntumi mfa address ntoto ho mfa nhu sɛ wotua sika kotoku koro. Aniwa so / Nsɛso Fa w’adwene bu anim pon bi a ɛwɔ mmeae abiɛsa a wɔde nkrataa mena. Slot foforo koraa no tow nkrataa gu sikakorabea bi a wɔato mu (Ironwood). Nea ɔto so abien no de wɔn gu drawer a wɔato mu mu (Sapling). Nea ɛto so abiɛsa no tow gu tray a wɔabue mu a obiara betumi akenkan afa mfɛnsere no mu (a ɛda adi pefee). Nea ɔde nkrataa kɔma no ne nea ɔde mena no sika kotoku. Ɛde kokoam slot a ɛsen biara a ɛfata mu di dwuma. Wode address biako ma ɔpon no, na sɛ ofie no nya sikakorabea foforo a, address a ɛwɔ ɔpon no so no tra hɔ. Deep Dive a Wɔde Nsu Gu Mu Nnwinnade a ɛfa ho Viewing keys. Akontaabu biara wɔ viewing keys a wɔaka abom a ɛkyɛ nea UA nya (anaa biribiara a ɛde mena) a ɛnkyɛ sika a wɔsɛe no tumi. Nsɛmfua a wɔde di kan uview ne uivk. Hwɛ safe a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma. TEX addresses. Exchanges binom, mprempren Binance, hwehwɛ sɛ sika a wɔde asie fi baabi a ɛda adi pefee ba. TE

title: Zallet Ntɛmntɛm Nhwehwɛmu Akwankyerɛ
description: Zallet nam JSON-RPC so da ne dwumadie adi, interface style korɔ no ara a zcashd kotokuo de dii dwuma. Biribiara a wopɛ sɛ sika kotoku no yɛ — hwɛ sika a aka…
text: Zallet Ntɛmntɛm Nhwehwɛmu Akwankyerɛ TL;DR Zallet yɛ Zcash sika kotoku a ɛwɔ node nyinaa a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Rust. Ɛsesa sika kotoku a kan no na ɛte zcashd. zcashd duu ne End-of-Support gyinabea wɔ 18 July 2026 na ɛnkɔ so bio. Mprempren Zebra di node afã no ho dwuma; Zallet di sika kotoku no fã ho dwuma. Wode Zallet fi ahyɛde kwan no so zallet rpc , sɛnea wode dii dwuma no ara pɛ zcash-cli ansa na. Ɛsɛ sɛ akyinnyegye biara a ɛwɔ ahyɛde din no akyi no yɛ JSON a ɛfata, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ahama botae ahorow no sie wɔn nsɛm a wɔafa aka abien no so. Zallet wɔ beta mu. Ahyɛdeɛ tumi sesa wɔ releases ntam, na ɛnyɛ zcashd RPC biara na wɔde akɔfa so de besi nnɛ. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Titiriw Zallet nam JSON-RPC so da ne dwumadie adi, interface style korɔ no ara a zcashd kotokuo de dii dwuma. Biribiara a wopɛ sɛ sika kotoku no yɛ — hwɛ sika a aka, yɛ akontaabu, de sikatua a wɔabɔ ho ban mena — yɛ ahyɛde a wobɛfa so zallet rpc. Nneɛma abien na ɛsono nea ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no zcash-cli su na ɛde mfomso dodow no ara a wodi ntɛm no ho akontaa. Nea edi kan no, ɛsɛ sɛ akyinnyegye yɛ JSON a ɛfata sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ nkyerɛwee a ɛda hɔ kwa, enti ahama akyinnyegye de n’ankasa nsɛm a wɔafa aka agyiraehyɛde kɔ shell nsɛm a wɔafa aka no mu. Nea ɛto so abien, ahyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no gyina beta release a woreyɛ so, enti list a wɔde ahyɛ wo binary no mu no yɛ nea wotumi de ho to so sen kratafa biara a wɔakyerɛw, a eyi ka ho. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokyerɛw RPC ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa din a: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wunya mmoa a ɛkɔ akyiri ma RPC pɔtee bi a: Ɛho hia: Akyinnyegye biara a ɛwɔ ɔkwan din no akyi ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ JSON a ɛfata. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛw string values sɛ "value" (a nsɛm a wɔafa aka abien no ka ho). Mfomso a Ɛtaa Tu Wɔretow emu nsɛm a wɔafa aka wɔ string arguments so. zallet rpc validateaddress u1abc... di nkogu, efisɛ ɛsɛ sɛ address no du hɔ sɛ JSON. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛw '"u1abc..."'. Sɛ yɛfa no sɛ RPC biara wɔ ha. Porting da so ara rekɔ so. Akwan bi yɛ wɔn ade pɛpɛɛpɛ, ebinom hia sɛ wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan soronko so, na ebinom nso renkɔ so koraa. Fa krataafa yi di dwuma sɛ ɛwɔ tumi wɔ wo binary so. Zallet wɔ beta mu na ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm. Sɛ ahyɛde bi a ɛwɔ ha no ntumi nyɛ adwuma a, hwɛ zallet rpc help ansa na woafa no sɛ biribi abubu. Wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ Zallet bɛyɛ node. Ɛyɛ sika kotoku no fã a ɛwɔ baanu no mu. Zebra na ɔde node no tu mmirika, na Zallet ne no kasa. RPC Ahyɛdeɛ decoderawasɛm a wɔde di dwuma Parameter a wɔde kyerɛ Korɔ Ɛhia Nkyerɛmu ------------- -------- ---------- -------------------------- hexstring ahoma Aane Nkitahodi hex ahama --- decodescript a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm Parameter a wɔde kyerɛ Korɔ Ɛhia Nkyerɛmu ------------- -------- ---------- ----------------- hexstring ahoma Aane Nkyerɛwee hex --- gettrawasɛm a wɔde di dwuma Parameter a wɔde kyerɛ Korɔ Ɛhia Mfiaseɛ Nkyerɛmu ------------ -------- ---------- --------- -------------------------------------- txid ahoma Aane Nkitahodi ID verbose nɔma no 0 0 = hex, ɛnyɛ zero = JSON ade blockhash ahoma no To hwehwɛ ano hye wɔ saa block yi so --- getwalletinfo ho nsɛm Parameters biara nni hɔ. --- getwalletstatus a ɛwɔ hɔ Parameters biara nni hɔ. --- listaddress ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ Parameters biara nni hɔ. --- rpc.hu sɛ wobɛhu Parameters biara nni hɔ. Sane de OpenRPC nhyehyeɛ no ba. --- gyae Parameters biara nni hɔ. (Kyerɛw wo din nkutoo) --- validateaddress no Parameter a wɔde kyerɛ Korɔ Ɛhia Nkyerɛmu ----------- -------- ---------- ------------------------- address ahoma Aane Address a ɛda adi pefee --- verifymessage no yɛ nokware Parameter a wɔde kyerɛ Korɔ Ɛhia Nkyerɛmu ------------ -------- ---------- ------------------------- address ahoma Aane Address a ɛda adi pefee signature ahoma Aane Base64 nsaano nkyerɛwee message ahoma Aane Mfitiase nkrasɛm --- sika kotoku a wɔde hyɛ mu Parameters biara nni hɔ. --- walletpassphrase a wɔde di dwuma Parameter a wɔde kyerɛ Korɔ Ɛhia Nkyerɛmu ------------- -------- ---------- -------------------------------------- passphrase ahoma Aane Wallet passphrase a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm timeout nɔma Aane Sekan a ɛbɛma sika kotoku no

title: Zcash Mining Guide: Sɛ wode Ankorankoro Hardware bɛka Mining Pool ho
description: Zcash (ZEC) yɛ cryptocurrency a ɛtwe adwene si kokoamsɛm so a ɛde Equihash proof-of-work algorithm di dwuma ma mining. Mining Zcash hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde kɔmputa tumi…
text: Zcash Mining Guide: Sɛ wode Ankorankoro Hardware bɛka Mining Pool ho Nnianimu Zcash (ZEC) yɛ cryptocurrency a ɛtwe adwene si kokoamsɛm so a ɛde Equihash proof-of-work algorithm di dwuma ma mining. Mining Zcash hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde kɔmputa tumi di dwuma de di akontaabu mu haw ahorow a ɛyɛ den ho dwuma, wɔma nkitahodi ahorow no yɛ nokware, na wɔbɔ netɛw no ho ban de sesa ZEC akatua. Esiane sɛ network no yɛ den kɛse nti, wɔmfa solo mining nkamfo mma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma dodow no ara. Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ mining pool mu a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan a eye sen biara a wobɛfa so anya akatua a ɛkɔ so daa denam wo hash tumi a wode bɛka afoforo ho no so. Saa akwankyerɛ yi twe adwene si Zcash a wɔde ankorankoro hardware di dwuma so (sɛ nhwɛso no, ofie PC a ɛwɔ GPUs anaa entry-level ASICs). Hyɛ no nsow sɛ bere a GPUs da so ara tumi tu Zcash, ASICs yɛ adwuma yiye koraa na mfaso wɔ so wɔ afe 2026 mu esiane ntwamutam a ɛyɛ den nti. Bere nyinaa fa nnwinnade te sɛ WhatToMine.com hwɛ mfaso a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren, efisɛ nneɛma te sɛ anyinam ahoɔden ho ka, hardware bo, ne ZEC bo ka sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye. Ebia mfaso remma obiara a wotu fagude; nhwehwɛmu mpɔtam hɔ mmara ne ahoɔden dodow (bɔ mmɔden sɛ wubenya < $0.08/kWh). Ahwehwɛde ahorow Hardware a wɔde yɛ nneɛma GPU Mining (Wɔkamfo Ankorankoro Nhyehyɛe Ma Wɔn a Wɔafi Ase): NVIDIA anaa AMD GPU ahorow a anyɛ yiye koraa no ɛwɔ 4GB VRAM (sɛ nhwɛso no, NVIDIA GTX 1070, RTX 3060; AMD RX 580 anaa nea eye sen saa). Motherboard a ɛne no hyia, PSU a ɛdɔɔso (anyɛ yiye koraa no 750W ma GPU ahorow pii), ne onwini pa a ɛbɛma ayɛ hyew dodo. Multi-GPU rigs abu so ma hash rates a eye (sɛ nhwɛso no, 6x GPUs tumi nya 1-2 kSol/s). ASIC Mining (Ɛyɛ adwuma yiye nanso ɛho ka yɛ kɛse): ASIC ahorow a ɛne Equihash hyia te sɛ Bitmain Antminer Z15 (420 kSol/s) anaa Innosilicon A9 (50 kSol/s). Eyinom yɛ den, ɛyɛ hyew, na ɛgye ahoɔden pii (sɛ nhwɛso no, 1500W+); a ɛfata ma mmeae a wɔahyira so. Kɔtɔ fi mmeae a agye din te sɛ Bitmain.com anaa wɔn a wɔtɔn nneɛma foforo (Blockware Mining). General: Intanɛt a ɛyɛ den, kɔmputa a wɔde hyehyɛ/hwɛ so. ASICs di ntwamutam no so (13 GSol/s total hashrate wɔ 2026 mu), ɛma GPU mining nyɛ akansi kɛse nanso ɛda so ara yɛ yiye ma wɔn a wɔpɛ anigyede. Software Adwumayɛ Nhyehyɛe: Windows 10/11, Linux (Ubuntu kamfo kyerɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ den). Software a wɔde tu fagude: Wɔ GPU ahorow ho: lolMiner (ɛboa AMD/NVIDIA), GMiner, anaa miniZ (ɛde n’adwene si NVIDIA so). Twe fi GitHub repos a ɛyɛ aban de (sɛ nhwɛso no, github.com/Lolliedieb/lolMiner-releases). Wɔ ASICs ho: Fa firmware/dashboard a wɔde ahyɛ mu no di dwuma (sɛ nhwɛso no, Bitmain wɛb interface). Wallet: Zcash sika kotoku a wɔde gye sika a wotua. Susu ma: Wɔabɔ ho ban (ankorankoro): ZODL Sikakorabea, Zingo (Mobile/Desktop), Zkool (mobile/desktop). Ɛyɛ nea ɛda adi pefee (ɛyɛ mmerɛw nanso ɛnyɛ kokoam de): Edge Wallet, Zecwallet Lite. Twe fi sika kotoku. Yɛ address a wɔabɔ ho ban (ɛhyɛ aseɛ wɔ 'zs') ma kokoamsɛm sɛ pool no boa a. Foforɔ Ɛlektrik: Bu ɛka a wɔbɔ ho akontaa. GPU ahorow de 150-300W di dwuma wɔ kaad biara mu; ASICs 1000W + na ɛwɔ hɔ. Antivirus: Disable bere a woreyɛ nhyehyɛe efisɛ ebetumi ahyɛ miners frankaa sɛ ahunahuna. Akwankyerɛ a Ɛfa Anamɔn biara Ho a Ɛfa Ho a Wobɛka Mining Pool Ho Anamɔn 1: Siesie Wo Zcash Wallet Twe na fa sika kotoku bi fi Zcash wɛbsaet a ɛyɛ aban de no so sika kotoku. Yɛ sika kotoku foforo na fa wo aba kasasin no sie yiye. Yɛ address a wogye (ɛbɛyɛ papa sɛ wɔabɔ ho ban ama kokoamsɛm). Hyɛ no nsow, s.e., zs1exampleaddress.... Sɛ wode address a ɛda adi (fi ase wɔ 't') redi dwuma a, ɛyɛ mmerɛw nanso ɛmma kokoamsɛm pii. Anamɔn 2: Siesie Wo Hardware no Wɔ GPU ahorow ho no: Fa GPU ahorow hyɛ wo PC mu na fa draiver ahorow no foforo (NVIDIA: GeForce Experience; AMD: Radeon Software). Overclock sɛ wowɔ osuahu a (fa MSI Afterburner di dwuma ma ɛyɛ den; fa w’ani si so sɛ +100-200 core clock, -500 memory ma efficiency). Wɔ ASIC ahorow ho no: Fa ASIC no bata tumi ne Ethernet ho. Hwehwɛ ne IP address denam adwinnade te sɛ Advanced IP Scanner anaa nea ɔyɛe no app so

title: 2FA Hardware Mfiri a Wɔde Di Dwuma
description: Data ahobammɔ ne kokoam nsɛm yɛ ade titiriw a ɛhaw ankorankoro ne nnwumakuw nyinaa. Intanɛt so ntua ne data a wobu so reyɛ kɛse, na ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ nneɛma a…
text: 2FA Hardware Mfiri a Wɔde Di Dwuma Data ahobammɔ ne kokoam nsɛm yɛ ade titiriw a ɛhaw ankorankoro ne nnwumakuw nyinaa. Intanɛt so ntua ne data a wobu so reyɛ kɛse, na ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ nneɛma a edi kan de bɔ data a ɛho hia ho ban na wokora wo kokoam nsɛm so. Ade biako a ɛte saa ne sɛ wode hardware security keys bedi dwuma, a ɛma ahobammɔ foforo de bɔ wo mfiri ne wo data ho ban. Dɛn ne hardware ahobammɔ safe? Hardware ahobanbɔ safoa yɛ honam fam mfiri a wɔde di dwuma ma nneɛma abien ahotoso (2FA) de bɔ wo akontaabu ne mfiri ahorow ho ban. Ɛne wo din ne wo password bom yɛ adwuma de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔama wɔn tumi nkutoo na wobetumi anya wo akontaabu ne wo data. Wɔayɛ saa nsafe yi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛne wo din ne wo password bɛyɛ adwuma na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wɔama wɔn tumi nkutoo na wobetumi anya wo akontaabu ne wo data. Wɔba wɔ akwan horow so te sɛ pen drives, NFC cards anaa Bluetooth mfiri. Sɛnea hardware ahobammɔ safoa yɛ adwuma Ɛsɛ sɛ wo nam hardware ahobanbɔ safoa so ma 2FA yɛ adwuma wɔ wɛbsaet anaa platform a ɛboa saa mfiridwuma yi, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no Binance ne Coinbase nsakraeɛ. Sɛ wode hardware ahobanbɔ safoa te sɛ YubiKey di dwuma a, wode hardware safoa no hyɛ USB anaa Type-C port a ɛwɔ wo desktop/laptop anaa smartphone so no mu kɛkɛ, na safoa no wie nokwaredi no ma wo. Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ wode hardware security key bedi dwuma? Hardware ahobammɔ safoa ma mfaso pii sen atetesɛm akwan a wɔfa so di adanse a egyina password so. Ɛyɛ den kɛse sɛ wobɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so sen password ahorow, a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobetumi asɛe denam brute force, social engineering anaa phishing ntua so. Security keys ma code soronko bi ba bere biara a wɔde bedi dwuma, na ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ɛrentumi nyɛ yiye sɛ ntuafo betumi ahyɛ code no ho nkɔm anaasɛ wɔbɛsan ayɛ bi. Ɛnyɛ den nso sɛ wode bedi dwuma na woasiesie na enhia sɛ wode softwea anaa draiver foforo biara bɛhyɛ wo mfiri no so. So hardware ahobammɔ safe ne mfiri ne dwumadi nhyehyɛe nyinaa hyia? Dabi, hardware ahobammɔ safe no wɔ ahorow pii na ebia ɛne mfiri ne dwumadi nhyehyɛe nyinaa nhyia. Ansa na wobɛtɔ safe bi no, hwɛ hu sɛ ɛne wo mfiri ne wo dwumadi nhyehyɛe no hyia. So wobetumi de hardware ahobammɔ safoa adi dwuma wɔ akontaabu ahorow pii mu? Yiw, wobetumi de hardware ahobammɔ safoa biako adi dwuma de abɔ akontaabu pii ho ban wɔ wɛbsaet ne nnwuma ahorow so. Sɛ mehwere me hardware security key a, dɛn na ɛba? Sɛ wohwere wo hardware security key a, wobɛkɔ asiane mu sɛ wɔbɛsiw wo accounts no ano. Wɔhyɛ nyansa sɛ wobɛnya backup key anaa authentication kwan foforɔ na woakwati saa tebea yi. Nhwɛso ahorow a ɛfa 2FA Hardware ho 2FA Hardware a ɛwɔ gua so ho nhwɛsoɔ bi ni. Yubico YubiKey 5 NFC Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so. Yubico, a ɔne no yɛɛ FIDO U2F open authentication standard a ahobanbɔ safoa pii de di dwuma no na ɔyɛɛ no, YubiKey 5 NFC no wɔ nsa a ahobammɔ wom mu de bɔ wo mfiri ho ban. Sɛnea ne din kyerɛ no, ɛde USB A (anaasɛ USB C a wɔde adapter di dwuma) anaa NFC na ɛyɛ adwuma. Ɛde out of the box compatability ne nnwuma pii a Google Chrome, Facebook, Dropbox, LastPass, 1Password ne nea ɛkeka ho ka ho ma. YubiKey 5 no yɛ ketewa, ɛyɛ den na emu yɛ hare - na ɛyɛ nsuo mpo. Wubetumi asiesie YubiKey no sɛ U2F factor a ɛto so abien a ɔhaw biara nni ho denam ɔsom akwankyerɛ a wubedi akyi na wode safoa no ahyɛ USB slot no mu bere a wɔabisa wo no so. Sɛ wobɔ anaa womia sika kɔkɔɔ kurukuruwa a ɛwɔ safoa no so no a, ɛbɛkyerɛw wo safoa no, enti bere foforo a wobɛkɔ mu no, kyerɛw password no kɛkɛ, fa safoa no hyɛ mu, na pia. Thetis Fido U2F Ahobammɔ Safoa Sɛ worehwehwɛ bang-for-buck a eye sen biara wɔ ahobammɔ safoa mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ saa mfonini a efi Thetis yi wɔ wo din mu. Bluetooth biara nni hyɛn no mu (ɛwɔ nea ne bo yɛ den so), na ɛboa FIDO U2F gyinapɛn no nkutoo enti UAF anaa OTP a ɛne ne ho hyia biara nni hɔ. Nanso, ɛbɛma woanya wɛbsaet a ahobammɔ wom sɛ wode Chrome anaa Opera di dwuma sɛ browser wɔ Windows, macOS, anaa Linux so a. Handily, saa ahobammɔ safe a ne bo yɛ den yi sports a compact folding design a ɛkyinkyini aluminum

Arti version 1.4.0 no, wɔde nsakraeɛ a ɛho hia pii aba: RPC interface foforo ma nkitahodi a ɛkɔ anim. Ahosiesie adwuma ma relay mmoa. Nkɔso a aba wɔ ɔsom-afã onion ɔsom pow-ɔsom resistance. text: Graphene OS a wɔde yɛ adwuma TL;DR GrapheneOS yɛ mobile operating system a ɛnyɛ mfasoɔ, open-source a ɛtwe adwene si kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ so, a ɛne Android apps a ɛwɔ da biara da no hyia koraa Ahoɔden titiriw: app sandbox a ɛyɛ den, memory-safe code ne exploit mitigations, hardware-backed verified boot, fine-grained permissions, ne USB-C port ahobammɔ bere a wɔato afiri no mu Installation nam official WebUSB installer (wɔkamfo kyerɛ ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma dodow no ara) anaa command-line flow ma technical users Wɔ Zcash dwumadiefoɔ fam no, ɛyɛ nnyinasoɔ a ɛyɛ den ma mobile ankasa hwɛ: fa ka ho ne sika kotokuo a wɔabɔ ho ban a wɔhwɛ so ne OPSEC ahotew a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn GrapheneOS yɛ adwuma a ɛnyɛ mfasoɔ, a wɔabue ano a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ ɛbɛma kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ akɔ anim wɔ mobile mfiri so berɛ a ɛne Android apps hyia. Saa Operating system yi si so dua kɛseɛ sɛ wɔbɛma kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ mfiridwuma anya nkɔsoɔ, a wɔde wɔn adwene si sandboxing a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den, exploit mitigations, ne permission model no a wɔbɛsiesie so titire. Wɔwoo no afe 2014 wɔ din CopperheadOS, ɛfiri saa berɛ no, ɛdanee wo digyital kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ sohwɛfoɔ a ne ho yɛ hu. GrapheneOS botae titiriw ne sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ ahobammɔ ahye no mu den, te sɛ app sandbox no, a ɛrenka osuahu a ɔde di dwuma no wɔ ɔkwan a enye so. GrapheneOS betumi de toggles ahorow aba ama nneɛma pɔtee bi, te sɛ Network tumi krataa, Sensors kwan, anaa anohyeto bere a wɔato afiri no mu (a ɛkata afã horow te sɛ USB peripherals, camera access, ne quick tiles so). Bio nso, wɔayɛ kokoam nsɛm ne ahobammɔ ho nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa kɛse a ɛfa nea ɔde di dwuma ho no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛma osuahu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a ɔde di dwuma no akɔ so, na emu biara wɔ n’ankasa nea ɔde di dwuma no mu nkɔso. Nneɛma a ɛwɔ GrapheneOS Ahobanbɔ a Ɛyɛ Den GrapheneOS de ahobanbɔ mu nkɔsoɔ kɛseɛ ka ho, te sɛ programming kasa a ɛnyɛ memory-safe ne ahobanbɔ a egyina compiler so de tew mmerɛwyɛ a ɛtaa ba so. Sandboxing Ɛhyɛ app sandboxing den ma ɛtew app ahorow fi wɔn ho wɔn ho ho, na ɛto ntua vectors a ebetumi aba ano hye. Verified Boot GrapheneOS de hardware-backed keys ne boot process a wotumi di ho adanse di dwuma de hwɛ sɛ operating system no yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Enhanced Permissions Ɛma tumi a ɛkɔ anim wɔ app kwan so, ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi siesie na wɔhwɛ nea data apps betumi anya so. Privacy Dashboard Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi ahwɛ na wɔadi app nneyɛe so denam kokoamsɛm dashboard so, na ɛma ɛda adi pefee wɔ data a wɔde di dwuma mu. Ahobanbɔ Nsakraeɛ a Wɔahyɛ mu GrapheneOS de ahobanbɔ foforɔ a ɛyɛ ne berɛ mu ma, ɛhwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no wɔ ahobanbɔ a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛfiri mmerɛwyɛ ho. Strong Encryption Ɛde full-disk encryption di dwuma default, ɛbɔ data a wɔde asie wɔ afiri no so ho ban. Brawser Ahobanbɔ a Wɔatu mpɔn Wɔahyehyɛ browser default no ama ahobanbɔ a ɛkɔ anim, a ahobanbɔ a ɛtia akyidi ka ho. Minimal Pre-installed Apps GrapheneOS de apps a wɔadi kan ahyɛ mu kakraa bi na ɛba, na ɛtew ahobammɔ ne kokoam asiane a ebetumi aba so. USB Hostile Port Protection Ɛma ahobanbɔ a ɛfiri sɛ obiara ntumi nkɔ afiri no so denam USB ports so berɛ a wɔato afiri no mu. Anti-Malware Protections GrapheneOS de nneɛma bi ka ho a ɛbɛma wɔahu na asiw malware a wonim ano. Wɔde n’adwene asi Kokoamsɛm so Wɔayɛ OS no a wɔasi nea ɔde di dwuma no kokoam nsɛm so dua kɛse, na ɛma data a wɔboaboa ano ne nea wɔda no adi no so tew. Open Source Ɛyɛ adwuma a wɔabue ano, a ɛma kwan ma wɔyɛ ade pefee na mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ntoboa ma ahobanbɔ tu mpɔn. title: Namada Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ

text: Namada Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ Dɛn ne Namada? Namada Protocol yɛ adwuma sɛ Layer 1 platform a egyina adanseɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu, a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛma interchain agyapadeɛ-agnostic kokoamsɛm ama. Ɛnam Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC) protocol so no, Namada ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɛba awiei ntɛmntɛm no bom a ɛnyɛ den, na ɛma wotumi yɛ adwuma yiye. Bio nso, Namada ne Ethereum de akwan abien a wontumi mfa wɔn ho nto so si hɔ, na ɛma nkitahodi a ahobammɔ wom na wotumi de ho to so wɔ ntam nkitahodi abien no ntam. Namada de kokoamsɛm di kan denam Multi-Asset Shielded Pool (MASP) circuit no iteration a wɔama anya nkɔso a ɔde bedi dwuma no so. Saa nkyerɛaseɛ a wɔayɛ no foforɔ yi ma agyapadeɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa, a fungible ne non-fungible tokens nyinaa ka ho, tumi de shared shielded set di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛdeɛ Zcash. Nea ɛde ba ne sɛ, adeyɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔde agyapade a wɔaboa no bɛma Namada no bɛyɛ soronko bere a ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ wobehu esiane kokoamsɛm a ɛkorɔn a ɛwɔ mu nti. Afei nso, Multi Asset Shielded Pool circuit no foforɔ a ɛtwa toɔ no ma shielded set rewards a ɛyɛ groundbreaking feature anaa incentive a ɛkyekyɛ nneɛma de hyɛ kokoamsɛm ho nkuran sɛ ɔmanfoɔ yiedie. Ethereum Bridge + IBC a ɛne no hyia Ethereum bridge no a wɔde bɛka Namada ho no ma ɛho nhia sɛ wɔyɛ protocol a ɛyɛ soronko, efisɛ ɛbɛyɛ Namada abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ no fã titire. Wɔde ahyɛ Validators a wɔwɔ Namada mu no nsa sɛ wɔmfa bridge no nkɔ Namada protocol titiriw no nkyɛn. Saa validators yi nso yɛ relayers bere a ɛfa agyapadeɛ a wɔde bɛma Namada, na ɛma actors foforɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no ho nhia. Ɔkwan foforo so no, sɛ wɔde agyapade rekɔma Ethereum a, abɔnten so nnipa (a wonim wɔn sɛ relayers) na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ɛwom sɛ wonni asɛyɛde biara sɛ wɔbɛma bridge no ayɛ nokware anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ ho ban de. Namada Protocol nso wɔ tumi a ɛde ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biara a ɛyɛ ntɛm a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛboa Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC) protocol no di nkitaho a ɛnyɛ den. Sɛ ɛba sɛ wɔne Ethereum bɛyɛ adwuma a, Namada de Ethereum bridge soronko bi a ahobammɔ wom a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔkwan a wontumi mfa wɔn ho nto so so di dwuma. Wɔayɛ saa bridge yi yie sɛ ɛbɛma ahobanbɔ adi kan denam flow controls a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den ama bridge connections nyinaa na wɔadi Ethereum transfer biara a ɛdi mfomsoɔ sɛ mfomsoɔ kɛseɛ a ɛbɛtumi ama wɔatwa asotweɛ so. Shielded Set Akatua a Wɔde Ma Wɔ update a aba foforo a ɛfa.. Namada Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ, wɔhyɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wɔwɔ agyapade a wɔabɔ ho ban no nkuran ma wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔabɔ ho ban a wɔkyɛ no mu denneennen. Eyi nam MASP circuit a wɔayɛ no foforo a wɔde afrafra mu, a mprempren Convert Circuit foforo no ka ho no so na ɛbae. Ɛdenam saa ade foforo yi a wɔde di dwuma so no, Namada hyɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no nkuran sɛ wɔmfa mmoa mma wɔ kyɛfa a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu denam agyapade a wɔabɔ ho ban a wɔbɛkura so. Wɔ Namada, wobu set a wɔabɔ ho ban no sɛ ɛyɛ ɔmanfo yiyedi a ɛnyɛ nea ɛfa obiara ho na ɛne akansifo nhyia. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ bere a ankorankoro pii de nneɛma a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo a wɔabɔ ho ban di dwuma no, kokoam nsɛm ho bɔhyɛ ahorow no tu mpɔn ma obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu no. Protocol no gye hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔbom gye tom na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛma akɔ anim ama wɔn a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa. Enti, ɛdenam nkuranhyɛ a ɛkanyan wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ma wokura agyapade a wɔabɔ ho ban na wɔboa ma wɔkyɛ ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe no mu no, Namada hyɛ kokoam nsɛm a ɛyɛ den na ɛyɛ den ho nkuran. Agyapade a Wɔabɔ ho Ban ho Nkitahodi Sɛ ɛba shielded transfers so a, sɛ́ ɛfa Ethereum non-fungible token (NFT), ATOM, anaa NAM ho no, wontumi nkyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda wɔn ho wɔn ho ntam. Wei kyerɛ sɛ nneɛma a ɛkora kokoam nsɛm so a MASP (Modified Accumulator Sapling Protocol), Zcash Sapling amansin no fã a wɔama anya nkɔsoɔ de ama no, fa agyapadeɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa ho pɛpɛɛpɛ. MASP amansin no ma agyapadeɛ a ɛwɔ Namada abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ no mu nyinaa tumi kyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ korɔ a wɔabɔ ho ban. Saa kwan yi hwɛ hu sɛ wɔrenkyekyɛ kokoam nsɛm ho bɔhyɛ ahorow mu

title: Nym Mixnet Anonymity ma Zcash
description: Wɔdii ho adanseɛ a ɛtwa toɔ: Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 18, 2026
text: Nym Mixnet Anonymity ma Zcash Wɔdii ho adanseɛ a ɛtwa toɔ: Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 18, 2026 Zcash shielded pools sie sika dodow, wɔn a wɔde kɔma, ne wɔn a wogye wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so. Wɔmfa ntwamutam kwan a ɛda sika kotoku ne lightwallet server ntam no nsie. Nym's mixnet no de saa network-layer ahobammɔ a ɛyera no ka ho. Ɛde besi October 2026 no, nkabom no yɛ live wɔ production wallets (Zingo, Zkool). Farebae: Sɛnea Nym de anonymity ka Zcash sika kotoku ho (Nym, 13 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2026). Nea wɔbɔ ho ban Nym bubu ayɔnkofa packets (mpɛn pii no 7–15 KB a ɛyɛ sika a wɔsɛe no data ne ZK adanse) kɔ Sphinx packets mu na ɛde fa mixnet no so. Wei: Ɛde nea ɔde amena no IP sie fi lightwallet server no so Blends traffic no ne Nym traffic afoforo Ɛma entropy bɛyɛ 17 bits wɔ default nhyehyɛe mu, a cited anonymity a wɔahyehyɛ no boro 100,000 a wɔde di dwuma Katua ne boɔ a wɔbisa wɔ Zingo v7 mu no di saa kwan yi akyi default so. Nea wɔammɔ ho ban Chain synchronization, nullifier queries, transaction fetches, ne mempool traffic mprempren de indexer nkitahodi a ɛyɛ daa no di dwuma. Device-level anaa application-level metadata a ɛwɔ packets a wɔadi afra no akyi nso wɔ Nym's akyi. Sɛ wo ahunahuna nhwɛso no hwehwɛ sɛ wode sync traffic sie a, fa native-mixnet sika kotoku ne system-level NymVPN. Hwɛ Nym VPN na ɛwɔ hɔ. Sika kotoku Sikabɔtɔ Gyinabea Nsɛm a Wɔahyɛ no Nsow --- --- --- Zingo v7 Live, default, default makers run-cli bundles a wɔde ahyɛ mu nym-proxy. Nhyiam no fi ase wɔ offline; --online, --remember-online, or --server ma wɔpene so. Zkool Te ase Native mixnet nkabom. Afoforo nso Ɛnam NymVPN Fa sika kotoku no fa system-level Mixnet mode so. Setup ho nsɛm ma wallet-level kwan no wɔ mu Fa Zcash Wallet Traffic no fa Nym Mixnet no so. Nneɛma a wɔde di gua Nym-routed broadcast yɛ bɛyɛ 12.5× brɛoo sen clearnet (3.4 s). Tor yɛ ntɛmntɛm (3.7×) nanso ɛde FIFO nsuten di dwuma a ɛnfrafra, enti wiase nyinaa ɔtamfo da so ara betumi ayɛ abusuabɔ. Nym dwumadiefoɔ a wɔkyɛ no a wobɛma ayɛ kɛseɛ no ma anonymity kɔ soro yie sene sɛ wode akyɛdeɛ foforɔ bɛka ho. Ahotew a wɔde di dwuma-layer: nym-swizzle-zcash Network-layer ahobammɔ nnɔɔso. Sɛ wowɔ mixnet anaa VPN a ɛyɛ pɛ mpo a, lightwallet server da so ara tumi de nhyiam ahorow bata ho denam application-layer nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɔbɛhwɛ so: Resume-point chaining: akraman san fi ase sync fi pɛpɛɛpɛ previous end + 1, enti server no betumi abɔ nhyiam ahorow no nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn denam block height nkutoo so. Sync-then-send: sika kotokuo yɛ sync ntɛm ara ansa na wɔabɔ amanneɛ, na ɛma server no de asɛm bi to sync session a atwam no so. No nym-swizzle-zcash crate de ahotew ho nhyehyɛe Zcash-specific a ɛfa abien no nyinaa ho di dwuma. Ɛyɛ packages general no nym-swizzle primitives akɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn-aware nhyehyɛe ma hann akrafo. Quantised sync ranges. Wɔtrɛw abisadeɛ mu kɔ network-wide grid a ɛwɔ cells a ne kɛseɛ te sɛ da. Wɔyɛ mfiase no kurukuruwa kɔ fam na wɔde awiei no yɛ kurukuruwa kɔ soro. Ranges yɛ nea wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, ɛforo kɔ soro, na ɛnyɛ nea ɛka bom. Reorg checks tra widened range no mu enti wɔda resume point pɔtee no adi. Nnipa a wɔmmɔ wɔn din no fi nhyiam (sika kotoku pii a ɛma ahye koro no ara) mmom sen dede. Decoupled broadcasts. Wɔnam exponential distribution (kyerɛ sɛ 144 blocks ≈ nnɔnhwerew 3, cap 576 blocks ≈ nnɔnhwerew 12) a ɛne ZIP 318 transfer nhyehyɛe hyia so twentwɛn nkitahodi a wɔde mena no ase. Nneɛma a ɛkyɛ boro nhyehyɛe no nkwa nna a wɔtaa de di dwuma no so, enti wɔkɔ so yɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow. Wɔkyekye asɛm no wɔ ogya bere mu nkutoo atia tip foforo. Ɛsɛ sɛ Sync ne broadcast de server ahorow di dwuma. Crate no da adi BlockSource ne TxBroadcaster su ahorow, boaboa ano ma wasm32-unknown-unknown, na enni n’ankasa network stack biara. Afei wobɛtumi de wo PGP adwinnadeɛ no ayɛ encrypt email no denam nea wogye no ɔmanfoɔ safoa no so. Email a wɔabɔ no kokoam no rentumi nkenkan obiara a onni nea ogye no kokoam safe no. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokyerɛw email no a, nea wogye no no betumi de wɔn kokoam safoa no ayɛ decrypt email no. Nneyɛe a Ɛyɛ Paara Nneyɛe pa bi a wɔfa so de PGP di dwuma ni: Fa wo kokoam safe no sie dwoodwoo. text: Nea Enti a Kokoam Nsɛm Ho Hia TL;DR Tor fa wo traffic kwan fa relays abiɛsa so na ɛyɛ adwuma ma wɛb ne onion dwumadie a ɛyɛ daa no nyinaa — ɛnnɛ ɛyɛ default a ɛyɛ adwuma ma anonymising wallet connections ne browsing I2P yɛ peer-to-peer overlay network a wɔabɔ no kokoam koraa a wɔayɛ ama n’ankasa emu nnwuma; mprempren Zcash node biara nni hɔ a ɛka I2P ankasa Wɔ mobile so: fa Zcash sika kotoku bi fa Tor so wɔ tap kakraa bi mu ne Orbot ("Tor Enabled Apps") Zcash node a wobɛtu mmirika wɔ Tor so no ntumi nyɛ yie mprempren: zcashd duu mmoa awiei wɔ 18 July 2026, na Zebra's Tor feature no da so ara yɛ adwuma wɔ soro Tor de baabi a wowɔ sie, ɛnyɛ nea woyɛ wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so — nnwuma a ɛda adi pefee da so ara wɔ baguam Wɔ dijitaal bere yi mu no, ahobammɔ a wobɛbɔ wo kokoamusɛm abɛyɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse. Bere a ebia ebinom bebu kokoam nsɛm sɛ ade a ayera de, nanso ɛnte saa. Wo kokoam nsɛm da asiane mu na ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ ade a ɛhaw wo. Kokoam nsɛm som bo kɛse efisɛ ɛfa tumi ho, na hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde tumi bedi dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu no ho hia yiye. Tor & I2P Mfiridwuma Ho Nneɛma Tor Tor yɛ proxy adwinnade a ɛde Tor network no di dwuma de hyehyɛ nkitahodi ma application ahorow. Tor nya eyi denam wɔn kar akwan a wɔfa Tor, na ɛnam so ma ɛyɛ kɛse kokoam nsɛm ne din a wɔmmɔ ma saa akwammisa ahorow yi. I2P Ntrɛwmu I2P network a wɔsan frɛ no.. Intanɛt Dwumadi a Aniwa Nhu, yɛ peer-to-peer overlay network a wɔabɔ no kokoam koraa. Ɛhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde nkrasɛm no mu nsɛm, fibea, ne baabi a ɛkɔ no asie wɔn a wɔhwɛ no. Ɔkwan foforo so no, obiara ntumi nhu baabi a kar no fi anaa baabi a ɛrekɔ anaa nkrasɛm a wɔde rekɔ no mu nsɛm ankasa. Encryption a wɔde di dwuma wɔ I2P mu no hwɛ hu sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no nya kokoam nsɛm a ɛkorɔn na wɔmmɔ din. I2P a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu Nneɛma abien na wɔde di dwuma. Mfitiase no Java I2P na ɛwɔ hɔ ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ Windows, macOS, Linux ne Android. i2pd, a wɔde C++ akyerɛw no, yɛ hare na ɛyɛ nea wɔtaa paw wɔ server anaa afiri a ahoɔden sua so. Sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma wie a, I2P da mpɔtam hɔ console bi adi wɔ so 127.0.0.1:7657 ne proxy ahorow a ɛwɔ so 127.0.0.1:4444 (HTTP) ne 127.0.0.1:4447 (SƆKOSO). Hwɛ kwan sɛ ebegye simma pii wɔ mfiase a edi kan no mu: Ɛsɛ sɛ I2P yɛ tunnels fa network no so ansa na biribiara ayɛ adwuma, na ɛyɛ ntɛmntɛm bere tenten a ɛtra intanɛt so no. I2P a wode bedi dwuma ne Zcash Hu sɛ mprempren Zcash node biara nka I2P natively. Zebra nni I2P mmoa, na zcashd. Sɛ wohu akwankyerɛ bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛde Zcash node di dwuma wɔ I2P so a, ɛrekyerɛkyerɛ biribi a softwea no nyɛ mu. Nea I2P ho wɔ mfaso ankasa ma ha ne biribiara a atwa sika kotoku no ho ahyia: sɛ wobɛkɔ sait bi, forum anaa ɔsom bi so a worenda wo address adi. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɔ sika kotoku nkitahodi no ankasa din a, Tor ne ɔkwan a mfaso wɔ so nnɛ, na afã horow a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no kata so. Tor ne I2P kyɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ pɛ nanso ɛwɔ nsonsonoe kɛse nso. Tor ne I2P nyinaa yɛ decentralized ne anonymous peer-to-peer networks, nanso I2P ma ahobanbɔ a ɛkorɔn sɛ wɔde toto Tor. Nanso, wɔayɛ I2P titire sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ nnwuma te sɛ email, chat, ne torrentin wɔ ne network mu na wontumi mfa nni dwuma mfa nkɔ intanɛt a wɔde di dwuma daa no so. Ɔkwan foforɔ so no, Tor ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kwan ma wɔkɔ wɛbsaet a emu dɔ no so, te sɛ I2P, nanso ɛsan nso yɛ adwuma sɛ browser a ɛyɛ daa a wɔde kɔ wɛbsaet a ɛwɔ wɛb a ɛwɔ soro no so. Hyɛ no nsow: Sɛ wopɛ nsɛm pii fa nsɛdi ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ Tor & I2P mu ho a, kɔ hɔ ha Mobile sika kotoku a wɔde Orbot refa Tor so Orbot yɛ virtual private network (VPN) a ɛho ka sua a wɔayɛ ama smartphones a ɛkyerɛ traffic fi applications nyinaa a ɛwɔ wo device so denam Tor network so. Di akwankyerɛ yi akyi na fa Zcash sika kotoku bi fa Tor. Hyɛ no nsow sɛ YWallet, a akwankyerɛ yi nkyerɛase ahorow a atwam no de dii dwuma no, wɔnhwɛ so bio na ɛrenni netɛw no akyi wɔ Ironwood, enti paw sika kotoku a wɔahwɛ so yiye fi Sika kotoku kratafa. Twe na fa Orbot fi app store no so. Sɛ wo instɔl wie a, nkyia nkrasɛm bɛda adi. Kɔ so kɔ Orbot home page no so na klik 'Tor Enabled Apps' so.

title: VPN & dVPN na ɛyɛ adwuma
description: Wɔ dijitaal bere yi mu no, intanɛt so kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu no ho hia sen biara. Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) ne decentralized VPNs…
text: VPN & dVPN na ɛyɛ adwuma Wɔ dijitaal bere yi mu no, intanɛt so kokoamsɛm ne ahobammɔ a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu no ho hia sen biara. Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) ne decentralized VPNs (dVPNs) di dwuma titiriw wɔ wo intanɛt dwumadi ne data a wobɛbɔ ho ban mu. Saa wiki krataafa yi hwehwɛ nsonsonoeɛ titire a ɛda atetesɛm VPN ne dVPN a ɛreba ntam, ahobanbɔ ho nsusuiɛ berɛ a worepaw VPN, ne VPN dwumadie ahodoɔ a ɛgye cryptocurrency a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho, Zcash. Dɛn Ne Nsonsonoe no? Virtual Private Networks (VPNs): Atetesɛm VPNs yɛ ɔkwan a ahobammɔ wom, a wɔabɔ no kokoam wɔ wo mfiri ne akyirikyiri server a VPN dwumadie no di so ntam. Saa kwan yi de wo intanɛt so dwumadi ahorow sie na aniwa a ɛhwehwɛ wo te sɛ hackers, ISPs, anaa aban adwumayɛbea ahorow. Wɔde VPNs di dwuma kɛse wɔ atirimpɔw ahorow te sɛ browsing a wɔmmɔ obiara din, nsɛm a wɔabara wɔ geo-restricted a wobenya, ne ahobammɔ a wɔbɔ fi cyber ahunahuna ho. Decentralized VPNs (dVPNs): Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, dVPNs de blockchain ne peer-to-peer mfiridwuma di dwuma de yɛ decentralized network of nodes. Wɔde wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no akwantu fa saa node ahorow yi so, na ɛma ɛyɛ den ma adwumakuw biako biara sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ anaasɛ ɛbɛhwɛ ntam nkitahodi no nyinaa so. dVPNs taa yɛ nea ɛko tia censorship kɛse, efisɛ tumidi biara nni hɔ a ɛwɔ mfinimfini a ɛhwɛ network no so. Wɔfata yiye ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma a wɔrehwehwɛ kokoam nsɛm ne ahobammɔ a ɛkɔ anim. Ahobammɔ ho Nsusuwii Bere a Worepaw VPN Sɛ worepaw VPN dwumadie a, ɛho hia sɛ wosusu ahobanbɔ ho nneɛma a ɛdidi soɔ yi ho: Encryption: Hwɛ sɛ VPN no de encryption protocols a ɛyɛ den te sɛ OpenVPN anaa WireGuard di dwuma de bɔ wo data ho ban fi interception ho. No-Logs Policy: Hwehwɛ providers a wɔwɔ no-logs policy a ɛyɛ katee, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa wo intanɛt dwumadi ahorow ho kyerɛwtohɔ nsie. Server Beaeɛ: Susuw asasesin mu nkyekyɛmu a ɛwɔ server mmeaeɛ no ho na ama woanya nsɛm a ɛfiri mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu na woatew latency so. Kill Switch: Kill switch bɛtwa wo intanɛt no mu sɛ VPN nkitahodi no kɔ fam a, na ɛremma wo data no ntumi nda adi. Kokoamsɛm ne Tumi: Hwehwɛ VPN dwumadie no kokoamsɛm ho nneyɛeɛ ne ne tumidi mu, ɛfiri sɛ aman ahodoɔ wɔ mmara ahodoɔ a ɛfa data a wɔde sie ho. Leak Protection: Hwɛ sɛ VPN no siw DNS ne WebRTC leaks ano na ama woanya wo din. Boɔ ne Nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu: Hwɛ ɛka ne nneɛma a wɔn a wɔde ma ahodoɔ de ma no mu na woanya bi a ɛne w’ahiadeɛ ne wo sikasɛm hyia. VPN ahorow a Egye Zcash Zcash (ZEC) yɛ cryptocurrency a wɔayɛ ama kokoam nsɛm a ɛkɔ anim, na ɛma ɛyɛ nea ankorankoro a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn din wɔ wɔn sikasɛm mu nkitahodi mu no ani gye ho. Bere a ɛnyɛ VPN dwumadie nyinaa na ɛgye Zcash tẽẽ no, ebinom betumi agye cryptocurrency sikatua denam ntamgyinafoɔ dwumadie so. Nanso, ɛho hia sɛ wo ne VPN dwumadie no hwehwɛ tẽẽ hwehwɛ sikatua akwan a ɛyɛ foforɔ paa. VPN dwumadie kakraa bi a wonim sɛ ɛgye cryptocurrency sikatua ni: Mullvad VPN na ɛyɛ adwuma Mullvad VPN yɛ VPN dwumadie a wɔbu no kɛseɛ a wonim no sɛ ɛde ne ho a emu yɛ den ma ɔdefoɔ kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ. Ɛyɛ VPN a wɔde ma kakraa bi a wogye cryptocurrency no mu biako, a nea ɛka ho ne Zcash, sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so tua ka. Mullvad no mu nneɛma atitiriw bi ne: No-Logs Policy: Mullvad di no-logs nhyehyeɛ a ɛyɛ katee akyi, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛnkora data biara a ɛfa wo intanɛt dwumadiɛ ho. Strong Encryption: Ɔsom no de encryption protocols a ɛyɛ den di dwuma, a WireGuard ka ho, de bɔ wo data ho ban. Multi-Hop VPN: Mullvad de option ma multi-hop connections ma, a ɛde wo traffic fa server ahodoɔ pii so de ma kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ tu mpɔn. Bridge Mode: Ɛwɔ bridge mode a ebetumi aboa ma wɔatwa censorship nhyehyɛe ahorow bi ho. Anonymous Account Creation: Wɔde akontaabu nɔma a wɔayɛ no kwa ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no, na ɛmma enhia sɛ wonya ankorankoro ho nsɛm bere a wɔrekyerɛw wɔn din no. Zcash Payment: Mullvad gye Zcash tom sɛ sikatua kwan, ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi tua wɔn nkrataahyɛ ho ka denam kokoamsɛm a ɛkɔ anim so.Mullvad VPN.
