title: Wɛbsaet Browser ahorow
description: Sɛ worepaw wɛb brawsa a nneɛma kakraa bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wode sie w’adwene mu: Wɔtaa hu ahobammɔ ho mmerɛwyɛ ne mfaso a wɔde di dwuma daa. Browser ahorow bi wɔ…
text: Wɛbsaet Browser ahorow Brave: Browser a agye din na ahobammɔ wom sen biara wɔ gua so nnɛ no mu biako. Ɛsiw kokoam nsɛm-invasive ads & trackers. Ɛsiw nnipa foforo data a wɔkora so no kwan. Mulvad: Wɛb brawsa a ɛtwe adwene si kokoamsɛm so a wɔayɛ no wɔ Mullvad VPN ne Tor Project ntam. Wɔayɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtew tracking ne fingerprinting so Tor: Saa browser yi siw plugins te sɛ Flash, RealPlayer, QuickTime, ne afoforo kwan: wobetumi ayɛ nsakrae wɔ mu ma ada wo IP address adi. Yɛnhyɛ nyansa sɛ fa add-ons anaa plugins foforo hyɛ Tor Browser mu Dɛn Ne Ahobammɔ Ho Nsusuwii Bere a Worepaw Wɛb Browser? Sɛ worepaw wɛb brawsa a nneɛma kakraa bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wode sie w’adwene mu: Wɔtaa hu ahobammɔ ho mmerɛwyɛ ne mfaso a wɔde di dwuma daa. Browser ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wotumi hwehwɛ mu wɔ ɔkwan bi so, nanso, browser ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi hwehwɛ nneɛma mu a wɔmmɔ wɔn din - Tor browser Nhwɛsoɔ. Nsateaa: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode nneɛma sie kokoam te sɛ, software ahorow a wɔde ahyɛ wo mfiri no so, hardware nhyehyɛe, ne nea ɛkeka ho a, susuw ho sɛ wobɛhwɛ wɛb browser a ɛboa nsateaa nkyerɛwee resistance feature. HTTPS Sɔhwɛ: Ahobanbɔ ho adwene foforo a ɛsɛ sɛ wohwɛ yiye bere a worepaw wɛb brawsa ne HTTPS Sɔhwɛ protocol a ɛboa ma wɔde wɛbsaet nkitahodi sie na ɛde kuki, URL ne metadata ahorow a ɛho hia afoforo sie. HTTPS, nkitahodi no yɛ encrypted na nnipa foforo biara nni network no so ntumi nkenkan nsɛm a wɔde rekɔ server ne wo browser ntam. Kuki Ahobanbɔ a Wɔdi Akyi: Nea ɛsen saa no, wɛb nkratafa a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa wɛb no fã kɛse bi wɔ nnipa a wɔdi akyire a wɔde asie; saa trackers yi kenkan na wɔkyerɛw cookies wɔ wo browser no mu. Saa cookies yi betumi de aduru bɔne aba efisɛ wobetumi de adi wo browsing akyi wɔ wɛbsaet ahorow so; sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubesiw saa akyidi yi ano no, paw wɛb brawsa a esiw browsing cookies a wonnim ano. Navigation Test: Bere a worekɔ wɛbsaet krataafa biako so akɔ foforo so no, wubehu link ahorow pii (ebinom yɛ link ahorow a ɛwɔ mu bere a afoforo nso rekɔ wɛbsaet foforo so). Bere a wobɔ saa link ahorow yi so no, browser API ahorow bi ma sait a edi kan no ne sait a ɛto so abien no di nkitaho. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wusiesie eyi a, paw wɛb brawsa a ɛmma wɛbsaet ahorow ntumi nkyɛ tracking data bere a woabɔ link bi so no. Sɛ worepaw saa browser a wote nka sɛ ebia ɛbɛfata w’ahiade no a, hwɛ hu sɛ ɛde kokoam nsɛm a ɛyɛ den ne nneɛma a ɛho hia te sɛ ad blockers a wɔde ahyɛ mu ne nea ɛnte saa bɛma. Bio nso, saa wɛb brawsa yi mu pii boa ntrɛwmu a wɔde ka ho na ɛtɔ da bi a saa ntrɛwmu yi betumi de ahobammɔ ho asiane aba, hwɛ hu sɛ bere nyinaa wobɛhyehyɛ saa ntrɛwmu yi afi abɔde a nkwa wom nhyehyɛe a wɔabɔ ho ban anaa mmeae a wogye di. Brave Browser Zcash Sikakorabea Nkabom Brave browser rebue kwan ama web3 ecosystem no. Sɛn? Mprempren wobetumi de domɛn bɛboro ɔpepem 2 a wontumi nsiw ano adi dwuma de akyerɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a wɔde ahyɛ aman no nsa. Brave Browsers ahobanbɔ a ɛyɛ den nti, nkurɔfo betumi ahwehwɛ intanɛt so a wonni wɔn akyi. Brave ne Zcash reyɛ biako de kokoam nsɛm ho nnwinnade foforo aba Web3 ecosysem mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mfaso kɛse bɛba no, Brave bɛka abom ntɛmntɛm ne Zcash protocol denam Brave's crypto sika kotoku a wɔasisi mu no so de asakra crypto nkitahodi - Saa nkabom yi bɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no atumi de ahobammɔ asie, de amena , na wɔagye ZEC ntɛm ara ne crypto sika afoforo nso. Nkitahodi a ɛda Brave wɛb brawsa ne Zcash ntam no bɛsesa agoru no ampa efisɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no benya tumi kɛse wɔ wɔn Web3 dwumadi so. Nokwasɛm foforo a ɛyɛ anigye wɔ Brave browser ne Zcash nkabom ho ne kokoam ne decentralized nkrasɛm afã no; Brave, ECC, ne Filecoin Foundation kuw no rebue kwan ama kokoamsɛm-gyinasoɔ afã wɔ Brave browser no mu - saa adwumayɛkuo yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛde kokoam nkrasɛm ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ nkrasɛm bɛma denam Zcash protocol so. Ɛha yi, Interplanetary File System (IPFS) bedi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ sɛnea wɔde nneɛma a wɔde asie a ahobammɔ wom a wɔde bɛma no mu.

Kokoamsɛm ne ade titiriw a ɛwɔ Zcash. Ɛno na edii kan de adanse a wonni nimdeɛ biara dii dwuma de sie nnwuma nyinaa so. Sika kotoku pii wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de atua sika ntɛm ara, wɔ telefon so, ahobammɔ ne kokoam: Sika kotoku Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya Zcash? Wubetumi atɔ ZEC wɔ so nneɛma a wɔde sesa wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra so, DEX ahorow no, or centralized swap platform ahorow a wɔde sesa nneɛma. Wubetumi nso atɔ Zcash peer-to-peer anaasɛ woanya denam mining so. Nsonsonoe bɛn na ɛda Zcash ne cryptocurrencies afoforo ntam? Zcash yɛ titiriw kokoam sen Bitcoin anaa Ethereum. Ɛma block times ntɛmntɛm (sekan 75), ɛka a ɛba fam, ne daa upgrades. Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi apaw Transparent anaa Shielded nkitahodi ahorow. Sɛ wopɛ nsɛm pii a, hwɛ Abɔde a Nkwa Wom a Wɔabɔ Ho Ban. Ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔhwɛ Zcash protocol no so? Zcash Nkɔsoɔ Ho Nsusuiɛ (ZIP) nhyehyɛeɛ no na ɛdi protocol no so. Obiara betumi de ZIP. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ gye nsɛm a wɔayɛ no ho akyinnyeɛ na ZIP samufoɔ no gye tom anaa wɔpo: Daira Hopwood na ɔkyerɛwee (Electric Coin Company) Deirdre Connolly na ɔkyerɛwee (Zcash Foundation) Wɔkyerɛw gyinaesi ahorow wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu no mu na wɔpene so wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so bere a ntam nkitahodi no gye tom no. Ɛhe na me Transaction no wɔ? Di kan kenkan yɛn akwankyerɛ a yɛde siw nhwehwɛmufo kwan. Afei hwɛ Zcash Block Nhwehwɛmufoɔ. Nnwuma no twam wɔ bɛyɛ simma 25 (20 blocks) akyi na wɔsan de sika no ba ara kwa. Nteaseɛ a ɛtaa ba sɛ ebia asɛm bi renpue: Nkitahodi a ɛyera Transaction fee a ɛba fam dodo Network a ɛboro so Nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ mu a ɛda adi pefee dodow (kɛse yɛ kɛse dodo) Afotuo a ɛbɛma woadi nkonim: Fa nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den di dwuma Tua sika a wɔtaa tua (anaasɛ nea ɛboro saa ma nea edi kan) Twɛn na san sɔ hwɛ akyiri yi Fa inputs kakraa bi di dwuma na ama asɛm no ayɛ ketewaa So Zcash yɛ Private ampa? Yiw. Zcash de encrypt de nea ɔde kɔma, sika dodow, ne nea ogye no data ma nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ban. Zcash nyɛ ɛnyɛ: Encrypt multisignature nkitahodi (FROST nkabom da so ara wɔ hɔ) Bɔ ho ban fi abusuabɔ a ɛda nnwuma a ɛda adi pefee ntam Fa IP address ahorow sie Akenkan foforo: Abɔde a Nkwa Wom a Wɔabɔ Ho Ban zcashd gyaee adwuma, dɛn na metu mmirika seesei? zcashd yɛ obi a wakɔ pɛnhyen. Di kan sua stack no Ahodwiriw a ɛtaa ma adansifo a wofi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn afoforo mu ne adesua curve ma Zcash infrastructure, ɛnyɛ coding. Ma wo ho bere fa te sɛnea asinasin no hyia ase ansa na woayɛ wo app no. Fi ase de core stack a wɔtaa frɛ no Z kɔ nea ɛto so abiɛsa no so: zebrad, light server, ne wallet. text: ZGo Payment Processor: Gye Zcash a Wonnye Nhwɛso ZGo yɛ sikatua ho dwumadie a ɛnyɛ sikatua ho dwumadie ma Zcash. Adetɔfoɔ bi tua ka wɔ ZEC mu firi wɔn ankasa sika kotokuo mu, ZGo hwɛ Zcash blockchain no so ma asɛm no, na sika no kɔ aguadifoɔ no sika kotokuo mu tẽẽ denam shielded transfer so. ZGo nkura sika no wɔ ntam da. Saa akwankyerɛ yi kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea sikatua kwan no yɛ adwuma, sɛnea wɔhyehyɛ akontaabu, ne sɛnea wɔde ZGo ne Xero ne WooCommerce bɛka abom. Ɛsan nso ka mfomso abien a ɛde ɔhaw dodow no ara a ɛba bere a edi kan wɔ nhyehyɛe mu ba no so. Wɔ kratafa yi so Dɛn nti na wode ZGo bedi dwuma Sɛnea ZGo yɛ adwuma Wɔrehyehyɛ akontaabu ZGo ne Xero ZGo ne WooCommerce Su Mfomso ahorow a wɔtaa di Awie Akadeɛ Dɛn nti na wode ZGo bedi dwuma Cryptocurrency sikatua processors dodow no ara yɛ custodial. Sika di kan kɔ fam wɔ nea ɔyɛ adwuma no akontaabu mu na wɔde kɔma aguadifo no akyiri yi, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi a ɔto so abiɛsa di sika no so bere tiaa bi na obetumi de asie, akyɛ, anaasɛ wabɔ ho amanneɛ. ZGo fa ɔkwan a ɛne no bɔ abira so. Katua fi adetɔfo no sika kotoku mu kɔ aguadifo no sika kotoku mu tẽẽ denam Zcash shielded asɛmdi so. Processor no nkutoo na ɛyɛ invoice no na ɔhwɛ blockchain no ma ɛyɛ nokware. Ntamgyinafo biara nni hɔ a ɛkari pɛ, sika a woyi fi mu nni hɔ, na obi a ɔto so abiɛsa biara nni hɔ a obetumi akura sika a wobesiesie no mu. Wɔ aguadifo fam no, eyi kyerɛ nneɛma abiɛsa a mfaso wɔ so: ZEC a ɛba no a wɔbɛhwɛ so koraa, asɛm no ho kokoamsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban denam default so, ne ahotoso a wonni wɔ centralized provider a ɔbɛtra intanɛt so anaasɛ solvent so. Sɛnea ZGo yɛ adwuma Katua a ɛkɔ so no yɛ pɛ ɛmfa ho sɛ wɔde ZGo bedi dwuma a egyina hɔ ma ne ho, ɛnam Xero so, anaasɛ ɛnam WooCommerce so: Oguadifoɔ no yɛ sikatua abisadeɛ wɔ ZGo mu, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ QR koodu a sika dodoɔ, invoice ID, ne Zcash gye address. Adetɔfoɔ no de Zcash sika kotokuo scan QR no (Orchard, Sapling, ne Transparent address ahodoɔ no nyinaa boa wɔ WordPress plugin no so) na ɔpene sikatua no so. Wɔde asɛm no kɔ Zcash network no so sɛ shielded transfer fi adetɔfo no sika kotoku mu kɔ aguadifo no sika kotoku mu. ZGo hwɛ Zcash blockchain no so ma asɛm no. Wɔ si so dua anum akyi no, ZGo hyɛ sikatua no agyirae sɛ nea etwa to na ɛbɔ nkabom biara a ɛka bom (Xero, WooCommerce, anaa wɛbhook) amanneɛ. Anum-si so dua aboboano no ne nɔma titiriw no. Biribiara a edi kan no yɛ sika a wɔretua, na ɛnyɛ sika a wɔagye. Ɛsɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔkra no mmamu, nneɛma a wɔakora so no foforo, ne adeyɛ biara a wontumi nsakra wɔ aguadifo afã no twɛn anammɔn 5. ZGo yɛ adwuma wɔ nnɛyi browser biara mu wɔ desktop anaa mobile so, a enni instɔlehyɛn biara wɔ afã abien no nyinaa. Adetɔfo no hia Zcash sika kotoku; aguadifoɔ no hia Zcash sika kotokuo ne ZGo akonta. Akontaabu a wobɛhyehyɛ Sɛ wobɛbɔ ZGo akonta a, Zcash sika kotoku a ZEC kakraa bi na ɛwɔ mu ho hia. text: Maya Decentralized Exchange (Maya Asekyerɛbea a ɛnni tumi) --- Adesuabea a wɔhwɛ so Dɛn ne Maya Protocol? Maya yɛ obi a ne ho nni asɛm. nkitahodie a enni nnyinasoɔ (DEX) nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma kwan ma wɔde cryptocurrency di dwa wɔ blockchain ahodoɔ so. Wobɛtumi, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ de Bitcoin (BTC) asesa Ethereum (ETH) wɔ Blockchain no mu ɔkwan tiawa bi so, bere a wonni sika anaa wɔnni tumi biara na afei nso wonnim wo kwampaefo akwan (KYC). Maya Protocol na wɔde Cosmos Software Development Kit (Cosmos SDK) no yɛɛ adwuma, a ɛyɛ proof of bond (PoB) consensus mechanism. "Node Operators" na ɛhwɛ so ma wɔnya sika wɔ system mu de tua wɔn ka ne mmɔdenbɔ ho akatua. Ne titiriw no, nodes yɛ kɔmputa ahorow a wɔyɛ software a ɛma user swaps di dwuma na hwɛ nneɛma so wɔ address ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ ama blockchains ahodoɔ nyinaa. Sɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ swap no awie a, ɛsɛ sɛ wonya cryptocurrency a wɔboa ma ɛtumi yɛ adwuma yi bi firi Maya address baako so na afei wɔde sika korɔ kɔma obi foforo. Saa akwantuo yi bɛyɛ yie paa araa ne sε nkwammoaa mmienu-mu mmiɛnsa bɛhwɛ kwan ama wɔn agye atoom de ahwɛ sɛ wɔanya sika no pɛpɛɛpɛ anaa. Saa kwan yi so no, wɔn a wɔde di dwuma betumi asende tokens baako wɔ blockchain biako mu na wɔanya foforo bi nso wɔ ɔfã foforɔ. Ne nyinaa yɛ native ne sɛ wonfa wrapped tokens nni dwuma. Dɛn ne Ɔsom Boayikuw ho Adanse? Proof of Bond (PoB) is a consensus mechanism where node operators must commit a bond (usually in the form of the network's native token) to participate in the network. This bond acts as a form of economic security, ensuring that nodes act honestly and maintain the network's integrity2. If a node tries to act maliciously or fails to perform its duties, its bond can be slashed, meaning a portion of it is taken away as a penalty. Wɔ Maya Protocol mu no, saa kwan yi boa ma wonya sika a ɛsom bo fi node operators ho de hyɛ wɔn akodeɛ so. Saa ara nso na wɔ THORChain mu no , node operator bɔ RUNE (native token) to hɔ sɛ ɛbɛbɔ network no ho ban na ama adwumayɛfo anya adwuma ayɛ yie. Nsonsonoe a ɛda Maya ne THORChain ntam no Maya yɛ THORChain mu kyɛfa nanso wɔde nneɛma foforo kakra ne dwuma a edi no sɛ ade foforɔ. Nea ɛho hia paa ne: Liquidity Nodes (Node nketenkete) Sɛ́ anka wɔbɛdi Pure Bond Model akyi no, Maya rehwɛ kwan sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Liquidity Nodes model so. Wɔ saa system yi mu no, wɔ ma nodes tumi de liquidity boa tẽẽ, na wɔde kɔ network hɔ. Saa akwan a wɔnfa so yɛ adwuma yi kyerɛ sɛ node operators hyia asiane kɛse bi: sε wͻde sika di dwuma amapa a, wonya asotwe, na ɛno nso yεε ade titiriw a εkyi nkogu. ILP no kyɛfa yɛ adwuma wɔ ASSET ne $CACAO dwumadie ho. Akwantuo a edi mu biara kɔ so ma nnipa 150 nya akatua pa, na sɛ CACA O nso tɔ yiye a wɔnya akatua papa bi. Wɔtua ILP ka bere nyinaa nanso obi tu hyɛ da gye sika kakra pɛ. Sɛ ɔtɔre aka foforo de to hɔ a, wɔde ILP bɛsan asi ananmu ama obiara anya akatua no bio. text: ZEC a wode bedi dwuma, wɔ kokoam Shielded (Private) vs. Nea ɛda adi pefee Sɛnea ɛte mprempren no, address ne nkitahodi ahorow abien na ɛwɔ Zcash mu, wɔabɔ ho ban na ɛda adi pefee. Nsonsonoe a ɛda ZEC a wɔabɔ ho ban ne nea ɛda adi ntam no yɛ mmerɛw yiye. Shielded ZEC ma wo sika ne wo nnwuma yɛ kokoam, sɛ baabi a transparent ZEC yɛ adwuma te sɛ Bitcoin, transparent koraa. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ obi betumi ahwɛ wo sika a aka ne wo nnwuma nyinaa sɛ onim wo address a. Sɛ nkurɔfo di kan fi ase de ZEC di dwuma a, ebia wɔrenhu address ko a wɔde redi dwuma. Eyi te saa efisɛ ɛnyɛ exchanges nyinaa na ɛboa shielded ZEC ne/anaa shielded ZEC withdrawals. Enti, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, sɛ obi de Coinbase di dwuma na wɔtɔ ZEC a, anka ɔbɛtɔ ZEC a ɛda adi pefee na ɔbɛtumi atwe saa ZEC no akɔ address a ɛda adi wɔ sika kotokuo mu nko ara. Walets te sɛ Zodl betumi abɔ sika a wɔde kɔ address a ɛda adi pefee so de adi eyi ho dwuma no ho ban, nanso ɛnyɛ obiara na onim saa. Nnipa pii, sɛ yɛbɛka no tiawa a, wɔde ZEC di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a wɔn exchange anaa primary wallet ma wɔn kwan so. Hwɛ sɛ wo ZEC no abɔ ho ban Yɛhyɛ nyansa sɛ obiara mfa ne ho nhwɛ ne ZEC so. Nea ɛkyerɛ ne sɛ, fa wo ZEC no fi exchange so kɔ sika kotoku mu. Ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so ahu sɛ wode shielded, a.k.a private, ZEC redi dwuma ne sɛ wobɛhwɛ address a balance no te mu Sɛ address no fi ase wɔ "z" anaa "u1" , ɛnde wo balance no yɛ shielded. Sɛ address no fi ase de "t" a, ɛnde balance no yɛ transparent. Mpɛn pii no, akwan abien na ɛwɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so akɔ ZEC a wɔabɔ ho ban no so. Efi exchange a ɛboa shielded withdrawals: Kɔtɔ ZEC wɔ exchange mu Fi ase yi sika a woyi no fi ase wɔ nsakrae no mu Bue wo ZEC sika kotoku a wɔabɔ ho ban no na hwɛ hu sɛ address a wogye no fi ase de "u1" anaa "z". Run withdrawal no fi wo exchange no mu Efi exchange a ɛboa transparent a wɔayi afi mu: Kɔtɔ ZEC wɔ exchange mu Fi ase yi sika a woyi no fi ase wɔ nsakrae no mu Bue wo autoshielding ZEC sika kotoku no na fa address a ɛda adi pefee a wogye no di dwuma Run withdrawal no fi wo exchange no mu Twɛn si so dua du, na afei bɔ ZEC no ho ban fi wo address a ɛda adi pefee no so kɔ address a wɔabɔ ho ban no so Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobɛtwe ZEC afi exchange mu ni. Hyɛ no nsow sɛ eyi yɛ sika a wɔtwe fi mu a wɔabɔ ho ban. --- Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea wobɛbɔ wo ZEC ho ban afi address a ɛda adi so akɔ address a wɔabɔ ho ban so ni. --- Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobɛtɔ ZEC wɔ Coinbase na wode akɔ Zodl ni. Nkitahodi ahorow Bere a woahwɛ ahu sɛ wo ZEC no wɔ sika kotoku a wɔabɔ ho ban a ɛboa address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban mu akyi no, afei wubetumi asi gyinae sɛ wopɛ sɛ wo ne saa ZEC no di nkitaho anaa. Transacting ne ZEC yɛ super mmerɛw. Wubetumi de ZEC akɔ address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban anaasɛ ɛda adi pefee so a egyina onipa no pɛ so. Sɛnea ɛte wɔ sikasɛm mu aguadi biara ho no, hokwan nketenkete wɔ hɔ sɛ nkurɔfo betumi de data akɔ. ZEC yɛ nea eye sen biara wɔ ko a wɔko tia data leakage, nanso ɛno nkyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wode di dwuma a ahwɛyiye biara nni ho. Nneɛma bi a wobɛpɛ sɛ wokwati bere a wo ne ZEC redi nkitaho ni. Wo address a wɔabɔ ho ban no a wobɛda no adi Address a wɔabɔ ho ban a wɔde di dwuma sɛ pass through ma t-addresses (a.k.a "mixing") . Mmirikatu, na woda wo mmirikatu adi, dodow a ɛkorɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban ama nnwuma a ɛda adi pefee Daa a wobɛma nkurɔfo ahu baabi a wosɛe sika shielded ZEC Ne titiriw no, ade a eye sen biara a wode wo ZEC bɛyɛ ne sɛ wode bɛhyɛ sika kotoku a wɔabɔ ho ban mu, adi nkitaho wɔ address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban ntam, na woahwɛ yiye wɔ sɛnea wode ZEC bedi dwuma wɔ baguam (i.e. kɔfetɔnbea). Kokoam nsɛm a wobɛhwɛ ahu no de asɛyɛde bi ba. Akadeɛ Zcash nkitahodi ahorow

title: Run a Full Node on a Raspberry Pi 4 (Zebra + Zallet) - Abɔdin: Kɔmputa, Wifi ne kɔmputa ho dwumadie.
description: W'ayi afiri mfitiaseɛ zcashd-based guide no mu. Zcashd nyaa ne automatic End of Support stop wɔ July 18, 2026, enti saa akwankyerԑ yi de seesei ara na ɛde di…
text: Run a Full Node on a Raspberry Pi 4 (Zebra + Zallet) - Abɔdin: Kɔmputa, Wifi ne kɔmputa ho dwumadie. W'ayi afiri mfitiaseɛ zcashd-based guide no mu. Zcashd nyaa ne automatic End of Support stop wɔ July 18, 2026, enti saa akwankyerԑ yi de seesei ara na ɛde di dwuma Zebra (a ɛnnɛ yɛ nokorɛ a, Zcash Foundation hwɛ so) ɛne Zallet (abɔfra abɔfra bɔfra abrabↄ ma wͻsesaeε zcash denden no). Nea wubesua no bi Sεnea wobεtwe Ubuntu Server 22.04+ (64-bit) no na wode asiesie so wɔ Raspberry Pi 4 a wonfa ti nni dwuma ho Sεnea wobεhyehyε Zebra na wode adi dwuma, sε εfa Docker anaa binary a w'adi kan asi no so. Sɛnea wobɛhyehyɛ, asiesie na woadi kan Zallet no so dwuma a ɛka sika kotoku ahwehwɛde ho nhyehyɛɛ nso ka ho. Sεnea wobεfa akwantu kwan so de wͻn zcashd config/wallet a εwᴐ hͻ no asi Zallet mu Deɛn na ɛsesae firi kan akwankyerɛ no mu? The previous version of this guide walked through compiling zcashd natively on a Pi 4 — a single-threaded compile that took 3–4 hours because the Pi 4 doesn't have enough memory for a parallel (-j$(nproc)Afei, Zebra ne Zallet nyinaa de ARM64 binaries a wɔasiesie no ato dwa na wɔde Docker mfoni nso adi dwuma. Enti mpɛn pii no ɛho nhia sɛ wode biribi firi source so yɛ adwuma wɔ Pi ankasa mu bio. Ahwehwɛde ahorow a edi kan Raspberry Pi 4 (4 GB RAM anaa nea ɛboro saa a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran) microSD kaade (32 GB+) ma OS no External SSD/HDD a USB 3.0 support Zebra hia bɛyɛ 300 GB ma cached Mainnet data, na ɛreyɛ kɛse wɔ bere mu, enti mmɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛfa microSD card no nko ara adi dwuma Kɔmputa a microSD kaade mu (sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na OS no bɛpue) Wired Ethernet connection anaa Wi-Fi a wo de di dwuma no so. Nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa ɔmansin so ho wɔ SSH mu no yɛ papa pa ara. Anammɔn 1: Flash Ubuntu Server 22.04+ (64-bit) Zebra ne Zallet's pre-built binaries na Docker images hia glibc 2.34+, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Ubuntu Server 22.04 anaa foforɔ (64-bit/aarch64). Fa Raspberry Pi Imager no si wo kͻmputa titiriw no so. Fa wo microSD kaade no hyɛ mu. Paw Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma wɔ OS foforo so → Ubuntu → Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS (64-bit) (anaa nea ɛyɛ foforɔ). Fa Imager no nhyehyeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (gear icon) di dwuma de asiesie hostname, ma SSH kwan na fa Wi-Fi ho nimdeɛ sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔ headless kan boot. Kyerɛw mfonini no, fa kaade no hyɛ mu na bɔ Pi a ɛwɔ hɔ no so. SSH wɔ: ssh @ Ntoso 2: Fa mpuntuo a w'atumi de adi dwuma na fa hyɛ no akyi. Fa wo mpuntuo SSD/HDD no fa USB 3.0 so. Kyerɛ afidie no: lsblk Format (sɛ ɛyɛ foforo) na fa to so, e.g., sɛ wo de di dwuma a: /mnt/zcash-data, a standard no ho yɛ den paa. mkfs/fstab Sεnea ɛbɛyɛ a sε w'asan de wo ho asi hɔ bio no. Anammɔn 3: Siesie nhyehyɛe no Anammɔn 4: Fa Zebra si hɔ na di dwuma Option A Docker (recommended) Hwɛ nkɔso: docker logs -f zebra Option B Pre-built binary via cargo binstall (pre-builded binary) - faako a wɔhyehyɛ nneɛma no kɔ akyiri. Eyi de ɔhyehyɛ a wɔasi no dedaw bi si hɔ. aarch64 binary no compilation required. On sync time: expect this to take a while commonly-cited first-sync figures (roughly 2 hours) come from reference hardware that is more powerful than a Pi 4's CPU, so your actual sync times on real Pi 4 hardware will likely run longer. Anammɔn 5: Fa Zallet si hɔ Seesei Zallet wɔ alpha mu. Ɛhwɛ kwan sɛ nsakrae bɛba, na mma no nyɛ wo ho te sɛ sika a ɛho hia ma wɔn a wobetumi de ayɛ adwuma ama so. Option A Docker (recommended) Saa mfoni yi boa ARM64 (nam Nix-based build so) na ɛfiri file system a ɛnni shell biara mu fa configuration ne data akwan kɔ explicitly via --datadir ne mpԑn a ԑso wɔ soro (Hwɛ Asetena 6). Nhyehyεe B Fi mfitiase no so siesie Zallet's crates no nnya nhyiaa mu wɔ crates.io berɛ a alpha phase, enti wɔn de firi git repo hɔ tẽẽ na ɛboa non-Docker akwan. Anammɔn 6: Sesa Zallet no Bue w'ani ma no zallet.toml w'ahyehyɛ wo data din (sɛ. nhwɛso, "database") no mu; /mnt/zcash-data/zallet): Sesa no ma ɛnyɛ yiye. validatoraddress Sɛ Zebra yɛ adwuma wɔ host/port foforɔ so a, na fa siesie no saa ara. validatorcookieauth/validatoruser/validatorpassword asefoɔ a- [indexer]

text: RPi5 Zebra lightwalletd a wɔde Zingo ahyɛ mu Video Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho to so Boaboa Zebra ano Zebra GitHub time cargo install --git https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra --tag v3.1.0 zebrad Hyehyɛ zebrad.toml fa ka ho: listenaddr = '127.0.0.1:8232' cachedir = "/media/zebra5/zebra/" Sync Zebra zebrad start Boaboa lightwalletd install kɔ fa lightwalletd no hyɛ mu Sync lightwalletd hyɛ data-dir nsakrae no nsow lightwalletd --zcash-conf-path /.config/zcash.conf --data-dir /media/zebra5/zebra/.cache/lightwalletd --log-file /dev/stdout --no-tls-very-insecure Fa NodeJS no hyɛ mu Sɛ wuhyia mfomso bi a, ha yɛ akwan foforo bi a wobɛfa so ahyɛ NodeJS. Fa Yarn hyɛ mu corepack enable Fa Zingo hyɛ mu Fi ase Zingo-PC Wobetumi de appimage, anaa binary adi dwuma wɔ unpacked folda mu Di dɛ! :) Nneɛma a wonya fi mu

title: Sɛnea wɔyɛ Zebra wɔ Akash Network so
description: Anamɔn-anamɔn akwankyerɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma a wɔde Zebra Zcash full node bedi dwuma Akash Console na ɛwɔ hɔ.
text: Sɛnea wɔyɛ Zebra wɔ Akash Network so Anamɔn-anamɔn akwankyerɛ a wɔde bedi dwuma a wɔde Zebra Zcash full node bedi dwuma Akash Console na ɛwɔ hɔ. Nea Woreyɛ Deploying Zebra node a edi mũ a ɛbɛma: -> Sync Zcash blockchain no nyinaa (100GB + ma mainnet, 40GB ma testnet) -> Ɛka bɛyɛ $15/ɔsram a egyina AKT token bo so -> Gye nnɔnhwerew pii kosi nna pii na ama ayɛ sync koraa -> Fa vCPU 4, 16GB RAM, 350GB akoraeɛ (mainnet) anaa 2 vCPUs, 8GB RAM, 50GB (testnet) di dwuma Nea ɛho hia: Hyɛn Gyinabea Ho Mfoniniyɛ wɔ Akash Sɛ woda port bi adi wɔ Akash so (e.g., port 8233 ma Zebra P2P) a, ENNYƐ saa port pɔtee no wɔ ɔdemafoɔ no baguam IP so. Mmom, ɔdemafoɔ no de random high port (te sɛ 31234 anaa 42567) ma na ɔde reverse-proxies kɔ wo container no port 8233. Eyi nam design so - providers run deployments pii, na sɛ obiara bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔde port 8233 bedi dwuma tẽẽ a, anka wobenya ntawntawdi. Nea eyi kyerɛ ma wo: -> Wo hyehyɛ port 8233 wɔ SDL (Zebra gyinapɛn P2P hyɛn gyinabea) . -> Akash ma wo URI te sɛ provider.com:31234 . -> Zcash nodes afoforo kɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ provider.com:31234 -> Wo container no mu no, Zebra da so ara tie wɔ 8233 so Wɔdi eyi ho dwuma ara kwa. Fa URI a Akash de ma wo no di dwuma kɛkɛ. Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi kan yɛ Keplr Wallet wɔde brawsa ntrɛwmu ahyɛ mu (Chrome/Brave/Firefox) AKT tokens - Nya 50-100 AKT fi nsakrae bi mu (Coinbase, Kraken, Osmosis) Simma 5 na wobɛkyere afa Console UI no so Anamɔn 1: Fa Wo Sikakorabea no Bata Ho -> Go to https://console.akash.network -> Klik "Connect Wallet" wɔ atifi nifa so -> Paw Keplr (anaasɛ Cosmos sika kotoku a wopɛ) . -> pene nkitahodi no so bere a Keplr pue Ɛsɛ sɛ wo AKT balance no pue wɔ soro nifa so. Sɛ ɛyɛ zero a, kɔ kan kɔ fund wo sika kotoku no. Anamɔn 2: Yɛ Deployment -> Klik "Deploy" bɔtn (bɔn kɛse bruu, kratafa no mfinimfini) -> Paw "Si wo template" (anaasɛ twa tẽẽ kɔ SDL a wode bɛto so) Ɔkwan A: Fa SDL Fael (Wɔkamfo kyerɛ) . Ɔkwan B: Fa SDL Editor di dwuma Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode nsa hyɛ mu a SDL no: -> Kɔpi zebra-akash.yml mu nsɛm no. -> Fa hyɛ SDL editor no mu -> Sesa sɛnea ɛho hia (hwɛ nhyehyeɛ ɔfa a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha) -> Klik "Bɔ Deployment" so. Anamɔn 3: Hwɛ na pene Deposit so Console no bɛkyerɛ wo: -> Deployment deposit: 5 AKT (wonya eyi san bere a woato deployment no mu) -> Ɛka a wɔabu ho akontaa: Egyina wo SDL bo so Klik "Approve" na fa wo nsa hyɛ asɛm no ase wɔ Keplr mu. Anamɔn 4: Paw Ɔdemafo 30 seconds akyi no, wubehu bids a efi providers hɔ. Bid biara kyerɛ sɛ: -> Boɔ a wɔbɔ wɔ block biara ho (wɔ AKT anaa USDC mu) -> Ɔsram biara sika a wɔabu ho akontaa -> Ɔdemafo ho nsɛm (bere a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ɔmantam, ne nea ɛkeka ho) Npaw nea ne bo yɛ mmerɛw kɛkɛ. Hwɛ: -> Uptime % ( botaeɛ ne sɛ > 95%) . -> Region (ɛbɛn wo = latency a eye, nanso ɛnyɛ hwee kɛse mma blockchain nodes) -> Audited tebea (green checkmark = ahotoso kɛse) . Klik "Accept Bid" wɔ wo provider a woapaw no so na hyɛ Keplr mu. Anamɔn 5: Twɛn Deployment Console no bɛyɛ: -> Yɛ lease no ne wo provider a woapaw no -> Send manifest (ɛkyerɛ nea ɔde ma no nea ɛsɛ sɛ wotu mmirika) . -> Fi ase wo container no Eyi gye simma 1-2. Wobɛhunu status updates wɔ UI no mu. Anamɔn 6: Hwɛ sɛ Ɛretu mmirika Sɛ wɔde di dwuma wie a, wubehu sɛ: -> Services tab: Kyerɛ wo zebra som a ɛwɔ tebea -> Logs tab: Nkwammoaa mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw -> Leases tab: Nsɛm a ɛfa wo deployment ho (DSEQ, provider, ɛka) Hwɛ Logs no mu Klik Logs so na ɛsɛ sɛ wuhu sɛ Zebra refi ase: Sync no begye nnɔnhwerew kosi nna a egyina network no so. Hwɛ sɛ: -> Nkɔanim wɔ block sorokɔ -> Atipɛnfo nkitahodi (ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ atipɛnfo 10-30) . -> Mfomsoɔ biara nni hɔ a wɔsan yɛ Anamɔn 7: Nya Wo Node no Address Klik Leases tab no so, afei URIs. Wubehu biribi te sɛ: Eyi ne wo node no public P2P endpoint. Zcash nodes afoforo bɛka wo ho wɔ saa address yi so. Hyɛ port mapping no nsow: Wo hyehyɛɛ port 8233 wɔ SDL no mu, nanso Akash de maa ɔmanfoɔ port soronko (31234 wɔ nhwɛsoɔ yi mu). Eyi yɛ ade a ɛyɛ daa - hwɛ "Port Mapping on Akash" ɔfa a ɛwɔ soro hɔ sɛ eyi ma wo adwene tu fra a. Wo node no yɛ nea

title: Zcash Avalanche RedBridge a ɛwɔ hɔ no
description: Zcash Avalanche RedBridge yɛ decentralized bridge a ɛma wotumi yɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash (ZEC) ne Avalanche (AVAX) blockchains ntam. Wɔayɛ saa bridge yi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a…
text: Zcash Avalanche RedBridge a ɛwɔ hɔ no Zcash Avalanche RedBridge yɛ decentralized bridge a ɛma wotumi yɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash (ZEC) ne Avalanche (AVAX) blockchains ntam. Wɔayɛ saa bridge yi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde ZEC bɛkɔ Avalanche blockchain no so a biribiara nhaw wɔn, de Avalanche no throughput a ɛkɔ soro, ɛka a ɛba fam, ne ecofriendly consensus mechanisms no adi dwuma bere a wɔkora Zcash no kokoamsɛm ho nneɛma so. RedBridge no boa nsɛm ahodoɔ a wɔde di dwuma, a crosschain decentralized finance (DeFi), ankorankoro nkitahodiɛ, ne sika a wɔkyɛ ka ho, na ɛma Zcash wuranom tumi ma wɔtrɛ kwan a wɔfa so kɔ Avalanche abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. Wɔnam decentralized nodes ne oracle, a wɔfrɛ no ZavaX, a ɛhwɛ ma wotumi de ho to so sɛ wɔde data bɛkɔ baabi foforo ne bo a wɔagye atom wɔ Zcash ne Avalanche ntam so na ɛyɛ saa bridge yi adwuma. Nneɛma Titiriw a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Privacy Preserving Interoperability: Ɛma Zcash dwumadiefoɔ kwan ma wɔhwɛ kokoamsɛm so berɛ a wɔde DeFi applications redi dwuma wɔ Avalanche so. Decentralized Oracle ZavaX: Ɛka oracle nhyehyɛe bi bom de hwɛ hu sɛ ZEC/AVAX bo ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛma kwan ma wɔyɛ crosschain adwumayɛ a ahotoso nnim. Scalable ne Eco Friendly: Ɛde Avalanches consensus model di dwuma, na ɛma nkitahodi a ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm a enni nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so nkɛntɛnso ketewaa bi. Mmoa a wɔde ma DeFi ne DApps: Mprempren Zcash wuranom betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ DeFi platform ahorow mu wɔ Avalanche a wɔrensɛe kokoam nsɛm. Mfiridwuma mu Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma ZavaX Oracle a wɔde ahyɛ aman nsa Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: ZavaX Oracle no ho hia kɛse ma bridge no, ɛma crosschain bo feeds na ɛma ZEC kɔ AVAX nsakrae a wonni ahotoso tumi. Link a ɛkɔ Oracle so Cross Chain Bridge Apam Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Smart contract architecture a ɛboa Zcash Avalanche bridge, a ɛdi sika a wɔde asie, nsakraeɛ, ne sika a wɔayi afiri ZEC mu ho dwuma. Kokoamsɛm Layer Nkabom Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛhwɛ sɛ wɔakora Zcash kokoam nsɛm so wɔ bridging nhyehyɛe no nyinaa mu, na ɛma kwan ma wɔyɛ kokoam crosschain nkitahodi. Nneɛma a Wɔde Kɔma ne Nwoma a Wɔde Ma Zcash Elastic Subnet Bridge a ɛwɔ Avalanche so: Mmoa Ho Nsusuwii a Wɔde Ma Ase hɔ no yɛ nneɛma titire a wɔde bɛma ne mfiridwuma ho nneɛma a wɔawie ama Zcash Avalanche RedBridge adwuma no: Deliverable 1.1: PoC a ɛdi kan a ɛboa sɛ wɔbisa testnet Zcash nkitahodiɛ firi testnet Avalanche subnet a ɛwɔ CLI, a wɔatintim wɔ GitHub na ɛwɔ node subnet baako wɔ Avalanche testnet so. https://github.com/red-dev-inc/zavax-oracle Nea wobetumi de ama 2.1: Dan nhyehyɛeɛ Ade titiriw 3 Oforisuo 31, 2024 Deliverable 3.1 no awie, ɛde yɛn nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa FROST a yɛbɛgye atom wɔ BLS so ama threshold signatures wɔ ZavaX bridge no mu no rekyerɛ. Saa nsakrae yi de nhomakorabea ahorow a wɔahwɛ so yiye a efi Zcash Foundation no di dwuma na ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛka abom ne ahobammɔ a eye. https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/frost Deliverable 3.2 UX ne UI design for GUI awie, ɛkyerɛkyerɛ yɛn ahobanbɔ nkɔsoɔ ma ZavaX Oracle subnet, a penetration sɔhwɛ aba boa. Sɛ wopɛ nsɛm pii, a server nhyehyɛe ne sɔhwɛ mu aba ka ho Ahobammɔ Ho Nhwehwɛmu Akontaabu Amanneɛbɔ Bio nso, kuw no sesaa wɔn din fii ZavaX kɔɔ redbridge na wɔsesaa yɛn staking token no fii ZAX kɔɔ RBR. title: Zkool Multisig Akwankyerɛ
description: Saa akwankyerɛ yi ma anammɔn anammɔn nanteɛ a ɛfa sɛdeɛ wɔbɛyɛ multisig nkitahodiɛ denam Zkool so. Nea ɛka ho ne akontaabu a wɔbɛyɛ, sika a wɔde bɛmena anaa…
text: Zkool Multisig Akwankyerɛ Saa akwankyerɛ yi ma anammɔn anammɔn nanteɛ a ɛfa sɛdeɛ wɔbɛyɛ multisig nkitahodiɛ denam Zkool so. Nea ɛka ho ne akontaabu a wɔbɛyɛ, sika a wɔde bɛmena anaa wogye, ne distributed key generation (DKG) a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ama multisig. Wɔde screenshots aka ho ama anammɔn titiriw biara. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Akontaabu a Wɔbɛyɛ Bue Zkool app no na kɔ Akontaabu Foforo. Hyehyɛ Akontaabu Din (sɛ nhwɛso no, Anabelle). Sɛ wopɛ a, toggle Fa Internal Change anaa San Fa Akontaabu di dwuma sɛ ɛho hia a. Sɛ wobɔ wie a, akonta no bɛda adi wɔ wo Akontaabu Nkyerɛwde mu. Sika a Wogye Akontaabu biara ma address ahorow pii ba: Unified Address Orchard nkutoo Address Sapling Address Address a ɛda adi pefee Paw ɔkwan a wopɛ sɛ wode di dwuma na kyɛ na woanya sika. Sika a Wɔde Kɔma Kɔ Recipient ɔfa no so. Hyehyɛ wɔn a wogye no address no. Kyerɛ dodow ne memo a wopɛ. Hwɛ asɛm no ho nsɛm na si so dua. Sɛ wowie a, sika a aka no yɛ foforo wɔ wo akontaabu mu. Multisig Nkitahodi a Wɔyɛ: Setting Up Distributed Key Generation (Multisig) . Multisig a ɛwɔ Zkool mu no de Distributed Key Generation (DKG) di dwuma de hwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu pii di akonta a wɔkyɛ so. Anamɔn 1: Fi ase DKG Paw Edin ma sika kotoku a wɔakyekyɛ (sɛ nhwɛso no Anabelle). Set Nnipa dodow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Paw wo Participant ID no. Kyerɛkyerɛ Nnipa dodow a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ ase a wɔhwehwɛ (Threshold). Paw Sika a Wɔde Ma Akontaabu. Anamɔn 2: Fa Ɔdefo a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu Addresses Ka Ho Hyehyɛ obiara a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu no Unified Address (wɔkamfo kyerɛ). Hyɛ no nsow: Sɛ wode Orchard nkutoo anaa Sapling nkutoo address di dwuma a, multisig no bɛto saa pool no nkutoo so (Orchard anaa Sapling). Wei kyerɛ sɛ sika kotoku a wɔkyɛ no ntumi nnya sika mfi pool afoforo hɔ. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wo ne no hyia na wotumi sesa a, fa Unified Addresses di dwuma bere nyinaa. Anamɔn 3: Tu mmirika DKG Rounds Twɛn ma wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ bi no nyinaa bɛsesa round 1 ne round 2 packages. Anamɔn 4: Fa Address a Wɔakyekyɛ no Awie Sɛ wowie a, wɔyɛ address a wɔakyekyɛ. Awie Sɛ wode Zkool di dwuma a, wobɛtumi: ayɛ akonta, de sika amena na woagye, na wode Distributed Key Generation asiesie multisig wallet. Wei hwɛ ma ahobanbɔ a ɛkɔ anim ne adwumayɛ ne ankorankoro sikakorabea sohwɛ.

title: Ywallet FROST ho ɔyɛkyerɛ
description: Wɔhwɛ Ywallet so bio. Nea ɔyɛɛ no no asi so dua sɛ wɔrennyɛ no foforo mma Ironwood (NU6.3), enti entumi nni nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no akyi bio na anammɔn a ɛwɔ ase ha…
text: Ywallet FROST ho ɔyɛkyerɛ Wɔhwɛ Ywallet so bio. Nea ɔyɛɛ no no asi so dua sɛ wɔrennyɛ no foforo mma Ironwood (NU6.3), enti entumi nni nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no akyi bio na anammɔn a ɛwɔ ase ha no ntumi nwie wɔ mainnet so. Wɔde kratafa yi asie sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi ahwɛ mu. Zkool, a efi developer koro no ara mu, ne nea wɔhwɛ so no na ɛboa FROST multisig. Boaboa FROST bin ahorow ano GitHub link no Fa atifi hɔ repo no di dwuma na di akwankyerɛ a ɛfa compiling ho akyi: Bins bɛyɛ nea wɔde asi wɔn ani so folda no. Yɛ FROST UA ./generateFROSTUA.sh Fa UFVK ba Ywallet mu Accounts -> Klik + na paste ufvk fi anammɔn a ɛwɔ atifi hɔ no Yɛ asɛm bi a ɛfa Ywallet ho Paste wɔ UA biara mu na fa tx mena. Fa fael no sie. Fi ase FROST nsaano nkyerɛwee nhyehyɛe no ./signFROSTtx.sh rawtxs/mytx signedtxs/mysignedtx kan input ne beae a raw tx no fi anammɔn a ɛwɔ atifi hɔ no input a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne beaeɛ ne din a signed tx a wopɛ sɛ wobɔ no Eyi yɛ fã bi a woka kyerɛ FROST sɛ transction bɛn na wopɛ sɛ obiara de ne nsa hyɛ ase Fi ase Ntamgyinafo ./runCoordinator.sh Eyi na ɛhyehyɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu biara nsaano nkyerɛwee na ɛma kuw nsaano nkyerɛwee Ma Ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu biara mfa ne nsa nhyɛ saa asɛm yi ase Finalize nsaano nkyerɛwee Transaction Wɔ coordinator window no mu no, kɔpi kuw signature a ɛrepue no na fa hyɛ FROST signing window no mu. Wei bɛma FROST nsaano nkyerɛwee no awie na ɛde 'mysingedtx' afiri adi. Broadcast wo Transaction ne Ywallet Klik 'More' wɔ Ywallet ase nifa so na hwehwɛ 'Broadcast'. Hwehwɛ 'mysignedtx' na klik ok. Sɛ biribiara yɛ adwuma a wobɛnya transaction ID :)

title: Blockchain Nhwehwɛmufo
description: Wɔ atetesɛm aguadi wiase no mu no, wɔde krataa a wɔde gye sika a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔatɔ ade ka ho. Saa ara nso na wɔ blockchain wiase no mu no, obi a ɔde di dwuma no…
text: Blockchain Nhwehwɛmufo Nnianimu Wɔ atetesɛm aguadi wiase no mu no, wɔde krataa a wɔde gye sika a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔatɔ ade ka ho. Saa ara nso na wɔ blockchain wiase no mu no, obi a ɔde di dwuma no nya dijitaal krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma id wɔ asɛm biara a wɔawie ho. Sika kotoku dodow no ara bɛma eyi ama wo. Blockchain explorers yɛ nnwinnade a ɛma obi tumi yɛ nea asi dedaw wɔ blockchain so ho mfonini wɔ n’adwenem ara kwa. Wɔfa ma inputs: transaction id's, addresses, anaa block hashes, na wɔde aniwa kyerɛ nea ɛkɔɔ so. Nhwɛso ahorow Bitcoin: c839b44a7052393f4672cdc4ec79f8f15d3036565e13bede0fab91f674506a7c Ethereum: 0x43117fc201f8d3c09a72d42ab4a048003f348917771b9ace64b8944a91807320 Cosmos: D0587C76E7689A9EFBDDA587DDB450F6C6E972FCEEA37DD8DA9AF95C23CF8170 Zcash (ɔmanfoɔ): 8dd212847a97c5eb9cee5e7e58c4d9e739f4156273ae3b2da1a4ff79ad95ff82 Zcash (ankorankoro): 19a4be270089490ece2e5fe7a6c9b9804af3c7ed43e1fb1b744b0fb29070fa5d Hyɛ no nsow ne Zcash sɛnea asɛm a ɛto so abien no wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia nyinaa a wɔde asie, eyi ho hia na ɛwɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu kɛse wɔ dijitaal wiase. Blockchain Asase Mfonini ahorow Enti yɛwɔ saa nkyerɛwde tenten yi sɛ dijitaal krataa, afei dɛn? Eyi ne baabi a yɛde a blockchain nhwehwɛmufo, anaa asase mfonini, na aboa yɛn ma yɛayɛ nea esii wɔ blockchain no so. Hyɛ sɛnea nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biara wɔ n’ankasa nkyerɛase a ɛfa blockchain nhwehwɛmufo boro so. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛte aseɛ sɛ saa blockchain nnwuma yi nyinaa yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa open source software ho. Ɛne sɛ, obiara betumi aboa na anaasɛ ɔde fork ahyɛ mmara no mu sɛnea n’ani gye ho. Saa nteaseɛ no, adwuma biara yɛ soronko wɔ mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ na ɛyɛ blockchain explorer no sɛdeɛ ɛfata adwuma a wɔaka ho asɛm no ahiadeɛ. Nneɛma a wɔde siw ano Wɔde nkitahodi ahorow no gu blocks mu. Sɛ wɔ mined/validated block bi a, wɔasi asɛm biara a ɛwɔ saa block no mu no so dua na wɔyɛ block hash. Hash biara a wɔayɛ no, wobetumi de ahyɛ block explorer mu. Ebia woahu sɛ CEX hia confirmations dodow bi ansa na wɔayi wo sika adi, eyi ne metric a wɔde redi dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wo transaction no te saa a wɔawie no sɛnea ɛsɛ. Ɔkwan bɛn so na blockchain no kyerɛ nnwuma a ɛkɔ block a edi hɔ no mu? Nhwehwɛmu asɛmti a ɛyɛ den, nanso nnɛyi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn dodow no ara de adwene a ɛne sɛ akatua di dwuma de kyerɛ onii a ɔbɛkɔ anim wɔ nkyerɛwde no mu. Dodow a sika no dɔɔso no, dodow no ara na hokwan a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛforo akɔ ntonto no anim. Address ahorow Ɔkwan a ɛyɛ anigye a wɔfa so sua ade wɔ aniwa so blockchain nhwehwɛmufo ne sɛ wode address a ɛwɔ asɛm biara a wɔde di dwuma kwa no bɛhyɛ mu. Afei wubetumi akɔ w’akyi wɔ bere mu na woahu baabi a sika no fi! Adwuma biara wɔ address a wɔde hyɛ mu ne nea wɔde fi mu nyinaa. Bere a obi de saa nsɛm yi ayɛ akode no, obetumi akɔ n’anim ne n’akyi ntɛm ara afi asɛm biara a wɔasɛe no mu. Wɔn a wɔpɛ ahodwiriwde no, eyi ne dijitaal a ɛne sikasɛm mu ahodwiriwde kɛse bi yɛ pɛ, na wobetumi de adi dwuma de ayɛ nea ɛda adi pefee. Blockchain explorer a wode bedi dwuma no mma ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛyɛ mmerɛw kɛse sɛ wobɛhwɛ eyi wɔ w’adwenem nko, na mmom ɛsan nso si hia a ehia sɛ wɔde asɛm no kokoam nsɛm sie no so dua. Gye sɛ wode Zcash, wubetumi de biara blockchain a ɛda adi pefee ayɛ eyi: BTC, ETH, ATOM, DOGE, VTC, ne nea ɛkeka ho ... . Saa asɛm yi ho hia ma obiara a ɔde blockchain no di dwuma dwoodwoo a ɔretu akɔ dijitaal nkutoo daakye mu. Sika dodow a wɔde ma Te sɛ address ahorow a ɛwɔ atifi hɔ no, asɛm biara a wɔyɛ wɔ ɔmanfo blockchain so no wɔ sika dodow a ɔmanfo betumi anya wɔ ɔyɛkyerɛ nyinaa mu. Eyi ka sika dodow a ɛwɔ input ne output address nyinaa so ma asɛm biara. Adeɛ baako a ɛfiri yei mu ne berɛ a wopaw sɛ wode Shielded Zcash bedi dwuma -- afei sika dodoɔ no nyinaa asie. Wɔ nnwuma nketewa wuranom a ɛho hia sɛ wohia kokoam nsɛm ma aguadi a ɛfata no, eyi yɛ mfaso kɛse! Nea obi a ɔhwehwɛ nneɛma mu betumi ahu ne nea ontumi nhu wɔ Zcash so TL;DR Fann (t) address ahorow no da adi koraa wɔ explorer so, te sɛ Bitcoin Nkitahodi a wɔabɔ ho ban koraa (z kosi z) no de sika dodow, address ahorow, ne memo no

title: Sɛnea Wɔde Brave Wallet Kɔma na Wogye Shielded Zcash (ZEC): Anamɔn biara a Wɔde Siesie Nsɛm Ho Akwankyerɛ
description: Brave Wallet yɛ ahobanbɔ, native crypto wallet a wɔasi no tẽẽ wɔ Brave browser no mu - enhia sɛ wɔtrɛw mu.
text: Sɛnea Wɔde Brave Wallet Kɔma na Wogye Shielded Zcash (ZEC): Anamɔn biara a Wɔde Siesie Nsɛm Ho Akwankyerɛ Brave Wallet yɛ ahobanbɔ, native crypto wallet a wɔasi no tẽẽ wɔ Brave browser no mu - enhia sɛ wɔtrɛw mu. Nea Enti a Shielded ZEC Mmoa Ho Hia Zcash yɛ cryptocurrencies nko ara a ɛde kokoamsɛm ma default a ɛwɔ shielded transactions no mu biako. Mprempren Brave Wallet boa Orchard shielded ZEC, na ɛma wotumi yɛ kokoam nkitahodi a wonni softwea a ɛto so abiɛsa. Afei deɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no bɛtumi de ZEC amena/agye a wɔrenna balances anaa metadata adi - ne nyinaa wɔ Brave browser no mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Ɔfã 1: Brave Wallet a Wobɛhyehyɛ Anamɔn a wɔakata so: Bue Brave Browser (desktop nkutoo mprempren) . Klik Wallet icon no so anaa kɔ brave://wallet Hyehyɛ wo sika kotoku (bɔ anaa fa ba) . Kɔ crypto dashboard no so Ɔfa 2: Zcash (ZEC) a wɔde bɛka Brave Wallet ho Anamɔn a wɔakata so: Wɔ Wallet dashboard no mu no, klik "Manage Assets" so. Hwehwɛ ZEC na ma ɛnyɛ adwuma Afei ZEC bɛda adi wɔ wo sika kotoku mu Part 3: Receiving Shielded ZEC (Unified Address) Anamɔn a wɔakata so: Klik ZEC wɔ w’agyapade mu Paw "Gye". Brave yɛ Unified Address (UA) - address baako a ɛboa nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ban ne nea ɛda adi pefee Kɔpi anaa scan QR code no Kyɛ wo UA no ma nea ɔde kɔmaa no Ɔfa 4: Shielded ZEC a wɔde bɛmena wɔ kokoam Anamɔn a wɔakata so: Paw ZEC -> Send Fa nea woregye no Unified Address anaa address a wɔabɔ ho ban no hyɛ mu Hyehyɛ sika dodow Si asɛm a ɛfa asɛm no ho no so dua Klik Send - seesei wɔde sika no kɔ kokoam, de Orchard pool no di dwuma Address Ahorow Ahorow Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛfa Zcash address type biara ho ni: t-addr (t1...) - Address a ɛda adi pefee yɛ adwuma te sɛ Bitcoin address, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkitahodi yɛ baguam wɔ blockchain no so. Ɛnyɛ den sɛ wode bedi dwuma wɔ sika kotoku a ɛnyɛ Zcash mu nanso ɛmma kokoam nsɛm. z-addr (zs...) - Address a wɔabɔ ho ban de Zcash kokoam nsɛm (Sprout/Sapling) di dwuma de sie nea ɔde kɔmaa, nea ogye, ne sika dodow. View keys anaa owura no nkutoo na obetumi ada nsɛm no adi. UA (u... anaa QR) - Address a Wɔaka abom no ka address ahorow pii (transparent, shielded, Orchard) bom yɛ biako. Eyi ma kwan ma ɛne ne ho hyia kɛse bere a wɔpɛ kokoam nsɛm wɔ baabi a ɛbɛyɛ yiye no. Kɔ anim Awiei: Wɔayɛ Kokoam Nsɛm a Wɔde Di Dwuma Brave Wallet ne ZEC a wɔabɔ ho ban no, seesei obiara tumi nya kokoam nsɛm - software soronko anaa nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim biara nhia. Ɛyɛ papa ma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden, anaa ankorankoro a wɔpɛ kokoam nsɛm. Sɔ wo shielded transaction a edi kan hwɛ nnɛ wɔ Brave mu! Tena kokoam. Tra hɔ kwa. Fa ZEC kɔma kokoam ne Brave Wallet.

title: BTCPay Server a Zcash Mmoa: Installation ne Integration Akwankyerɛ a Edi Mu
description: BTCPay Server ma intanɛt so nnwuma kwan ma wogye cryptocurrency sikatua tẽẽ, a ntamgyinafo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so nni mu. Saa akwankyerɛ yi nante wo fa ɔkwan a…
text: BTCPay Server a Zcash Mmoa: Installation ne Integration Akwankyerɛ a Edi Mu BTCPay Server ma intanɛt so nnwuma kwan ma wogye cryptocurrency sikatua tẽẽ, a ntamgyinafo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so nni mu. Saa akwankyerɛ yi nante wo fa ɔkwan a edi mũ a wɔfa so hyehyɛ BTCPay Server a ɛwɔ native mmoa ma Zcash shielded payments. Saa nkrataa yi twe adwene si Zcash a wode bɛka wo BTCPay Server nhwɛsoɔ no ho. Ɛboa full node (Zebra) ne lightwalletd-based nhyehyɛe nyinaa. --- Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ Nea enti a ɛsɛ sɛ wode BTCPay Server di dwuma ne Zcash Sɛnea BTCPay Server Yɛ Adwuma Ɛhe na Wɔde Sika Sie? Hena na Ɔdi Kokoam Safe no So? Sɛnea Wobɛhyehyɛ BTCPay Server ama Zcash agye atom BTCPay Server a wɔde Zcash Mmoa di dwuma Wo Ankasa Zcash Full Node (Zebra + lightwalletd) a Woretu mmirika Nkitahodi a ɛkɔ External lightwalletd Node (Nhyehyɛe a Wɔahyɛ da ayɛ) so BTCPay Server a wobɛgye wɔ Fie ne Cloudflare Tunnel Zcash Plugin a wɔrehyehyɛ wɔ BTCPay Server Wɛb Nkitahodi no mu BTCPay Server a wode bɛka Wo Wɛbsaet no ho API Nkitahodi API Safoa a Wɔreyɛ Nhwɛsoɔ: Invoice a wɔreyɛ denam API so Webhook a Wobɛhyehyɛ CMS Nkabom Katua Button anaa Iframe Awie Akadeɛ --- Nea enti a ɛsɛ sɛ wode BTCPay Server di dwuma ne Zcash Intanɛt so aguadi gye cryptocurrency tom kɛse. Ɛyɛ ntɛmntɛm, ɛyɛ wiase nyinaa de, na ɛyɛ adwuma a sikakorabea nni mu. Eyi so ba aguadifo ne adetɔfo nyinaa so mfaso. Nanso asɛm bi a ɛho hia wɔ hɔ a nnipa pii bu wɔn ani gu so. Sɛ adetɔfo no reyɛ ade bi a, mpɛn pii no ɔde n’ankasa ho nsɛm ma: ne din, address a wɔde mena, ne telefon nɔma. Sɛ wɔde ɔmanfo blockchain na ɛyɛ sikatua no - te sɛ Bitcoin, Ethereum, anaa stablecoins wɔ Ethereum anaa Tron so a - asɛm no bɛyɛ nea wotumi hu daa ma nhwehwɛmu. Obiara, mpo a onnim nea wɔhyɛɛ no, betumi: hwɛ bere a wotuae ne sika dodow a wotuae hwehwɛ baabi a sika no fi bae ne baabi a ɛkɔe fa cryptocurrency address bi bata onipa ankasa ho sɛ biribi wɔ abusuabɔ a (sɛ nhwɛso no, email anaa din a wɔde mena a ɛdaa adi) Eyi kyerɛ sɛ ebia adetɔ biako pɛ bɛma wɔahu adetɔfo bi sikasɛm ho abakɔsɛm nyinaa. Na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔkwan foforo so nso. Sɛ aguadifo bi address apue wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so pɛn a, wɔda wɔn ho adi. Wɔn a wɔresi akan ne nnipa a wɔto so abiɛsa a wɔhwɛ no betumi ahwɛ sika dodow a wotua, wɔn a wɔde nneɛma ma no dwumadi, ne sɛnea adwumayɛ kɔ so no nhyehyɛe. BTCPay Server ne Zcash a wɔaka abom no betumi adi eyi ho dwuma. BTCPay Server yɛ nhyehyɛe a wontua hwee na wɔde ma a wɔde gye cryptocurrency sikatua. Ɛnyɛ ntamgyinafo a ɔde tua sika na enkura sika biara. Sika a wotua nyinaa kɔ aguadifo no sika kotoku mu tẽẽ. Eyi betumi ayɛ ankorankoro sika kotoku anaasɛ multisig nhyehyɛe wɔ ahyehyɛde bi mu. Server no di coordination nnwuma ho dwuma: ma address soronko bi ma ade biara a wɔkra di bere a wɔanya sika no akyi na ɛde bata nea wɔkrae no ho de nkrataa a wɔde gye sika ne amanneɛbɔ ahorow ma de sikatua ho nhyehyɛe ma adetɔfo no Biribiara di dwuma wɔ sotɔɔ wura no tumi ase, a wɔmfa wɔn ho nto nnipa foforo nnwuma so. Zcash yɛ cryptocurrency a wɔasi wɔ zero-nimdeɛ adanse so. Ɛboa kokoam nkitahodi nhyehyɛe a edi mũ. Sɛ wode address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban (a wɔfrɛ no “address” kɛkɛ) redi dwuma a, wɔmfa nea ɔde kɔmaa, nea ogye, ne sika a wɔde di gua no nkyerɛ wɔ blockchain no so. Wɔ intanɛt so sotɔɔ ahorow fam no, eyi kyerɛ sɛ: Adetɔfo no betumi awie sika no a ɔrenka wɔn sikasɛm ho abakɔsɛm adi Ɔdetɔnfo no nsa ka sika a ɔnka wɔn address, adetɔn dodow, anaa wɔn aguadi nhyehyɛe ho asɛm Obiara nni hɔ a ɔhwɛ abɔnten so a obetumi de sikatua no abata ade a wɔkrae no ho anaasɛ adetɔfo ho nsɛm ho Nhwɛso a mfaso wɔ so Obi a ɔde di dwuma de ahyɛde bi na ɔpaw Bitcoin anaa USDT sɛ ɔkwan a ɔbɛfa so atua. Wɛbsaet no yɛ address a wɔde tua sika na ɛkyerɛ sika dodow no. Sɛ wotua sika no wie a, wɔde saa address yi sie wɔ blockchain no so na ɛbɛyɛ baguam. Nea ehia ara ne sɛ ɔtowhyɛfo de ahyɛde biako bata address no ho na ama watumi ahu n’adwuma ho abakɔsɛm nyinaa bere tenten. Afei susuw tebea koro no ara a ɛwɔ Zcash. BTCPay Server yɛ address a

title: Zcash Network no a wobɛhwɛ wɔ w’adwenem
description: Nea edidi so yi yɛ akwankyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde Ziggurat 3.0 Crawler for Zcash ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbata ho Crunchy ne P2P-Viz wɔ Ubuntu 22.04 a wɔde boaboa…
text: Zcash Network no a wobɛhwɛ wɔ w’adwenem Nea edidi so yi yɛ akwankyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde Ziggurat 3.0 Crawler for Zcash ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbata ho Crunchy ne P2P-Viz wɔ Ubuntu 22.04 a wɔde boaboa Zcash ntwamutam ho nsɛm ano na wɔyɛ ho mfonini wɔ w’adwenem. Video a ɛwɔ ase ha a wɔde link ahyɛ mu no di adeyɛ koro no ara akyi. ---------------- Install Ahwehwɛde ahorow: Rust -> https://rustup.rs/ Ɛnyɛ ɔhyɛ: jq -> https://jqlang.github.io/jq/download/ (ma json nsɛm a wɔda no adi wɔ terminal no mu) kurukuruwa -> https://everything.curl.dev/install/linux.html (ma wobisabisa crawler RPC no) npm (ne nvm) -> https://medium.com/@iamvinojan/how-to-install-node-js-and-npm-using-node-version-manager-nvm-143165b16ce1 (ma P2P-Viz a wobɛda no adi wɔ browser no mu) ---------------- ---------------- Ziggurat 3.0 Adekorabea https://github.com/runziggurat Crawler Repo a Wɔde Di Dwuma https://github.com/runziggurat/zcash.git Crunchy Repo a Ɛyɛ Fɛ https://github.com/runziggurat/crunchy.git P2P-Viz Repo a Wɔde Di Dwuma https://github.com/runziggurat/p2p-viz.git ---------------- Fi ase denam updates a wɔtaa de di dwuma no so. Fa ahyɛde ahorow a edidi so yi di dwuma: ---------------- Zcash Ntwamutam a Wɔhwehwɛ Zcash Crawler no te folda bi a wɔato din 'zcash' mu enti ebia ɛbɛyɛ papa sɛ wobɛbɔ directory foforo ansa na woayɛ crawler no clone (runziggurat/zcash repo). Efi /Home directory no mu, Run ahyɛde ahorow a edidi so yi: Kɔ browser mu kɔ https://github.com/runziggurat/zcash/blob/main/src/tools/crawler/README.md Anaasɛ bue readme no wɔ '/runziggurat/zcash/src/nnwinnade/krawler/README.md'. Kratafa yi kura nsɛm a ɛfa sɛnea wɔde di dwuma pɔtee bi ho. ---------------- --seed-addrs \ --dns-seed yɛ akyinnyegye biako pɛ a wɔhwehwɛ na anyɛ yiye koraa no ehia address biako a wɔakyerɛ na ama atumi ayɛ adwuma. ---------------- Ahyɛdeɛ 'cargo run --release --features crawler --bin crawler -- --help' yɛ run ahyɛdeɛ ankasa na ɛbɛtintim mmoa menu a wɔakyerɛ no. Fa ahyɛde no tu mmirika Eyi bɛboaboa dwumadi no ano na ahwɛ ahu sɛ biribiara reyɛ adwuma yiye. Sɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ Crawler no a, ɛhia sɛ wode '--seed-addrs' frankaa ka start ahyɛdeɛ no ho, a anyɛ yie koraa no, Zcash node IP address baako, a ɛfata, na ɛwɔ mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma crawler no kwan ma otu mmirika bere a ɛfata na ama wɔanya nea efi mu ba no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Wobetumi ahu nhwɛsode node IP address ahorow bi wɔ so https://mainnet.zcashexplorer.app/nodes. Sɛ wobɛnya nsɛm afiri Crawler no hɔ berɛ a ɛretu mmirika a, ɛhia sɛ wode '--rpc-addr' frankaa bɛka start ahyɛdeɛ no ho. Eyi nhia sɛ wode krawler no ankasa nkutoo na ɛyɛ adwuma nanso sɛ ɛnte saa a, ɛbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wugyae krawla no (ctrl+c anaa SIGKILL) na ama woada nsɛm biara adi koraa. Fa ahyɛde no tu mmirika Crawler no bɛhyɛ aseɛ ne network no adi nkitaho (default biara 20 secs) na waboaboa network data ano. Wobetumi ada nsɛm a efi Crawler no adi denam curl a wɔde bedi dwuma de abisa node no so (eyi hwehwɛ sɛ jq de kyerɛ saa info no). Wɔde Crawler RPC address a ɛwɔ nhwɛsoɔ yi mu no ato hɔ sɛ '127.0.0.1:54321'. Wɔ Terminal foforo mu no, Run ahyɛde no Wei bɛkyerɛ '.protocolversion' data a wɔaboaboa ano mprempren a ɛwɔ '.result' field no mu. '.result' field no yɛ kɛseɛ paa enti mfasoɔ wɔ so sɛ wobɛfrɛ ne fã pɔtee bi mmom. Data ahorow afoforo a mfaso wɔ so ne '.numknownnodes', '.numgoodnodes', '.useragents' ne nea ɛkeka ho Hwɛ metrics ɔfa no Ha ---------------- ---------------- Sɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ Crunchy ne P2P-Viz a, ɛhia sɛ wode '.result' no paipe kɔ .json fael mu. Fa ahyɛde no tu mmirika Wei bɛma woanya 'latest.json' fael wɔ mprempren daerekta no mu.Wɔde saa 'latest.json' fael yi bedi dwuma ne Crunchy. Saa bere yi, wobetumi de 'ctrl+c' agyae Crawler no sɛ data foforo biara ho nhia a. Crawler no de amanneɛbɔ bi bɛkɔ terminal a nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so wom. ---------------- Crunchy a ɛyɛ mmerɛw Crunchy hia sɛ ɛboaboa output json fael no ano ma wɔde di dwuma ne P2P-Viz. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokyekye Crunchy a, kɔ wo '/runziggurat' folda no so Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wo clone kɔ Crunchy repo no mu a, Run ahyɛ

title: Zcash Address ahorow a wobɛyɛ wɔ w’adwenem
description: Sɛ woresua Zcash ho ade nea edi kan a wubehu ntɛm ara sɛ ahorow abien na ɛwɔ hɔ nkitahodi ahorow a ebetumi aba: transparent ne shielded.
text: Zcash Address ahorow a wobɛyɛ wɔ w’adwenem Sɛ woresua Zcash ho ade nea edi kan a wubehu ntɛm ara sɛ ahorow abien na ɛwɔ hɔ nkitahodi ahorow a ebetumi aba: transparent ne shielded. Bio nso, sɛ woakɔ so ayɛ nea aba foforo wɔ Zcash abɔde a nkwa wom nhyehyɛe no mu a, ebia woasua ho ade Address ahorow a Wɔaka abom, or UA's. Sɛ folks wɔ Zcash adwumayɛ mu ka shielded nkitahodi ho asɛm a, wɔkyerɛ nkitahodi a ɛfa address ahorow a wɔde encoded ama sapling anaa orchard protocols no ho. Wɔayɛ UA's sɛ ɛbɛka biara ayɔnkofa a wɔabɔ ho ban anaa ɛda adi pefee abom ayɛ no address baako. Saa generalization yi ne ade titiriw a ɛbɛma UX a ɛkɔ n’anim no ayɛ mmerɛw. Akwankyerɛ yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛde nhwɛsoɔ a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde aniwa hu bɛka UA ho nteaseɛ ho. Zcash address ahorow ahorow Mprempren address ahorow atitiriw abiɛsa na wɔde di dwuma de besi nnɛ. Eyinom bi ne fann dua a wɔde yɛ nnuadewa Unified Address (Full) Ade a edi kan a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow ne sɛnea ɛsono address ahorow biara tenten. Wubetumi ahu eyi wɔ w’ani so denam nkyerɛwde dodow a ɛwɔ address string no mu anaasɛ denam QR code ahorow a ɛbata ho a wobɛhwɛ so. Bere a address no tenten kɔ soro no, QR code no taa brɛ ase na ɛde data pii hyɛ ahinanan no mu. t1goiSyw2JinFCmUnfiwwp72LEZzD42TyYu no tenten yɛ nkyerɛwde 35 zs1cpf4prtmnqpg6x2ngcrwelu9a39z9l9lqukq9fwagnaqrknk34a7n3szwxpjuxfjdxkuzykel53 no tenten yɛ nkyerɛwde 78 u1ckeydud0996ftppqrnpdsqyeq4e57qcyjr4raht4dc8j3njuyj3gmm9yk7hq9k88cdkqfuqusgpcpjfhwu3plm2vrd32g8du78kzkm5un357r4vkhz4vhxd4yfl8zvszk99cmsc89qv4trd7jzkcs8h6lukzgy25j8cv76p0g603nrrg6yt6cxsh2v8rmkasskd69ylfyphhjyv0cxs no tenten yɛ nkyerɛwde 213 Adeɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow ne address string biara prefix -- transparent start ne t, sapling de zs, na awiei koraa no UA's de u1. Ɛho hia sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow: "Orchard akatua address nni stand-alone string encoding. Mmom, yɛkyerɛkyerɛ "address a wɔaka abom" a ebetumi abɔ address ahorow a ɛsono emu biara abom, a Orchard ka ho. Address a wɔaka abom wɔ "u" Ɔfã a Onipa Akenkan wɔ Mainnet so, i.e. wobenya prefix "u1 Unified Address agyefo Sɛnea yɛaka ho asɛm no ha obi betumi akyekye UA's ne receivers ahorow -- ebinom a wɔaka abom a ɛyɛ transparent,sapling, ne orchard address ahorow. Sɛ UA a edi mũ da nkyɛn a, nea ɛtaa ba a wubehu wɔ wuram no ni: transparent + dua a ɛyɛ nnuadewa transparent + nnuaba turo nnuadewa + nnuaba turo nnuaba turo Adeɛ a ɛdi kan a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow ne sɛ saa UA yi mu biara firi private key korɔ no ara mu! Ade a ɛto so abien a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow ne UA ahorow biara tenten: t+s u13qutpuktq026dwczvxmnh8mxdacsjx3kg2rrhzgns8zsty53t9y0hqp5d440zc9w7z7zkkjqw8dq0uuc0mkt883464mq8mkys7l4xjnhylh7u3u02ukknurm5yxerqlf500y2atq28e nkyerɛwde 141 na ɛwɔ mu t+o u1yvwppp7ann6n3pgkysdu0spvr50w4jf4jwgme3c8x8fp4av59rupgvdd3fddc3f2cwrk3ghs5lxt87ggj8cvjuzcrf4jkejwlu9pc83gk2vtx03ucqcc3ed0furcuypqs6d6swu3nws nkyerɛwde 141 na ɛwɔ mu s+o u1dq8kg78fgpjsc7dn2ynpdzc8xu99wra0jec4jy30rjqk5frsj62qtgqcu9nn0j8g352phlwprshancgxcuhdcclx0wxtvqylhmuegas7ul8hwnwggy727l05pyujuywtnn4nkfznctaelpkcrqcm9cxhkgv3t9jtrvgym7la5varrmzc nkyerɛwde 178 na ɛwɔ mu o u1cysntkxwt0h4sahp7rhj7u27pgc2ga7685ekf65g0d5ht5glkfm4zkumhvkd2zg2pdrgv3mrwq2x3vw2yl5u7zef3cr2nqwrzu7v2dsa nkyerɛwde 106 na ɛwɔ mu Ade a ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow ne sɛnea wɔ aniwa so no UA biara yɛ soronko kakra! Tumi a UA's wɔ ne choice a wɔma ho kwan ma end users. Sɛ daakye ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ protocol foforo a, UA's bɛyɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛbɔ. title: Zcash Devtool no na ɛyɛ adwuma
description: Zcash Devtool yɛ platform a wɔde hacking wɔ Zcash. Ɛyɛ developers na wɔasi, ma developers, ma sɔhwɛ & nkɔsoɔ a ɛfa Zcash dwumadie foforɔ ho; na ɛnsɛ sɛ wobu no…
text: Zcash Devtool no na ɛyɛ adwuma Dɛn ne zcash-devtool? Zcash Devtool yɛ platform a wɔde hacking wɔ Zcash. Ɛyɛ developers na wɔasi, ma developers, ma sɔhwɛ & nkɔsoɔ a ɛfa Zcash dwumadie foforɔ ho; na ɛnsɛ sɛ wobu no sɛ wɔasiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ. Ahyɛdeɛ kwan API a saa adwinnadeɛ yi da no adi no tumi & bɛsesa bere biara a wɔremmɔ kɔkɔ. MMFA sika kɛseɛ mma zcash-devtool embedded wallet no sohwɛ. Video nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa Zcash Devtool ho: Kris Nuttycombe (@nuttycom) de saa adwinnade yi mae wɔ ZconVI bere mu. --- Sɛ wopɛ anammɔn anammɔn akwankyerɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wubefi ase de nnwinnade yi adi dwuma a, hwɛ saa nantew yi. Ɛkyerɛw nantew a edi mũ a ɛfa sɛnea wɔhyehyɛ na wɔde zcash devtool nnwinnade no di dwuma ho. Wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ akwankyerɛ ama sɛdeɛ wobɛnya nhyehyɛɛ ne sɛdeɛ wode w’ankasa dwumadie bɛka adwinnadeɛ no ho. Fi ase ntɛmntɛm Wɔhwɛɛ ahyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no wɔ zcash-devtool ho main (yɛ 5a26ee8, Ɔpɛpɔn 2026). Adwinnade no sesa a wɔmmɔ wo amanneɛ, enti tu mmirika --help wɔ ahyɛde biara so sɛ biribi a ɛwɔ ha no nhyia bio a. Fa sto so Binaries a wɔadi kan ayɛ biara nni hɔ. Fa sto so Rust, afei si fi fibea: Nhwɛso ahorow a ɛwɔ ase ha no frɛ binary a wɔasisi no, target/release/zcash-devtool. cargo run --release -- ... yɛ adwuma wɔ ɔkwan koro no ara so. Yɛ testnet sika kotoku Fi ase wɔ testnet so. Testnet sika (TAZ) nni mfaso biara. -w ne sika kotoku no kyerɛwtohɔ. Ɛkɔ akyi wallet na ansa na ahyɛde ketewa no aba. -i is an mfeɛ fael a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ onipa. Wɔde sika kotoku no mnemonic kasasin no ahyɛ mu, na sɛ enni hɔ a, wɔbɔ fael no. Fa sie: send, shield na ahyɛde afoforo a ɛfa sika a wɔsɛe no ho hia no na ama wɔatumi akyerɛkyerɛ aba no mu. -n ne network no: test or main. -s paw kanea sika kotoku server no. Nea wɔde ahyɛ mu no, zecrocks, kɔ zec.rocks server no so ma ntwamutam a wɔapaw no. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosan de sika kotoku a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no ba a, fa di dwuma restore-mnemonic wɔ ananmu init. Ɛkanyan kasasin no. balance bobɔ ɔtare biara din wɔ ɔkwan soronko so, a Ironwood: Dwane zcash-devtool wallet -w ./my-wallet list-addresses sɛ wobɛhunu sika kotokuo no address a wɔaka abom, na wode testnet sika afiri a faucet a wɔde yɛ adwuma. Sɛ wopɛ mainnet a, twam -n main to init. Fa sika dodow a wubetumi atua nkutoo di dwuma. Soma na fa kyɛm Dodow no wɔ zatoshis mu (1 ZEC = 100,000,000 zatoshis). propose kyerɛ asɛm a wɔde di dwuma a send anka wɔbɛkyekye, a wɔremfa nkɔma. list-tx ne list-unspent kyerɛ sika kotoku no abakɔsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw. Ahyɛde biara a ɛne server bi kasa nso gye tom --connection tor, a ɛde nkitahodi no fa Tor afɛfo a wɔahyɛ no mu no so. Hwɛ address ahorow, nsafe ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ inspect decodes Zcash data offline: address, nsafe, ne nnwuma a wɔanhyɛ da. Fa ka ho --lookup sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobenya nsɛm pii afi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu, te sɛ asɛm bi a ɛnam ne ID so. Wɔde Ironwood nkrataa kɔma Orchard receiver koro no ara wɔ address a wɔaka abom mu, enti address ahorow no ansesa wɔ NU6.3. Si nkitahodi ahorow wɔ anammɔn ahorow mu ne PCZTs PCZT (Zcash asɛm a wɔabɔ no fã bi) kyekyɛ atɔfoɔ a wɔbɛkyekyere no mu ayɛ no anammɔn ahodoɔ: bɔ, di ho adanseɛ, de wɔn nsa hyɛ aseɛ, na soma. Anamɔn biara betumi ayɛ adwuma wɔ afiri soronko so, sɛ nhwɛso no, ɛwɔ hardware signer te sɛ Keystone. Ebiara pczt ahyɛde kenkan PCZT no fi fael anaa stdin mu na ɛkyerɛw kɔ fael bi mu (--output) anaa stdout, enti wobetumi de anammɔn no ayɛ paipu: zcash-devtool pczt --help bobɔ anammɔn afoforo no din, a nea ɛka ho ne inspect, redact, combine, extract ne shield. Fa sika fi Orchard kɔ Ironwood Efi NU6.3, Orchard sika betumi akɔ sika kotoku no ankasa address nkutoo so. No migration ahyɛde ahorow de wɔn kɔ Ironwood: plan di kan hwɛ nkyerɛwde no mu mpaapaemu ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛkɔ baabi foforo no, na ɛnsakra hwee. commit ɔkyekye na odi kan de ne nsa hyɛ ahosiesie nkitahodi ahorow a edi kan ase. Fa ka ho --external sɛ wobegyaw wɔn a wɔmfa wɔn nsa nhyɛ ase mma obi a ofi ase de ne nsa hyɛ ase te sɛ Keystone. status kyerɛ nkɔso a atutra no anya ne anammɔn a edi hɔ. adva

title: Zcash Nkɔsoɔ Ho Nsusuiɛ
description: Zcash Nkɔsoɔ Nsusuiɛ (ZIP) yɛ nhyehyɛɛ nwoma a ɛde nsɛm ma Zcash mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, anaa ɛkyerɛkyerɛ adeɛ foforɔ bi a ɛwɔ Zcash anaa ne nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nneɛma a atwa…
text: Zcash Nkɔsoɔ Ho Nsusuiɛ Dɛn ne ZIP Zcash Nkɔsoɔ Nsusuiɛ (ZIP) yɛ nhyehyɛɛ nwoma a ɛde nsɛm ma Zcash mpɔtam hɔfoɔ, anaa ɛkyerɛkyerɛ adeɛ foforɔ bi a ɛwɔ Zcash anaa ne nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ ZIP no de mfiridwuma ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu tiawa a ɛfa ade no ho ne ntease a ɛwɔ afã no ho ma. Yɛabɔ yɛn tirim sɛ ZIPs bɛyɛ ɔkwan titiriw a yɛbɛfa so ahyɛ nneɛma foforo ho nyansa, de aboaboa mpɔtam hɔfo adwene ano wɔ asɛm bi ho, na yɛakyerɛw nhyehyɛe ho gyinaesi ahorow a akɔ Zcash mu no. ZIP (Wɔwura) (mpɛn pii no akyerɛwfo (akyerɛwfo)) no na ɛyɛ wɔn asɛyɛde sɛ wɔma adwene koro wɔ mpɔtam hɔ na wɔkyerɛw adwene a ɛne wɔn ho nhyia. Esiane sɛ wɔhwɛ ZIP ahorow no so sɛ nsɛm fael wɔ versioned repository mu nti, wɔn nsakrae abakɔsɛm yɛ abakɔsɛm kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛfa feature proposal no ho. -> zips.z.sika a wɔde yɛ adwuma ZIP Nkyerɛwfo ZIP biara a ɛbɛba no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛfa nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu. Wɔde adwuma ahyɛ ZIP samufoɔ nsa sɛ wɔnhwɛ sɛ ZIP biara nhyehyɛɛ ne emu nsɛm no kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛmfua, nteaseɛ ne mfiridwuma mu nsakraeɛ a wɔayɛ mu yie. Mprempren ZIP ahorow a ɛda nsow Wɔhwɛɛ tebea ne asɛmti ahorow a ɛwɔ ase ha no de totoo ZIP index no ho wɔ zips.z.sika a wɔde yɛ adwuma on 18 August 2026. ZIP tebea sesa bere a bere kɔ so no, enti fa index no sɛ nokware fibea. Atwerɛkan: Zcash Ntrɛwmu a ɛda adi pefee Atwerɛkan: Zcash Shielded Assets a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo ne nea wɔhyew Atwerɛkan: Zcash Shielded Assets a Wɔde Ma Wɔatwe wɔn ho afi ho: Wɔatwe Version 6 Nkitahodi Nhyehyɛe — ZIP 229 a seesei ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asɛmdi version 6. Hwɛ NU6.3 list a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no ayɛ dedaw. title: Zero Nimdeɛ vs Decoy a egyina Systems so
description: "Cryptocurrency da wo sikasɛm dwumadi nyinaa adi kyerɛ ɔmanfo efisɛ ɛte sɛ Twitter a ɛkɔ wo Sikakorabea akontaabu so ara pɛ na eyi yɛ asɛm kɛse a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi…
text: Zero Nimdeɛ vs Decoy a egyina Systems so "Cryptocurrency da wo sikasɛm dwumadi nyinaa adi kyerɛ ɔmanfo efisɛ ɛte sɛ Twitter a ɛkɔ wo Sikakorabea akontaabu so ara pɛ na eyi yɛ asɛm kɛse a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi ho dwuma denam nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kokoamsɛm a wogye tom so." - Ian Miers wɔ Devcon4. Crypto nnwuma bi anya agyede wɔ wɔn akwan a ɛfa kokoam nsɛm ho no ho. Zcash agye din sɛ wɔde Zero Knowledge Proofs (ZK) di dwuma de bɔ nnwuma sika ne address ho ban. Monero da nsow wɔ Decoy-based sender obfuscation a ɔde di dwuma de ka encryption nhyehyɛe afoforo ho de nya ɔdefo kokoamsɛm wɔ blockchain no so. ZK Adanse ne Decoy Based Systems ntease Zero Knowledge Proofs yɛ cryptographic nhyehyɛe a ɛma ɔfã biako (ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo) kyerɛ ɔfã foforo (ɔhwɛfo) sɛ asɛm bi yɛ nokware a ɔnna nsɛm biara a ɛhyɛ ase a ɛfa asɛm no ankasa ho adi. Wɔ Zcash, wɔde ZK adanseɛ di dwuma de hwɛ sɛ asɛm bi yɛ nokware a wɔmfa asɛm no ho nsɛm te sɛ SENDER, RECEIVER anaa asɛm no HO AKATUO adi. Eyi hwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛkora ɔdefo no kokoamsɛm so efisɛ asɛm no da so ara yɛ kokoamsɛm bere a wɔda so ara di ho adanse no. Wɔayɛ saa mfiridwuma yi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a sikasɛm mu nkitahodi a ɛwɔ Zcash ntam no yɛ kokoamsɛm. Wɔ Decoy-gyina nhyehyɛe ahorow te sɛ RingCT na ɛyɛ adwuma, wɔka nnwuma pii bom ma ɛyɛ den anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wobehu baabi a sika no fi ne baabi ankasa. Algorithm no de decoy inputs ne outputs ba wɔ transactions nso de encryption di dwuma wɔ addresses a wɔde di dwuma sɛ inputs & de Range adanse di dwuma de kyerɛ sɛ sika dodow a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo no yɛ spendable. Saa kwan yi ma nkitahodi kwan no yɛ basaa. Decoy inputs a wɔde di dwuma no ma ɛyɛ den ma obiara a ɔreyɛ blockchain no mu nhwehwɛmu sɛ obehu nea ɔde kɔmaa, nea ogye, anaa sika a wɔde di gua ankasa. Hyɛ no nsow a ɛho hia: Saa kwan yi a wɔfa so kora nkitahodi so wɔ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn so no da so ara da (encrypted) inputs adi pefee wɔ ɔdefo no nkitahodi nyinaa mu. Metadata te sɛ FLOW OF TRANSACTIONS a ɛda nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ntwamutam no so ntam no, wɔda so ara tumi boaboa ano. Sɛ ɔtamfo bi de ne ho hyɛ nkitahodi ahorow a wɔyɛ wɔ ntam no mu denneennen a, ɛma afoforo a wɔde di dwuma no decoy inputs no yɛ deanonymise wɔ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn so. Mfaso a ɛwɔ ZK so sen Decoy Based Systems Zcash ne Monero nyinaa yɛ cryptocurrencies a wɔde wɔn adwene si kokoamsɛm so, nanso wonya kokoamsɛm wɔ akwan horow so. Mfaso bi a ɛwɔ Zcash's zero-knowledge proofs (ZK) so sen Monero decoy nhyehyɛe no ni: 1) Selective Disclosure: Zcash ZK feature set, wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no wɔ hokwan sɛ wɔbɛda asɛm no ho nsɛm adi akyerɛ nnipa pɔtee bi Kenkan ECC Blog a ɛfa Selective Disclosure ho. Wɔ Zcash, shielded transactions’ encrypted contents ma ankorankoro tumi paw da data a efi transfer pɔtee bi mu adi. Bio nso, wobetumi de safe a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma ama de ada nnwuma a ɛfa address pɔtee bi a wɔabɔ ho ban ho nyinaa adi. Saa adeɛ yi ma kwan ma wɔdi mmara so na wɔtumi yɛ akontabuo a ɛnsɛe ntwamutam no kokoamsɛm nyinaa. Bere a Monero decoy algorithm (ring signature) boa wɔ kokoamsɛm a wɔde ma mu no, ɛmma selective disclosure wɔ ɔkwan koro no ara so. 2) Optional Visibility: Zcash ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kwan ma wɔpaw nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee (ɛnyɛ kokoam de) ne nea wɔabɔ ho ban (kokoam de) ntam. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ Zcash ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kwan ma wɔde wɔn sikasɛm ho nsɛm sie kokoam (wɔabɔ ho ban) anaasɛ wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛda adi na ɛda adi wɔ baguam te sɛ blockchain afoforo dodow no ara sɛnea wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ so no Zcash aban wɛbsaet. Saa kokoamsɛm a wɔpaw yi ma kwan ma wɔyɛ nsakrae kɛse ne nsɛm a ɛfa adwumayɛ/ahyehyɛde ho a wɔde di dwuma, efisɛ ebia nnwuma bi bɛhwehwɛ kokoamsɛm kakraa bi na ɔmanfo ahwɛ mu, bere a afoforo nso nya mfaso fi kokoamsɛm a wɔama anya nkɔso mu. 3) Anonymity Set: Wɔde anonymity set a wɔahyehyɛ of zero knowledge shielded pools no yɛ nnwuma a asisi pɛn nyinaa. Eyi yɛ kɛse kɛse sen on-chain akwan afoforo dodow no ara a wɔfa so nya nkitahodi a enni nkitahodi. Hyɛ no nsow: eyi fa nnwuma a ɛwɔ shielded pool koro no ara mu nkutoo ho. Decoys a w

title: Wɔde zcashd rekɔ Akash denam Console so
description: Wɔagyae. Mfa akwankyerɛ yi akyi mfa node a woabɔ wo tirim sɛ wode bedi dwuma no nkɔ.
text: Wɔde zcashd rekɔ Akash denam Console so Wɔagyae. Mfa akwankyerɛ yi akyi mfa node a woabɔ wo tirim sɛ wode bedi dwuma no nkɔ. zcashd reached its automatic End-of-Support halt on July 18, 2026. zcashd node a wɔde ahyɛ mu nnɛ no renhyia nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn tip no, enti dwumadie no gye sika bosome biara na ɛnyɛ hwee. Fa Zebra di dwuma mmom: Sɛnea wɔyɛ Zebra wɔ Akash Network so, a ɛkata Akash Console adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe koro no ara so na ehia bɛyɛ disk no nkyem abiɛsa mu biako. Sɛ woretu nhyehyɛe bi a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a, hwɛ zcashd to Zebra ne Zallet atutra akwankyerɛ. Wɔde krataafa yi sie sɛ abakɔsɛm kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛfa zcashd dwumadie no ho. Akwankyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnea wode zcashd Zcash full node (Electric Coin Co dwumadie) bedi dwuma Akash Console na ɛwɔ hɔ. Video nkyerɛkyerɛ bi a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha ni. Wobetumi ahu akwankyerɛ a emu dɔ kɛse wɔ ase ha. Nea Woreyɛ Deploying zcashd node a edi mũ a ɛbɛma: -> Sync Zcash blockchain no nyinaa (350GB + ma mainnet, 40GB ma testnet) -> Ɛka bɛyɛ $15/ɔsram a egyina AKT token bo so -> Gye nnɔnhwerew pii kosi nna pii na ama ayɛ sync koraa -> Fa vCPU 4, 16GB RAM, 350GB akoraeɛ (mainnet) anaa 2 vCPUs, 8GB RAM, 50GB (testnet) di dwuma -> Twe cryptographic parameters wɔ mmirikatu a edi kan ( 2GB, pɛnkoro) zcashd vs Zebra: -> zcashd yɛ mfitiaseɛ Zcash node dwumadie a Electric Coin Co de dii dwuma, a wɔgyaee firi July 18, 2026 -> Zebra, a efi Zcash Foundation, ne node a edi mũ a wɔde di dwuma nnɛ -> Zebra nko ara na odi mprempren nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no akyi; zcashd node bi ntumi nkɔ ano -> zcashd sika kotokuo no na wɔasesa Zallet -> Fa zcashd di dwuma sɛ wo hia sika kotoku dwumadie anaa RPC API pɔtee bi a Nea ɛho hia: Port Mapping wɔ Akash Sɛ woda port bi adi wɔ Akash so (e.g., port 8233 ma zcashd P2P) a, ƐNYƐ saa port pɔtee no wɔ ɔdemafoɔ no baguam IP so. Mmom, ɔdemafoɔ no de random high port (te sɛ 31234 anaa 42567) ma na ɔde reverse-proxies kɔ wo container no port 8233. Eyi nam design so - providers run deployments pii, na sɛ obiara bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔde port 8233 bedi dwuma tẽẽ a, anka wobenya ntawntawdi. Nea eyi kyerɛ ma wo: -> Wo hyehyɛ port 8233 wɔ SDL (zcashd no gyinapɛn P2P hyɛn gyinabea) . -> Akash ma wo URI te sɛ provider.com:31234 . -> Zcash nodes afoforo kɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ provider.com:31234 -> Wo container no mu no, zcashd da so ara tie wɔ 8233 so Wɔdi eyi ho dwuma ara kwa. Fa URI a Akash de ma wo no di dwuma kɛkɛ. Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wodi kan yɛ -> Keplr Wallet browser ntrɛwmu a wɔde ahyɛ mu (Chrome/Brave/Firefox) -> AKT tokens - Nya 50-100 AKT fi nsakrae bi mu (Coinbase, Kraken, Osmosis) -> Simma 5 na wobɛkyere afa Console UI no so Anamɔn 1: Fa Wo Sikakorabea no Bata Ho -> Go to https://console.akash.network -> Klik "Connect Wallet" wɔ atifi nifa so -> Paw Keplr (anaasɛ Cosmos sika kotoku a wopɛ) . -> pene nkitahodi no so bere a Keplr pue Ɛsɛ sɛ wo AKT balance no pue wɔ soro nifa so. Sɛ ɛyɛ zero a, kɔ kan kɔ fund wo sika kotoku no. Anamɔn 2: Yɛ Deployment -> Klik "Deploy" bɔtn (bɔn kɛse bruu, kratafa no mfinimfini) -> Paw "Si wo template" (anaasɛ twa tẽẽ kɔ SDL a wode bɛto so) Ɔkwan A: Fa SDL Fael (Wɔkamfo kyerɛ) . Saa bɔtn yi de node a wɔagyae no di dwuma. Ɛbɔ ka tia wo AKT balance ma node a entumi nyɛ sync. Fa no di dwuma Zebra guide sɛ anka. Ɔkwan B: Fa SDL Editor di dwuma Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode nsa de SDL no hyɛ mu a: -> Kɔpi zcashd-akash.yml mu nsɛm no. -> Fa hyɛ SDL editor no mu -> Sesa sɛnea ɛho hia (hwɛ nhyehyeɛ ɔfa a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha) -> Klik "Bɔ Deployment" so. Anamɔn 4: Paw Ɔdemafo 30 seconds akyi no, wubehu bids a efi providers hɔ. title: Kɔka Crosslink Feature Net ho
description: Wɔde Feature Net version 14 asɔ ahwɛ wɔ Windows 11 (version 10.0.26200.9550), fi 8 kosi 10 October 2026. Software no yɛ nhwɛsode na ɛsakra bere biara a wɔayi…
text: Kɔka Crosslink Feature Net ho TL;DR Feature Net yɛ Shielded Labs' ɔmanfo sɔhwɛ ntam nkitahodi ma Crosslink, finality layer a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa a ɛde staking ka Zcash's proof-of-work nkyɛn. Ɛtu mmirika wɔ sɔhwɛ sika, cTAZ so. Biribiara nni hɔ a wobɛyɛ wɔ so a ɛnkɔ anaasɛ ɛde asiane to mainnet ZEC. Desktop app baako ne node, miner, wallet ne finalizer. Ɛyɛ mines cTAZ default na ɛwɔ faucet button. Staking, unstaking ne twedrawing nkutoo yɛ adwuma wɔ "Staking Day" mu, da koro wɔ abiɛsa biara mu. Miss it na wotwɛn nea edi hɔ no. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode toto ho a, wode finalizer bi identity gu so na wo klik sika bi so. Saa akwankyerɛ yi de ZecHub's finalizer di dwuma sɛ nhwɛsoɔ. RPC frɛ abien kyerɛ baabi a wugyina: walletstakingpositions ne gettflrecencystatus. Wɔde Feature Net version 14 asɔ ahwɛ wɔ Windows 11 (version 10.0.26200.9550), fi 8 kosi 10 October 2026. Software no yɛ nhwɛsode na ɛsakra bere biara a wɔayi no adi. Sɛ nea wuhu no yɛ soronko wɔ krataafa yi ho a, gye w’ankasa mmirikatu di na yɛsrɛ wo bue PR. Nea Feature Net yɛ Crosslink yɛ nsusuwii, ɛnyɛ Zcash fã nnɛ. Shielded Labs' Crosslink Nsɛm a Wɔtaa bisa ka sɛ "ɛbɛhia sɛ ɛfa Zcash nnisoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn no mu" ansa na atumi adu mainnet. No Crosslink Protocol no ho nhyehyɛe kratafa no kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wɔyɛɛ no mu. Sɛ wobɛsɔ adwini no ahwɛ wɔ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma ankasa nkyɛn a, Shielded Labs yɛ nea ɛfrɛ no feature nets a wɔde kanyan wɔn: "a ɛtoatoa so a wɔde kanyan testnets". Dwumadi abiɛsa na ɛwɔ network no so, na desktop app no betumi adi ne nyinaa: Asodie Nea ɛyɛ --- --- Miner a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ Ɛyɛ proof-of-work blocks, sɛnea ɛte wɔ Zcash so nnɛ no Staker na ɔkyerɛwee Locks cTAZ wɔ delegation bond mu na ɔtwe adwene si finalizer bi so Nea etwa to Votes de wie blocks. Ne abatow tumi ne kyɛfa a wɔde ahyɛ ne nsa no Adekorabea a ɛwɔ n’akyi no de asɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ woayɛ no yiye a ɛfata sɛ wokenkan ansa na wode biribiara ahyɛ mu no bue: "ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛ nsusuwii ahorow, ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛ adwumayɛ ho mfiridwuma" na "ɛnyɛ mmara a wɔasiesie ama nneɛma a wɔyɛ" (KENKAN NKYERƐKYERƐMU). Fa tu mmirika wɔ afiri bi so wɔ baabi a ɛno yɛ nea wogye tom. Dɛn na version 14 sesae Nkyerɛase 14 came out on 1 October 2026. Ne network no fi ase sɛ plain proof-of-work na ɛdane Crosslink wɔ anammɔn abiɛsa mu (farebae, a wɔakyerɛ nso wɔ so ctaz.sika a wɔde yɛ adwuma): Si kwan Nea ɛba --- --- 20,736 Staking bue 34,560 Wɔfa wɔn a wɔawie no din a edi kan no fi stakes on chain no mu 36,288 BFT finality fi ase, na staking akatua ne no Akatua a wɔde to gua no fi ase wɔ saa block ahorow no mu nea etwa to. Bond a wɔadi kan ayɛ no nnya hwee kosi saa bere no (farebae). title: Ledger Shielded ZEC Dwumadie Nkyerɛkyerɛmu
description: Wɔ 23 September 2026 Ledger de native shielded ZEC kaa Ledger Wallet Desktop ho. Mprempren Zcash akontaabu biako kura sika a ɛda adi pefee ne kokoam sika a ɛwɔ…
text: Ledger Shielded ZEC Dwumadie Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Wɔ 23 September 2026 Ledger de native shielded ZEC kaa Ledger Wallet Desktop ho. Mprempren Zcash akontaabu biako kura sika a ɛda adi pefee ne kokoam sika a ɛwɔ Zcash's Ironwood pool mu. Wo kokoam safe no tra wo Ledger, na wɔhwɛ asɛm biara a wodi mu na wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛ ase wɔ afiri no so. Desktop nkutoo. Ledger's dawurubɔ no ka sɛ shielded ZEC no "wɔ Ledger Wallet Desktop nkutoo so. Mobile mmoa nni hɔ saa bere yi, nanso ɛreba nnansa yi ara." Desktop app no nso kyerɛ amanneɛbɔ koro no ara. Wɔhwɛɛ mu wɔ 15 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2026. Ahoboa Ledger mfiri a ɛde Zcash app no di dwuma: Nano S Plus, Nano X, Stax anaa Flex. Wɔankyekyere mprempren Zcash app no amma mfitiase Nano S. Ledger Wallet Desktop 4.21 anaa nea ɛba akyiri yi, a wɔtwe fi hɔ nkutoo ledger.com so na ɛwɔ hɔ. Saa akwankyerɛ yi de version 4.24.0 dii dwuma. Zcash app a aba foforo wɔ wo Ledger so (3.9.4 bere a wɔkyerɛw akwankyerɛ yi). ZEC kakraa bi a wode bɛsɔ ahwɛ. Wɔyɛɛ anammɔn biara a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no wɔ mainnet so a 0.001 ZEC. Adwuma biara gye network fee ketewaa bi (0.00015 ZEC wɔ yɛn sɔhwɛ no mu). Wo kasasin a ɛwɔ nsɛmfua 24 a wode bɛsan agye no tra krataa so. Mfa nkyerɛw nkɔ kɔmputa so da anaasɛ nkyɛ. Anamɔn biara akwankyerɛ (Ledger Wallet Desktop) 1. Install anaa update Zcash app no Bue Ledger Wallet, fa bata na bue wo Ledger, na bue Me Ledger. Ma kwan ma nkitahodi no nkɔ afiri no so. Hwehwɛ Zcash wɔ app catalog no mu, afei klik Install, anaa Update sɛ wɔahyɛ no dedaw a. Bue Zcash app no wɔ wo Ledger. Screen no kenkan sɛ "Zcash app no ayɛ krado". Scroll nifa kɔ App info na hwɛ version no. 2. Fa Zcash akontaabu bi ka ho Wɔ Ledger Wallet mu no, paw Fa akontaabu ka ho. Wɔ Paw agyapade mu no, hwehwɛ Zcash na paw Zcash (ZEC), ɛnyɛ token a wɔabɔ ho ban te sɛ Binance-Peg Zcash Token. Sɛ Zcash app no abue wɔ wo Ledger, Ledger Wallet hwehwɛ wo akonta. Tick no wɔ Paw akontaabu a wopɛ sɛ wode ka ho ase na klik Confirm. Akontaabu krataafa no kyerɛ Nka a ɛwɔ hɔ, Nka a ɛda adi pefee ne Private balance, ne Enable shielded button. 3. Ma private balance no nyɛ adwuma Klik Ma shielded nyɛ adwuma. Enable Zcash private balance mfɛnsere no wɔ anammɔn anan: Awoda, UFVK, Device ne Confirmation. Awoda: sɛ wopɛ akontaabu foforo a, fa awoda no sorokɔ sie nnɛ da. Tick "This account received shielded ZEC in the past" nko ara sɛ wunim sɛ ɛyɛɛ saa a, efisɛ scanning fi block 0 betumi agye bere tenten. UFVK ne Mfiri: Ledger Wallet bisa wo Ledger sɛ ɔmfa wo Unified Full Viewing Key (UFVK) nkɔ amannɔne. Kenkan screens a ɛwɔ device no so na pene so. Sɛ wohu sɛ "Device connection ayera" a, hwɛ sɛ Zcash app no abue, pene so ntɛm ara na klik Retry. Sɛ wohu sɛ UFVK a wɔde aba no yiye a, klik Fi ase yɛ sync. Sɛ syncing wie a, button no sesa kɔ Update balance a "Last sync" bere. Safoa a wode hwɛ ade no tra wo kɔmputa no so. Ebetumi ahu wo sika a wɔabɔ ho ban no nanso entumi mfa nni dwuma. 4. Gye ZEC na hwɛ sɛ address abien no nyinaa yɛ nokware wɔ wo Ledger Klik Gye na paw wo Zcash akontaabu. Ledger Wallet kyerɛ Address ma Zcash 1 (a ɛda adi pefee, ɛfiri aseɛ wɔ t1) ne Private address ma Zcash 1 (ɛfiri aseɛ wɔ u1). Address ahorow a edi kan no kɔ so yɛ adwuma. Wo Ledger kyerɛ "Verify Zcash addresses", Private address wɔ nkratafa abien so, afei Public Address. Fa nkyerɛwde biara toto screen no ho ansa na woakyɛ address no mu biara, afei si so dua wɔ afiri no so. Pɛ kokoam address no; fa nea ɛda adi pefee no di dwuma bere a nea ɔde kɔmaa no no mmoa biribi foforo biara nkutoo. 5. Fa ZEC a ɛda adi pefee no kɔ wo private balance mu Klik Send so na hwɛ. Wɔ Self transfer ase no, paw Send to private balance. Hyehyɛ sika bi anaa fa 25%, 50%, 75% anaa Max di dwuma. Hwɛ network fee no, afei klik Review so. Wɔ wo Ledger, fa anammɔn fa: "Hwɛ asɛm no mu na fa ZEC", "Transfer from public to private address", sika dodow, output address wɔ nkratafa abien mu, sika a wɔbɔ ne bere a etwa to no sorokɔ. Hwɛ sɛ output address no ne wo private address no hyia fi anammɔn 4, afei mia button abien no nyi

text: Tukɔ Akwankyerɛ: Efi zcashd kɔ Zebrad/Zallet Amanneɛ kwan so zcashd full node, a Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Zodl na ɛhwɛ so no, wɔde Zebra ne Zallet asi ananmu. zcashd duu ne mmoa awieeɛ gyinabea wɔ 18 Ɔpɛpɔn 2026 na ɛntu mmirika bio. Zebra yɛ nnɛyi Rust dwumadie a ɛfa Zcash protocol a Zcash Foundation na ɛyɛeɛ no ho Zallet yɛ sika kotoku a emu yɛ hare a wɔasi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛne Zebra nodes a Zodl ayɛ no bedi nkitaho a ɛnyɛ den Saa akwankyerɛ yi de wo nantew fa tu a ɛfiri zcashd kɔ Zebrad ne Zallet mu, a nhyehyeɛ, sika kotokuo a wɔde ba, ne ɔhaw a ɛfa atutena a ɛtaa ba ho dwumadie ka ho. --- zcashd gyaee mmirikatuo wɔ 18 Ɔpɛpɔn 2026 Nea eyi kyerɛ zcashd duu ne end-of-support halt wɔ 18 July 2026. Ɛrenhyia nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn tip no bio, na entumi mfa sika nkɔma anaasɛ ennye sika. Eyi yɛ nea wɔawie, ɛnyɛ nea wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe. zcashd nnwuma mmienu no mu apaapae seesei: zebrad yɛ node a ɛyɛ ma, na Zallet yɛ sika kotokuo. Zallet wɔ beta mu. Nsakraeɛ a ɛbubuu betumi aba wɔ nsɛm a wɔayi no adi ntam, na wɔmfa zcashd JSON-RPC akwan bi nni dwuma de besi nnɛ. Hwɛ sɛnea ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ tebea matrix ansa na wode wo ho ato ɔfrɛ pɔtee bi so. Sɛ woda so ara kura Sprout sika a, kenkan kɔkɔbɔ a ɛwɔ anammɔn 6 no kan. Zallet ntumi mmoa Sprout pool no, na ɔkwan a wɔtaa fa so de saa sika no kɔ baabi foforo no hwehwɛɛ sɛ wonya zcashd a ɛretu mmirika. Nea enti a wotu kɔtra baabi foforo - Beyond Deprecation Sɛ yɛgyae animtiaabu mpo a, ntease ahorow a emu yɛ den wɔ hɔ a enti ɛsɛ sɛ wotu kɔtra baabi foforo: Security & Robustness: Rust memory-safety ne nnɛyi nnwinnade brɛ asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ mmerɛwyɛ mu ase. Adwumayɛ & Adwumayɛ: Wɔayɛ Zebrad ama parallelism, nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma yiye, ne sync ntɛmntɛm. Modular Architecture: Sɛ wotetew node logic (Zebrad) mu fi wallet UI (Zallet) ho a, ɛma ahye a emu da hɔ ne akwan a eye a wɔfa so yɛ upgrade. Daakye Abɔdeɛ a Nkwa Wom a Ɛne Nkɔsoɔ: Nnwinnadeɛ, nkɔsoɔ, ne Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom a aka no bɛkɔ so de wɔn ani asi Zebrad/Zallet so. Asomdwoe: Kwati sɛ wobɛkɔ so ayɛ adwuma wɔ ade bi a wɔmfa nni dwuma bio a wɔmmoa no mu. Afei momma yɛnkɔ Migration akwankyerɛ no mu 1.1. Backup Biribiara Backup wo wallet.dat (anaasɛ wallet fael foforo biara / safoa store) fi wo zcashd node. Sie wo zcash.conf ne nhyehyɛe biara a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ. Fa RPC scripts anaa automation biara a wode di dwuma no bi kɔ amannɔne. Hwɛ sɛ wo backups no yɛ adwuma (e.g. wɔ beae foforo, bɔ mmɔden sɛ wubebue anaa wobɛhwɛ). Hwɛ JSON-RPC akwan a wode wo ho to so mprempren no mu. Fa toto nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛne ne ho hyia pon a wɔahwɛ so wɔ so no ho Zcash mmoa wɛbsaet Siesie wo ho ma nsakrae anaa akwan a ɛyera (ebia ebinom behia sɛ wodi ho dwuma anaasɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae). 2.1. System Ahwehwɛde & Disk Space . Disk space ne ahwehwɛde a nkurɔfo bu no adewa. Zcash nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no twaam 270 GB wɔ August 2026 mu, enti ma anyɛ yiye koraa no 300 GB kwan ma baabi a ɛnyɛ hwee, wɔ SSD so sɛ wubetumi a. Hwɛ sɛ wo mfiri no wɔ network, CPU, RAM a ɛyɛ den. Intanɛt nkitahodi bi Sɛ woayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wobɛboaboa ano afi fibea a, ma Rust & Cargo nhyɛ mu. 3.1. Install / Setup Zebrad . Wubetumi atwe binary a wɔadi kan ayɛ anaasɛ wobɛkyekye afi fibea. Zcash Foundation tintim nsɛm a wɔayi no adi ne binaries ma Zebra. S.e., s.e. wobɛtumi de install script adi dwuma anaasɛ wobɛtwe binary a ɛfata ama wo OS. Hyɛ no nsow sɛ wɔ Zebra nkyerɛase ahorow a aba nnansa yi mu no, . RPC awiei no ntumi nyɛ adwuma bio default wɔ Docker mu. Ɔkwan A: Fa binary a wɔadi kan ayɛ so instɔlehyɛn Wɔ Linux/macOS so no: Eyi de zebrad a ɛyɛ pintinn a aba foforo no hyɛ mu. Option B: Si fi fibea Sɛ wosi wie a, fa binary no kɔ wo kwan so: 4.1. Nsiesiei & Fi ase Yɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ: Sesa zebrad.toml sɛnea wopɛ (tie address, ports, state directory, caching). Fi ase node no: Node no befi ase ayɛ syncing fi genesis - hwɛ kwan sɛ nnɔnhwerew pii (anaa nea ɛboro saa) gyina hardware ne network so. 5.1. Fa / Setup Zallet (Wallet) .
