title: Twerɛ Wɛbsaet bi wɔ IPFS so
description: IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) yɛ peer-to-peer protocol ne network a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de fael sie na wɔkyɛ.
text: Twerɛ Wɛbsaet bi wɔ IPFS so IPFS ho nnianim asɛm IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) yɛ peer-to-peer protocol ne network a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de fael sie na wɔkyɛ. Nea ɛnte sɛ intanɛt so atetesɛm client-server model no, IPFS ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kwan ma wɔkyɛ fael ahorow no ne wɔn ho wɔn ho tẽẽ, sen sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto centralized server so de asie na wɔakyekyɛ nneɛma. Wɔde content-addressing na ɛyɛ fael ahorow a ɛwɔ IPFS mu no address, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔma fael biara hash soronko anaa CONTENT IDENTIFIER (CID) a egyina ne nsɛm so, na wɔde saa hash yi di dwuma de gye fael no fi ntwamutam no mu. Sɛ obi de fael bi ka IPFS ho a, wɔkyekyɛ fael no mu nketenkete a wɔfrɛ no blocks, na wɔma block biara CID. Afei wɔde saa blocks yi sie wɔ node ahorow so wɔ network no mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobetumi agye fael no afi mmeae pii. Eyi hwɛ hu sɛ redundancy ne fault-tolerance bere a ɛsan nso ma ɛyɛ den ma node biako biara sɛ ɛbɛyɛ beae biako a edi huammɔ anaasɛ ɛhyɛ so. Kenkan IPFS ho Nnianim Nsɛm Wo Wɛbsaet no a wobɛbɔ Saa nhwɛsoɔ yi nti yɛreyɛ wɛbsaet a ɛnyɛ den. Nhwɛso Site Anamɔn 1: Sɛ wunnim wɛb nhyehyɛe a kyerɛw wo wɛbsaet no mu nsɛm titiriw a Title, Main Body of text ka ho, a links kɔ nkratafa/site & footers afoforo ka ho. Anamɔn 2: Fa HTML nsusuiɛ! Fa nsɛm a woakyerɛw no hyɛ mu sɛnea ɛfata. Optional sɛ wobɛsan nso ayɛ .CSS stylesheet ama wo wɛbsaet no. Step 3: Save your directory. Ɛsɛ sɛ .html nkratafa + mfonini nyinaa wɔ Folda koro mu. Node bi a wɔde besi hɔ Twe na fa IPFS fi Official website. Hyɛ IPFS ase: Sɛ wode Desktop Application no redi dwuma a ɛho renhia sɛ wohyɛ aseɛ. Sɛ wode Terminal anaa ahyɛde a ɛkyerɛw di dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: ipfs ahyɛ aseɛ . Fa Site Folder ka IPFS ho: Paw folda a wo wɛbsaet fael ahorow wom no na kɔ Add Folder option no so. -- Sɛ wode Terminal redi dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: ipfs fa -r "foldadin" ka ho. sɛ wode folda no nyinaa bɛka IPFS ho mpɛn pii. Pin Site a ɛwɔ IPFS so: Sɛ wɔde wo wɛbsaet fael ahorow no ka IPFS ho wie a, ɛsɛ sɛ wo pin de hwɛ sɛ ɛbɛkɔ so ayɛ nea ɛwɔ ntwamutam no so. -- Sɛ wode Terminal redi dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: Sɛ wode Terminal redi dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: ipfs pin fa "hash" ka ho. "hash" = CID a ɛwɔ folda a wode kaa ho wɔ anammɔn a atwam no mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, wo nso wotumi de nnwuma te sɛ Pinata anaasɛ Dolpin Ɛmma bere pii nsɛe! -- Kɔ wo wɛbsaet no so wɔ IPFS so: Seesei wɔatintim wo wɛbsaet no wɔ IPFS so na wobɛtumi de hash a ɛwɔ folda no mu akɔ so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokɔ wo wɛbsaet no so a, wubetumi akɔ hɔ https://ipfs.io/ipfs/"hash" "hash" = CID a ɛwɔ folda no mu. Wɔ yɛn fam no CID = "QmW2UEfap1vrRRvS5H9aware8qmsx4WsvXBk3GPGVVfWx3r3". IPNS Interplanetary Naming System (IPNS) ma wo kwan ma wo update IPFS CID's a ɛbata wo wɛbsaet no ho na ɛda so ara som static link. Wɔde ama sɛ safe. Wɔ nhyehyeɛ menu ma wo sait foldre wɔ IPFS desktop application paw Publish to IPNS. Safoa: "k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyhoa2cl0qlwpfxn5p9ypcu8jbzgnj4n". Wobetumi nso de ahwɛ yɛn wɛbsaet no denam apon bi so: https://ipfs.io/ipns/k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyhoa2cl0qlwpfxn5p9ypcu8jbzgnj4n DNS Nkitahodi Wɔayɛ sait no, seesei yehia ɔkwan a yɛbɛfa so akyerɛ URL bi akɔ emu nsɛm no so. Sɛ wowɔ wɛb address dedaw a wobɛtumi de kyerɛwtohɔ foforo aka ho denam TXT kyerɛwtohɔ "dnslink(wo domain)" no so. Ɛgyina provider so no ebia auto populate. Ɛbɛgye bere ansa na woatumi atrɛw denam network no so ansa na woatumi ahwɛ. Yɛma wo akwaaba! Woahyehyɛ wɛbsaet a ɛko tia censorship. description: Zcash on-chain funding model, block-reward mechanics, ne dwumadie a ahyehyɛdeɛ akɛseɛ no di
text: Zcash Sikasɛm & Aban Ho Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ Zcash on-chain funding model, block-reward mechanics, ne dwumadie a ahyehyɛdeɛ akɛseɛ no di Sɛnea Zcash Block Akatua Yɛ Adwuma Zcash yɛ Adanse-a-Adwuma cryptocurrency. Block biara a wɔatu no kyekyɛ ne block subsidy (ZEC a wɔayɛ no foforo) ne ayɔnkofa ho ka sɛnea protocol mmara a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a network upgrades de asi hɔ no kyerɛ. Mprempren nhwɛsoɔ (NU6 akyi / November 2024 rekɔ) Ɛde besi April 2026 no, ne kyekyɛ ne: Nea ogye no Ɔha biara mu nkyem 100 Nea ɛde sika ma / gyinabea -------------------------------- ------------ ------------------------------------------------------------- Wɔn a wotu fagude 80% na ɛwɔ hɔ Direct block akatua ma wɔn a wotu fagude Zcash Mpɔtam Hɔ Mmoa (ZCG) 8% na ɛyɛ Mpɔtam hɔ mmoa (ɛkɔ so kɔsi 2028) Lockbox (a wɔde protocol di so) 12% na ɛwɔ hɔ Sika boaboa ano; sika a wɔsɛe no ho nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ de besi nnɛ; daakye mpɔtam hɔfo abatow a wɔhwehwɛ Pre-NU6 abakɔsɛm dev sikakorabea (2020-Nov 2024) Block subsidy biara mu 20% kɔɔ nkɔsoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ hɔ tẽẽ: 7% -> Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Bootstrap Project 5% -> Zcash Foundation (ZF) 8% -> Zcash Mpɔtam Hɔ Mmoa a Wɔde Ma (ZCG) . Saa 20% "dev fund" yi na wɔde 8% ZCG + 12% lockbox model via sii ananmu ZIP 1015 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Nkɔsoɔ a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa: ZIP 1016 - Mpɔtam ne Sikakorabea Sikakorabea Nhwɛsoɔ ZIP 1016 (wɔahyɛ ho nyansa sɛ February 2025, gyinabea: Wɔahyɛ ho nyansa) de sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛma wɔ amansin mu kɛse ba. Ná ɛbɛyɛ sɛ: Toa 8% a wɔde ma ZCG no so. Dane 12% lockbox no kɔ "Coinholder-Controlled Fund" (wɔde lockbox sika a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw + 12% block subsidy a ɛkɔ so no na ɛyɛ seeded). Fa saa nhwɛso yi yɛ adwuma kosi sɛ ɛbɛbɔ fã a ɛto so abiɛsa (bɛyɛ mfe 3). Ma wɔn a wɔwɔ ZEC sika no tumi ma wɔtow aba wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma no ho asram abiɛsa biara denam nhyehyɛe a mpɔtam hɔfo akyerɛkyerɛ mu so (dodow no ara a ɛnyɛ den, dodow a ɛba fam koraa a ɛyɛ ZEC 420,000). Hwehwɛ sɛ Key-Holder Organizations (mprempren ZF ne Shielded Labs ka ho, a Bootstrap/ECC a wɔatwe adwene asi so wɔ grant contexts mu) sɛ wɔnam multisig so di sika a wɔde ma no so, a mmara kwan so apam ne coin-holder gyinaesi ahorow akyekyere wɔn. Hwɛ ZIP 1015 ahwehwɛdeɛ nyinaa so wɔ lockbox dwumadie ho (sika a wɔde ma ecosystem grants). Saa nsusuiɛ yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛdane afiri ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛhwɛ so so akɔ sika-kurafoɔ nnisoɔ a ɛkɔ tẽẽ so ama 12% nkyekyɛmu no. Ɛnsakra ZIP nhyehyɛe anaa aguadi agyiraehyɛde ho mmara. Ahyehyɛde Titiriw & Wɔn Sika Fibea Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Bootstrap Project Mfitiaseɛ abɔfoɔ a wɔyɛɛ Zcash (2016). Abakɔsɛm mu no, onyaa 7% wɔ dev sikakorabea no mu kosii November 2024. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2026 mu no, core engineering ne product team no gyaee adwuma wɔ Bootstrap/ECC esiane nniso ho ntawntawdi nti na wɔhyehyɛɛ Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL). ECC/Bootstrap nnya protocol sika tẽẽ bio na wɔmfa nkɔso kuw titiriw no nyɛ adwuma bio. Ɛde ne ho to ntoboa, sika a wɔde boa, ne n’ankasa sikakorabea so. Ɛkura abakɔsɛm mu nteaseɛ nanso ɛnyɛ protocol nkɔsoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ nnam bio. -> Hwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa ho nyinaa: Electric Coin Company Zcash Nkɔsoɔ a Wɔabue (ZODL) Wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2026 mu denam mfitiaseɛ Zcash protocol developers (core ECC engineering ne product team) akyi a wɔfiri Bootstrap/ECC. Ɔboaboaa bɛboro dɔla ɔpepem 25 ano wɔ aba sika mu firii sikakorafoɔ akɛseɛ a a16z Crypto ne Coinbase Ventures ka ho. Kuw no, a wɔn a wɔyɛɛ mfitiaseɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛɛ Zcash protocol no, kɔ so yɛ core protocol nkɔsoɔ, ZIP ntoboa, ne nnwinnadeɛ a ɛtwe adwene si kokoamsɛm so a Zodl mobile wallet (a wɔasan ahyɛ no foforɔ afiri Zashi) ka ho. text: ZODL (Zcash Open Development Lab) Wɛbsaet no - GitHub - X/Twitter - Discord Asɛmpatrɛw Asɛm ZODL yɛ wiase a wɔrenhwɛ sikasɛm so kɛse, baabi a nnipa a wodi mmara so betumi adi nkitaho wɔ ahofadi mu ne kokoam ho mfonini wɔ n’adwenem. Ahyehyɛde no gye di sɛ tumidi biara nni hɔ a kokoam nsɛm nni hɔ, na ɛsɛ sɛ sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm yɛ nea wɔde di dwuma na gua so kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ yɛ hokwan a nnipa wɔ. Akyigyina & Abakɔsɛm ZODL (Zcash Open Development Lab) no, Josh Swihart, a na ɔyɛ Electric Coin Company (ECC). Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2026 mu no, ECC mfiridwuma ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ no nyinaa gyaee adwuma wɔ nnisoɔ ho akasakasa bi a wɔne Bootstrap, 501(c)(3) adwumayɛkuo a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfasoɔ wɔ so a ɛhwɛ ECC. Kuw titiriw a mfiase no na wɔayɛ Zcash's nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛho hia sen biara no, wɔde adi dwuma, na wɔahwɛ so no dan kɔɔ ZODL so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtoa wɔn adwuma so wɔ wɔn ankasa mu. Wɔsesaa Zashi sika kotokuo a kan no na wɔyɛɛ na wɔhwɛɛ so wɔ ECC, ase no yɛɛ no ZODL wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ no ase. Na ɛho nhia sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ biribiara, efisɛ app no san de ne din too so ankasa bere a wɔde update a edi hɔ no bae no. Sika a wɔde ma Wɔ Oforisuo 2026 mu no, ZODL nyaa bɛboro dɔla ɔpepem 25 wɔ aba ho sika mu firii sikakorafoɔ akuo bi a wɔagye din hɔ, a nea ɛka ho ne: Paradigm a16z crypto Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so Winklevoss Capital Coinbase Ventures Cypherpunk Technologies ($5M sika a wɔde asie) Chapter One David Friedberg Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so Balaji Srinivasan Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so Abɔfo foforo a wɔde wɔn sika hyɛ mu a wofi crypto ne mfiridwuma mu Wɔde ahenkuro no redi dwuma de atrɛw Zcash protocol ne ZODL sika kotoku no nyinaa nkɔso mu. Akannifoɔ Josh Swihart - CEO & Founder (kan CEO a ɔyɛ Electric Coin Company) Kuw a ɛtrɛw no yɛ mfitiase Zcash protocol abɔfo ne wɔn a wɔyɛe a kan no na wɔkyekyee na wɔhwɛɛ Zcash so wɔ ECC. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nimdeɛ a emu dɔ wɔ cryptography mu, adanse a wonni nimdeɛ biara, ne protocol engineering. Nneɛma a wɔyɛ ZODL Sikakorabea (kan no na wɔfrɛ no Zashi) ZODL yɛ mobile sika kotoku a wɔde wɔn ankasa hwɛ a wɔayɛ ama kokoam Zcash nkitahodi. Ɛka nimdeɛ a emu dɔ a ɛwɔ protocol-level ne design a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma bom, de nsɛm a ɛyɛ den sie bere a ɛkura ahobammɔ mu. title: Electric Coin Company (Sunset)

text: Electric Coin Company (Sunset) Wɛbsaet no - GitHub a wɔde di dwuma - X/Twitter na ɛwɔ hɔ Ɛfa saa GitHub link no ho. ECC adekorabea ahorow no wɔ zodl-inc. Ɛno ne ahyehyɛde koro no ara, a wɔsesaa ne din bere a kuw no tu kɔɔ hɔ no ZODL. Dedaw no github.com/Electric-Coin-Company din no, obi a ɔne no nni abusuabɔ na ɔkyerɛw too hɔ wɔ May 2026 mu na ɛne ECC anaa ZODL nni hwee yɛ, enti nnye mmara a wɔatintim wɔ hɔ no nni. Asɛmpatrɛw Asɛm Adwuma a ɛwɔ ECC ne sɛ wɔbɛma sikasɛm mu ahofadi anya tumi. Sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm yɛ ade titiriw wɔ saa mmɔdenbɔ yi mu, na ɛho hia na wɔabɔ nnipa nidi, ahobammɔ, wɔn ankasa tumidi, ne pene a wɔpene so ho ban. Ɛsɛ sɛ sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm a wubenya no yɛ mmerɛw te sɛ wo fie ntama a wobɛto mu no. Nanso bere a Web2 aba no, tumi no akɔ mfinimfini kɛse, na wɔn a wɔwɔ tumi no wɔ wo dan mu dedaw. Worentumi ntoto ntama no mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkyekye biribi foforo. Saa sikasɛm mu nnwinnadeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ yi, a obiara bɛtumi anya no, bɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma, ɛyɛ kokoam de koraa a ɛwɔ akwan a wɔbɛfa so ada no adi, na wɔbɛkyekyɛ ne nnwuma a ɛboa no na ayɛ den. Zodl, a kan no na wɔfrɛ no Zashi: iOS - Android - F-Droid a wɔde yɛ adwuma Wɔasi ama Ankorankoro Katua. Zashi yɛ ZEC sika kotokuo a wɔde wɔn ho abɔ ho ban a wɔde yɛ digyital nkitahodiɛ a wɔabɔ no kokoam, ECC na ɛsiiɛ na wɔyii no adi wɔ afe 2024 mu. Wɔyɛɛ no ​​sɛ ɛbɛhyɛn nnamfo ne abusuafo akɔ Zcash ne kokoam dijitaal sikatua mu, a ɛwɔ interface a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a ɛbɛma nnipa a wonni kan crypto osuahu biara atumi asiesie sika kotoku, anya ZEC, na wɔafi ase adi nkitaho wɔ simma kakraa bi mu. Wɔsesaa sika kotoku no din Zodl wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2026 mu bere a kuw no tu kɔɔ ZODL akyi. Na ɛho nhia sɛ wɔn a wɔde di dwuma dedaw no yɛ biribiara, sɛnea app no ​​rebranded wɔ ne update a edi hɔ no so, ɛno nti na store links a ɛwɔ soro no bue Zodl no. Mprempren wɔhwɛ so wɔ hɔ sen sɛ ECC bɛhwɛ so, enti hwɛ... ZODL krataafa no sɛ wopɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren. Nkabom ahorow a wɔkyekyee wɔ ECC mfe no mu: Coinbase a wɔde yɛ adwuma: crypto newbies betumi atɔ ZEC tẽẽ wɔ sika kotoku no mu skipping hassles of account registration, KYC, ne sika a woyi fi exchanges. Flexa: 1 . ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wode ZEC bedi dwuma ankasa, na ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma foforo no tumi sɛe wɔ mmeae mpempem pii a wɔtɔn nneɛma te sɛ Barnes & Noble, GameStop, ne Chipotle. Keystone: nkɔso kɛse ma Zcash mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde mfe pii reyɛ. Saa nkabom yi hyɛ nkɔsoɔ kɛseɛ agyiraeɛ wɔ Zcash dwumadie mu denam ZEC a wɔabɔ ho ban no a ɛma wɔtumi de sie awɔw mu no so. Nhwehwɛmu ne Nkɔso Kuw no adi nkɔso ahorow a wogye tom anim mpɛn pii, na nea edi kan ne... Zcash a wɔde sii hɔ sɛ wiase no mu nea edi kan a wɔde Zero-Knowledge Proofs dii dwuma wɔ aguadi mu. Nnipa pii a wodi akyi te sɛ nea Sapling ntwamutam a wɔayɛ no foforo a ɛma kwan ma wɔyɛ nkitahodi a emu yɛ hare, a wɔabɔ ho ban a bere a wɔtew so 90% ma nkitahodi a wɔkyekye, ne nkae a wɔtew so bɛboro 97%, a ɛma wotumi yɛ nkitahodi a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ mobile device so nea edi kan. Nkɔso a ɛho hia sen biara ne nea ɛbae nnansa yi ara. Adebɔ ne nea wɔde di dwuma no ho halo2 ahotoso a enni adanse nhyehyɛe wɔ Network Upgrade 5 ma Zcash. Eyi yii nhyehyɛe a wogye di no fii hɔ na ɛde bere foforo sii hɔ maa Zcash. Nkɔmmɔbɔ no bi ne sɛ wɔne Gemini bɛyɛ adwuma de atumi ayɛ shielded transactions wɔ wɔn platform so, Flexa ama Zcash mobile payments a ɛnyɛ den wɔ retal mmeae, hardware wallet nnwumakuw te sɛ Keystone a ɛbɛma shielded cold storage of ZEC, Brave for Zcash support wɔ browser no mu, & akuw afoforo a wɔwɔ Zcash ecosystem no mu de nkɔso aba Zcash. title: Zcash Foundation
description: Yɛn botaeɛ wɔ ZF ne sɛ yɛbɛbɔ nnwinnadeɛ a ɛboa ma nkitahodiɛ a ɛbue kɔ so, na ama obiara ne obiara atumi abɔ n’ankasa kokoamsɛm ho ban wɔ n’ankasa nsɛm so…
text: Zcash Foundation Asɛmpatrɛw Asɛm Yɛn botaeɛ wɔ ZF ne sɛ yɛbɛbɔ nnwinnadeɛ a ɛboa ma nkitahodiɛ a ɛbue kɔ so, na ama obiara ne obiara atumi abɔ n’ankasa kokoamsɛm ho ban wɔ n’ankasa nsɛm so. Adeɛ titire a ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm mu ankasa ne sɛ wobɛtumi apaw deɛ ɛyɛ anaasɛ wɔmfa nkyɛ afoforo. Kokoamsɛm yɛ ahofadi ne pene a wɔpene so nyinaa; ɛho hia ma nnipa nidi ne ɔmanfo a wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ adwuma yiye. Nnipa ne Akuw ahorow Zcash Foundation no wɔ 12 adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔkyekyɛ wɔn mu wɔ wiase nyinaa. Wɔde wɔn adwene si protocol nkɔsoɔ, protocol ahobanbɔ, protocol nnisoɔ, infrastructure nkɔsoɔ ne Zcash mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu a wɔhwɛ so. Zcash Foundation no nnyɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash nkutoo so na enti ɛsan nso de ne ho hyɛ mfiridwuma a ɛkora kokoam nsɛm so ma nnipa mmoa na ama ɔmanfo nyinaa yiyedi. Zcash Foundation Grants ma abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ no nya ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so atua nnwuma a ɛboa kokoam nneɛma a nkwa wom te sɛ Zebra (node ​​dwumadie a ɛde ne ho ma Zcash) & FROST saa ara nso na ahorow ahorow nnwuma afoforo a ɛnam Zcash Community Grants Committee so. Fapem no nso kura Zcon, afe afe nhyiamu a wɔyɛ no ankasa a ɛtwe adwene si Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom so na ɛboa nnipa a wɔte aseɛ, mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma te sɛ Zcon Vozes, ɔmantam pɔtee bi nhyiam ahorow, the Zcash Foundation A/V Club, mprempren Zero Knowledge Audio Visual Klub ne mpɔtam [frɛ] afoforo ahorow a wɔabue ano](https://zfnd.org/arborist-calls/), mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a esisi ne AMA deɛ. Zcash Foundation no de Zcash Aguadi Agyiraehyɛde nhyehyɛe no di dwuma per the updated conditions of it's donation by the Electric Coin Co. which helps "Bɔ Zcash, ne nnwumakuo a ɛka ho, ne Zcash mpɔtam hɔfoɔ din ho ban" denam "kyerɛ(ing) aban amanneɛbɔ fibea, tew hokwan a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ nnaadaa anaa nsɛm a ɛnteɛ so" ne "Identify(ing) official apps and services, reducing the likelihood of fraudulent activities. Ahyehyɛde Nhyehyɛe The Zcash Foundation is a 501(c)(3) tow a wontua, a wonnya mfaso adɔe adwuma. Wɔ wɔn Team, wɔwɔ Board of Akwankyerɛfo na ama mpɔtam nnisoɔ abatoɔ ayɛ mmerɛ denam Zcash Community Advisory Panel. Sika a wɔde ma Zcash Foundation no nnya sika mfi Zcash nkɔso sikakorabea as of November, 2024. Mprempren wɔde sika a wɔde bɛma The Foundation no nam atetesɛm, towtua a wotumi tew so ntoboa. Yebetumi ahu sɛnea wɔde sikasɛm di dwuma wɔ wɔn asram abiɛsa biara Transparency Reports. text: Sikasɛm mu Nsɛm a Wɔde Siesie Nsɛm Ho Fapem (FPF) Ɛfa FPF ho Sikasɛm mu Kokoamsɛm Fapem (FPF) yɛ ahyehyɛde a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde ahyɛ Cayman Nsupɔw so. FPFs botaeɛ titire ne sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ na wɔama ankorankoro ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ tumi ma wɔadi wɔn sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm ne ahobanbɔ so. FPF nso asi ne bo sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛfata na ɛyɛ pɛ a ɛkyerɛ obu ma ankorankoro kokoam nsɛm ho nkuran. FPFs dwumadie titire a ɛfa sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm ho ne sɛ ɛbɛma ankorankoro ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ nsɛm, nneɛma ne mmoa a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm ho ban na wɔayɛ no yie. title: Shielded Labs
description: Shielded Labs yɛ Zcash mmoa ahyehyɛde a ɛde ne ho, a wɔde ntoboa na ɛyɛ adwuma a ɛwɔ Switzerland. N’adwuma ne sɛ ɛbɛkyekye ankorankoro sika a wontumi nsiw ano…
text: Shielded Labs Shielded Labs yɛ Zcash mmoa ahyehyɛde a ɛde ne ho, a wɔde ntoboa na ɛyɛ adwuma a ɛwɔ Switzerland. N’adwuma ne sɛ ɛbɛkyekye ankorankoro sika a wontumi nsiw ano a ɛma nnipa ahofadi ne wɔn ankasa tumidi tumi, a wɔde wɔn adwene besi adwuma a ɛma Zcash ntam nkitahodi no a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ, ahobammɔ, ne nea ɛtumi sesa so. Shielded Labs de mfiridwuma tumi a ɛde ne ho ka Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ no ho. Ɛnyɛ Electric Coin Company, Zcash Foundation, anaa Zcash Community Grants, na ɛka ne ho asɛm sɛ Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛdi kan a ɛnnyaa sika tẽẽ anaa ɛnnya sika mfii Development Fund anaasɛ block akatua. Asɛmpatrɛw ne Dwuma Shielded Labs de n’adwene si protocol ne infrastructure adwuma a ebetumi ama Zcash atumi agyina ano kɛse wɔ bere tenten mu so. Ne baguam nneɛma si so dua sɛ: Nnipa ahofadi ne sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm Sika a wɔde ma a ɛde ne ho a ɛwɔ Nkɔso Foto no akyi Obu a wɔde ma ZEC kurafo ne coinholder input Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ahofadi ne wɔn ankasa tumidi Mfiridwuma mu nnoɔma foforɔ a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa, ahobanbɔ, ne scalability Adwuma a wɔne Zcash mmoa afoforo yɛ Ahyehyɛde no nam mfiridwuma tẽẽ, ɔmanfo nhwehwɛmu, nnwuma a wɔde boa, ne abɔde a nkwa wom a wɔyɛ no biako so na ɛboa. Ɛsan nso hwɛ ɔmanfoɔ ahodeɛ so ma nnisoɔ abatoɔ ne sika a wɔde sika a wɔde di dwuma no kyerɛ kwan, na ɛboa Zcash mpɔtam hɔfoɔ ma wɔte berɛ ne sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nnisoɔ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mu ase. Mprempren Nnwuma a Wɔyɛ Shielded Labs bobɔ adwuma no mmeae pii a ɛyɛ nnam din wɔ baguam: Network Sustainability Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma - nsakraeɛ a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa sɛ wɔbɛboa Zcash's ahobanbɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛkyɛ berɛ a wɔkora ZEC nneɛma a wɔde ma ɔpepem 21 no so. NSM adwuma no bi ne ZEC hyew a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ, sika a wɔde ma no smoothing, ne sika a wɔbɛhyew ho nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ ZIP 233, 234, ne 235 mu. Crosslink - Hybrid consensus upgrade a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa a ɛbɛka Zcash's proof-of-work block production ne proof-of-stake finality abom, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ZEC wuranom bɛtumi aboa ama wɔabɔ network no ho ban berɛ a miners kɔ so yɛ blocks. Dynamic Fees a Wɔbɔ - nhwehwɛmu ne nnwinnade a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ahyɛ nkɔm, ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma, na ɛyɛ den sɛ wobetua Zcash asɛmdi ho ka bere a ntwamutam no renya nkɔso no. Ohunu - a woboa suite a open-source Zcash infrastructure software ma exchanges, mining pools, wallet providers, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ a wɔde wɔn ho to Zcash infrastructure so. Ironwood - Zcash network upgrade ne shielded pool a wɔayɛ de abua Orchard atoro a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛsan de ahofadi a wobetumi agye atom wɔ Zcash's circulating supply no mu. Epoch - Nhwehwɛmu ne mfiridwuma adwuma bi a wɔde too gua wɔ October 2026 mu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ production-ready, high-assurance post-quantum cryptography ama Zcash na wɔatrɛw formal verification a ɛfa cryptographic components a ɛho hia ho. Dwumadie no de n’ani asi so sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma a ɛyɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛyɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2027 awieeɛ a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ nnyinasoɔ ama daakye ntwamutam nkɔsoɔ. Ɛboa Project Tachyon ne mmɔdenbɔ afoforo a wɔbɔ wɔ quantum akyi wɔ abɔde a nkwa wom no nyinaa mu. Epoch ne cryptography kuw no Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2026 mu no Shielded Labs hyɛɛ Epoch, mmɔdenbɔ a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛdi Zcash daakye adanseɛ atia quantum kɔmputa, ntua a AI boa, ne ahunahuna foforɔ a ɛkɔ anim. Adwuma no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛsesa quantum-vulnerable cryptographic components na wɔde formal verification adi dwuma wɔ protocol no afã horow a ɛho hia no mu. Epoch, nnipa baasa a wɔyɛ cryptography kuw bi na wodi anim: Ulrich Haböck – Cryptographer panyin (kan no na ɔwɔ StarkWare; kan no na ɔwɔ Polygon Zero). Ɔbenfo wɔ nimdeɛ a enni adanse ne post-quantum cryptography mu; ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔkyerɛw logUp lookup argument no na ɔne no kyerɛw Circle STARKs krataa no. title: Valar Kuw no
description: Valar Group yɛ nwumakuo a wɔn ho nni mu na wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw Zcash, ahyɛ sikasesafoɔ nniso den, ne sɛ ɛbɛboa ma ahintasɛm no ayɛ adwuma yie.
text: Valar Kuw no Kɔ wɛbsaet hɔ Adwuma ho nkrataa Valar Group yɛ nwumakuo a wɔn ho nni mu na wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw Zcash, ahyɛ sikasesafoɔ nniso den, ne sɛ ɛbɛboa ma ahintasɛm no ayɛ adwuma yie. Ne adwuma no fa protocol-level mfitiase: private token holder voting, high performance full node software, wallet sync technology ne network upgrades a ɛma shielded Zcash tumi di dwuma wɔ kɛse mu. Ahyehyɛde no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma ZEC difo kwan a wɔbɛfa so akyerɛ wɔn apɛdeɛ wɔ kokoam, de dwumadie ahodoɔ ama node operatorfoɔ ntɛmntɛm na wɔanya tumi pii, na wɔde mfiri ma wallets a ɛhwɛ dwumafoɔ ahobanbɔ ho bere koro mu ka bɔ bi to hɔ. Atirimpɔw ahorow no bi Valar Group na Dev Ojha (ValarDragon) di so, ɔno nso yɛ Osmosis fo a ɔsan de ne ho bɔɔ Cosmos kuo no mu baako. Wɔ mfe du atwam yi wayɛ adwuma wɔ zk-SNARKs, BFT consensus, ɛne DeFi nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow nyinaa ase. The group’s public work in Zcash became prominent as the ecosystem shifted toward independent protocol teams after the 2026 reorganization of core development. Valar Group emerged as one of the organizations building the next generation of Zcash infrastructure alongside Project Tachyon, Shielded Labs, ZODL, and the Zcash Foundation. A recurring theme in its work is that Zcash’s privacy properties should extend beyond payments. If holders are asked to vote on issuance, block times, or network-upgrade scope, they should be able to do so from shielded balances without revealing identities, balances, or individual votes. That requirement led Valar Group to design and ship a dedicated coinholder voting chain. Saa ara nso na ne nsunsuansoɔ no yɛ adwuma wɔ node, sync dwumadie mu. N'adane a ɛyɛ den, wallet sintɔn kakra, ɛne nokorɛ sɛ obi bɛtumi ayɛ biribi de adi dwuma ma sika ankasa bi a wobetumi afa so atwitwa ho aka nea wɔde di dwuma wɔ network-scale mmom sen sɛ ɛsom bo korabea nkoara. Anisoadehu Valar kuo no dawurubɔ nkrataa ne dwumadie a wɔyɛ kyerɛ sɛ wɔn ani da Zcash ho kwan a: Ɔboa ma wɔn a wɔdi sika no ho dwuma na wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu tumi di abatoɔ sɛ aban nhyehyɛe mu adeyɛ. Scale proof-of-work akatua a wontua so ka, bere a womfa w'ankasa ahofadi mmɔ afɔre. Twe kͻkͻbͻ a wͻde sie no mu na twe hͻn ho firi PIR, pruning ne block propagation. Yԑde nhyehyԑe ahorow a' ԑfa akwankyerԑ ho bԑto dwa denam ahwehwԑde soronko bi so. Sɛ yɛboa ma wɔsiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛdi quantum akyi na wɔayɛ protocol upgrades a wɔahwɛ so ayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nhyehyɛe no yɛ adwuma sɛ nea ɔde ne ho to so, ɛnyɛ sɛ protocol wura. Protocol nsakrae da so ara nam ZIPs, implementation, review, and community signaling so kɔ. Valar Group dwuma ne sε wɔbεyε nhyehyεεde a εma saa mmrכ yi yε yie na wͻn de di dwuma ma wɔn nyinaa adi dwuma yiye. Nsase a ɛho hia pa ara no bi ne: Valar kuo no yɛ adwuma fa nneɛma anan ho. Private Coinholder Governance (Nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma) Zcash mfa automatic on-chain protocol control nni dwuma. Coinholder polls yɛ advisory signals a ɛma broader rough consensus process nya ahoɔden. Valar Group na ɛbɔɔ Tokenholder Voting Chain no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtumi ato saa nsɛnkyerɛne yi afiri akontabuo ho bere a wɔnnyi voter identity anaa ankorankoro vote size adi nkyerɛ obiara. Mprenpren adwinsa no de: Ahyεde a wɔde ama Cosmos SDK de asi nnidi ho dwuma. Mfonini a wɔde di dwuma no yɛ adanse wɔ Ironwood sika nkrataa ho. Homomorphic nkrataa a wɔhyehyɛ no mu. Private Information Retrieval ma aberɛ a wonnyi w'atwerԑde adi. Ɔfese a wɔhwɛ ma wɔn nsa ka nsɛm pii ne ɔmansin so tumi. Botae no ne sɛ wɔde nhyehyɛe a wotumi de di dwuma bio, wɔhwɛ so yɛ adwuma na wobetumi ayɛ bi ama ahyehyɛde afoforo ma wɔn ankasa atumi adi ho dwuma. Node Software ne Network Scaling (Node) dwumadie a wɔhwɛ so no. Valar Group ne Project Tachyon yɛ adwuma wɔ Zakura, a ɛyɛ Zcash node ma no nyinaa na w'atwe afiri Zebra codebase so. zcashd Users. text: Zcash Labs --- Zcash Labs is an independent organization focused on the practical implementation, integration, and adoption of Zcash and its digital asset, ZEC. Zcash Labs helps businesses, institutions, developers, and independent projects that want to use Zcash technology in products, services, payment systems, or applications that can be used in real-world scenarios. Zcash Labs gyinabea ne sɛ, wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ma sika no. Wɔ saa kwan yi so no, eyi kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛboa ama wɔde Zcash nimdeɛ afi mfidie mu tumi aba dwumadi ahodoɔ bi mu na nnwuma ne nnipa atumi de adi dwuma. Sɛ wobetumi ayɛ wei nti, Zcash Lab fa afotuo, mmuaeɛ ho nwomasua, adansiɛ dwumadie, nnwumakuo nhyehyɛeɛ, nneɛma nketenkete di dwuma, sikasɛm mu mmoa, ɛne aguadi ka bom yɛ adwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ. Zcash Labs ka sɛ ahyehyɛde no yɛ nea ne ho nni na ɛnni afidie biara wɔ Zcash Foundation. Saa gyinabea a ɛho nni nsɛ yi ma kwan ma Zcash Laboratories ankasa si gyinae fa nnwuma, nkabom, ɛne abɛɛfo mfitiaseɛ a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔboa de sika a ɛwɔ n'ahyehyɛdeɛ mu di dwuma no so. --- Atirimpɔw ahorow no bi Zcash Labs de ne ho hyɛɛ ɔmanfo no nsa wɔ n'ɔmanfoɔ wɛbsaet hɔ August 6, 2026. Wɔ August 12, 2026 mu, Zcash Laboratories yii wɔn nnwuma adi kyerɛɛ amanfoɔ a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Ɛnam saa kwan yi so na wɔde too dwa sɛ "Announcing Zcash labs A Zcash Go To Market Company". Although the public announcement was made in August 2026, Zcash Labs states that its activities had been underway before that announcement. Zcash Labs had been working with projects that use Zcash and assisting in the development process before the Zcash Labs identity was widely introduced. One early example that was later announced to the public is its involvement in the development of zcashtocash. The emergence of Zcash Labs is related to the need to narrow the gap between available Zcash technology and the ability of businesses or developers to use it. A company may have needs that align with Zcash but not yet know the required technology, how to integrate, or the infrastructure to use. At the same time, a new project may have a promising concept but require technical assistance, product management, seed capital, or support to reach the production stage. Zcash Labs works in that space by providing support that connects business and developer needs with Zcash technology. Zcash Labs' kwan no fi ase wɔ ɔhaw anaa ahwehwɛde a ɛwɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ bi mu ho nteaseɛ so. Sɛ saa ahiadeɛ yi yɛ yie wie pɛ, na sɛ ɛmu da hɔ a, ɔboa ma wohu ɔkwan pɔtee a wɔbɛfa so de ayɛ nhyehyeɛ no. Saa gyinabea yi betumi aka nsunsuansoɔ ahodoɔ a ɛda hɔ ama Zcash, ne ɛho mpuntuo, ɛne abɛɛfo mfidie ahobanbɔfoɔ (infrastructure requirements) nhyehyɛeɛ ahorow a ɛbɛtumi aboa wɔn bere a wontumi nyɛ deɛ wɔpɛ biara. With this approach, Zcash Labs can be involved from initial discussions about a use case to a system actually running. This forms the basis of Zcash Labs' position as an independent organization in the Zcash ecosystem that goes to market, because its work does not stop at planning or technical development, but also includes the process of bringing solutions to real-world use. --- Zcash Labs botae titiriw ne sɛ ɛbɛboa ma wɔayi sika a wɔde yɛ adwuma no adi. Zcash Labs botae titiriw ne sɛ wɔbɛ ma nnipa bebree agye Zcash denam mmoa a wɔn a wɔ yɛ adwuma no bɛtumi de adi dwuma ntɛm so. Saa atirimpɔ yi nam akwan atitire pii so na ɛrekɔ mu: ɔboa nnwuma ɛne nhyiamu ahorow ama wɔahu sε Zcash fata wɔn ahiade, boa fekuo fahodie dwumadie ho, ɛde mfitiaseɛ boaboa ba, na wɔde ntoboa ma dwumadi ahodoɔ a wobetumi atrɛw Zcash gye tom. Zcash Labs botae ne sɛ ɛrenyɛ adwuma bebree na mmom ɛbɛboa wɔn a wonni nimdeɛ pii wɔ mfiridwuma ho no. Eyi nti, wɔde nhyehyɛe pa bi di dwuma de boa ma obiara nya nsunsuansoɔ; nea edi kan yɛ nhyehyeɛ, deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu nso ɛyɛ mfidie mu dwumadi ahodoɔ, ɛne sika mmoa nyinaa kɔ akyiri. --- Zcash Labs' adwumayɛbea no afã atitiriw Sɛnea ne no kyerɛ.wɛbsaet a ɛwɔ hɔ ankasaZcash Labs de akwan atitire anan a ɛboa ma wɔde Zcash di dwuma no to gua. title: Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Ntoboa a Wɔde Ma
description: Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Grants Program no de sika ma adwuma a wɔawie a ɛde boɔ a wɔtumi di ho adanseɛ ama Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ no.
text: Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Ntoboa a Wɔde Ma Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Grants Program no de sika ma adwuma a wɔawie a ɛde boɔ a wɔtumi di ho adanseɛ ama Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nhyehyɛeɛ no. Ɛgye firi Coinholder-Controlled Fund (12% wɔ block akatua + Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox aba), a ZIP 1016 de sii hɔ na wɔde yɛɛ adwuma wɔ NU6.1 (November 2025). Dwumadie no kɔ so bosome mmiɛnsa biara kɔsi 3rd halving (2028). Sika no, Key-Holder Organizations (e.g., Shielded Labs, FPF) na ɛkora so wɔ multisig mu. --- Ntoboa yɛ retroactive only - ɛma ntoboa a atwam (e.g., nkɔsoɔ, nkabom, mpɔtam dansi). Ɛsɛ sɛ adwuma a wɔhwɛ kwan no fa Zcash Community Grants (ZCG, akatua 8%) ho. --- Akwankyerɛ a Ɛfata Baabi a ani si: Adwuma a wɔawie, a ɔmanfoɔ tumi di ho adanseɛ a ɛboa Zcash (kokoamsɛm, gye a wɔfa, nnwinnadeɛ, ahobanbɔ). Criteria (sika a wɔwɔ sika no susuw ho): Ɔdaa nkɛntɛnso adi na ɔde bo a ɛsom mae. Alignment ne Zcash gyinapɛn ahorow (kokoamsɛm, decentralization). Adanse a ɛda adi pefee (kode, amanneɛbɔ, metrics). Anohyeto biara nni hɔ: Obiara (ankorankoro, akuw, ahyehyɛde ahorow) betumi abisa anaasɛ wɔbɛpaw no. Nsusuwii ahorow a wɔde si akan: Wɔtow aba wɔ ɔkwan soronko so; ZEC mmoa a ɛkorɔn sen biara na edi nkonim. Veto betumi aba: Ɛnam Key-Holders so wɔ mmara mu nsɛm anaa ɔhaw a ɛba wɔn a wɔde di dwuma/mpɔtam hɔ so (ɛho yɛ na, ɛwɔ nteaseɛ). Sɛnea Wɔde Akwammisa Krataa Kɔma Siesie Nsusuwii: Kyerɛkyerɛ adwuma a wɔawie, nkɛntɛnso, adanse (links, deliverables). Kyerɛ sika dodow a wɔabisa (ZEC/USD a ɛne no sɛ) ne nea ɛfata. Fa address a wotua ho ka ne nkitahodi ka ho. Fa kɔ: Fa to Zcash Community Forum (forum.zcashcommunity.com) so wɔ Grants ɔfa no mu. Title: "[Retroactive Grant] - [Adwuma no Din]". Fa markdown format a emu da hɔ di dwuma. Awieeɛ da: Afe abiɛsa biara; wɔde too gua wɔ forum/X (e.g., Q4 2025: Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 12, 2025, 11:59 PM UTC). Nneɛma a wɔde bɛkɔ akyiri: San fa kɔ round a edi hɔ no mu anaa fa wo ho hyɛ ZCG nkyɛn. Hunu no: Bua mpɔtam hɔfo nsɛmmisa wɔ nnafua 30 nhwehwɛmu mu. hyɛ no nsow: FPF na ɛhwɛ so (wɔdi mmara so, nkitahodi); nsusuwii ahorow a wɔaboaboa ano wɔ GitHub so ama wɔahu. Abatow ho nhyehyɛe ne Cadence Afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa Cadence (e.g., Q4 2025, Q1 2026): Da a etwa to a wɔde bɛmena: Mid-quarter (wɔde too gua). Nnafua 30 Nhwehwɛmu: Efi ase wɔ bere a wɔde ama no akyi; discuss/feedback wɔ forum threads mu (wɔtaa yɛ summary thread). Bere a Wɔde To Aba: Di nhwehwɛmu akyi (e.g., 1-2 adapɛn wɔ November mu ma Q4). Nea efi mu ba & Sika a Wɔde Ma: Ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi; grant a wɔapene so a wotua wɔ nsɛm biara mu (KYC ma >$50k). Abatow a wɔtow: Coinholders de ZEC holdings tow aba (no lockup; Orchard pool fata). Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma: Abatow a wɔde ahyɛ aman nsa (e.g., ɛnam abatow mpanyimfo so). Mpeneebɔ: anyɛ yiye koraa no ZEC quorum 420,000 + dodow no ara a ɛnyɛ den yiw. Abatow a wɔde wɔn ho to so; sika a wotumi de di dwuma bio wɔ nsusuwii ahorow nyinaa mu. Nea efi mu ba wɔ baguam, a ɛda adi pefee. hyɛ no nsow: Mprempren Round (ɛfiri Ɔbɛnem 5, 2026): Q4 2025 awie (November abatoɔ); Q1 2026 submissions hwɛ kwan sɛ ɛrenkyɛ - hwɛ forum so ma nsɛm a wɔde bɛto gua. Nsɛm a Wɔayɛ no Foforo: Hwɛ Zcash Community Forum Grants Ɔfã no. Adeyɛ no betumi akɔ so denam mpɔtam hɔfo mmuae so.

title: Sovright
description: Sovright yɛ US 501(c3) adwumakuw a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfaso a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛboa nnipa ahofadi. Sɛ yɛde yɛn adwene si Zcash nhyehyɛe, atuo, protocol…
text: Sovright Sovright yɛ US 501(c3) adwumakuw a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfaso a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛboa nnipa ahofadi. Sɛ yɛde yɛn adwene si Zcash nhyehyɛe, atuo, protocol nkɔso, ne abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom mmoa so a, adwuma no kyekye nnwinnadeɛ ne nnwuma a wɔabɔ wɔn tirim sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ ankorankoro digyital sika nhyehyɛeɛ mu den na wɔaboa Zcash ntam nkitahodiɛ no a ɛbɛtumi agyina ano bere tenten. Kan no na wɔfrɛ Sovright sɛ Bootstrap. Mfitiase din no daa ahyehyɛde ahorow no mfitiase botae a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ Zcash infrastructure company bi afi mfiase no adi. Kɔ wɛbsaet hɔ Din Edin Sovright yɛ sovereign ne right a wɔabom ayɛ. Ɛda no adi sɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow no de wɔn adwene si ankorankoro tumidi, kokoam nsɛm, ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpaw sɛnea wɔhwɛ ankorankoro data, sika, nkitahodi, kɔmputa, ne intanɛt so dwumadi so. Sovrights adwuma no fii ase wɔ Zcash, cryptocurrency a ɛkora kokoam nsɛm so a ɛde zero-knowledge cryptography di dwuma de boa nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ban. Bere kɔɔ so no, ahyehyɛde ahorow no de wɔn adwene trɛwee sen ankorankoro sika de kaa nnwuma ho haw ahorow a ɛtrɛw ho, a nkitahodi a ahobammɔ wom, nkitahodi a ɛyɛ den, ankorankoro kɔmputa, ne AI nkitahodi a ahobammɔ wom ka ho. Mining Pool Sovright yɛ Zcash a wotu fagude ho adwuma wɔ: tuo.sovright.com Wɔayɛ Sovright Mining Pool no sɛ ɛbɛboa wɔn a wotu fagude no tumidi na ɛbɛtew mining pool no dodow so. Mining pool concentration yɛ ade a ɛhaw adwene mpɛn pii wɔ proof-of-work networks mu efisɛ pools kakraa bi betumi awie sɛ wɔadi network hashrate kyɛfa kɛse so. Eyi betumi ama decentralization ayɛ mmerɛw na ama ahotoso a wɔde to pool adwumayɛfo atitiriw nneyɛe so no ayɛ kɛse. Sovright Mining Pool no yɛ nea wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wɔtu fagudeɛ a wɔn nkutoo, adwumayɛfoɔ nketewa, ne afoforɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa Zcash mining ecosystem a wɔde ahyɛ aman nyinaa nsa. Pool no si ntease a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa sikatua ho, akontaabu a wobetumi asusuw ho, ne adwumayɛ ho ka a ɛba fam koraa so dua. Mprempren testnet version no mma payouts na wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛsɔ ahwɛ nkutoo. (Reba seesei ara) Network Resilience a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Network resilience kyerɛ ahotoso ne ahoɔden a ɛwɔ infrastructure a ɛde Zcash nnwuma kɔ no mu. Ankorankoro nkitahodi nnyina cryptography nko so, na mmom egyina sɛnea network nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ wɔn ase no wɔ hɔ ne ahotoso a ɛwɔ so nso so. Sovright kyerɛ sɛ network resilience yɛ adwuma titiriw a wɔde hwɛ Zcash ahobammɔ a mfaso wɔ so ne sɛnea wɔde di dwuma so. Sikasɛm mu Tumidi Sikasɛm mu tumidi kyerɛ tumi a ankorankoro tumi di wɔn ankasa sika so na wonya bi a wɔmfa wɔn ho nto kwan a efi ntamgyinafo hɔ so. Wɔ Zcash nsɛm mu no, eyi ka ankorankoro sikatua, wɔn ankasa hwɛ, ne nhyehyɛe a ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi di nkitaho wɔ wɔn ankasa nsɛm so. Sovright bu sikasɛm mu kwan a wobenya ne sika a wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no di so sɛ nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ ankorankoro tumidi mu.

title: Obscura Labs
description: Obscura Labs is an independent organization registered in Nigeria with a strategic focus on Africa and other emerging markets.
text: Obscura Labs Kɔ wɛbsaet hɔ Adwuma ho nkrataa Obscura Labs is an independent organization registered in Nigeria with a strategic focus on Africa and other emerging markets. N'adwuma ne sɛ ɛbɛsi mfitiaseɛ, nnwinnade, ne akwan a wɔfa so de di dwuma a ɛma Zcash mu kwan yɛ yie, mfasoɔ, amammui, ne bere tenten mu ahoɔden wɔ Afrika nyinaa. The organization aims to support the use of privacy-preserving financial technology by improving access to reliable infrastructure, supporting developers and businesses, educating users, and strengthening local Zcash communities. Atirimpɔw Obscura Labs na Chidi Olisa, a ɔyɛ Zcash Nigeria panyin no de sii hɔ. Before establishing Obscura Labs, Chidi contributed to the Zcash ecosystem through community building, education, advocacy, localized content creation, user support, and initiatives designed to introduce people in Nigeria and other parts of Africa to financial privacy and Zcash. Engagement with users, students, developers, businesses, and community members highlighted several barriers to broader Zcash adoption across Africa. These included limited infrastructure, difficulty accessing ZEC through local currencies, insufficient developer support, a shortage of localized educational resources, and limited integration with everyday payment systems. Wɔhyehyɛɛ Obscura Labs de dii saa nsɛnnennen yi ho dwuma. The organization is based on the view that awareness alone is not sufficient for sustainable adoption. Communities also require reliable infrastructure, accessible products, developer tools, financial access, education, and long-term institutional support. Anisoadehu Obscura Labs anisoadehunu ne sɛ ɛbɛboa ama Afrika abɛyɛ nsase a emu yɛ den paa wɔ Zcash mfitiaseɛ, ne fa a wɔde di dwuma, ne ewiase mu nkɔso ho. Nhyehyɛeɛ no pɛ sɛ ɛyɛ Afrikafoɔ a wɔboa ma wɔdi Zcash mu dwuma a ɛhia sɛ wɔde di dwuma: Ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Zcash mfitiaseɛ a w'atumi de ho ato so. Sɛ wobɛtumi anya ZEC na woahwɛ wo kokoam ho nsɛm so a, yɛ saa. Wɔboa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma, wɔn a wɔyɛ dwumadie, nnwuma, ne mpɔtam ahyehyɛde ahorow. Wɔrehyehyɛ nnwinnade ne dwumadie a mfaso wɔ so. Wɔrehyɛ Zcash mpɔtam a ɛgyina hɔ ama wɔn a wɔn ani da hɔ no nkuran. Wɔreboa ama Zcash mfidie a wɔde di dwuma wɔ aman ahodoɔ so ne nnipa a wɔdi dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa anya nkɔso. Nsase a ɛho hia Mfiase no, Obscura Labs bɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔde n'adwuma no bɛtoto nneɛma atitiriw anan ho. Nhyehyɛe a ɛfa nneɛma nketenkete ho Wohia mfidie a wͻde bεto gua, nhyehyεeε, deε edidi mu, nsesaeɛ, akatua ho dwumadie, ne nea wohia na ama wͻn atumi ayε adwuma wͻ Zcash kͻmputa no mu. Obscura Labs yɛ adwuma na ɛreyɛ Zcash mfitiaseɛ wɔ Afrika mu de reboa network accessibility, geographic diversity, reliability, ne resilience. Adwuma yi botae ne sɛ ɛbɛboa ma nnipa kakra a wɔyɛ mfitiasesɛm adwuma no agye wɔn ho adi, na wɔde dwumadie pa ama wɔn a wɔdi dwuma ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ Afrika mpɔtam hɔ. Ahyeaseԑ akwankyerԑ a' edidisoɔ yi bi ne: Aban Zcash mainnet RPC awiei nkyea. Public Zcash testnet RPC endpoints. Zebra full nodes. lightwalletd dwumadie. DNS aguadifo. Aban amammerɛ akwanhwɛ. Developer-focused APIs. Agyinasoɔ dwumadie ne twerԑtohɔ Akadeɛ foforɔ a ɛboa ma yɛtumi twe sika wɔ Zcash so. Obscura Labs botae ne sɛ ɛbɛboa wɔn a wɔyɛ dwumadie, sika nkotoku, dwumadie, nnwuma, ne dwumadie a ɛne Zcash amansan nhyehyɛe di nsɛ. Awofoyɛ ne Sika Ho Kwan Sɛ Zcash bɛtumi aboa wɔ da biara da tebea mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa tumi nya, sie, de yɛ adwuma, na wɔsesa ZEC a ɛho nhia biara. Obscura Labs boa nhyehyeԑ a' yԑde reboa: Ɛkwan a wobɛtumi afa so anya ZEC ne Afrika sika. Fiat on-ramps ne off-rands. Adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn ba. Agyedeɛ a wɔde di dwuma. title: ZingoLabs
description: ZingoLabs yɛ anisoadehunufoɔ kuo a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛma nnipa suahunu akɔ anim. Yɛgye di sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mfiridwuma so ba adesamma mfaso na yɛnam nkitahodi a…
text: ZingoLabs Ɔmanfo Wɛbsaet - GitHub - X/Twitter - Instagram ZingoLabs yɛ anisoadehunufoɔ kuo a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛma nnipa suahunu akɔ anim. Yɛgye di sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mfiridwuma so ba adesamma mfaso na yɛnam nkitahodi a yɛpene so so na edi yiye. Yɛrekyerɛ nhwɛso ahorow a ɛma eyi tumi yɛ yiye. Zingo Lab Cyan yɛ adwuma sɛ Shielded DAO. Yɛkora yɛn sika so wɔ sikakorabea bi a asɔremma biara wɔ view key. Wɔsɛe sika fi sikakorabea hɔ bere a asɔremma tow aba de gyina nyansahyɛ bi akyi no. Nnwuma a wɔyɛ Zingo! Sikabɔtɔ (GitHub) Zingo Wallet yɛ Zcash sika kotoku a ɛwɔ nneɛma nyinaa a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no adamfofa su, ɛwom sɛ ɛde nneɛma bi a ɛkɔ akyiri ka ho ma wɔn a wɔakɔ anim kɛse de. Ɛboa transparent, Sapling ne Ironwood pools, ɛwɔ address book a wɔde tua sika mpɛn pii na ɛwɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu. Ɛyɛ sika kotoku a edi kan a ɛboaa Orchard na ɛde NU5 format ahorow dii dwuma. Zingo! ne tumi a ɛwɔ sɛ ɛde Memo field no di dwuma de nhumu a ɛsom bo ma wɔ wo nnwuma ho. Zingo! no wɔ hɔ ma mobile mfiri ne PC ahorow. Wubehu nea wɔatwe nyinaa ha Zingolib (GitHub) API ne test-app a ɛda zcash dwumadie adi ma app a wɔde di dwuma. Zingolib de nhomakorabea ma zingo-mobile, ne cli application a ɛka ho a wɔfrɛ no zingo-cli, ahyɛde-kwan hann sika kotoku a ɛne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn indexer te sɛ Zaino. Zaino Indexer (GitHub) Zaino yɛ Rust indexer ma Zcash blockchain, a Zingo kuw no na wɔyɛe. Ɛyɛ indexer a ɛwɔ.. Z3 stack na ɛyɛ: ɛkyerɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn data fi a Zebra validator na ɛsom sika kotoku, explorers, ne clients afoforo. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a edi akyi kɔ lightwalletd. Zaino de nneɛma a ɛho hia ma akraman a wɔn ho yɛ hare nyinaa, te sɛ sika kotoku ne aplikeshɔn a enhia blockchain abakɔsɛm a edi mũ, ne akraman anaa sika kotoku a edi mũ. Ɛsan nso boa block explorers, ma kwan ma wonya blockchain a wɔawie ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ne mempool a eye sen biara a wɔanwie a Zebra full validator di so no nyinaa. zcashd duu ne End-of-Support gyinabea wɔ 18 July 2026 wɔ block 3,417,100 na ɛnboa Ironwood (NU6.3). Zaino kenkan Zebra validator bi. ZLN (zcash-mpɔtam hɔ-net) (GitHub) A set of utilities a ɛde Zcash nhyehyɛe ahorow no fi ase na ɛhwɛ so. Wɔde eyi di dwuma ma nkabom sɔhwɛ wɔ nkɔso a ɛfa: lightclients a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu indexers a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm validators a wɔyɛ saa Ne botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma sɔhwɛ tebea a ɛyɛ mmerɛw kɛse na ɛyɛ den ama core nodes (validators) te sɛ Zebra, indexers te sɛ Zaino, ne light client wallets te sɛ zingo-cli. Default stack a ɛde fi ase ne Zebrad, zainod, ne zcash-devtool. Agyapade no zcashd na lightwalletd processes te akyi a ɛnyɛ mmoa legacy-stack feature na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wobeyi afi hɔ. Wɔ nnwinnadeɛ a wɔde hyɛ aseɛ, de sie, na wɔde bɛhyɛ Zcash nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn data (ma mainnet, testnet, ne regtest) akyi no, wɔde zcash-local-net di dwuma firi Zaino's sɔhwɛ suite mu de hwɛ Lightwallet RPC dwumadie a wɔagye wɔ Zaino (hwɛ Zaino sɔhwɛ docs).

title: ZKAV Club
description: The Zcash Foundation na ɛboa saa adwuma a ɛyɛ aniberesɛm yi a ɛwɔ fam no botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛnam mpɔtam hɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ nneyɛeɛ so bɛnya wiase nyinaa nkɛntɛnsoɔ…
text: ZKAV Club Wɛbsaet no - GitHub a woagye atom - X/Twitter so na woagye atom - YouTube so na woayɛ The Zcash Foundation na ɛboa saa adwuma a ɛyɛ aniberesɛm yi a ɛwɔ fam no botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛnam mpɔtam hɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ nneyɛeɛ so bɛnya wiase nyinaa nkɛntɛnsoɔ. Adebɔfoɔ akuo bi a wɔbɛto nsa afrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnsua na wɔnyɛ adwuma bom mfa nkɔ soro na wɔkyekyɛ nsɛm ne nsɛm a ɛkanyan, kyerɛkyerɛ, na ɛkyɛ Zcash ne sikasɛm mu kokoamsɛm ho bɔhyɛ. Asɛmpatrɛw Asɛm Yɛyɛ wiase nyinaa kuw a yɛyɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ a wɔdwene kokoamsɛm, Zcash, ne mpɔtam a wɔkyekye ho. Yɛbɛbom akyekye beaeɛ a yɛbɛkyɛ nsɛm, ahokokwaa ne nneɛma a yɛde bɛboa ama wɔayɛ ne tintim a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛfa nsɛmti a yɛdwene ho. Yɛpɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔbɛn adeyɛ no paa no bɛka nsɛm, akyɛ wɔn anigyeɛ ne wɔn suahunu a wɔatena ase de kokoam nkyerɛkyerɛ ne Zcash aba wiase fã biara. Zk Av Club no botaeɛ a ɛkyɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔtumi, wɔasiesie wɔn ho na wɔanya sika a wɔde bɛbɔ amanneɛ na wɔakyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa Zcash ne kokoamsɛm ho a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ ne wiase nyinaa de. Nkɔmmɔbɔ & Nkɔmmɔbɔ Zk Av Club no bɛyɛ nhyiamu a wɔyɛ wɔ intanɛt so daa na wɔne mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu ayɛ adwuma de ayɛ nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nsɛmti a wiase nyinaa Zcash ne kokoam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ani gye ho. Ɛnam sɛ yɛde yɛn adwene si intanɛt so ɔdio/aniwa so adwumayɛ so nti yei bɛyɛ berɛ ne beaeɛ a yɛbɛsua pii afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahiadeɛ ne haw a ɛfa mpɔtam hɔ Zcash ne mpɔtam a wɔde wɔn adwene si kokoam nsɛm so wɔ wiase nyinaa no ho na yɛayɛ ho biribi. Nsɛm a esisi Nhyiamu no bɛbue na wɔamfa hwee nto mu, na ɛbɛtumi ayɛ akwan pii te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu, Q+A, AMA, adwumayɛbea, ɔhaw ano aduru, adwene mu nsɛm anaa biribi foforɔ koraa. Nkɔmmɔbɔ biara, ɛmfa ho ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no, bɛkura Zcash adwene a ɛwɔ kokoamsɛm so sɛ asɛmti ne sɛ adeyɛ. Wontumi nsusuw sɛ wɔpene so. Hwan Yɛyɛ wiase nyinaa nne ne osuahu ahorow. Yɛnam mpɔtam hɔfoɔ so bɛma ankorankoro biara tumi na yɛama no ayɛ kɛseɛ ma ɔnam wɔn ankasa adwene so aka Zcash asɛm no, wɔ wɔn ankasa nsɛm mu. Yɛbɛhyɛ nneɛma ne nkitahodi a ɛkanyan na ɛboa wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no ho nkuran sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi de wɔn nne soronko aba wiase nyinaa kokoam nsɛm ho nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu. Yɛyɛ wɛb a nkitahodi ahorow a ɛkasa na ɛbɔ wɔ kasa ahorow mu, a ne nyinaa di, na ɛboa, nsɛm ne nneɛma a Zk Av Kuw no kyɛ no ho mfonini wɔ yɛn adwenem. Yɛbɛma yɛn ho yɛn ho so na yɛabom akyekye ahoɔden a ɛhia na yɛde Zcash ne kokoamsɛm aba wiase. Kɔka yɛn ho! Yɛto nsa frɛ obiara na yɛma no akwaaba sɛ ɔmmɛka Zk Av Club no ho! Obiara a n’ani gye kokoam nsɛm ho a n’ani gye ho sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔdio/aniwa ne intanɛt mfiridwuma foforo mu no betumi akɔ nhyiam ahorow ase na ɔde ne ho ahyɛ mu akodu sɛnea n’ankasa ahotɔ te. title: Mpɔtam Hɔ Broadcasting a wɔde VDO.Ninja ne OBS Studio di dwuma
description: Wɔyɛɛ saa nkyerɛkyerɛ tiawa yi wɔ bere a... DWeb Nsraban 2023 denam mfɛfo ne atuhoamafo kuw bi so. Botaeɛ a ɛwɔ saa dwumadie yi mu ne sɛ wɔde smart phone mfiri…
text: Mpɔtam Hɔ Broadcasting a wɔde VDO.Ninja ne OBS Studio di dwuma Wɔyɛɛ saa nkyerɛkyerɛ tiawa yi wɔ bere a... DWeb Nsraban 2023 denam mfɛfo ne atuhoamafo kuw bi so. Botaeɛ a ɛwɔ saa dwumadie yi mu ne sɛ wɔde smart phone mfiri a ɛka offline MESH network ho bedi dwuma de ayɛ video a wɔbom kyere ne streaming. Yɛde software abien a wɔabue ano na edi dwuma OBS Studio (Abue Broadcaster softwea) . ne VDO.Ninja na ɔkyerɛwee. Wobetumi atwe saa softwea yi na wɔayɛ adwuma wɔ wo kɔmputa so wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. OBS Studio (Bue Boardcaster softwea) . OBS Studio yɛ Free ne Open source software a wɔde kyere nsɛm gu kasɛt so na wɔde live streaming a ɛwɔ hɔ ma operating system ahorow pii. Wɔdii kan yii software no adi wɔ afe 2012 mu na ɛwɔ akyidifoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ game streaming community ne video content creators a wɔde wɔn ho no mu. OBS Studio dwumadiefoɔ ntam nkitahodiɛ no bɛtumi ayɛ sɛ ɛyɛ hu yie nea ɛdi kan wɔ berɛ a wɔde di dwuma no. OBS studio no mu akyekyɛ ayɛ no mfɛnsere abien "Preview" ne "Broadcast". Preview window no kyerɛ video ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ (camera ahodoɔ te sɛ webcam, Iriun Webcam, OBS Virtual Camera, Video ne Browser source) a wɔfrɛ no "Scenes" na "Broadcast" kyerɛ live stream no. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi afiri akyirikyiri kamera nsuo afiri VDO.ninja akɔ OBS Studio mu no, wobɛhyɛ aseɛ denam "Browser Source" foforɔ a wode "Sources > Add > Browser" bɛka ho. Wɔ mfɛnsere foforo no mu no, wubetumi de URL a efi VDO.Ninja no ama na woapaw "Ma fibea no nhu". Afei afei wubetumi afi ase abɔ akyirikyiri nsuten no ho amanneɛ. VDO.Ninja na ɔkyerɛwee VDO.Ninja na ɔkyerɛwee yɛ Free na open source wɛb application a ɛma wotumi dane wo mobile devices ma ɛbɛyɛ live streaming camera. Software no betumi atwe na wode akɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ kɔmputa so anaasɛ wubetumi de adi dwuma tẽẽ intanɛt so nkyerɛase wɔ https://vdo.ninja. VOD.Ninja interface no yɛ mmerɛw, bue VDO.Ninja no wɔ wo mobile devices wɛb brawsa no mu kɛkɛ na paw "Fa wo camera to OBS". Afei wobɛpaw wo camera ne audio device no afi list of devices mu na woakliki "Start". Afei wobɛnya "view" link a ɛbɛtumi de aka OBS Studio ho. Mpɔtam hɔ frɛ a wɔde VDO.Ninja rekyerɛ kwan Fi ase denam kɔ ​​a wobɛkɔ so VDO.ninja na ɛwɔ hɔ ne wo wɛb brawsa a ɛwɔ desktop/laptop so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wobɔ dan foforo na wokyerɛ w’ankasa mpɔtam hɔ frɛ livestream kwan a, klik Create a Room. Screen a edi hɔ no bebisa nsɛm atitiriw a wode besiesie wo dan no. Sɛ wɔyɛ dan bi wie a, ɔkwankyerɛfo no wɔ nneɛma pii a obetumi apaw wɔ screen a edidi so yi so. Sɛ nkurɔfo bɛka wo dan ho a ɛnde wo, ɔkwankyerɛfo no, behu sɛ source options ne controls no nyinaa apue ne wɔn video ne audio. FAQ Video graphic card ahorow bɛn na wɔhwehwɛ ma OBS Studio ? Wubetumi de ankorankoro kɔmputa a ɛwɔ graphic card pa ne memory pii adi dwuma anaasɛ ɔkwan foforo so no wubetumi de hardware encoders adi dwuma Teradek VidiU na ɔkyerɛwee So OBS ma wo kwan ma woyɛ nkyerɛase a ɛte ase ne nsɛm a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm? Plugin ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a mpɔtam hɔfo aboa a ɛte sɛ nea ɛde ade a ɛte saa ma. https://github.com/eddieoz/OBS-live-translation So wubetumi ayɛ w’ankasa plugins ama OBS Studio? Yiw, OBS wɔ mmoa lua, python scripting. Afei nso JavaScript ma Overlays ne webviews. So yɛde live fade to black anaa transitions di dwuma? Ɛno gyina wo, nea ɔyɛ sini no so! So latency bi wɔ hɔ bere a woreyɛ streaming no? Eyi gyina baabi a worekɔ baabi a worekɔ no so kɛse. Sɛ nhwɛso no, YouTube betumi akyɛ simma biako anaa nea ɛboro saa esiane video ho dwumadie a wɔyɛ wɔ wɔn servers so ansa na wɔabɔ amanneɛ nti. Audio so tew bere a wode OBS redi dwuma wɔ slow machine so ne bere a woreyɛ green-screening no Fa Hardware encoder di dwuma anaa fa stream yard di dwuma https://support.streamyard.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056350852-How-to-Use-OBS-Virtual-Camera-with-StreamYard or RiverSide.FM Nneɛma a wɔde ma Ryan na ɔkyerɛwee Ajay na ɔkyerɛwee Arky Akadeɛ https://obsproject.com/help https://docs.vdo.ninja/ Ɔfese Nnɔnhwerew: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne dijitaal nhyiam ahorow kuw https://alex4d.com/notes/item/media-

title: Twerɛ Wɛbsaet bi wɔ IPFS so
description: IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) yɛ peer-to-peer protocol ne network a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de fael sie na wɔkyɛ.
text: Twerɛ Wɛbsaet bi wɔ IPFS so IPFS ho nnianim asɛm IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) yɛ peer-to-peer protocol ne network a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de fael sie na wɔkyɛ. Nea ɛnte sɛ intanɛt so atetesɛm client-server model no, IPFS ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no kwan ma wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho kyɛ fael tẽẽ, sen sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto centralized server so de akora nneɛma so na wɔakyekyɛ. Wɔde content-addressing na ɛyɛ fael ahorow a ɛwɔ IPFS mu no address, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔma fael biara hash soronko anaa CONTENT IDENTIFIER (CID) a egyina ne nsɛm so, na wɔde saa hash yi di dwuma de gye fael no fi ntwamutam no mu. Sɛ obi de fael bi ka IPFS ho a, wɔkyekyɛ fael no mu nketenkete a wɔfrɛ no blocks, na wɔma block biara CID. Afei wɔde saa blocks yi sie wɔ node ahorow so wɔ network no mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobetumi agye fael no afi mmeae pii. Eyi hwɛ hu sɛ redundancy ne fault-tolerance bere a ɛsan nso ma ɛyɛ den ma node biako biara sɛ ɛbɛyɛ beae biako a edi huammɔ anaasɛ ɛhyɛ so. Kenkan: IPFS ho Nnianim Nsɛm Wo Wɛbsaet no a wobɛbɔ Saa nhwɛsoɔ yi nti yɛreyɛ wɛbsaet a ɛnyɛ den. Nhwɛso Site Anamɔn 1: Sɛ wunnim wɛb nhyehyɛe a kyerɛw wo wɛbsaet no mu nsɛm titiriw a Title, Main Body of text ka ho, a links kɔ nkratafa/site & footers afoforo ka ho. Anamɔn 2: Fa HTML nsusuiɛ! Fa nsɛm a woakyerɛw no hyɛ mu sɛnea ɛfata. Optional sɛ wobɛsan nso ayɛ .CSS stylesheet ama wo wɛbsaet no. Anamɔn 3: Fa wo directory no sie. Ɛsɛ sɛ .html nkratafa + mfonini nyinaa wɔ Folda koro mu. Node bi a wɔde besi hɔ Twe na fa IPFS fi Official website. Hyɛ IPFS ase: Sɛ wode Desktop Application no redi dwuma a ɛho renhia sɛ wohyɛ aseɛ. Sɛ wode Terminal anaa ahyɛde krataa di dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: ipfs init Fa Site Folder ka IPFS ho: Paw folda a wo wɛbsaet fael ahorow wom no na kɔ Add Folder option no so. – Sɛ wode Terminal redi dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: ipfs add -r foldername de ka folda no nyinaa ho mpɛn pii wɔ IPFS mu. Pin Site a ɛwɔ IPFS so: Sɛ wɔde wo wɛbsaet fael ahorow no ka IPFS ho wie a, ɛsɛ sɛ wo pin wɔn de hwɛ hu sɛ ɛbɛkɔ so ayɛ nea ɛwɔ ntwamutam no so. – Sɛ wode Terminal redi dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: Sɛ wode Terminal redi dwuma a, Run ahyɛde: ipfs pin add hash hash = CID a ɛwɔ folda a wode kaa ho wɔ anammɔn a atwam no mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, wo nso wotumi de nnwuma te sɛ Pinata anaasɛ Dolpin Ɛmma bere pii nsɛe! – Kɔ wo wɛbsaet no so wɔ IPFS so: Seesei wɔatintim wo wɛbsaet no wɔ IPFS so na wobɛtumi de hash a ɛwɔ folda no mu akɔ so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokɔ wo wɛbsaet no so a, wubetumi akɔ hɔ https://ipfs.io/ipfs/hash hash = CID a ɛwɔ folda no mu. Wɔ yɛn fam no, CID = QmW2UEfap1vrRRvS5H9weed8qmsx4WsvXBk3GPGVVfWx3r3 IPNS Interplanetary Naming System (IPNS) ma wo kwan ma wo update IPFS CIDs a ɛbata wo wɛbsaet no ho na ɛda so ara som static link. Wɔde ama sɛ safe. Wɔ nhyehyeɛ menu a ɛwɔ wo sait folda a ɛwɔ IPFS desktop application so no mu no paw Publish to IPNS. Safoa: “k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyhoa2cl0qlwpfxn5p9ypcu8jbzgnj4n” Wobetumi nso de ahwɛ yɛn wɛbsaet no denam apon bi so: https://ipfs.io/ipns/k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyhoa2cl0qlwpfxn5p9ypcu8jbzgnj4n DNS Nkitahodi Wɔayɛ sait no, seesei yehia ɔkwan a yɛbɛfa so akyerɛ URL bi akɔ emu nsɛm no so. Sɛ wowɔ wɛb address dedaw a wobɛtumi de kyerɛwtohɔ foforo aka ho denam TXT kyerɛwtohɔ dnslink(wo domain) so. Ɛgyina provider so no ebia auto populate. title: Som GitHub Repo ne IPFS
description: Wɔ saa akwankyerɛ yi mu no yɛsua sɛdeɛ yɛbɛbɔ git cloneable URL ama wo GitHub akoraeɛ a wɔde IPFS CID som.
text: Som GitHub Repo ne IPFS Nnianimu Wɔ saa akwankyerɛ yi mu no yɛsua sɛdeɛ yɛbɛbɔ git cloneable URL ama wo GitHub akoraeɛ a wɔde IPFS CID som. Eyi ho wɔ mfaso de hwɛ hu sɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no wɔ hɔ a asasesin a ɛwɔ ɔmantam, censorship resistance ne sɛ nsɛm a ɛsom bo a ɛkɔ so daa a wɔde sie mfa ho! Hyɛ no nsow: Data a wɔde akɔ IPFS so no wɔ hɔ ma network dwumadiefoɔ nyinaa. Ebia wobɛpɛ sɛ wode w’ankasa/nsɛm a ɛho hia sie wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Fa IPFS Kubo no hyɛ mu Di instɔlehyɛn akwankyerɛ a wɔde ama no akyi ha Wɔ saa nhwɛsoɔ yi mu no yɛde Linux di dwuma, OS nkyerɛaseɛ foforɔ wɔ hɔ. Hwɛ sɛ instɔlehyɛn no dii nkonim denam ipfs –version so Clone Adekorabea Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohyɛ aseɛ a, paw Git akoraeɛ a wopɛ sɛ wo host & clone no: Run Ahyɛde: “git clone https://github.com/zechub/zechub” Afei, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛyɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛfa IPFS so ayɛ no clone. cd zechub git update-server-nsɛm a ɛfa ho Yi Gits nneɛma no mu: Wei a wobɛyɛ no bɛma IPFS atumi deduplicate nneɛma sɛ wo update Git repository no akyiri yi a. Fa ka IPFS ho Sɛ woyɛ saa wie a, saa adekorabea no ayɛ krado sɛ wɔbɛsom. Nea aka ara ne sɛ wode bɛka IPFS ho: $ pwd /kode/myrepo na ɛwɔ hɔ $ ipfs de -r ka ho CID a efi mu ba ne: Qmbgqox5g3614gjTb43s5mdSmmk95aGWWA9EHksL2T91A2 Adenim! Seesei wɔde wo repository no akɔ network no so. Clone denam IPFS so Afei ɛsɛ sɛ wotumi gye GitHub akoraeɛ no denam: git clone a wɔde yɛ nneɛma http://ipfs.io/ipfs/yourCID Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi ahwehwɛ & agye denam wo mpɔtam hɔ IPFS node no so. Hyɛ no nsow a etwa to: Repo folda a ɛwɔ IPFS so no nnya nsɛm foforo wɔ github akorae ankasa no nkyɛn. Wɔkamfo kyerɛ sɛ wobɛsan de folda no akɔ so bere ne bere mu.

text: Ɔreboa ZecHub ZecHub boa nkurɔfo ma wosua Zcash. Sɛ worekenkan kratafa yi a, yɛn ani agye ankasa sɛ woresusuw ho sɛ wobɛboa! Ntoboa biara a wode bɛma no, wobesusuw ho zechub.wiki na ɛwɔ hɔ ne ZecHub sohyial media afoforo. Wɔn a wɔde mmoa foforo ma Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wunya ZecHub, kenkan.. KENKAN NKYERƐKYERƐMU. Sɛnea wofi ase ZecHub de GitHub di dwuma de hwɛ mpɔtam hɔfo ntoboa so. Sɛ woyɛ foforo wɔ GitHub, ɛnsɛ sɛ wohaw wo ho! Yɛrebɛkyekyɛ sɛdeɛ wobɛtumi de wo ho ahyɛ mu sɛ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔboa ZecHub. Yɛtua tips wɔ shielded ZEC mu ma ntoboa a wɔagye atom. Wɔnhyɛɛ akatua dodoɔ wɔ ZEC mu — hwɛ Sɛnea wɔde akatua ahorow si hɔ. Wɔ saa akwankyerɛ yi mu no wobɛnya ntoboa adwumayɛ kwan no ho nsusuiɛ afiri asɛm bi a wobɛbue, twetwe abisadeɛ (PR a wobɛbɔ), PR no a wobɛsan ahwɛ mu, na woaka abom. Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu Nea edi kan no, fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu wɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔfo nkitahodi. Style Akwankyerɛfo Ɛsɛ sɛ ntoboa biara a wɔde bɛma ZecHub di akyi ZecHub style akwankyerɛ. Eyi ka wiki, docs ne social media mu nsɛm ho. Akwan a wubetumi afa so aboa ZecHub yɛ adwuma a mpɔtam hɔfoɔ di anim a ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmoa ne nneɛma ama Zcash dwumadiefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ no. Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wobɛfa so de wo ho ahyɛ ZecHub, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobɛkyerɛw ama yɛn dapɛn dapɛn nsɛmma nhoma, wobɛboa yɛn nimdeɛ, anaasɛ wobɛboa wɔ nkɔso adwuma mu. Eyinom ne ntoboa ahorow a ZecHub gye tom mprempren: Sɛnea wɔde akatua ahorow si hɔ Wɔtua tips wɔ shielded ZEC. ZEC nɔma a na ɛtra nsɛmti a ɛwɔ ase ha no mu no yɛ abakɔsɛm mu mfonini ahorow a ɛwɔ ZEC/USD bo dedaw so. Mfa wɔn sɛ mprempren rates. Sɛnea wɔpaw sika dodow bi: Fa adwuma no hyia USD ntamgyinafo wɔ bounty sika a wɔde ma ho nhyehyɛe. Paw botae bi wɔ saa band no mu — ɛnyɛ automatically top. Dane wɔ ɔmanfo ZEC/USD beae na hyɛ ZEC wɔ bounty no so: Kurukuruwa kɔ 4 decimal mmeae. Policy fael no ne nokware fibea biako pɛ. Sɛ krataafa yi ne saa fael no nhyia a, nhyehyɛe no di nkonim. Wɔakyerɛw adwuma a wotua ho ka wɔ ZEC Bounties. Aman abiɛsa a ɛnyɛ pɛ: Merged — wɔgye PR no tom wɔ adekorabea no mu. Wɔapene akatua so — sponsor anaa DAO pene so sɛ akatua bi ka, ne kɛseɛ bɛn. Paid — ZEC du wo Shielded Unified Address. Ntoboa a wɔaka abom no ankasa mpene akatua bi so. Akatua a wɔapene so nyɛ sika a wɔawie. Dev Adwuma Dev adwuma biara a wɔapene so a ɛboa ma wɔkyekye Zcash ecoystem no. Eyi betumi ayɛ yɛn wiki, sika kotoku foforo, anaa application biara a wubetumi asusuw ho. text: ZecWeekly Nsɛmma Nhoma ZecWeekly yɛ nsɛmma nhoma a ɛba Kwasida anɔpa biara. Ɛka nsɛm a esisii wɔ dapɛn no mu wɔ Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom mu nyinaa ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ na wɔhwɛ amanneɛbɔ no so dapɛn biara na wɔde nkitahodiɛ a ɛfa ho nyinaa ka nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ krataa no ho. Yɛsrɛ sɛ monkyerɛw wo din wɔ nsɛmma nhoma no mu ha. Boa Newsletter ntoboa yɛ adwuma yie berɛ a ntoboafoɔ baako siesie nkyerɛaseɛ no ma dapɛn a ɛfata, di mprempren bounty anaa coordination thread no akyi, na ɔde twe adesrɛ no kɔ bere a dapɛn dapɛn links no ayɛ krado akyi. Yɛsrɛ sɛ mma daakye nkyerɛaseɛ biara mmra ansa na ZecHub de ahyɛ da a wɔde bɛba saa nkyerɛaseɛ no so anaasɛ ahyɛ no den. Twe adesrɛ a edi kan no taa hwere dapɛn awiei updates, ɛne curator a wɔde ama no bɔ abira, anaasɛ wɔde bere a wɔde ama a ɛnteɛ di dwuma. Si nea ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren no so dua Ansa na wubefi ase akyerɛw: Hwɛ ZEC Bounties ama mprempren nsɛmma nhoma adwuma no. Twɛn na wɔama wo adwuma. Newsletter editions te XS nnwontofo kuw no mu bounty sika a wɔde ma ho nhyehyɛe. ZEC akontaabu a ɛwɔ live bounty no so no yɛ sika no, ɛnyɛ asɛmti dedaw biara a ɛwɔ akwankyerɛ nhoma ahorow a ɛboa no mu. Fork akorae no Sɛ woyɛ foforo wɔ GitHub, fa adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe yi di dwuma: Bue no ZecHub akoraeɛ. Klik Fork na yɛ fork wɔ wo GitHub akonta ase. Wɔ wo fork mu no, yɛ baa dwumadibea foforo ma edition no. Baa dwumadibea din a emu da hɔ boa, te sɛ digest-may-30-2026. Hwɛ sɛ wo twe abisade no bɛto w’ani so ZecHub/zechub sɛ base akoraeɛ ne main sɛ nnyinaso nkorabata. Sɛ wode ahyɛde kwan no di dwuma a, adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe koro no ara te sɛ eyi: Hyɛ anan mu YOUR-USERNAME ne w’ankasa GitHub dwumadie din. URL a ɛwɔ atifi hɔ no yɛ beaeɛ na ɛrensiesie sɛdeɛ wɔakyerɛw no. Yɛ nsɛmma nhoma fael no Fa no di dwuma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ krataa nsusuwso sɛ wo mfiase. Newsletter nkyerɛase ahorow no yɛ nea ɛwɔ.. newsletter folda no mu. Sɛ woreyɛ fael no a: Fa fael din format a nsɛmma nhoma no bisae anaasɛ nnansa yi nkyerɛase ahorow a wɔagye atom de adi dwuma no hyia. Fa ɔfa nhyehyɛe koro no ara sie sɛnea nsusuwso no te gye sɛ adwuma no bisa sɛ wɔmfa ɔkwan foforo so mma. Fa link ahorow a efi dapɛn a ɛfa ho no nkutoo mu ka ho. Kyerɛw nkyerɛkyerɛmu tiawa a emu da hɔ ma link biara sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a akenkanfo bɛte nea enti a ɛho hia no ase. Kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a ɛnyɛ Borɔfo kasa ase anaa bɔ mua wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu bere a ɛho hia. Hwɛ link biara ansa na woabue pull request no. Boaboa link ahorow ano wɔ bere a ɛfata mu ZecWeekly taa ka Zcash abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom dwumadiɛ ho asɛm ma dapɛn a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren no na wɔtintim no bɛyɛ dapɛn no awieeɛ. Bere a ahobammɔ wom sen biara ne: Fi ase boaboa link ahorow ano bere a wɔde mprempren nsɛmma nhoma anaa adwuma no ahyɛ hɔ awie no. Fa sraadi sie bere a dapɛn no da so ara yɛ nnam no. Fa twe abisadeɛ no kɔma bɛn da a wɔabisa sɛ wode bɛmena no, berɛ a woahwɛ sɛ dapɛn awieeɛ mu nsɛm foforɔ bi wɔ hɔ awie no. Mfa dapɛn a ɛbɛba daakye amanneɛbɔ krataa nkɔma ansa na adwuma a wɔbɛyɛ ama saa da no aba hɔ anaasɛ ansa na ZecHub asi so dua sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wusiesie. Sɛ nsɛmma nhoma bi ka sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wode mena ansa na da pɔtee bi adu a, di saa da no akyi. Sɛ akasakasa bi wɔ krataafa yi ne mprempren asɛm bi ntam a, di mprempren asɛm no akyi. Bue twetwe adesrɛ no Sɛ wo nsɛmma nhoma fael no ayɛ krado a: Fa wo nsakrae no hyɛ wo fork no so. Bue twe adesrɛ bi kɔ mu ZecHub/zechub wɔ no so main fa. Fa asɛmti a ɛne nea wɔatintim no hyia, te sɛ Zcash Ecosystem Digest May 30th. Fa asɛm no bata twe abisade nipadua no mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nhwehwɛmufo betumi de adwuma no abata adwuma no ho. Nhwɛso twe adesrɛ nipadua: Sɛ wobue twe abisade no wie a, hwɛ sɛnea wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu nsɛm. Sɛ ZecHub bisa sɛ wɔnyɛ nsakraeɛ a, yɛ baa dwumadibea koro no ara foforɔ sen sɛ wobɛbue twetwe abisadeɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu ama nkyerɛaseɛ korɔ no ara. Nhwɛso ahorow ankasa Fa saa nsɛmma nhoma twetwe abisade ahorow a wɔaka abom yi di dwuma sɛ nhwɛso a ɛfa nsɛm a wɔagye atom ho: Zcash Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ho Nhyehyɛe Digest Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 11 Zcash Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ho Nhyehyɛe Dig

title: MultiSig Demo
description: Historical. This walkthrough no longer runs.
text: MultiSig Demo Historical. This walkthrough no longer runs. Every step below depends on zcashd, which reached its automatic End-of-Support halt on 18 July 2026. The seven scripts shipped alongside this page drive it through zcash-cli, so none of them can reach a running node today. These scripts cannot be ported mechanically. They are built on the raw-transaction and wallet RPCs (createrawtransaction, signrawtransaction, createmultisig, dumpprivkey) that zcashd deprecated before the halt; Zallet replaces those with new methods that operate on PCZTs rather than raw transaction hex, and is still in beta with many zcashd methods not yet ported. For multi-party custody on Zcash today, see FROST & Threshold Custody, which includes a direct comparison with transparent multisig, and the Ywallet FROST demo. To move an existing node off zcashd, see the migration guide to Zebra and Zallet. This page is kept as a historical record of the transparent multisig workflow. This demo requires zcashd, which halted on 18 July 2026 and no longer runs. Nothing below can be completed against the live chain. Gather public keys from needed individuals https://github.com/iancoleman/bip39 If using zcashd, you can create a UA and use your transparent reciever as well. Then use getPubkey.sh to extract your public key. Create 2x Multisig (2 of 3) t3 addresses run createMultiSig.sh to generate your multisig address and redeem script. What's needed are 3 public keys ./createMultiSig.sh pubk1 pubk2 pubk3 # 1st t3 ./createMultiSig.sh pubk4 pubk5 pubk6 # 2nd t3 for the change address. NOTE: in this example pubk1,pubk4 are the same person, pubk2,pubk5 are the same person and so on ... NOTE2: the ORDER of your pubkeys matters! Pay attention to this!!!! Fund t3 address Use any wallet/facuet to fund address Create MultiSig transaction ./createMultiSigTX.sh txid voutIndex scriptPubKey redeemScript oldAmount tAddy amount changeTaddy where, ./txDetails.sh txid => will help you find the needed information Sign MultiSig TX Open signMultiSigTX.sh and add your private keys in the pk1,pk2, ... variables. I would not recommend typing these into your terminal. If you have access to all your private keys you can use them all at once to save time, but in most real world examples, the signing will be done via folks around the world so each of the required participants will need to sign, then send back the updated raxTX "hex" output which the others will use to sign to complete the signing proceedure. Who ever creates the first tx, will sign with their private key and send out the updated rawTX hex that needs to be signed by the other participants. ./signMultiSigTX.sh rawTX txid voutIndex scriptPubKey redeemScript valueInitialTX To sign this tx, at least 2 out of the three private keys need to sign it. If the public key you gave was exported using a T-address from zcashd, you can get the private key of your T address with: zcash-cli dumpprivkey "t-addr" This command halted with zcashd and returns nothing today; it is recorded here only to show how the demo obtained its keys. For this demo, I have used iancoleman's bip39 to quickly isolate the needed private keys. Broadcast signed TX ./sendMultiSignedTX.sh signedTXfromLastStep Sources https://learnmeabitcoin.com/technical/script/p2sh/ https://bitcoin.stackexchange.com/questions/6100/how-will-multisig-addresses-work https://zcash.github.io/rpc/

text: Workshop Day 3 Data Analytics The science of analyzing raw data using specialized systems, tools, and techniques to identify patterns, trends, and insights It involves: Zcash Encrypted electronic cash. The first cryptocurrency to develop zero-knowledge encryption for private peer-to-peer payments. note: If you want accurate data that you TRUST, it is recommended to run your own full node [zebrad]. You can setup the z3 infrastructure [ zebrad + zainod/lightwalletd + "wallet of choice here" ] if you want a complete and robust solution. You access the data using RPC's(Remote Procedure Calls) For a quick demostration of how this works, watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ok9Wa8FNbMA Workshop Demo This workshop will focus on collecting and transforming data from the wallet level. This level is where most folks will access the Zcash blockchain. Usecase ( Create a .csv file of all transactions for a given account in Zkool) This is a popular scenario where one would need to organize and optimize their digital personal finances. Step 1 Open Zkool and select the account you want to use note: We will be using a testnet wallet for this demo. note2: We are choosing Zkool here, but ANY wallet that has export functionality will work! https://github.com/hhanh00/zkool2 Step 2 Go to the top right menu and select "Export Transactions" Step 3 Download bash script we will use to transform our data. For Developers who are watching, I will be using bash which is standard in most Linux Distros, but you can use your language of choice. For non-devs or students getting your feet wet, use AI! Some example prompts that can get you started: "How can I use "bash/rust/python/ ... etc." to transform CSV files" note: You still need to understand the basics but running these workshops are how you understand the FLOW of the process. note2: AI is not usually private so be extra careful when using it as a student! Step 4 Setup scripts for use and run chmod +x cleanCSV.sh ./cleanCSV.sh "nameofexportBackup" Step 5 Use data Open in libreOffice or any CSV viewer for use!

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: CryptoNote Protocol
description: CryptoNote protocol no ma on-chain kokoamsɛm a emu yɛ den tumi yɛ adwuma. Ɛnnɛ yesua ne nneɛma atitiriw nyinaa ne sɛnea wɔde kokoam nsɛm ho adwuma atitiriw pii…
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: CryptoNote Protocol Series: Zero to Zero Knowledge Nea ɛyɛ anigye nnɛ! CryptoNote protocol no ma on-chain kokoamsɛm a emu yɛ den tumi yɛ adwuma. Ɛnnɛ yesua ne nneɛma atitiriw nyinaa ne sɛnea wɔde kokoam nsɛm ho adwuma atitiriw pii de adi dwuma. --- Akyi asɛm Wɔtintim CryptoNote krataa fitaa a edi kan no wɔ din hunu "Nicolas van Saberhagen" ase. Bytecoin ne cryptocurrency a edi kan a ɛde protocol no dii dwuma. Adwuma a wonim no yiye a wɔde di dwuma nnɛ ne Monero (XMR). Wɔde adi dwuma nso wɔ TurtleCoin, Aeon, ne afoforo pii mu. --- Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛwɔ CryptoNote mu CryptoNote Protocol no de nneɛma atitiriw abiɛsa ma: Untraceability ne Unlinkability a ɛfa nnwuma ho Adwuma ho Adanse a Ɛyɛ Pɛ (ASIC resistant) Dynamic emission a ɛyɛ nnam --- Untraceability - Ring Nsɛnkyerɛnne Untraceability no, wɔde Ring Signatures na ɛyɛ titiriw. Sɛ wode asɛm bi remena a, wo baguam safoa ankasa no frafra decoy safoa pii ("ring") - ne nyinaa kura sika dodow koro. Eyi ma ɛyɛ den yiye sɛ wobehu onii a ɔde sika no kɔe ankasa. Ring size nya anonymity set no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Nkawa akɛse ma obi nya kokoam nsɛm a eye. Nneɛma a wɔde toto Zcash ho: Zcash’s anonymity set yɛ nkitahodi dodow a pɛn a wɔayɛ wɔ shielded pool a wɔde ama mu (ɛsõ sen CryptoNote ring akɛse a wɔtaa yɛ no nyinaa). --- Ring CT (Akontaabu Nkitahodi) . Ring CT nhwɛsoɔ no maa kokoamsɛm nyaa nkɔsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ CryptoNote-based coins mu. Sɛ anka ɛde nea ɔde kɔmaa no nkutoo besie no, Ring CT nso ɛma asɛm no sika a ɛwɔ hɔ no yɛ basaa wɔ nea ɔde kɔmaa ne nea ogye no ntam. Ɛde: Elliptic Curve Nsɛm a Wɔde Kyerɛw Nsɛm Pedersen Bɔhyɛ ahorow Homomorphic Nsɛm a Wɔde Siesie Nsɛm Wɔde adanseɛ di dwuma de kyerɛ sɛ dodoɔ no boro 0 na ɛwɔ ntam a ɛfata mu a wɔnda botaeɛ ankasa adi. Stealth Addresses nso de address a wɔde di dwuma pɛnkoro ka ho ma nea ogye no. --- Adwumayɛ ho Adanse a Ɛma Nnipa Yɛ Pɛ (ePoW) . CryptoNote botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛbɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata a wɔde tu fagudeɛ denam ASIC ahodoɔ a ɛbɛko atia no so. Ɛde CryptoNight algorithm (adwuma a ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛkae) na edi dwuma. Nea ɛnte sɛ Bitcoin’s SHA256 no, wɔayɛ CryptoNight sɛ ɛbɛto nsonsonoe a ɛda CPU, GPU, ne ASIC miners ntam no mu. CryptoNight anammɔn: Fa pseudorandom data hyɛ aseɛ wɔ memory (scratchpad) beaeɛ kɛseɛ bi Yɛ akenkan/kyerɛw adwuma pii wɔ scratchpad no so Hash scratchpad no nyinaa na ama woanya bo a etwa to (Hyɛ no nsow: Efi saa bere no, Monero atwe ne ho afi CryptoNight so akɔ algorithms afoforo so.) --- Nneɛma a Ɛma Nneɛma a Ɛyɛ Nnam Sɛ anka ɛbɛtew nsɛm a esisi so mpofirim (te sɛ Bitcoin) no, CryptoNote de block akatua a ɛso tew yiye di dwuma. Eyi ma emission curve a ɛyɛ mmerɛw kɛse bere kɔ so no. Zcash Nkitahodi: Zcash developers asusuw ho sɛ wɔde emission curve a ɛyɛ mmerɛw bedi dwuma daakye, a ebetumi aba sɛ ɛnam "Zcash Posterity Fund" so. --- Awie CryptoNote ada ne ho adi sɛ ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ den na wɔasɔ ahwɛ wɔ ɔko mu a ɛfa on-chain kokoam nsɛm ho. Ne nneɛma foforo pii anya kokoam sika a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛtrɛw so no so nkɛntɛnso. Nhwehwɛmufo binom gye di sɛ awiei koraa no wobetumi de CryptoNote nneɛma no aka atare a wɔde nimdeɛ a wonni ho ban a wontumi mfa wɔn ho to so no ho. --- Mfitiaseɛ Nhama a ZecHub (@ZecHub) kyerɛwee https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1636473585781948416 --- Wɔboaboaa krataafa yi ano fii mfitiase Zero to Zero Knowledge thread no mu maa ZecHub wiki.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Hash Dwumadi ahorow
description: Yɛma wo akwaaba ba nsɛm foforo a ɛtoatoa so mu: Zero to Zero Knowledge!
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Hash Dwumadi ahorow Series Nnianim Nsɛm Yɛma wo akwaaba ba nsɛm foforo a ɛtoatoa so mu: Zero to Zero Knowledge! Wɔ saa nsɛm a ɛtoatoa so yi mu no yɛbɛsua mfitiaseɛ a ɛfa mfiridwuma ahodoɔ pii a ɛkɔ yɛn kokoam nsɛm a yɛkora so nhyehyɛeɛ mu. --- Ɔfa 1: Hash Dwumadie Ɛnnɛ yɛde Hash Functions - cryptography afã titiriw bi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ blockchains mu na efi ase. Akyiri yi wɔ saa nsɛm a ɛtoatoa so yi mu no yɛbɛka nsɛmti bi a ɛde ne ho to wɔn agyapade so ho asɛm. Dɛn ne Hash Dwumadi? Hash Functions fa input a ne tenten biara na ɛma output a ne tenten yɛ fixed. Nkrasɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde hash = Input Algorithm a wɔde di dwuma = Hash Function Nneɛma a ɛfiri mu ba = Hash Value W’ankasa sɔ hwɛ! Momma yɛmfa saa adwinnade yi nnya nsaano ntease! Hyehyɛ nkyerɛwee biara a wopɛ na ama woanya nea ɛyɛ tenten a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ. Hwɛ sɛnea output no gu ahorow gyina hashing algorithm soronko no so. Sɔ hwɛ: https://cryptii.com/pipes/hash-function --- Nneɛma a ɛwɔ Cryptographic Hash Dwumadi ahorow mu Ɛsɛ sɛ Cryptographic Hash Functions nya saa 3 su yi: Ɔkwan baako - Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nea entumi nyɛ yiye sɛ wobɛdan hash dwumadie bi Collision Resistant - Ɛnsɛ sɛ input ahorow abien yɛ hash kɔ output koro no ara so Deterministic - Wɔ input biara ho no, ɛsɛ sɛ hash function ma nea efi mu ba koro no ara bere nyinaa --- Hash Dwumadi Ahorow a Wɔtaa Yɛ Hash Functions ahorow pii wɔ hɔ. Nhwɛso ahorow bi: Hashing Algorithm a Ɛyɛ Ahobammɔ (SHA-3) Nkrasɛm Digest Algorithm 5 (MD5) BLAKE2b - Wɔde di dwuma wɔ Zcash safoa derivation mu Nnianim asɛm bi a ɛfa BLAKE2 ho: https://www.blake2.net --- Hash Dwumadie a Wɔde Di Dwuma Wɔ Wiase Ankasa Integrity Hashing (Data mudi mudi Nhwehwɛmu) Data mudi mudi nhwehwɛmu yɛ "Integrity Hashing" ho nhwɛso. Wɔde yɛ checksums wɔ data fael ahorow so na ɛma awerɛhyem sɛ ɛteɛ ma obi a ɔde di dwuma. Merkle Nnua (Hash Nnua) hash dua anaa Merkle dua yɛ nkorabata ne nhaban node a wɔde data block bi cryptographic hash ahyɛ so. Merkle nnua yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa cryptographic commitment scheme ho. Wohu dua Ntini no sɛ ahofama ne ahaban ntini a wɔada no adi sɛ ɛyɛ mfitiase ahofama no fã. Wɔhwɛ sɛ data a wɔde asie anaa wɔde kɔ P2P ntam nkitahodi so no yɛ nokware, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ data a wonya fi atipɛnfo hɔ no nsakra. Hyɛ Ahofama Dua a ɛwɔ Zcash mu no nsow Wɔ Zcash Sapling & Orchard shielded pools mu no, wɔde Note Commitment Tree no di dwuma de hwɛ sɛ nnwuma no yɛ nokware tia adwene a wɔahyia bere a wɔde nea ɔde kɔmaa, nea ogye & sika dodow a wɔde di dwuma no sie pɛpɛɛpɛ. Signature Hash (Bitcoin-kwan so blocks) SHA256 yɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa "Signature hash" a wɔde di dwuma de hyɛ inmutability a ɛwɔ block biara mu wɔ Bitcoin chain no mu. Miners de hash a ɛwɔ block a atwam no di dwuma + Hash a ɛfa nnwuma nyinaa a ɛwɔ mprempren block no mu (hashMerkleRoot) + Timestamp + random value / network difficulty ma blocks foforo. Equihash (Zcash a Wɔde Tu Fam) Equihash yɛ hashing algorithm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Zcash. Ɛsan nso de di dwuma wɔ networks te sɛ Komodo & Horizen. Equihash: Asymmetric Adanse-a-Adwuma a Egyina Generalized Birthday Problem so (Biryukov ne Khovratovich): https://eprint.iacr.org/2015/946 --- Akenkan a Ɛkɔ Akyiri Sɛ yɛbɛnya nteaseɛ kɛseɛ wɔ hash dwumadie ahodoɔ ne dwumadie a ɛbata ho no ho a, yei yɛ adeɛ a ɛkyɛn so: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hashfunction --- Asɛm a ZecHub (@ZecHub) Mfitiase X asaawa: https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1621240109663227906 --- Wɔboaboaa krataafa yi ano fii mfitiase Zero to Zero Knowledge thread no mu maa ZecHub wiki.

text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Lelantus Protocol Series: Zero to Zero Knowledge Ɛnnɛ yɛhwɛ Lelantus! Wɔyii no adi wɔ afe 2019 mu, saa protocol yi si Zerocoin so. Wɔde di dwuma wɔ Firo sika (kan no na wɔfrɛ no Zcoin) mu de ma kokoam on-chain nkitahodi tumi yɛ adwuma. Ɛte sɛ Zcash wɔ akwan bi so nanso ɛsono no pefee wɔ afã dodow no ara mu. --- Zcash vs Firo Protocol Fapem ahorow Zcash - Ɛkyekyere Zerocash protocol no so Firo (Zcoin) - Ɛkyekyere Zerocoin protocol no so --- Firo Privacy Protocols no nkɔso Te sɛ Zcash no, Firo de address ahorow a wɔabɔ ho ban di dwuma de tua sika a wɔmmɔ din. Bere nhyehyɛe: Zerocoin - Nnyigyei a abubu Sigma - Asɔre nhyehyɛe a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ Lelantus 1.0 - Enni ahobammɔ ho adanse a ɛteɛ --- Anohyeto ahorow a ɛwɔ Sigma Protocol no mu Na Σ (Sigma) protocol a wɔde dii dwuma wɔ Zcoin/Firo nkyerɛase ahorow a atwam no mu no wɔ anohyeto kɛse: na wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no betumi ayɛ mint fixed denominations nkutoo. Eyi maa anonymity sets nketewa bae na ebuee ɔpon maa bere ntua wɔ mint ne redeem adwumayɛ ntam (ne "tainted change" haw no). --- Sɛnea Lelantus Ma Kokoam Nsɛm Tu mpɔn Lelantus di fixed denomination asɛm no ho dwuma denam mints a wɔma ho kwan fi set kɛse biako mu no so. Mfaso atitiriw a ɛwɔ so: Yi fixed denomination anonymity nhyehyɛe ahorow fi hɔ Ɛtew bere ntua a ɛda ɔhyew/gye ntam no so Yi nsakrae ho haw a ɛho agu fĩ no fi hɔ Anohyeto: Set size mprempren wɔahyɛ no 65,000 sika. --- Sika a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma sika bɔhyɛ yɛ bɔhyɛ a wɔde anifurae abien ahyɛ mu a ɛkyerɛw sika no serial nɔma ne sika no bo. Eyinom yɛ adwuma te sɛ Notes wɔ Zcash mu. Wɔtintim sika no bɔhyɛ no na wɔkora so wɔ ledger no so bere a wɔabɔ sika no (ɛnam Mint anaa Spend nkitahodi so). --- Basecoin a wɔde yɛ adwuma Zerocoin Nhwɛsode Lelantus de basecoin a wɔagye din no di dwuma zerocoin nhwɛsoɔ. Adeɛ a ɛho hia: Afei de agyede fã bi ayɛ yie berɛ a wɔde nea aka ne sika dodoɔ no sie. Te sɛ Zcash no, ɛsɛ sɛ nea ɔde di dwuma no paw nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee. --- Adanse Pii Mu Baako Lelantus de One-of-Many Proofs di dwuma de yi input values ​​a ɛho hia ma adanse a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛkari pɛ a ɛnna input no mfiase adi - na enhia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe a wotumi de ho to so. Wɔde saa adanseɛ yi nso di dwuma wɔ Triptych (wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ yɛn CryptoNote thread no mu). --- Network Layer Nsɛm a Wɔde Sie: Dandelion++ Firo nodes de Network Magic koro no ara di dwuma sɛ Zcash Magicbean. Te sɛ Monero no, Firo de Dandelion++ dii dwuma de kokoamsɛm kaa ho denam IP address a ɔde bɛkata asɛm no ho amanneɛbɔfo no so. Dandelion ++ fa ahorow: Stem phase - Wɔde nkitahodi no kɔ random node biako so sen sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ atipɛnfo nyinaa so Fluff phase - Randomly initiated, afei ɛdan kɔ normal gossip mode so Eyi ma ɛyɛ den kɛse sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ baabi a asɛm bi fi bae denam nkitahodi nhyehyɛe mu nhwehwɛmu so. --- Daakye: Lelantus-Spark Lelantus-Spark (wɔayɛ nhyehyɛɛ ama akyiri yi 2023) de akwan mmienu a wɔfa so hu opt-in a wɔde ZIP-32 style derivation ne address ahodoɔ di dwuma ba. Ɛbɛsan nso de mmoa aka ho ama: Multisig Ahintasɛm Agyapade a Ɔdefo Akyerɛkyerɛ Mu Saa nneɛma yi ne Zcash Shielded Assets di nsɛ. --- Mfitiaseɛ Nhama a ZecHub (@ZecHub) kyerɛwee https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1641902859800150017 --- Wɔboaboaa krataafa yi ano fii mfitiase Zero to Zero Knowledge thread no mu maa ZecHub wiki.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Mnemonic Aba Nsɛmfua
description: Mnemonic aba nsɛmfua gyina cryptocurrency afã horow a ɛho hia sen biara no mu biako ase - self-custody.
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Mnemonic Aba Nsɛmfua Series: Zero to Zero Knowledge Mnemonic aba nsɛmfua gyina cryptocurrency afã horow a ɛho hia sen biara no mu biako ase - self-custody. Ɛnnɛ yɛsua sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ aba kasasin na wɔde di dwuma wɔ sika kotokuo mu. --- Dɛn ne Mnemonic Aba Nsɛmfua? Wɔde BIP-39 nkyerɛkyerɛmu, kasasin a wɔtaa de di dwuma nnɛ no na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ kasasin a wɔde san nya mu. Nsɛmfua a wɔde san yɛ adwuma no bɔ fi ase denam randomness a ɛde ba no so. Entropy pii kyerɛ ahobammɔ a ɛkorɔn. Wobu entropy 128 bits sɛ ɛdɔɔso ma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma dodow no ara. Ɛgyina entropy a edi kan no tenten so no, kasasin a wɔde san ba no bɛyɛ nsɛmfua 12 kosi 24. --- Anamɔn biara: Sɛnea Wɔyɛ Aba Kasasin a Ɛwɔ Nsɛmfua 12 Yɛ Entropy Yɛhyɛ aseɛ denam entropy 128 bits a yɛyɛ so. Fa Checksum ka ho Yɛde SHA256 na ɛyɛ hash entropy no. Hash yi mu bits kakraa bi a edi kan no bɛyɛ checksum. Eyi ma yenya nsateaa soronko bi ma yɛn entropy. Kyekyɛ mu yɛ no 11-bit chunks Wɔakyekyɛ bits 132 (entropy 128 + checksum 4) no nyinaa mu ayɛ no asinasin a ɛyɛ bits 11. Map a ɛkɔ Wordlist so Wɔdannan 11-bit nnidiso nnidiso biara ma ɛyɛ decimal nɔma (0-2047). BIP-39 nsɛmfua a wɔahyehyɛ no kura nsɛmfua 2048 pɛpɛɛpɛ (Borɔfo, Spania, China, ne nea ɛkeka ho). Wɔde saa nɔma ahorow yi hwehwɛ asɛmfua a ɛne no hyia wɔ nsɛmfua a wɔahyehyɛ no mu. Nea efi mu ba: Seesei yɛwɔ kasasin a ahobammɔ wom, a nnipa betumi akenkan a ɛwɔ nsɛmfua 12 a wɔde san nya ahoɔden! --- Efi Recovery Phrase -> Aba -> Katua Address ahorow Sɛ wode kasasin a wɔde san nya no di dwuma a, sika kotoku betumi ayɛ nsafe a wɔde bɛyɛ address a wɔde tua sika ne sika kotoku akontaabu ahorow. Keys a wɔayɛ no yɛ deterministic - input koro no ara ma output koro no ara ba bere nyinaa. Aba Awo Ntoatoaso Wɔnya sika kotokuo aba no firi nkaeɛ kasasin a wɔde Key Derivation Function (KDF) di dwuma: Wɔ Bitcoin mu no: PBKDF2 Wɔ Zcash mu no: Blake2b-256/512 Wei ma wonya 64-byte (512-bit) aba. Master Keys Wɔakyekyɛ aba no mu abien a ɛyɛ baiti 32 nnidiso nnidiso: Master Sikakorabea Safoa Owura Nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn Mmara Wɔde eyinom di dwuma wɔ Hierarchical Deterministic (HD) Walets mu ma mmofra safoa a wonya fi mu. --- Zcash Nneɛma pɔtee (ZIP-32) . Wɔ Zcash mu no, wobetumi de tumi a wɔhwɛ anaa tumi a wɔde di dwuma ahyɛ obi nsa wɔ ahofadi mu ama nnua nketewa a wɔrensɛe aba wura no. ZIP-32 kyerɛkyerɛ hierarchical deterministic key generation gyinapɛn a wɔayɛ ama Zcash kokoam nsɛm no mu. Efi Expanded Spending Key mu na yenya: Full Viewing Key Incoming Viewing Key Address ahorow a wɔde tua ka a wɔahyehyɛ Derivation akwan horow ma abɔnten address ahorow a ɛfata sɛ wɔde ma wɔn a wɔde nneɛma mena wɔ shielded pools (Sapling & Orchard) so. Zcash nso boa address a ɛwɔ mu ma sika kotokuo dwumadie te sɛ Auto-Shielding. --- Akadeɛ ZIP-32: Sikakorabea a Wɔabɔ no Yiye a Wɔde Di Dwuma a Wɔabɔ no Yiye Zcash Protocol Nkyerɛkyerɛmu (NU5) . Shielded-by-default sika kotoku ho nsɛm --- Mfitiaseɛ Nhama a ZecHub (@ZecHub) kyerɛwee https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1624125037945946145 --- Wɔboaboaa krataafa yi ano fii mfitiase Zero to Zero Knowledge thread no mu maa ZecHub wiki.
